We introduce StopLoss, a small external monitor that learns failure recognition from completed trajectories and their verifier outcomes. The name is inspired by the stop-loss order in finance: StopLoss ends a run early when the run is likely to fail, which saves resources. Final outcomes label earlier local windows, so a fine-tuned language model can score

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决 coding agent 执行中的成本浪费问题：很多轨迹最终无法通过 verifier，但 agent 仍会继续编辑、测试和调用工具；作者训练一个小型外部 monitor，在失败概率足够高时提前停止。
summary.importance: 它更偏 agent inference 和后训练系统，不是基座预训练论文。对预训练研究的启发在训练信号设计：最终 verifier outcome 可以反向标注中间 trajectory window，用低成本模型学习失败识别，而不需要访问 executor 内部状态。这个思路适合迁移到数据生成、RL 采样、agentic SFT 清洗等流程中，用 cheap monitor 过滤明显低质量轨迹。论文的另一个有用点是评价方式：早停策略不能只看 AUC，还要同时计算 monitor 开销、节省的执行成本，以及误杀成功轨迹带来的损失。
summary.technical_approach: StopLoss 使用完成后的 coding-agent trajectory 进行离线监督。每条轨迹包含若干 tool steps，每步有 action 和 observation，最终有 verifier outcome。运行到检查点时，monitor 只读取 step count 和最近三个 action-observation pairs，输入长度限制为 1,600 tokens。标签来自最终结果：失败轨迹的所有窗口标为 Abort；成功轨迹最后两个 tool steps 标为 Deliver；成功轨迹更早窗口标为 Continue。作者用 LoRA 微调 7B–8B causal LM，只在目标答案 token 上计算 loss。推理时不生成解释，只读取 Continue、Deliver、Abort 三个候选首 token 的 logits，并把 Abort 概率作为 failure score。阈值用成功轨迹校准，目标是控制误杀成功 run 的比例。检查点设为 tool step 5、8、11 等，executor 完全不改，因此也可监控闭源执行器。
summary.experiments: 训练数据来自 GPT-family SWE-rebench trajectories，评测在 SWE-bench Verified 和一个三仓库 SWE-bench Pro 子集上，executor 包括 GPT-5.6 Luna 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6。对比对象是六个通用 judge，每个 executor family 三个，所有方法读取相同窗口，并在 replay 中计入检查开销和误杀成功的代价。结果显示 outcome supervision 把 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在 Verified/Luna 上的 mean single-model tier AUC 从 0.491 提到 0.606，并且在第一个计划检查点 tool step 5 就已有区分信号。单次检查成本估计为 0.00024 美元，比测试的 judge 低一到两个数量级。calibration-disjoint Verified/Luna 上，策略保留 99.0% 原本成功的 run，同时把每个 retained solve 的成本降低 4.5%；GPT judge 策略反而提高成本。更昂贵的 Pro 子集上节省达到 31%。四个 executor–benchmark 设置中，StopLoss 的每个 retained solve 成本都低于 judge policy。一个有意思的负例是 Verified/Sonnet 上 Claude Opus 5 的 AUC 最高，但因为监控成本过高，每个 solve 成本增加约三分之一。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15 分钟。先看 Introduction 里的 break-even 逻辑：早停只有在节省的执行成本超过监控开销和误杀成功损失时才有意义。方法部分重点看标签构造，尤其是为什么失败轨迹的早期窗口也被标为 Abort；这里会引入噪声，但换来简单可扩展的监督。实验部分优先看 Section 4.2 的早期识别曲线、Section 4.3 的成本估计，以及 Section 5.3 的 break-even 分析。若要复现，Appendix A 的窗口编码、截断规则和 LoRA 训练细节需要细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets wasted compute in coding agents: many runs will eventually fail verification, yet the agent keeps editing files, running tests, and calling tools. StopLoss trains a small external monitor to predict likely failure and abort early.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent-inference and post-training systems paper rather than a foundation pretraining contribution. Its relevance to pretraining research is in supervision design and cost-aware filtering. Final verifier outcomes are used to label earlier local trajectory windows, allowing a cheap model to learn failure recognition without executor internals. The same pattern could be useful for RL rollouts, synthetic data generation, and agentic SFT pipelines, where low-cost monitors can remove unpromising trajectories. The evaluation framing is also important: a monitor with better ranking can still be uneconomical if its calls cost more than the execution it saves.
summary_en.technical_approach: StopLoss trains on completed trajectories consisting of action-observation tool steps and a final verifier outcome. At runtime checkpoints, the monitor reads only the step count and the latest three action-observation pairs, with a 1,600-token limit. Labels are derived from the final outcome: every window from a failed run is labeled Abort; the final two tool-step windows of a successful run are labeled Deliver; earlier successful windows are labeled Continue. A 7B–8B causal language model is adapted with LoRA, using a causal LM objective with loss on the target answer tokens only. At inference time, it performs one forward pass and reads the first-token logits for Continue, Deliver, and Abort; the Abort score drives the stopping decision. Thresholds are calibrated on successful trajectories to control the rate of killed successes. The executor is unchanged, so the method can monitor closed agents through text traces.
summary_en.experiments: The monitor is trained on GPT-family SWE-rebench trajectories and evaluated on SWE-bench Verified plus a three-repository SWE-bench Pro subset, using GPT-5.6 Luna and Claude Sonnet 4.6 executors. It is compared against six general-purpose judges that read the same windows, with replay accounting for monitoring cost and lost successes. On Verified/Luna, outcome supervision improves Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct’s mean single-model tier AUC from 0.491 to 0.606. The trained ensemble already separates outcomes at the first scheduled check, tool step 5. Each check costs about $0.00024, one to two orders of magnitude below the tested judges. On calibration-disjoint Verified/Luna runs, the policy retains 99.0% of otherwise successful runs and reduces cost per retained solve by 4.5%; GPT-based judge policies increase cost. Savings reach 31% on the more expensive Pro subset. Across all four executor-benchmark settings, StopLoss has lower estimated cost per retained solve than every judge policy. The paper also shows a useful counterexample: Claude Opus 5 has the highest AUC on Verified/Sonnet but raises cost per solve by roughly one third because monitoring is too expensive.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 15 minutes. Start with the break-even argument in the introduction, because it explains why AUC alone is not a sufficient metric for early stopping. Then read the method section for the outcome-derived labels and the logit-based Abort score. Pay attention to the noisy-label tradeoff: early windows from failed runs may not look locally doomed, but the labeling scheme scales cleanly. In the experiments, focus on the early-check curves, per-check cost estimates, and replay-based cost per retained solve. For reproduction, Appendix A on window formatting, truncation, and LoRA training details is the key part.

recommendation.zh: 读监督构造和阈值校准；这是 agent rollout 省算力的干净做法，比让大模型当裁判更可复现。
recommendation.en: Read the supervision and calibration setup; it is a clean way to save agent rollout compute and is more reproducible than frontier-model judging.

paper.title: Teaching Code Agents to Ask Without Leaking Private Code
paper.abstract: Local coding agents can extend their reach by consulting a stronger cloud model. Such consultations, however, often expose the repository's private identifiers, file paths, and source code. Host-side masking hides recognized identifiers but leaves the surrounding code and the agent's phrasing unchanged, while training for less disclosure risks suppressing consultation or producing questions too vague to answer. We propose utility-verified abstraction (UVA), which teaches the agent to describe pr

summary.core_problem: 本地代码 Agent 在向云端大模型（Expert）求助时，容易泄露代码库中的私有标识符、文件路径和源代码，而现有的基于 Prompt 隐藏或主机端字符串替换的方法，要么导致求助意愿降低，要么破坏了 Expert 提供有效修复建议所需的上下文。
summary.importance: 提出了一种在保证 Agent 修复能力的前提下，有效降低隐私泄露风险的训练范式。这为端云协同（Local-Cloud Collaboration）的 Agent 架构提供了一种实用的隐私保护方案，对构建企业级安全 Agent 具有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Utility-Verified Abstraction (UVA) 训练框架。核心思路是：利用离线 Teacher 模型，将成功修复轨迹中的求助问题重写为抽象形式（用角色和类型替代私有实体，但保留技术约束）。然后进行两步验证：1) 检查重写后的问题是否包含更少的私有实体；2) 将重写后的问题发给 Expert，并用其回答继续本地 Student 的修复流程，检查是否依然能通过测试。只有同时满足隐私减少和修复成功的重写样本，才会被用于通过 LoRA 对本地 Student 模型进行 SFT。
summary.experiments: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench 上，以 Qwen3.5-9B 为 Student，DeepSeek-V3.2 为 Expert。UVA 将 pass@1 从 24.6% 提升至 37.6%，同时每次求助的平均私有实体泄露量从 4.42 降至 1.20，5-gram 源码泄露从 8.4 降至 5.9。值得注意的是，求助率并未下降（从 4.8% 升至 7.4%），且消融实验表明，如果不进行修复重放验证（repair replay），pass@1 会大幅下降至 22.4%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 UVA 的两步验证机制（特别是 repair replay 的设计），以及实验部分对“隐私保护”与“任务成功率”之间 trade-off 的分析。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Local coding agents risk leaking private identifiers, file paths, and source code when consulting cloud-based expert models. Existing redaction or string-replacement methods either suppress the agent's willingness to consult or destroy the context necessary for the expert to provide useful repair advice.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a training paradigm that effectively mitigates privacy risks without compromising the agent's repair capabilities. This provides a practical privacy-preserving solution for Local-Cloud collaborative agent architectures, which is valuable for building enterprise-grade secure agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Utility-Verified Abstraction (UVA). An offline Teacher rewrites consultation questions from successful repair trajectories into an abstract form (replacing private entities with their roles and types while preserving technical constraints). The rewrite undergoes two checks: 1) it must contain fewer private entities; 2) the expert's answer to the rewritten question must still lead to a successful repair when replayed by the local Student. Only rewrites satisfying both privacy and utility criteria are used to fine-tune the Student via LoRA.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench using Qwen3.5-9B (Student) and DeepSeek-V3.2 (Expert). UVA improves pass@1 from 24.6% to 37.6%, while reducing mean private entity disclosure per consultation from 4.42 to 1.20, and 5-gram source code disclosure from 8.4 to 5.9. The consultation rate actually increases (4.8% to 7.4%). Ablations show that removing the repair replay verification drops pass@1 to 22.4%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the two-step verification mechanism in UVA (especially the repair replay), and the analysis of the trade-off between privacy and task success rate in the experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 UVA 的过滤准则和失败例；它把“少泄露”做成可训练信号，比普通 masking 更接近真实 coding agent 部署。
recommendation.en: Read the UVA filtering rule and failure cases; it turns lower disclosure into a trainable signal, which is more deployment-realistic than simple masking.

paper.title: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay
paper.abstract: Motivated by recursive self-improvement (RSI), we study how LLM agents can learn through external memory without updating model parameters. Extracting useful experience from a single attempt is difficult: flawed reasoning can produce success, while poor execution can obscure a sound strategy. Preserving its value over time is also difficult: our accumulation baseline without consolidation initially improves but eventually performs below a no-memory baseline. Our key idea is to compare attempts a

summary.core_problem: 不更新模型参数的前提下，让LLM coding agent通过外部记忆实现“自我进化”，并避免记忆越积越差（memory drift/污染）。
summary.importance: 属于agent记忆与自举策略，对预训练本身不直接；但“比较式经验提炼 + 适用条件”对构造高质量训练轨迹/避免错误累积有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: Hippo：对同一任务的多次尝试做对比，抽取可复用决策并诊断短板；与已有记忆对齐后合并重叠、解决冲突，并显式学习“何时适用”的条件；通过类似海马体选择性编码与replay做巩固，而非把每条lesson独立堆叠。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-bench Verified等coding agent任务上实验；摘要未给出具体模型、记忆容量、对比基线与提升幅度细节，但声称简单累积记忆会从早期提升走向劣于无记忆基线。
summary.authors_note: UC Irvine / Rice University（合作）

summary_en.core_problem: Enable training-free self-evolution of LLM coding agents via external memory, while preventing memory accumulation from degrading performance over time.
summary_en.importance: Agent memory/self-improvement rather than pretraining; still offers an indirect lesson on extracting reusable decisions and controlling error accumulation, which can inform trajectory curation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hippo compares multiple attempts on the same task to distill reusable decisions and diagnose shortcomings, then consolidates memory by merging overlaps, resolving conflicts, and learning explicit applicability conditions—akin to selective hippocampal encoding and replay.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on SWE-bench Verified and related coding-agent settings. The abstract omits model details, memory budgets, baselines, and exact gains, but claims naive accumulation can eventually underperform a no-memory baseline.
summary_en.authors_note: UC Irvine / Rice University collaboration

recommendation.zh: 把它当“记忆会污染、需要 consolidation”的工程教训：只看它如何用同题多次尝试做对比提炼与适用条件；别把结果当通用RSI证据。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an engineering lesson: memory can poison unless you consolidate; focus on the compare-attempts + applicability-conditions idea, not as evidence for general RSI.

paper.title: Secure Agentic Coding through Counterexample-Grounded Feedback
paper.abstract: As coding models and agent harnesses become more capable, reliable security verification is becoming a central bottleneck. Improving secure code generation requires a signal whose reported progress remains aligned with actual program behavior under optimization; otherwise, an optimizer can improve the signal's verdict without removing the underlying vulnerability. Existing model-based approaches require models to either infer program behavior from source code or specify correct outcomes for adve

summary.core_problem: 解决安全代码生成中的验证信号不可靠问题：模型或优化器可能让安全评估器给出更好判定，但真实程序漏洞并未被修复。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码智能中的验证与反馈机制改进。它关注的不是单次代码生成能力，而是安全信号在 test-time repair 过程中是否和真实执行行为保持一致，对后训练 reward/verifier 设计有旁路参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FALCON，一个 counterexample-grounded verification 框架。核心做法是把攻击探索和行为验证拆开：先寻找可能触发漏洞的反例，再通过被测程序的执行轨迹连接到行为验证，避免让模型仅从源码中推断安全性或直接生成对抗测试的正确输出。
summary.experiments: 在 secure code generation benchmarks 上做 test-time repair，对比多种安全信号。摘要称 FALCON 在 held-out functional-security gains 上明显更强，同时保持或提升功能正确性；未给出模型规模、具体 benchmark 名称和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Pierre-Luc Bacon 是强化学习方向研究者，代表性工作包括层级强化学习和 option-critic 相关研究；论文机构信息未在给定材料中提供。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unreliable security feedback for code generation, where an optimizer can improve a verifier's verdict without actually removing the vulnerability.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a verification and feedback mechanism for secure coding agents. Its relevance is less about code generation itself and more about designing behavioral signals that remain aligned under optimization, which is adjacent to reward and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces FALCON, a counterexample-grounded verification framework. The key idea is to separate attack exploration from behavioral verification and connect them through execution traces of the program under test, reducing the burden on models to infer behavior from source alone or specify expected outcomes for adversarial tests.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated in test-time repair on secure code generation benchmarks. The abstract reports stronger held-out functional-security gains than alternative security signals while preserving or improving functionality, but does not provide model sizes, exact benchmark names, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Pierre-Luc Bacon is known for reinforcement learning work, including hierarchical RL and option-critic methods; affiliations are not available in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 可作 verifier/reward hacking 案例看；重点读执行轨迹如何约束反馈，别把它当通用代码模型进展。
recommendation.en: Useful as a verifier/reward-hacking case study; read the trace-grounded feedback design, not as evidence of broader code-model progress.

paper.title: MetaCurate: Evolving Curation Filters for High-Quality Agentic Coding Data
paper.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning on agent trajectories is an effective way to improve coding agents, but selecting useful training examples requires more than identifying successful runs. A resolved patch may follow inefficient reasoning or unnecessary tool use, while a failed run may still contain useful intermediate steps. Training pipelines therefore rely on rules and qualitative assessments to filter trajectories, yet designing these filters typically requires substantial human expertise, and validati

summary.core_problem: 用于训练 coding agent 的轨迹数据很难筛：成功轨迹可能低效/滥用工具，失败轨迹也可能含有高价值中间步骤；手工设计过滤规则成本高且验证昂贵。
summary.importance: 把“轨迹筛选/数据质量”做成可搜索的对象：用 LLM 偏好判断来进化过滤器，属于 agent 数据管线层面的自动化，能间接影响后训练效果与成本。
summary.technical_approach: MetaCurate：训练-free 地进化可执行的轨迹筛选过滤器（规则、rubric、聚合策略）；用 pairwise LLM judge 给轨迹排序偏好，过滤器排序与 judge 偏好不一致处作为反馈信号，驱动对规则与聚合的联合修订；搜索阶段需要 pairwise 比较，得到的过滤器可独立打分轨迹用于大规模筛选。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 agent/模型/数据规模；应包含：用 MetaCurate 产生的过滤器筛选轨迹后做 SFT（或类似）训练 coding agent，并与“只筛成功/手工规则/随机”对比；需要看正文确认成本（judge 调用次数）与收益（pass@k、SWE 类指标等）。

summary_en.core_problem: Curation of agentic coding trajectories is hard: successful runs can be inefficient or misuse tools, while failed runs may still contain valuable intermediate steps; hand-crafted filters are costly and slow to validate.
summary_en.importance: Turns trajectory filtering/data quality into a searchable object using LLM preference judgments, automating a key piece of the agent post-training data pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: MetaCurate evolves executable curation filters (rules, rubric, aggregation) in a training-free manner; it uses pairwise LLM judgments as preferences, and disagreements between the filter ranking and judge preferences provide targeted feedback to revise rules and aggregation; pairwise comparisons are only needed during search, after which the learned filter can score trajectories at scale.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract lacks concrete scales; likely evaluates SFT (or similar) of coding agents on trajectories curated by MetaCurate vs baselines (success-only, manual heuristics), reporting coding metrics and curation cost (judge calls).

recommendation.zh: 属于“数据管线自动化”而非新训练法；只需看过滤器表示+搜索信号设计，关键是 judge 偏好是否稳定、以及筛选收益是否超过调用成本。
recommendation.en: More data-pipeline automation than a new learning algorithm; skim the filter representation and search signal, and be skeptical about judge stability and whether gains justify the labeling cost.

paper.title: WebCoder: Scaling General Frontend Development with Artifact-Grounded Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Real-world frontend development requires agents to compose reproduction, generation, modification, and repair over an evolving application state. Learning a general policy for this process requires translating heterogeneous execution feedback into task-aligned rewards and effective credit assignment across long sequences of interdependent actions. We introduce WebCoder, a general frontend development agent trained with artifact-grounded agentic reinforcement learning. Our key idea is to assess d

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单次代码生成，而是更接近真实前端开发流程的长程 agent 学习问题：一个 agent 需要在持续演化的项目状态上交替完成复现、生成、修改、修复，并且每一步都可能影响后续所有步骤。难点不在于某个局部技能，而在于如何把异构反馈——编译是否通过、页面是否能运行、视觉是否接近、交互是否正确、旧功能是否被破坏——统一成可训练的奖励，并把 credit assignment 分配到长轨迹中的不同阶段。作者把这个问题表述得比较清楚：如果没有共享的 artifact 作为评价基准，前端 agent 很难学到跨任务、跨阶段的通用策略。
summary.importance: 它和基座预训练的直接关系不强，更偏 agent post-training 与环境构建。但有两点仍然值得关注。第一，它展示了一种较成熟的 artifact-grounded RL 训练范式：不是只看最终文本答案，而是围绕可执行产物建立终局奖励和中间进度信号，这对代码 agent、工具使用 agent、甚至多模态操作型 agent 都有参考价值。第二，它处理了长上下文训练中的一个实际问题：项目状态持续增长，交互历史会超出上下文窗口，因此需要环境状态持久化和 context compaction。这些设计对研究“如何让模型在外部状态上长期工作”有启发。若从严格的 LLM 基座研究筛选标准看，这篇更适合 skim，而不是 must-read。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 artifact-grounded agentic reinforcement learning。作者先构建 Webdev-World，一个可执行环境，统一提供代码编辑、应用执行、浏览器检查和按需技能调用，并保持项目状态跨轮次持久存在。训练信号建立在 requirement checklist 上：把任务需求拆成带权重的检查项，再由独立 verifier 对最终应用进行 build、run、inspect。终局奖励不是简单的 pass/fail，而是由确定性检查和视觉评估共同组成，并且受“应用能否成功执行和渲染”门控。为了让 RL 不只依赖稀疏终局奖励，作者又估计中间阶段的 requirement satisfaction，用阶段间分数变化构造 progress / regression 信号，给长轨迹做 credit assignment。另一个关键设计是支持跨 context window 训练。它结合 context compaction 和 message-tree sample construction：当对话历史过长时，对上下文做压缩，但项目真实状态仍保存在环境里；message tree 记录多次上下文重写后的历史依赖关系，使同一条长轨迹的不同阶段都能被用于训练，同时避免同一段已生成历史被重复计入 policy loss。这个设计比单纯截断上下文更贴近真实 agent 训练。
summary.experiments: 主实验在 Webdev-Bench 和 Vision2Web 上。Webdev-Bench 是作者新建的 benchmark，强调在同一项目里组合多种开发需求，并要求保留指定既有行为。结果上，WebCoder-27B 在 Webdev-Bench 的 requirement satisfaction score 为 72.8，明显高于其基座 Qwen3.8-27B 的 64.8，也高于 Claude-Opus-4.8 的 65.1；并且在全部 40 个任务上都能交付可运行应用。Vision2Web 上，WebCoder-27B 的平均视觉与功能分数为 62.4，基座模型是 41.1，和 Claude-Opus-4.8 的 62.5 基本持平。若看方法有效性，最重要的不是单个 benchmark 数字，而是作者证明了三件事：1）统一的 artifact-grounded reward 能覆盖复现、生成、修改、修复等异构活动；2）中间进度信号确实改善了长程 credit assignment；3）context compaction 加 message-tree 训练能让 agent 在超长开发过程中继续学习，而不是因为窗口限制中断。若全文有消融，建议重点关注去掉 progress signal、去掉 verifier gating、去掉 context compaction 后的性能变化，因为这些最能说明方法是否真的在解决长程 agent 学习，而不是只靠更强 base model。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1/2，理解作者如何把前端开发抽象成“围绕共享 artifact 的能力组合”。然后看 Method 里三块：Webdev-World 环境接口、checklist-based verifier 与 reward 设计、跨窗口训练机制。实验部分优先看 Webdev-Bench 的任务构成和评分协议，再看与 base model、Claude 的对比。预计 25 分钟左右可以抓住主要信息。若只想判断是否值得深入，关键问题有两个：一是 reward 是否足够稳健，能否避免 verifier 被投机利用；二是这种 artifact-grounded RL 是否能迁移到更一般的软件工程或工具型 agent，而不只是前端页面开发。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-horizon frontend development as a sequential agent-learning problem rather than a one-shot code generation task. A useful frontend agent must reproduce designs, generate new components, modify existing code, and repair regressions while the underlying project state keeps evolving. The hard part is not any single skill in isolation. It is how to convert heterogeneous execution feedback—build success, runtime behavior, visual fidelity, interaction correctness, and preservation of existing functionality—into a unified reward signal, and how to assign credit across long trajectories where later edits can undo earlier progress.
summary_en.importance: This is more of an agent post-training and environment-design paper than a core pretraining paper. Still, it is relevant in two ways. First, it presents a fairly mature artifact-grounded RL setup where learning is tied to an executable external object rather than text-only outputs. That is useful for code agents, tool-using agents, and multimodal action-oriented systems. Second, it addresses a practical issue that increasingly matters for model training: the task state can outlive the context window. The paper’s treatment of persistent environment state plus context compaction is a concrete example of how to train agents that operate over long horizons without forcing everything into the model’s token context.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central idea is artifact-grounded agentic reinforcement learning. The authors build Webdev-World, an executable environment that exposes code editing, application execution, browser inspection, and on-demand skills through a shared interface while preserving project state across interactions. Rewards are defined through a weighted checklist derived from task requirements. An independent verifier builds, runs, and inspects the final application. Deterministic checks and visual assessments are aggregated into a terminal reward, gated by successful execution and rendering. To avoid relying only on sparse terminal rewards, the method also estimates intermediate requirement satisfaction from project and execution evidence, and uses changes in these estimates as progress and regression signals for stage-level credit assignment. A second important component is training across context windows. The system combines context compaction with message-tree sample construction: when the interaction history grows too long, the textual context is rewritten compactly while the true project state remains in the environment. The message tree preserves dependencies across rewrites so that different stages of the same long trajectory can still be used for training without repeatedly charging the policy loss for the same generated history.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluations are on Webdev-Bench and Vision2Web. Webdev-Bench is introduced to test capability composition within a single project, including requested changes and preservation of specified existing behavior. On this benchmark, WebCoder-27B reaches a requirement satisfaction score of 72.8, compared with 64.8 for its Qwen3.8-27B base model and 65.1 for Claude-Opus-4.8. It also delivers a running application on all 40 tasks. On Vision2Web, WebCoder-27B achieves an average visual and functional score of 62.4 versus 41.1 for the base model, and is essentially on par with Claude-Opus-4.8 at 62.5. The more interesting takeaway is methodological: the paper argues that a single artifact-grounded reward can supervise heterogeneous frontend activities, that intermediate progress signals improve long-horizon credit assignment, and that context compaction plus message-tree training makes it possible to continue learning when trajectories exceed the model’s context window. If the full paper includes ablations, the most important ones to inspect are the removal of progress signals, verifier gating, and cross-window training support.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the main method figure to understand the framing: frontend development is treated as capability composition over a persistent executable artifact. Then read three parts of the method section: the Webdev-World environment, the checklist-based verifier and reward construction, and the cross-context-window training mechanism. In the experiments, prioritize the definition and scoring protocol of Webdev-Bench before looking at the headline comparisons against the base model and Claude. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to capture the main ideas. Two questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the verifier is robust enough to avoid reward hacking, and whether the artifact-grounded RL recipe can transfer beyond frontend development to broader software engineering agents.

recommendation.zh: 看 Webdev-World 的状态保持和 reward redistribution；前端任务偏应用，但 artifact-grounded RL 对软件 agent 训练信号设计有参考。
recommendation.en: Read the Webdev-World state handling and reward redistribution; the frontend focus is applied, but artifact-grounded RL is relevant for software-agent training signals.

paper.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promising potential in coding tasks, and their performance is jointly determined by the policy model and the harness that mediates their interaction with the environment. Indeed, harness and policy are mutually reinforcing and evolving only one component is suboptimal---a harness tuned for one checkpoint may not target the failure modes of an updated policy, while policy learning remains limited to the trajectories elicited by a fixed harness. In ligh

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的核心不是单独把 agent policy 训得更强，也不是单独把 harness 调得更好，而是两者存在联动：固定 harness 会限制 policy 能暴露和学习到的行为，固定 policy 又会让 harness 搜索停留在过时的失败模式上。作者要解决的问题，是如何让 coding agent 在“外部交互脚手架”和“内部策略模型”两个层面递归共同演化，而且不依赖一个长期固定的外部 harness proposer。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 与 agentic training 的接口有现实意义。现在很多代码 agent 提升来自 prompt、工具调用、反馈格式、终止条件这些 harness 设计，而不是纯模型能力；同时，RL 或 trajectory learning 的上限又受制于 harness 能否把正确行为诱导出来。Self-HPO 把这两部分放进一个交替优化闭环，说明 agent 能力边界并不只在 base model，也在 interaction protocol。对基座研究员的启发主要有三点：第一，后训练中的环境设计本身是可学习对象；第二，policy 更新会改变之后最该优化的 harness 搜索空间，静态数据或静态 scaffold 容易过时；第三，pass@1 和 pass@k 同时提升，说明这种闭环不只是提高稳定性，也可能扩展可达行为集合。它更接近 agent post-training 方法论文，而不是通用预训练论文，因此放在 skim 是合适的。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Harness-Policy Optimization。设 coding agent 由 policy P 和 harness H 组成，任务执行轨迹由二者共同决定，并由可执行 verifier 给出二值反馈。作者把自我改进拆成两个交替步骤。H-step 固定当前 policy，用它分析失败轨迹并提出新的 harness 候选；候选可能修改提示词、上下文组织、工具使用流程、反馈暴露方式、终止规则等。然后在一个 search set 上评估这些候选，选出当前最优 harness。P-step 固定新 harness，在其下用强化学习更新 policy。更新后的 policy 再成为下一轮 harness proposer，同时上一轮训练中识别出的 hard tasks 被拿来构成下一轮 harness 搜索集，使 harness 搜索始终对准 policy 当前的薄弱点。作者实现了两个版本：Self-HPO 用 evolving policy 自己提出 harness；另一个参考版本用外部模型 Opus 4.8 作为固定 proposer。方法上的关键点不是“同时优化两部分”这句口号，而是两个具体设计：一是 harness proposer 由当前 policy 自举，避免外部 proposer 与被优化 policy 脱节；二是 harness search set 随 policy 演化，用训练中暴露出的 hard tasks 对齐新的 failure modes，而不是一直在固定开发集上搜索。论文还强调，优化后的 harness 和优化后的 policy 各自与 base counterpart 组合时仍保留部分收益，但联合收益超过简单相加，说明两者确实存在互补而非替代关系。
summary.experiments: 基座 policy 是 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，初始 harness 是 mini-SWE-agent。评测覆盖三个 coding benchmark，文中给出的总体平均 resolve rate 从 57.8% 提升到 64.8%。在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，base 从 61.0% 提升到 69.5%；如果在同样的 HPO 框架里使用外部 proposer Opus 4.8，进一步到 71.6%。作者还报告这些收益能迁移到分布外设置，包括 SWE-Bench Multilingual 和 SWE-Bench Pro，说明优化后的 harness 没有只记住单一 benchmark 的表面模式。消融里最关键的一项是 search set 更新：用 policy learning 过程中识别出的 hard tasks 动态更新 harness 搜索集，优于反复使用固定搜索集。另一个重要观察是，Self-HPO 不只提升 pass@1，也提升 pass@k，这意味着它不仅让已有能力更稳定地被 harness 调出来，也让 agent 在多次尝试下能覆盖到更多原本不可达的成功轨迹。摘要没有展开 RL 细节和每轮增益曲线，但引言明确说平均 resolve rate 在每个优化步骤都持续上升，这支持“交替优化而非一次性联合调参”的设定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓住 agent 分解：policy 决定能力上界，harness 决定这些能力如何被激发。Introduction 和 Figure 1/2 足够说明为什么单独做 harness optimization 或 policy optimization 都不够。方法部分重点看 H-step 和 P-step 的接口：失败轨迹如何被总结成 harness revision proposal，候选 harness 如何筛选，RL 在固定 harness 下如何训练，以及 hard-task search set 如何更新。实验部分建议优先看三类结果：一是 Self-HPO 相对 policy-only / harness-only 的增益；二是 optimized harness 与 optimized policy 的交叉组合实验，用来判断收益是否互补；三是 pass@k 与 OOD benchmark 结果，判断它是在做 exploit 还是确实扩展了行为覆盖。若只想了解思路，20 到 30 分钟足够；若想迁移到非 coding agent，需要细看 harness 变更空间的定义，因为这决定方法能否推广。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a coupled optimization problem in coding agents: policy and harness co-determine performance, so improving only one side is inherently limited. A fixed harness constrains which behaviors the policy can express and learn from, while a fixed policy makes harness search chase outdated failure modes. The core question is how to let both components evolve recursively, with the current policy itself driving harness improvement rather than relying on a permanently external proposer.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface and to agentic training more broadly. In coding agents, a large fraction of gains often comes from harness design—prompting, tool mediation, feedback exposure, and termination logic—rather than from the base model alone. At the same time, policy optimization is bottlenecked by the trajectories that the harness can elicit. Self-HPO turns this into an alternating optimization loop and makes a useful point for foundation-model researchers: the environment scaffold is itself an optimizable object, and its optimal form shifts as the policy changes. The reported gains in both pass@1 and pass@k suggest the loop improves not only reliability but also the reachable behavior frontier.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework is called Harness-Policy Optimization (HPO). A coding agent is modeled as a pair of policy P and harness H, with trajectories scored by an executable verifier. Each round alternates two updates. In the H-step, the current policy is frozen and used to analyze its own failed trajectories, propose harness revisions, and select the best candidate on a search set. The harness can modify prompts, context organization, tool usage flow, feedback format, and stopping rules. In the P-step, the selected harness is frozen and the policy is updated with reinforcement learning under that harness. The updated policy then becomes the proposer for the next H-step. Crucially, the harness search set is also updated using hard tasks identified during the preceding policy-learning phase, so harness search stays aligned with the policy’s current weaknesses. The paper instantiates two versions: Self-HPO, where the evolving policy proposes its own harness candidates, and an external-model variant using Opus 4.8 as a fixed proposer. The main design insight is not merely “optimize both,” but to couple proposer identity and search-set construction to the evolving policy.
summary_en.experiments: The base policy is Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and the seed harness is mini-SWE-agent. Experiments are run on three coding benchmarks. The headline aggregate result is an average resolve-rate improvement from 57.8% to 64.8%. On SWE-Bench Verified, the base agent improves from 61.0% to 69.5% under Self-HPO, and to 71.6% when the same HPO loop uses Opus 4.8 as an external harness proposer. The gains transfer to out-of-distribution settings, including SWE-Bench Multilingual and SWE-Bench Pro. One of the most important ablations concerns the search set: dynamically updating it with hard tasks discovered during policy learning works better than reusing a fixed set. Another notable result is that Self-HPO improves both pass@1 and pass@k, which suggests it is not only making existing successful behaviors more reliable, but also expanding the set of successful trajectories the agent can reach. The provided text does not expose all RL details or per-round tables, but the paper states that average resolve rate improves at every optimization step.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the decomposition itself: policy defines the capability boundary, harness determines how that capability is elicited. The introduction and Figures 1–2 are enough to understand why harness-only and policy-only optimization are both incomplete. In the method section, focus on the interface between H-step and P-step: how failures are summarized into harness proposals, how candidate harnesses are selected, how RL is run under a fixed harness, and how the hard-task search set is refreshed. In experiments, prioritize three pieces: Self-HPO versus policy-only and harness-only baselines, cross-combinations of optimized policy and optimized harness, and the pass@k plus OOD results. Those are the sections that tell you whether the method is merely overfitting a scaffold or actually improving the agent loop. A quick read takes 20–30 minutes. A deeper read is only necessary if you want to port the idea beyond coding agents, in which case the definition of the harness search space becomes the key detail.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 H-step 的设计；如果 harness 搜索成本没控住，这更像昂贵 prompt/tool co-evolution，不应直接类比预训练自举。
recommendation.en: Read the H-step design; if harness-search cost is not controlled, this is expensive prompt/tool co-evolution rather than a clean analogue of pretraining self-improvement.

paper.title: Repairing LLM-Generated Specifications with Deterministic Diagnosis
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as formalizers: given a reasoning problem expressed in natural language, they produce a formal specification that a symbolic solver can then solve, with guarantees relative to that specification. Many specifications are runnable yet semantically wrong, encoding incorrect constraints, domains, objectives, predicates, or goals, and solver-error feedback dries up once execution succeeds. Purely LLM-based diagnosis, lacking a formal ground truth, of

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 把自然语言问题 formalize 成可运行规格时，规格虽能执行但语义错误、且 solver 不再提供错误反馈的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是方法改进和工具链可靠性。它对 LLM+symbolic solver 的神经符号推理流程有参考价值，特别是提醒纯 LLM 自我诊断会引入回归；但它主要是形式规格修复，不直接影响基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DRAGO，用 deterministic、formalism-specific diagnosis 替代无依据的 LLM critique。系统根据形式语言的诊断结果给错误赋权，并只在 reference-free acceptance predicate 判断诊断错误权重严格下降时接受重写，从而减少修复时把正确规格改坏的风险。
summary.experiments: 在五个 benchmark 上评估，覆盖 SMT-LIB2 逻辑推理、MiniZinc 约束规划以及规划类规格。摘要报告纯 LLM 诊断会让 11.8% 原本正确的规格发生回归，但未给出完整提升幅度、模型规模和各 benchmark 细分结果。
summary.authors_note: Michael J. Wooldridge 是多 Agent 系统领域知名研究者；Philip S. Yu 在数据挖掘与 AI 领域有长期代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses semantically wrong but executable formal specifications produced by LLMs, where solver errors disappear once the specification runs.
summary_en.importance: This is a reliability improvement for LLM-to-symbolic-solver pipelines. It is useful for neuro-symbolic reasoning and tool-mediated agents, especially because it quantifies regressions caused by ungrounded LLM critique. It is not a foundation-model pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: DRAGO replaces free-form LLM critique with deterministic, formalism-specific diagnosis. It assigns weights to diagnosed errors and accepts a rewrite only when a reference-free predicate shows a strict decrease in diagnosed error weight.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans five benchmarks covering SMT-LIB2, MiniZinc, and planning specifications. The abstract reports that pure LLM-based diagnosis regresses 11.8% of initially correct specifications, but does not provide full model-scale details or per-benchmark numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: Michael J. Wooldridge is a well-known researcher in multi-agent systems; Philip S. Yu is widely known for work in data mining and AI.

recommendation.zh: 把自我批评换成确定性诊断这个取舍靠谱；看 acceptance predicate，别当通用推理修复。
recommendation.en: The useful part is replacing self-critique with deterministic diagnosis; inspect the acceptance predicate, not the headline task.

paper.title: From Approval to Abuse: Privilege Escalation Attacks on Harness-Protected Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents use execution harnesses to constrain the consequences of prompt injection by enforcing permission boundaries. These systems deterministically intercept any out-of-sandbox action and prompt the user for approval. To reduce approval fatigue, users can approve allow-rules proposed by the agent, after which any future action matching the rule is allowed without a prompt. In this work, we show that this mechanism introduces a new risk: untrusted context can influence the permissions pre

summary.core_problem: 受 harness 保护的 coding agent 会通过用户审批 allow-rule 来降低权限提示频率，但不可信仓库上下文可能诱导 agent 请求过宽权限，形成持久化权限升级。
summary.importance: 这是 coding agent 安全机制分析。贡献在于指出一个不只发生在单次 prompt injection 内的风险：攻击者可以污染仓库上下文，影响权限更新流程，让用户批准看似合理但危险的长期规则。
summary.technical_approach: 论文研究针对 permission-update process 的 privilege escalation。攻击者在代码仓库中植入对抗性上下文，使 agent 在执行常规任务时提出一个表面上与任务相关、实则范围过宽的 allow-rule；一旦用户批准，该规则会被保存，后续匹配该规则的越界动作不再触发审批。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该攻击能可靠地引导 agent 请求危险的宽权限规则，并在用户批准后使 harness 对原本会被拦截的恶意动作失效。摘要未给出具体 coding agent、仓库任务、成功率或人类审批实验细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Harness-protected coding agents use user-approved allow-rules to reduce permission prompts, but untrusted repository context can steer the agent into requesting overly broad persistent permissions.
summary_en.importance: This is a security analysis for coding agents. Its main contribution is identifying a risk that extends beyond a single prompt-injection episode: adversarial repository context can influence the permission-update process and create durable privilege escalation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper studies privilege escalation against the permission-update mechanism. An attacker plants adversarial context in a repository, causing the agent during a routine task to request an allow-rule that appears justified but is dangerously broad. Once approved, the saved rule allows future matching actions without prompting the user.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that the attack reliably steers agents into requesting dangerous broad allow-rules and, after approval, effectively blinds the harness to malicious actions that would otherwise be blocked. Specific agents, repository tasks, success rates, and user-study details are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent 安全 checklist 值得记录；核心教训是权限学习比单轮 prompt injection 更难防。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-security checklist item: permission learning is harder to secure than single-turn prompt injection.

paper.title: Mallea: Building, Steering, and Memorizing Worlds with Coding Agent
paper.abstract: Code world models represent world dynamics through explicit state and executable rules. We investigate how to coordinate object representations, behavioral revisions, and visual memory within this formulation. We present Mallea, a system for building, steering, and memorizing worlds from text. A coding agent infers object interaction requirements from the prompt and jointly plans object structure, properties, and rules, favoring compact representations that support those requirements. The world

summary.core_problem: 如何让大模型构建、控制并记忆一个包含显式状态和可执行规则的代码世界模型？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于代码的交互式世界生成与控制框架，将对象表示、行为规则和视觉记忆统一在代码范式下。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Mallea 系统。Coding agent 根据文本提示推断对象交互需求，联合规划对象结构、属性和规则。世界在规划的规则下演化，用户可通过动作干预，或通过文本请求修改属性/扩展能力。系统为白盒定义的对象维护纹理记忆，并在对象变化时更新。生成式渲染器将当前结构与记忆的外观结合。
summary.experiments: 未提及具体模型参数量和量化指标，主要展示了系统构建、干预和记忆世界的能力。
summary.authors_note: 北京大学团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to enable LLMs to build, steer, and memorize a code-based world model with explicit states and executable rules?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an interactive world generation and control framework based on code, unifying object representation, behavioral rules, and visual memory under a coding paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Mallea system. A coding agent infers object interaction requirements from text prompts and jointly plans object structure, properties, and rules. The world evolves under these rules; users can steer it via actions or edit properties/extend capabilities via text requests. The system maintains texture memory for whitebox-defined objects and updates it as objects change. A generative renderer combines the current structure with remembered appearance.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model parameters or quantitative metrics mentioned; primarily demonstrates the system's capability to build, intervene in, and memorize worlds.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Peking University.

recommendation.zh: 用代码生成来做交互式世界模型，思路有趣但偏应用系统，作为 agent 构造环境的 reference 了解即可。
recommendation.en: Uses code generation for interactive world modeling; interesting concept but leans towards application systems, good as a reference for agent environment construction.

paper.title: OPRD: On-Policy Reminder Distillation for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Reliable repository-level coding requires agents not only to generate correct code but also to preserve constraints and respond to tool feedback across long interactions. However, our diagnostic analysis shows that agents often fail to act on relevant information already available in context, while final Pass/Fail outcomes provide only sparse process supervision. We introduce On-Policy Reminder Distillation (OPRD), which combines Multi-Scope Reminder supervision with outcome-based routing on rem

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是长轨迹代码 Agent 的过程监督问题：模型在仓库级任务中经常已经看到了约束、工具反馈或测试错误，却没有在后续决策中使用这些信息。最终 Pass/Fail 只能告诉结果对错，不能指出哪些约束需要长期保持，哪些局部观察应该影响下一步动作。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 post-train / coding-agent 训练论文，不是预训练方法论文。对预训练研究的启发在于训练信号设计：它把稀疏 outcome 转换成带时间作用域的过程监督，并用 on-policy rollout 降低训练和推理分布不一致。对于关注 pretrain-posttrain 接口的人，OPRD 展示了一个实用思路：不要只用成功轨迹做 imitation，也不要直接强化失败轨迹；失败样本可以保留学生自己的前缀，再让带提醒的教师重新评估，从而把错误上下文转化为可学习的局部分布修正。
summary.technical_approach: OPRD 包含三部分。第一是 Multi-Scope Reminder。Global Reminder 根据最终测试诊断生成轨迹级指导，用来表达整个任务期间都应保持的约束；Turn-local Reminder 绑定到某个环境观察，只作用于下一次决策，用来处理工具失败、执行反馈、测试报错等局部信息。第二是两阶段冷启动：先做 Coding SFT 建立代码能力，再做 Instruction-Following SFT，提高模型对约束、反馈和 reminder 的响应能力；教师和学生都从 IF checkpoint 初始化。第三是 outcome-based routing。训练时先让不带 reminder 的学生做 on-policy rollout。通过可执行验证后，成功轨迹进入自回归 self-imitation；失败轨迹不直接模仿，而是让教师在相同学生生成前缀上加入 reminder 重新预测，学生用 Top-100 reverse KL 匹配教师分布。推理时学生不需要 reminder，目标是把 reminder 诱导出的行为内化到参数中。
summary.experiments: 作者先在 200 个 SWE-rebench V2 验证任务上做诊断分析，使用 Qwen3.5-4B，每个任务两条 rollout：一条无 reminder，一条运行时插入 reminder。错误事件分为四类：Tool-Feedback Recovery、Scope and Source Grounding、Scenario-Condition Reasoning、Post-Edit Control and Validation。带 reminder 的 rollout 在四类错误上都减少，说明主要瓶颈不是完全缺少信息，而是模型没有在正确时间使用上下文信息。主实验在 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Pro、SWE-bench Multilingual 上评测。OPRD 相比开源 Qwen3.5-4B base，benchmark 平均任务解决率提升 11.3 个百分点。在同一诊断协议下，四类错误事件总数从 446 降到 222，下降 50.2%。这些数字表明收益主要来自更稳定地使用约束和工具反馈，而不仅是生成更强的代码片段。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看诊断分析和 Fig. 1，确认问题是不是“已有信息未被使用”。方法部分重点看三处：Global Reminder 与 Turn-local Reminder 的作用域设计，成功/失败 rollout 的路由逻辑，Top-100 reverse KL 为什么用于失败轨迹蒸馏。实验部分建议找冷启动、Global/Turn-local reminder、outcome routing 的消融；这些消融比绝对分数更能判断方法是否可迁移到其他长轨迹 Agent。代码基准的任务说明可以快速略过。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses process supervision for long-horizon coding agents. In repository-level tasks, agents often have the relevant constraint, tool feedback, or test failure already in context, but fail to use it at the right later decision. A final Pass/Fail signal is too sparse: it does not say which constraints should persist across the trajectory or which local observation should guide the next action.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and coding-agent paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model training is the supervision design. OPRD turns sparse executable outcomes into scoped process supervision and uses on-policy student rollouts to reduce train-test mismatch. The useful idea is that failed rollouts should not be imitated directly, but they also should not be discarded. Keeping the student’s own prefixes and asking a reminder-conditioned teacher to re-evaluate them creates a targeted distributional correction for the states the student actually visits.
summary_en.technical_approach: OPRD has three main components. First, Multi-Scope Reminder supervision separates global and local corrective signals. A Global Reminder converts final test diagnostics into trajectory-level guidance, while a Turn-local Reminder is anchored to an environment observation and applies only to the next decision. This avoids diluting local feedback over a long context or applying it to unrelated turns. Second, a two-stage cold start performs Coding SFT followed by Instruction-Following SFT, so the model becomes more responsive to constraints, feedback, and reminders before distillation. Teacher and student are initialized from the instruction-following checkpoint. Third, outcome-based routing is applied to reminder-free on-policy student rollouts. Verified successful rollouts become autoregressive self-imitation targets. Failed rollouts are handled by a teacher that re-evaluates the same student-generated prefixes under reminders, and the student matches the teacher distribution with Top-100 reverse KL. At inference time, the trained student runs without reminders.
summary_en.experiments: The diagnostic study uses 200 SWE-rebench V2 validation tasks with Qwen3.5-4B and two rollouts per task: one without reminders and one with runtime reminder insertion. Error events are grouped into Tool-Feedback Recovery, Scope and Source Grounding, Scenario-Condition Reasoning, and Post-Edit Control and Validation. Reminder-assisted rollouts reduce errors in all four categories, supporting the claim that agents often fail to act on information that is already available. Main evaluations are on SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Pro, and SWE-bench Multilingual. OPRD improves the benchmark-averaged task resolution rate by 11.3 points over the open-source Qwen3.5-4B base model. Under the same diagnostic protocol, aggregate error events drop from 446 to 222, a 50.2% reduction. The reported gains point to better use of constraints and feedback across the trajectory, not just stronger local code generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the diagnostic analysis and Fig. 1 to understand the failure mode: relevant information is present but not used. In the method section, focus on the scope design of Global versus Turn-local Reminders, the routing of successful and failed rollouts, and the use of Top-100 reverse KL for failed-trajectory distillation. In the experiments, the most informative parts are likely the ablations on cold start, reminder scope, and outcome-based routing. Benchmark descriptions can be skimmed unless repository-level coding agents are the main focus.

recommendation.zh: 别把它当 coding trick，看的是稀疏 outcome 如何蒸成局部训练信号；先读 reminder 设计和 routing，可能能迁到 RL/SFT 混合配方里。
recommendation.en: Do not read this as a coding trick—the useful part is how sparse outcomes are distilled into local training signals; focus on the reminder design and routing.

paper.title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
paper.abstract: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单一的 3D 生成模型问题，而是 3D code generation 缺少统一基础设施的问题：一方面，现有数据集分散在 CAD、Blender、shader、scene、articulation 等不同环境里，表示形式不统一，很多样本也不能直接执行；另一方面，评测和训练闭环不完整，模型即使能写出“看起来像对的”代码，也常常在执行、几何一致性、资产依赖、场景组装这些环节失败。作者试图把 3D 内容生成重新表述为“可执行程序生成”问题，并同时补齐三件事：可复用的大规模可执行代码语料、可自动验证的生成 harness、以及由执行—评估—修复轨迹反哺训练的数据闭环。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练本身，这篇论文不是核心 pretrain 方法论文，但它对“代码即环境接口”的数据构造和 agentic data flywheel 有直接启发。价值主要有三层。第一，它展示了如何把异构结构化对象统一转成可执行代码语料，这和把图像、语音、机器人轨迹转成统一 token/程序表示是同一类问题。第二，它把 inference-time agent loop 产出的失败轨迹、修复轨迹、偏好比较沉淀成训练数据，这一点和 post-train 反哺 pretrain、以及 tool-use/code agent 的持续数据生成很接近。第三，它说明在复杂生成任务里，单靠 pass@1 或表面视觉评分不够，必须把执行信号、几何检查、judge feedback 组合成更可靠的训练监督。若从贡献量级看，它更像一个面向 3D coding 的基础设施与数据工程系统，而不是会直接改变通用 LLM 预训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由两部分组成。第一部分是 3DCodeVerse-2M 数据集。作者不是简单抓取现成代码，而是做了较重的表示统一和可执行化处理：从公开资源收集多类 3D 数据，包括 CAD 构造序列、Blender 脚本、Shadertoy、Three.js/React Three Fiber 项目、Thingiverse 等；把异构表示转换成可运行源码，例如把 DeepCAD 的 construction sequence 转成 CadQuery 程序，把 Articraft 的几何例程内联到源码中，同时保留 URDF articulation 规格；再把源文件、依赖资产、文本描述、来源信息、验证记录一起打包，形成 standalone executable program。这里真正难的地方不是“多收数据”，而是去掉专有或不可用依赖，让样本在声明环境中可复现执行。第二部分是 3DCodeVerse Harness。它把复杂 3D 项目分解成一个 DAG，节点对应 coding/assembly 子任务，由多 agent 协作生成多个源文件并集成。生成后执行并渲染，再由独立 judge agent 按显式 acceptance criteria 评估，同时辅以空间一致性检查，避免仅在渲染图上看似合理、但几何结构错误的结果拿高分。评估反馈会被转成局部 repair objective，驱动多轮 execution-evaluation-revision。这个设计和普通 ReAct/Reflexion 的差别在于：它不是开放式自然语言反思，而是围绕可执行 artifact 的结构化验证与局部修复；而且 harness 本身被设计成数据生成引擎，会记录成功程序、失败尝试、定向修复和 preference comparison，用于后续 SFT 与 preference learning。
summary.experiments: 从文中给出的主结果看，最直接的数字有两类。其一，基于 3DCodeVerse-2M 微调后，3D 可执行代码生成能力明显提升：在 3DCodeBench 上，9B 模型执行率达到 84.9%，27B 模型达到 92.9%。这说明数据集至少在“让模型写出能跑的 3D 程序”这一层是有效的。其二，Harness 相比 one-shot generation 带来 15.5 到 29.1 分的质量增益，说明多轮执行—评估—修复对复杂 3D 项目是必要的，而不是锦上添花。论文强调 harness 支持包含数千行代码的复杂项目，这一点比静态 object generation 更接近真实软件工程场景。值得注意的是，作者把质量评估拆成执行成功、视觉评估和空间/结构检查几部分，这比只看 render 更严格。若精读全文，建议重点核对数据组成比例、各环境覆盖范围、转换失败率、judge 与空间检查各自的增益、以及失败案例中常见错误类型；这些细节决定这个生态更像“可扩展训练资产”还是“高成本定制系统”。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，不建议投入过多时间在任务细节上。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，明确它解决的是基础设施缺口，不是单个模型架构。然后看数据集构建部分，重点关注“如何把异构 3D 表示转成可执行代码”以及“如何处理依赖和验证信号”；这部分对做结构化预训练数据的人更有借鉴意义。接着看 Harness 的方法图，理解 DAG 分解、judge、spatial checks、repair loop 之间的关系。实验部分只需抓三件事：微调后执行率提升、harness 相对 one-shot 的增益、以及不同 agent/backbone 是否都受益。预计 20 到 30 分钟足够。若想深挖，只看附录里数据来源、转换规则和验证协议，不必细读 3D 任务案例本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about a new 3D generation model. It targets a missing infrastructure layer for 3D code generation. Existing resources are fragmented across CAD, Blender, shaders, scenes, and articulated assets; representations are heterogeneous; many samples are not directly executable; and evaluation is weak because visual plausibility often hides execution or geometric failures. The work reframes 3D generation as executable program generation and tries to close the loop with three pieces: a large executable code corpus, an automated generation-and-verification harness, and trace collection from execution, judging, and repair for future training.
summary_en.importance: For core LLM pretraining, this is not a central pretrain-method paper. Its value is more indirect but still relevant. First, it shows how to convert heterogeneous structured artifacts into a unified executable-code dataset, which is closely related to broader questions around unified representations for non-text modalities. Second, it turns inference-time agent traces—failures, repairs, and preference comparisons—into training assets, which connects naturally to the pretrain/post-train loop and continual data generation for code agents. Third, it argues that complex generation tasks need richer supervision than pass@1 or surface-level visual scores; execution signals, structural checks, and judge feedback need to be combined. The contribution is best understood as a domain-specific infrastructure and data-engineering system for 3D coding, not as a paper that changes the general LLM pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system has two main components. The first is 3DCodeVerse-2M. Instead of merely aggregating public code, the authors perform substantial representation unification and executabilization. They collect diverse 3D sources, including CAD construction sequences, Blender scripts, Shadertoy programs, Three.js / React Three Fiber projects, Thingiverse assets, and more. They then convert heterogeneous formats into runnable source code: for example, DeepCAD construction sequences are translated into CadQuery programs, and Articraft geometry routines are inlined while preserving URDF articulation specifications. Each sample is packaged as a standalone executable program with source files, assets, textual descriptions, provenance, and available verification records. The hard part here is not scale alone, but removing specialized or unavailable dependencies so that samples can actually run in the declared environment. The second component is the 3DCodeVerse Harness. It decomposes a complex 3D project into a DAG of coding and assembly tasks, lets multiple agents generate and integrate source files, executes and renders the result, and then uses an independent judge agent plus spatial consistency checks to evaluate it. The spatial checks are important because they prevent visually plausible but geometrically invalid outputs from scoring well. Feedback is converted into localized repair objectives, enabling repeated execution-evaluation-revision cycles. This differs from generic ReAct-style loops because the process is centered on executable artifacts, structured verification, and targeted repair rather than open-ended natural-language reflection. The harness is also designed as a data engine: it records successful programs, failed attempts, targeted repairs, and preference comparisons for later SFT and preference learning.
summary_en.experiments: The headline results are straightforward. Fine-tuning on 3DCodeVerse-2M substantially improves executable 3D code generation: on 3DCodeBench, execution rates reach 84.9% for a 9B model and 92.9% for a 27B model. This suggests the dataset is effective at teaching models to produce runnable 3D programs. In addition, the Harness improves generation quality by 15.5 to 29.1 points over one-shot generation across coding agents, indicating that iterative execution-judging-repair is necessary for complex 3D projects rather than a marginal add-on. The paper also emphasizes support for projects with thousands of lines of code, which makes the setup closer to real software engineering than static object generation. A useful detail is that evaluation is split into execution success, visual assessment, and spatial/structural checks, making it stricter than render-only evaluation. If reading the full paper, the most informative details are likely the dataset composition, environment coverage, conversion failure modes, the separate gains from judge versus spatial checks, and the taxonomy of common errors.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and the main system figure to understand that the contribution is infrastructure, not a new model architecture. Then read the dataset construction section, focusing on how heterogeneous 3D representations are converted into executable code and how dependencies and verification metadata are handled. After that, read the Harness section for the DAG decomposition, judge design, spatial checks, and repair loop. In experiments, only track three things: gains from fine-tuning on the dataset, gains from the harness over one-shot generation, and whether the improvements hold across different agents or backbones. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough. If you want one deeper pass, spend it on the appendix sections about data sources, conversion rules, and verification protocol rather than on the 3D task examples themselves.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“可执行环境+自动验证+agent 生成数据”这套闭环值得借鉴；先看数据构建和 harness 设计，方法细节可后放。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the executable-environment plus auto-verification loop is worth stealing; read the dataset construction and harness design first.

paper.title: When Correctness Feedback Erases Evidence: Phase-Separated Completeness Auditing in Verus
paper.abstract: Correctness feedback suppresses the very evidence that specification-completeness auditing is designed to uncover: programs that satisfy a written contract but violate intended behavior. We demonstrate this objective reversal on 12 Verus/Rust tasks across four model families under matched call budgets. Independent no-feedback discovery more than doubles certified-witness yield relative to IntentShield's corrective-feedback loop (59.0% versus 27.1%). A format-matched iterative control places the

summary.core_problem: 在程序验证与规范审计场景中，给模型提供 correctness feedback 可能会抹掉那些“满足当前规范但违背真实意图”的关键反例证据，从而让 completeness auditing 目标反转。
summary.importance: 这是一个较窄但方法上有意思的负结果：反馈并不总是帮助搜索，反而可能压制对 specification 漏洞的发现。对通用 LLM pretrain 的直接相关性不高，但对后训练、verifier-in-the-loop、以及 reward/feedback 设计有一点启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 Verus/Rust 任务上比较了带 corrective feedback 的循环与无反馈独立发现流程，并进一步设计 format-matched iterative control 来隔离“反馈内容”与“独立重启”两个因素。随后提出 phase-separated execution，把发现 witness 与后续修正规范分成不同阶段，避免早期反馈污染搜索空间。核心观点是把 auditing 与 repair 解耦。
summary.experiments: 在 12 个 Verus/Rust 任务、4 个模型家族、匹配调用预算下，无反馈独立发现的 certified-witness yield 为 59.0%，高于 IntentShield 式 corrective-feedback loop 的 27.1%。phase-separated 执行在不复用响应的情况下可匹配总体 yield；基于保留 witness 的 Phase-Revised contract 达到 81.3% implementation success，而 IS-Revised 为 62.5%，Direct-Revised 接近前者。任务范围较窄，外推到一般 agent/RL 仍需谨慎。

summary_en.core_problem: In program verification and specification auditing, correctness feedback may erase the very counterexamples needed to expose incomplete specs, effectively reversing the objective of completeness auditing.
summary_en.importance: This is a narrow but methodologically interesting negative result: feedback does not always help search and can suppress evidence of specification holes. Its direct relevance to general LLM pretraining is limited, but it offers some signal for post-training, verifier-in-the-loop setups, and feedback design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares corrective-feedback loops against no-feedback independent discovery on Verus/Rust tasks, and adds a format-matched iterative control to separate the effect of feedback content from that of independent restarts. It then proposes phase-separated execution, decoupling witness discovery from later specification repair so that early feedback does not contaminate the search space.
summary_en.experiments: Across 12 Verus/Rust tasks, four model families, and matched call budgets, no-feedback independent discovery achieves 59.0% certified-witness yield versus 27.1% for an IntentShield-style corrective-feedback loop. Phase-separated execution matches aggregate yield without response reuse. For downstream repair, Phase-Revised contracts reach 81.3% implementation success versus 62.5% for IS-Revised, with Direct-Revised close behind. The domain is narrow, so generalization to broader agent/RL settings should be treated cautiously.

recommendation.zh: 题材偏窄，但“反馈会抹掉证据”这个负结果值得记一下；别把它外推太远，当作 verifier-in-the-loop 设计里的一个警告样本即可。
recommendation.en: Narrow domain, but the 'feedback erases evidence' result is worth keeping in mind; do not overgeneralize it, just treat it as a warning case for verifier-in-the-loop design.

paper.title: Improving Environment-Agnostic Coding Agents: The Role of Scaffolding

summary.core_problem: 研究环境无关的 coding agent 中，脚手架设计是否比底层模型能力更决定实际任务完成率与稳健性。
summary.importance: 这类工作对基座预训练不是直接方法贡献，但会影响大家如何解释 agent 结果：很多所谓模型进步，可能主要来自 scaffold、工具编排和错误恢复机制，而不是模型本身。
summary.technical_approach: 从标题看，核心是分析或改进 coding agent 的 scaffolding，即任务分解、工具调用、状态管理、回滚/重试、环境适配等执行层设计，用来提升 agent 在不同运行环境中的泛化与稳定性。由于缺少摘要，无法确认是否提出新算法，还是系统性 ablation。
summary.experiments: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体 benchmark、模型规模、环境数量和提升幅度。按题意推测，实验应围绕跨环境 coding 任务，对比不同 scaffold 设计在成功率、鲁棒性和环境迁移上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies whether scaffold design, rather than the base model alone, is the main driver of robustness and success for environment-agnostic coding agents.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it matters for interpreting agent progress: many apparent model gains may actually come from scaffolding, tool orchestration, and recovery logic.
summary_en.technical_approach: From the title, the paper likely focuses on coding-agent scaffolding: task decomposition, tool use, state tracking, retry/rollback, and environment adaptation to improve cross-environment robustness. Without an abstract, it is unclear whether this is a new algorithm or mainly a systematic ablation study.
summary_en.experiments: No abstract is available, so model sizes, benchmarks, environments, and gains cannot be verified. The likely setup compares scaffold variants on coding tasks across heterogeneous execution environments, measuring success rate and transfer robustness.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent engineering 复盘，不是 pretrain 论文；若你在看 coding agent 结果是否被 scaffold 污染，可以只找 ablation 表和失败案例。
recommendation.en: This looks more like agent engineering than pretraining; only worth checking if you want to see whether coding-agent gains are mostly scaffold-driven.

paper.title: CodeHealth Predicts the Token Cost of Agentic Code Review: A Pre-Registered Study of 465 Agent-Authored Pull Requests

summary.core_problem: 研究代码健康度指标是否能预测 agentic code review 在审查 agent-authored pull requests 时消耗的 token 成本。
summary.importance: 贡献是软件工程 agent 的经验分析，而不是新的 coding model、训练方法或评测基准。对预训练研究员的间接价值在于把 agent 成本从“任务完成率”扩展到可预测的 token 预算问题。
summary.technical_approach: 摘要缺失；题名显示这是一个预注册研究，样本为 465 个 agent-authored pull requests。方法可能用 CodeHealth 指标作为解释变量或预测变量，建模 code review 过程中的 token cost。
summary.experiments: 基于题名可确认样本规模为 465 个 agent-authored PRs，但无法确认使用的代码审查 agent、模型、仓库来源、统计模型、显著性结果或预测误差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether CodeHealth metrics can predict the token cost of agentic code review on agent-authored pull requests.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical software-engineering study, not a new coding model, training method, or benchmark. Its indirect value is treating agent cost as a predictable resource budget rather than only measuring task success.
summary_en.technical_approach: No abstract is available. The title indicates a pre-registered study over 465 agent-authored pull requests, likely using CodeHealth as an explanatory or predictive variable for token usage during code review.
summary_en.experiments: The title confirms a sample of 465 agent-authored PRs, but the reviewing agent, model, repository source, statistical model, significance results, and prediction error are not available from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent 成本建模线索可扫一眼；若没有干净控制 diff size，结论只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as a coding-agent cost-modeling signal; without clean diff-size controls, treat the conclusion as weak evidence.

paper.title: ANCHOR: Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding
paper.abstract: For repository-grounded coding agents, a functionally correct patch is not necessarily an acceptable one: developers also constrain how the task must be carried out-modification scope, workflow order, validation, tool use, and reporting. This capability, which we call engineering constraint following, remains largely invisible to current evaluations. We introduce ANCHOR (Assessing Naturalistic Constraint Hierarchies and Ordering in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding), a benchmark built on natura

summary.core_problem: 仓库级coding agent评测只看patch是否功能正确，忽略了真实工程中的约束（改动范围、步骤顺序、验证、工具使用与汇报），导致能力缺口不可见。
summary.importance: 典型的“把隐性需求显式化”的评测资产：提出工程约束跟随（engineering constraint following）并给出层级约束体系与轨迹级评测；对训练/对齐coding agent的奖励设计与数据合成也有直接牵引。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ANCHOR基准：(i) 从真实开发者交互中抽取10大类、78个叶子类型的约束taxonomy；(ii) 自动化流水线把任务落到原子约束，并组合成AND/THEN/PRIORITY等关系；(iii) 轨迹对齐评测：同时检查代码diff与执行轨迹，结合规则判定与LLM judge。
summary.experiments: 在多语言仓库任务（8个语言组）上评测19种agent配置（摘要截断，未给出具体指标与领先幅度）；强调“功能正确≠可接受”的失败模式可被该基准捕获。

summary_en.core_problem: Repository-level coding agent evaluations focus on functional correctness, missing real engineering constraints (edit scope, workflow order, validation, tool use, reporting).
summary_en.importance: An evaluation asset that makes implicit engineering requirements explicit: introduces ‘engineering constraint following’ with a hierarchical constraint taxonomy and trajectory-grounded evaluation, likely to influence reward design and data synthesis for coding agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: ANCHOR benchmark: (i) a 10-category / 78-leaf constraint taxonomy distilled from real developer interactions; (ii) an automated pipeline to instantiate atomic constraints and compose them via AND/THEN/PRIORITY relations; (iii) trajectory-grounded evaluation checking both code diffs and execution trajectories using rule-based checks plus LLM judges.
summary_en.experiments: Multilingual repository tasks spanning 8 language groups; evaluates 19 agent configurations (abstract truncated; no concrete metrics reported).

recommendation.zh: 评测点抓得准：把“工程可接受性”拆成可组合约束并做轨迹级检查；读taxonomy与判定规则即可，LLM judge部分要警惕可重复性。
recommendation.en: Solid eval framing: compositional engineering constraints + trajectory checks; read the taxonomy and rule checks, and treat the LLM-judge parts with reproducibility caution.

paper.title: TurnCost: Turns, Not Observations: Cache-Aware Loop Engineering for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: AI coding agents operate in iterative loops: they modify code, run tools, inspect the results, and decide what to do next. We call the design of this process loop engineering, which includes context management, model selection, compaction, and termination. Existing efficiency work mainly compresses tool observations or routes selected turns to cheaper models, but the practical opportunity for these optimizations remains unclear. We analyze 600 publicly released coding-agent trajectories spanning

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 效率分析里一个常见误判：大家把成本归因于长 observation，但真实瓶颈可能是 turn 数和缓存命中下的循环设计。
summary.importance: 这是面向 agent inference economics 的实证分析，不是预训练论文，但对 test-time compute、agent scaling 和 serving 成本建模有直接启发。贡献类型更像系统分析与成本模型，而不是新 agent 架构。
summary.technical_approach: 作者分析 600 条公开 coding-agent 轨迹，拆解 observation token、prefix cache 命中率、模型委派的 break-even 条件，提出 loop engineering 视角：上下文管理、模型选择、压缩和终止策略都应围绕 turn 成本而不是 observation 长度来设计。核心结论是高缓存命中使平坦 input pricing 严重高估真实成本，并给出闭式 delegation 条件。
summary.experiments: 数据来自两个 agent scaffold 和两个语言模型的 600 条公开轨迹。关键统计包括：median observation 仅 118-286 tokens，大日志接近 99 分位；98.6% 的输入 token 来自 prefix cache；在接近理想缓存下，按平坦 input pricing 估算会平均高估约 7 倍成本；模型委派在一半评估中反而增成本。论文更偏 measurement study，没有追求 benchmark 刷分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper questions a common assumption in coding-agent efficiency: long tool observations are not the main cost driver; turn count and cache-aware loop design matter more.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is directly relevant to test-time compute, agent scaling, and serving economics. The contribution is a systems-style measurement study and cost model rather than a new agent architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze 600 public coding-agent trajectories and decompose observation length, prefix-cache hit rate, and delegation break-even conditions. They frame the problem as loop engineering: context management, model selection, compaction, and termination should be optimized around turn cost rather than raw observation size. A closed-form delegation criterion is derived and empirically validated.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 600 trajectories from two agent scaffolds and two language models. Key findings include median observations of only 118-286 tokens, large build logs appearing near the 99th percentile, 98.6% of input tokens served from prefix cache, roughly 7x average cost overestimation under flat input pricing, and delegation increasing cost in half of the evaluated cases. This is a measurement paper, not a benchmark-chasing one.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain，但会改你对 agent 成本的 prior：先看缓存命中和 turn 数，再谈 observation 压缩；读摘要和成本公式就够了。
recommendation.en: It won’t change pretraining, but it should change your agent-cost prior: inspect cache hit rate and turn count before optimizing observation compression; abstract plus the cost formula is enough.

paper.title: DuoDiscover: Scaling Autonomous Discovery Beyond the Evaluation Bottleneck
paper.abstract: Evaluation has been central to advances in AI, and it is equally critical to autonomous discovery. Yet scaling autonomous discovery to real-world engineering challenges faces a fundamental bottleneck: the cost of evaluating progress. In real settings, a single true evaluation, such as a full benchmark or serving trace, can take hours, so a search can afford only a handful of true evaluations. We present DuoDiscover, a search system that jointly discovers what to optimize and how to evaluate prog

summary.core_problem: 解决自主发现系统在真实工程任务中被昂贵评测卡住的问题：一次真实评测可能要跑完整 benchmark 或 serving trace，导致搜索只能尝试很少候选。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agentic search 系统创新。它把“优化什么”和“如何低成本评估进展”放在同一个搜索循环里处理，切中了工程型 coding agent 从 demo 走向真实优化任务时的主要瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DuoDiscover：多个 coding agent worker 各自发现优化目标和一个快速代理评测器，称为 yardstick；worker 主要在 yardstick 上 hill-climb，而不是频繁调用真实评测；系统用 fidelity tests 持续检查 yardstick 的排序是否仍然贴近真实目标，一旦漂移就失效；整体采用自底向上的 fleet 设计，不依赖中心化任务分解。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、具体任务数或提升幅度。实验设定强调真实工程优化中评测昂贵，例如完整 benchmark 或 serving trace 级别的评测需要小时级成本，并比较在少量真实评测预算下的搜索效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the evaluation bottleneck in autonomous discovery: in real engineering settings, a single true evaluation can take hours, leaving only a few full evaluations for search.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agentic search system. It treats target discovery and cheap progress measurement as coupled problems, which is the right failure mode to study for coding agents moving from demos to real optimization loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: DuoDiscover runs a fleet of coding-agent workers. Each worker co-discovers an optimization target and a fast proxy evaluator, called a yardstick, then hill-climbs against that yardstick instead of repeatedly invoking the true objective. Fidelity tests periodically check whether each yardstick still preserves the true ranking and invalidate proxies that drift. The fleet is bottom-up rather than centrally decomposed.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model scale, number of tasks, or numeric gains. The experimental framing is real engineering optimization with expensive true evaluations, such as full benchmarks or serving traces that take hours, under a small true-evaluation budget.

recommendation.zh: 读系统设计和 fidelity test 部分即可；它对 pretrain 不直接，但对低预算评测下的自动化消融搜索有可迁移价值。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and fidelity-test sections; it is not pretraining work, but the low-budget evaluation loop transfers to automated ablation search.

paper.title: SPROUT: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Software Engineering
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has driven substantial progress in coding agents by relying on verified successful trajectories as learning signals. However, such trajectories are scarce in long-horizon software engineering tasks, where a minor error can invalidate the entire rollout. Repeatedly restarting from the initial state is commonly used yet inefficient, and resetting only the context with working directory misses state changes such as installed dependencies. Therefore, branching from interm

summary.core_problem: 长程软件工程任务中的 RL 训练很难获得完整成功轨迹；一旦中途出错，从初始状态反复重启既低效，也会丢失已完成的环境状态与上下文。
summary.importance: 这是 coding agent 的训练基础设施工作，重点不是新模型，而是把 rollout 单位从“整条轨迹”改成“可回溯、可分叉的中间状态”。对预训练研究员的启发在于：长程任务的学习信号可能更依赖状态恢复与 credit assignment 设计，而不是继续堆更大模型。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPROUT（SnaPshot-based RollOUT）：在每个 assistant turn 后同时 checkpoint 文件系统和 agent context，使训练可以从中间状态恢复并分叉，而不是只重置上下文或工作目录。其上再叠加 verifier-guided backtracking policy，从中间节点选择更有希望的分支继续探索。核心是把环境状态、依赖安装、文件改动和对话上下文统一纳入可恢复快照。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark 分数、模型规模或提升幅度，但明确针对 long-horizon software engineering RL。关键实验应包括：与从头重启、仅恢复 context、仅恢复 working directory 的对比；验证 snapshot+backtracking 是否提高成功率、样本效率和有效 credit assignment。若正文没有严格控制每步 compute 与分支预算，结论需要保守看。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon software engineering RL, successful full trajectories are rare; restarting from scratch after each mistake is inefficient and loses valuable environment state and context.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent training infrastructure paper. The main idea is to change the rollout unit from a full trajectory to recoverable, branchable intermediate states. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is that long-horizon learning may depend more on state restoration and credit assignment design than on simply scaling the model.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPROUT (SnaPshot-based RollOUT) checkpoints both the filesystem and the agent context after each assistant turn, so training can resume and branch from intermediate states instead of only resetting context or working directory. On top of that, a verifier-guided backtracking policy selects promising branches to continue exploration. The key is to make environment state, installed dependencies, file edits, and dialogue context jointly recoverable.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmark scores, model sizes, or exact gains, but the target setting is long-horizon software engineering RL. The critical comparisons should be against restart-from-scratch, context-only reset, and working-directory-only reset, measuring success rate, sample efficiency, and credit assignment quality. If the full paper does not tightly control per-step compute and branching budget, the conclusions should be treated cautiously.

recommendation.zh: 这篇更像 RL 基础设施而非算法突破，但长程任务里“状态可恢复”常比 reward 花样更关键；先看 snapshot 粒度和 backtracking 开销是否算清楚。
recommendation.en: This is more RL infrastructure than algorithmic novelty, but in long-horizon tasks recoverable state often matters more than fancy rewards; check whether snapshot granularity and backtracking cost are accounted for cleanly.

paper.title: LAGO: Language Agents with Reusable Growing Options
paper.abstract: Long-horizon tasks expose a weakness of monolithic tool-use loops: one agent must decompose, execute, and verify a task within a single trajectory. We introduce LAGO, which treats specialized language agents as reusable temporally extended options. A meta-agent retrieves options from a persistent library or spawns new ones, dispatches sub-tasks, verifies results, and admits successful novel options. The library grows across tasks without updating model weights. On 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks, f

summary.core_problem: 解决长程软件工程任务中单体 agent 在分解、执行、验证都塞进单条轨迹时容易失效的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 coding agent 系统设计工作，贡献在把 specialized agents 组织成可复用、可增长的 options library，而不是更新模型权重。对预训练研究员的直接价值有限，但对 test-time compute 组织和 agent memory 设计有一点参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LAGO，将专门化语言 agent 视作 temporally extended options。一个 meta-agent 负责从持久化库中检索已有 option 或生成新 option，分派子任务、验证结果，并把成功的新 option 写回库中。核心是跨任务积累可复用技能，而非在线 finetune。
summary.experiments: 在 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务上，冻结的 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 作为 meta-agent 和 option agent，单次评测 resolve rate 为 58.6%。在固定 150 题子集上，与 mini-SWE-agent、Terminus 2 对齐 policy、temperature、task IDs 和 evaluator 后，分别为 49.3%、57.3%、60.3%。50 题消融显示去掉 decomposition 少解 4 题，去掉其他组件少解 2 题以上。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the failure mode of monolithic coding agents on long-horizon software tasks, where decomposition, execution, and verification are all forced into a single trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent systems paper. Its contribution is to organize specialized agents as reusable and growing options without weight updates. The direct value to pretraining researchers is limited, but it offers some ideas about test-time compute organization and persistent skill memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes LAGO, which treats specialized language agents as temporally extended options. A meta-agent retrieves options from a persistent library or spawns new ones, dispatches subtasks, verifies outputs, and stores successful new options back into the library. The key idea is cross-task skill accumulation without online finetuning.
summary_en.experiments: On 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks, frozen Qwen3.5-35B-A3B used in both roles reaches 58.6% resolve rate under single-attempt official evaluation. On a fixed 150-task subset with matched policy, temperature, task IDs, and evaluator, mini-SWE-agent, Terminus 2, and LAGO score 49.3%, 57.3%, and 60.3%. A 50-task ablation shows decomposition alone accounts for four resolved tasks.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把 test-time skill accumulation 做得比“多 agent 套娃”更规整；只看实验设定和 ablation，别被系统包装带跑。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it structures test-time skill accumulation more cleanly than the usual multi-agent nesting; read the eval setup and ablations, not the packaging.

paper.title: SpecForge: Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents via Behavioral Specifications
paper.abstract: Coding agents based on frozen language models can improve their performance by refining the external context they rely on, without updating model weights. We study recursive self-improvement through behavioral specifications: natural-language code documentation that describes the behavior of program entities and guides agents in generating correct code. We formulate a self-improvement loop in which an agent generates code from its current specifications, evaluates it with execution-verified test

summary.core_problem: 如何通过自然语言行为规范（behavioral specifications）实现冻结语言模型驱动的 Coding Agent 的递归自我改进，并解决代码实体间的输出耦合（output coupling）问题？
summary.importance: 方法创新。提出了一种无需更新模型权重的自我改进机制，揭示了在代码生成任务中，局部规范的改进可能导致全局退化的“打地鼠”效应，并提出了缓解策略。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个自我改进循环：Agent 根据当前规范生成代码，通过执行验证测试进行评估，并基于观察到的失败改进规范。为了解决输出耦合问题，引入了 SpecForge 框架，通过特定的策略（如隔离测试、依赖感知更新等，具体需看正文）来管理实体间的依赖关系。
summary.experiments: 在代码生成任务上验证了 SpecForge 的有效性，展示了其在缓解输出耦合和提升整体代码正确性方面的优势。

summary_en.core_problem: How to enable recursive self-improvement of frozen language model-based coding agents via natural-language behavioral specifications, and address the output coupling problem among code entities?
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation. Proposes a self-improvement mechanism without updating model weights, reveals the 'whack-a-mole' effect where local specification improvements cause global regressions in code generation, and proposes mitigation strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a self-improvement loop: the agent generates code from current specifications, evaluates it with execution-verified tests, and refines specifications based on observed failures. To address output coupling, introduces the SpecForge framework, which manages entity dependencies through specific strategies (e.g., isolated testing, dependency-aware updates, details in paper).
