summary_en.experiments: Validated the effectiveness of SpecForge on code generation tasks, demonstrating its advantages in mitigating output coupling and improving overall code correctness.

recommendation.zh: 关注 test-time scaling 和 agent self-improvement 的可以扫一眼，核心 insight 是代码实体间的耦合会导致局部优化带来全局退化。
recommendation.en: Glance for those interested in test-time scaling and agent self-improvement; the core insight is that coupling between code entities causes local optimizations to lead to global regressions.

paper.title: Scaling Inference-Time Compute with Teams of Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems promise a new axis for scaling inference: rather than having one agent think longer or sample more attempts, a task is split across many agents that work in parallel and coordinate. However, in practice, more agents can easily produce duplicate work, coordination failures, and higher costs. We therefore formulate team design as a compute allocation problem: starting from a solo agent, where should additional inference compute go to reach the reward-cost Pareto frontier? We bu

summary.core_problem: 研究 coding agent 的 inference-time compute 应该如何在多 agent 团队中分配，才能在 reward-cost Pareto frontier 上获得更好性价比。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 inference-time scaling 与 agent 系统分析。它把“增加 agent 数量”从经验工程问题改写为 compute allocation 问题，并明确比较规划、实现、验证等不同委派阶段的边际收益和成本。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 solo coding agent 出发，构建一个最小化 multi-agent harness，逐一改变 lead 委派给 worker 的阶段、团队中模型组合、worker 数量，并追踪 reward-cost Pareto frontier。重点不是提出复杂框架，而是把变量控制干净，估计额外推理计算花在哪里更划算。
summary.experiments: 实验在 ProgramBench 上进行。多 agent team 通常优于 solo agent，但成本提高约 3 到 7 倍。合适的计算分配可以让一个 heterogeneous 17-agent team 在分数上只比 strong homogeneous 5-agent team 低 1.4 分，同时成本降低约 70%。
summary.authors_note: Nouha Dziri 以语言模型推理、事实性和评测相关工作为代表；机构信息未从摘要中完整确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how inference-time compute should be allocated across teams of coding agents to reach a better reward-cost Pareto frontier.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time scaling and agent-systems contribution. It reframes adding more agents as a compute-allocation problem and measures the marginal value of delegating planning, implementation, or verification work.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from a solo coding agent, the authors build a minimal multi-agent harness and vary one factor at a time: the workflow stage where a lead delegates to workers, the models used in the team, and the number of workers. The emphasis is controlled measurement of where extra inference compute is useful.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on ProgramBench. Teams outperform solo agents but cost roughly 3x to 7x more. With appropriate allocation, a heterogeneous 17-agent team comes within 1.4 points of a strong homogeneous 5-agent team while using about 70% lower cost.
summary_en.authors_note: Nouha Dziri is known for work on language-model reasoning, factuality, and evaluation; the full affiliation set is not confirmed from the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把多 agent 当 compute allocation 看是对的；只看 Pareto 曲线和 worker 数 ablation，别被团队规模叙事带跑。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the compute-allocation framing; read the Pareto and worker-count ablations, not the team-size narrative.

paper.title: SWEPatchTest: Evaluating Software Tests Beyond Reproduction
paper.abstract: Coding agents use generated tests to decide whether a proposed patch satisfies an issue's requirements. A suite that fails on the buggy program and passes after applying the reference patch can still accept an incorrect patch or reject a correct patch. We introduce SWEPATCHTEST, a test-generation benchmark with 619 tasks from SWE-bench Pro, SWE-bench Multilingual, and DeepSWE and 82,579 candidate patches collected from coding-agent trajectories. By replaying each suite on the buggy and patched c

summary.core_problem: 评估 coding agent 生成的测试是否真的能验证补丁正确性，而不只是复现“buggy 失败、reference patch 通过”的单一转移。
summary.importance: 这是软件工程 agent 评测资产。它指出测试生成 benchmark 中常见的 reproduction 指标会高估测试质量，并提出同时衡量复现 bug、接受正确补丁、拒绝错误补丁的联合验证指标。
summary.technical_approach: SWEPatchTest 包含 619 个来自 SWE-bench Pro、SWE-bench Multilingual 和 DeepSWE 的任务，以及从 coding-agent 轨迹中收集的 82,579 个候选补丁。每个生成测试套件会在 buggy 和 patched codebase 上重放，并用 Joint Validation Rate 同时要求三项条件在同一任务上成立。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告，最佳配置能在 59.29% 任务上复现 reference transition，但 JVR 只有 9.21%，说明单参考转移远不足以证明测试有效。论文还用 validation score 选择和扩展 demonstrations 做 SFT，但摘要未给出 SFT 后完整提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluate whether tests generated by coding agents actually validate patch correctness, rather than merely reproducing the buggy-to-reference transition.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation asset for software-engineering agents. It argues that reproduction-only metrics overestimate test quality and introduces a joint metric covering bug reproduction, acceptance of correct patches, and rejection of incorrect patches.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWEPatchTest contains 619 tasks from SWE-bench Pro, SWE-bench Multilingual, and DeepSWE, plus 82,579 candidate patches collected from coding-agent trajectories. Generated test suites are replayed on buggy and patched codebases. Joint Validation Rate requires all three validation criteria to hold on the same task.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that the best configuration reproduces the reference transition on 59.29% of tasks but reaches only 9.21% JVR, revealing failures hidden by single-reference evaluation. The paper also uses validation scores to select and scale demonstrations for SFT, though the abstract does not report full post-SFT gains.

recommendation.zh: 这是 coding-agent eval 里比较干净的负例集合；重点看 JVR 定义和 59.29% 到 9.21% 的落差。
recommendation.en: This is a fairly clean negative set for coding-agent evaluation; focus on the JVR definition and the drop from 59.29% reproduction to 9.21% JVR.

paper.title: PhysCodeGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Physically Verifiable 4D Reconstruction
paper.abstract: Building physical simulations from video requires coding agents to translate observations into executable models and refine them through tool use. We introduce PhysCodeGym, a benchmark for physically verifiable 4D reconstruction with $156$ tasks covering rigid-body, liquid, deformable, and wind-driven motion. Agents autonomously inspect videos, write and run Blender programs, and revise their scenes using simulation feedback. Six metrics combine rule-based measurements with rubric-based judgment

summary.core_problem: 现有 coding agent 评测很少检验从视频观察构建可执行物理仿真的能力，尤其缺少可验证的 4D reconstruction 任务。
summary.importance: 贡献是 PhysCodeGym，一个面向 coding agent 的物理可验证 benchmark。它把视频理解、程序生成、工具使用、仿真反馈和反事实物理一致性放在同一评测闭环里，对通用 Agent 能力评估有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: benchmark 包含 156 个任务，覆盖刚体、液体、可形变物体和风驱动运动。Agent 需要检查视频，编写并运行 Blender 程序，再根据 simulation feedback 修改场景。评测使用 6 类指标，结合 rule-based measurements 与 rubric-based judgments；还通过程序检查、场景测量和 counterfactual interventions 检验物理一致性。
summary.experiments: 作者测试了多个 frontier coding agents。结果显示，不同 reasoning-effort 设置下存在 artifact quality 与 task completion 的权衡；harness 对比和 agent trace 分析把 verification behavior 与 reconstruction performance 联系起来。案例显示，匹配可见物体和事件并不保证反事实物理一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: Current coding-agent evaluations rarely test whether agents can build executable physical simulations from video, especially under physically verifiable 4D reconstruction tasks.
summary_en.importance: PhysCodeGym is a benchmark for physically verifiable coding agents. It connects video understanding, program synthesis, tool use, simulation feedback, and counterfactual physical consistency in one evaluation loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 156 tasks spanning rigid-body, liquid, deformable, and wind-driven motion. Agents inspect videos, write and run Blender programs, and revise scenes using simulation feedback. Six metrics combine rule-based measurements and rubric-based judgments, with program inspection, scene measurements, and counterfactual interventions testing physical consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates several frontier coding agents. It reports a tradeoff between artifact quality and completion under different reasoning-effort settings, and uses harness comparisons plus agent traces to link verification behavior with reconstruction performance. Case studies show that matching visible objects and events can coexist with poor counterfactual physical consistency.

recommendation.zh: 看 metric 和反事实干预设计即可；它是好 eval 资产，但对基座训练只提供间接压力信号。
recommendation.en: Read the metrics and counterfactual interventions; it is a useful eval asset, but only an indirect signal for foundation-model training.

paper.title: SWE-MISBEHAVIOR: Benchmarking and Mitigating Boundary Violations in Software Coding Agents
paper.abstract: We present SWE-MISBEHAVIOR, the first taxonomy and evaluation framework for diagnosing boundary-violating misbehaviors in coding agents. It contains 7.4K human-in-the-loop synthesized samples spanning three layers of agent action space: (i) Code Generation, (ii) File Management, and (iii) System Interaction. Across these categories, SWE-MISBEHAVIOR covers 11 distinct misbehaviors with a fully automated evaluation protocol, including coding-action violations, Create/Read/Update/Delete (CRUD) file

summary.core_problem: 现有 coding agent 评测多关注能否完成任务，缺少对越界行为的系统诊断，例如误改用户输入、破坏文件环境、滥用系统交互等。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark 和 evaluation protocol。SWE-MISBEHAVIOR 给出 coding agent 边界违规的 taxonomy、7.4K human-in-the-loop 合成样本和自动评测流程，补上了软件工程 agent 安全评测中的一块缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 agent 行为空间分为 Code Generation、File Management、System Interaction 三层，覆盖 11 类 misbehavior。数据由 human-in-the-loop 合成，评测协议自动化执行；此外提出 CODE-KIT，一个轻量自适应缓解框架，用 misbehavior-aware 信号约束 agent 行为。
summary.experiments: 实验评估了 OpenHands、smolagents 等开源 coding agents。结果显示越界行为很常见：dependency misinterpretation 最高达到 98.5%，unintended modification of user inputs 达到 50.5%，silent compromise of environment integrity 达到 53%。摘要未给出 CODE-KIT 的完整提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Most coding-agent evaluations focus on task success and under-measure boundary violations such as unintended edits, file-system misuse, and unsafe system interactions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark and evaluation-protocol contribution. SWE-MISBEHAVIOR introduces a taxonomy, 7.4K human-in-the-loop synthesized cases, and an automated evaluation setup for diagnosing boundary violations in software agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark decomposes the agent action space into code generation, file management, and system interaction, covering 11 misbehavior types. It uses human-in-the-loop synthetic cases and automated checks, and adds CODE-KIT as a lightweight adaptive mitigation framework driven by misbehavior-aware signals.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates open-source coding agents including OpenHands and smolagents. Reported failure rates are high: dependency misinterpretation reaches 98.5%, unintended modification of user inputs reaches 50.5%, and silent compromise of environment integrity reaches 53%. The abstract does not provide the full mitigation numbers for CODE-KIT.

recommendation.zh: 看 taxonomy 和错误率表；它把 coding agent 的失败从“做不对”拆到“越界做”，更贴近后训练约束。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and failure-rate tables; it reframes coding-agent failure from just wrong answers to boundary violations, which is closer to useful post-training constraints.

paper.title: CodeLift: Your Test Suite Is Secretly a Dense SWE Curriculum
paper.abstract: The pass-all-test binary reward has become a standard recipe for training software engineering agents, but its sparsity eliminates difference of partially correct patches. The test pass-rate is a natural alternative. However, we find that it is not a reliable indicator of patch quality. A functionality being tested can be covered by either one challenging test or one hundred trivial tests, where the majority might be already satisfied pass-to-pass tests. We introduce CodeLift, a reinforcement le

summary.core_problem: 解决 SWE agent 训练中 pass-all-tests 二值奖励过稀疏、而原始 test pass-rate 又不能真实反映补丁质量的问题。
summary.importance: 这是后训练侧的代码 agent 强化学习方法。价值不在代码修复本身，而在它把稀疏程序验证信号重写成动态课程奖励，对 RL 训练信号设计有可迁移启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CodeLift：在每轮训练中，把“杀死相同补丁的测试”和“通过相同测试的补丁”分别聚类，再对更少补丁组能通过的测试组赋更高权重。这样把测试套件转成难度自适应课程，降低大量简单测试对奖励的淹没效应；同时在 rollout 内对仓库快照使用同一评分规则，为中间有用动作分配 credit。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量，但任务显然是软件工程 agent / 代码修复 RL。核心比较对象包括 pass-all-tests 二值奖励、原始 pass-rate 奖励，以及可能的仓库级 credit assignment 基线；论文声称通过动态校准后能更稳定地区分部分正确补丁并提升训练效果。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Pinjia He，长期从事软件工程与智能代码系统研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between sparse pass-all-tests rewards and misleading raw test pass-rate rewards when training SWE agents.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method for coding agents. Its value is not the repair task itself, but the redesign of program-verification signals into a dynamic curriculum, which may transfer to RL signal design more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach: CodeLift dynamically calibrates test rewards by grouping tests that kill the same patches and patches that pass the same tests, then upweighting test groups passed by fewer patch groups. This turns the test suite into an adaptive curriculum and also applies the same scoring rule to repository snapshots for within-rollout credit assignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, but the setting is clearly software engineering agent RL. Key baselines include binary pass-all-tests rewards, raw pass-rate rewards, and likely repository-level credit assignment baselines; the claim is that dynamic calibration better distinguishes partially correct patches and improves training.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Pinjia He, known for work in software engineering and intelligent code systems.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“验证器输出如何变成可学奖励”讲得比很多 RLHF 工作更干净；先看奖励构造和组权重定义，别被 SWE 外壳劝退。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it treats the conversion from verifier outputs to learnable rewards more cleanly than many RLHF papers; read the reward construction and grouping scheme, not the SWE wrapper.

paper.title: ReTerm: Recovery Training for Self-Improving Terminal Agents
paper.abstract: Terminal agents have shown strong abilities in complex coding tasks. However, they often struggle to recover from errors during long-running execution (e.g., command errors, faulty implementations), eventually leading to task failures. To this end, we present ReTerm, a self-improving terminal agent trained by learning how to recover from its own failed terminal tasks. To support its training, we construct a customized data pipeline and produce ReTerm-10K, a high-quality dataset that provides eff

summary.core_problem: 提升终端编码 agent 在长程执行中从命令错误、实现错误和中间失败状态恢复的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding agent 后训练方法，而不是单纯 benchmark 刷分。它把训练起点从任务初始状态扩展到 agent 自己制造的失败状态，直接优化长程执行中的 recovery skill，这对 RLVR 和 agent training 的状态分布设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReTerm。先构造 ReTerm-10K，用高质量恢复示范做 SFT cold start。随后使用 ReTerm-GRPO：从 agent 自身失败的 terminal states 分叉，生成多个独立恢复尝试，根据这些尝试是否最终完成任务来更新策略。关键点是训练分布贴近真实错误状态，而不是只从干净初始任务采样。
summary.experiments: 基于 Qwen3.5-9B 训练 ReTerm-9B，在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上达到 34.8% Pass@1，相比 base model 提升 14.6 个百分点。摘要还提到进一步分析显示恢复训练带来错误恢复能力提升，但细节未完整给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves terminal coding agents' ability to recover from command errors, faulty implementations, and intermediate failures during long-running execution.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for coding agents, not just benchmark tuning. It moves training from clean initial states to the agent's own failed states, directly optimizing recovery behavior under realistic execution distributions.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReTerm first builds ReTerm-10K, a dataset of high-quality recovery demonstrations for SFT cold start. ReTerm-GRPO then forks from the agent's own failed terminal states, samples multiple independent recovery attempts, and learns from whether these attempts eventually complete the task. The key design is to train on the failure-state distribution the agent actually visits.
summary_en.experiments: Built on Qwen3.5-9B, ReTerm-9B reaches 34.8% Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0, improving over the base model by 14.6 points. The abstract also reports analysis showing improved recovery behavior, but the supplied excerpt does not include full ablations.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 ReTerm-GRPO 的状态分叉设计；它比常规全轨迹 RL 更贴近 agent 真正崩掉的位置。
recommendation.en: Read the failure-state forking design in ReTerm-GRPO; it targets where agents actually break, unlike cleaner full-episode RL.

paper.title: StateHarness: Maintaining Evolving Project State for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon coding requires agents to maintain an evolving view of the project they are changing: what problem is currently being solved, what has already been learned or modified, which other artifacts may be affected, and what work remains unresolved. When this information is scattered across a growing interaction history, local edits can become disconnected from their later consequences and progress can be difficult to carry forward. We introduce StateHarness, a runtime framework that mainta

summary.core_problem: 解决长周期代码代理在多轮修改中无法持续维护项目状态、导致局部编辑与后续影响脱节的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个运行时系统设计工作，不改模型参数，而是改代理如何外置和维护工作记忆。对做长程 agent、仓库级编辑和上下文管理的人有参考价值，但对基座预训练本身的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 StateHarness，在代理运行时持续记录当前问题、假设、关键发现、已做决策、仓库依赖关系和未完成事项；同时提供受影响调用方、测试、文档的检索支持，并维护紧凑工作摘要供后续决策使用。当行为信号累积后，再启动独立诊断会话回看历史并修正状态。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，工作重点是长周期 coding agent 的运行时框架，而非新模型训练。摘要未给出明确参数规模、训练数据或标准基线数字；应主要比较有无状态维护时在长程仓库任务上的完成率、错误传播和恢复能力。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the failure of long-horizon coding agents to maintain an evolving project state, causing local edits to drift away from downstream consequences.
summary_en.importance: This is a runtime systems paper rather than a model-training paper. It is relevant for long-horizon agents, repository-level editing, and context management, but only indirectly useful for foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: StateHarness maintains explicit external state during execution: current problem and hypothesis, important findings, decisions, repository relations, and unresolved work. It also provides runtime support for impact search over callers, tests, and docs, and keeps a compact working brief for future decisions. A separate diagnostic session revisits the recorded history when behavioral signals accumulate.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the focus is on a runtime framework for long-horizon coding agents rather than new model training. No model scale, training corpus, or concrete baseline numbers are given in the abstract; the likely evaluation compares task completion, error propagation, and recovery with and without explicit state maintenance.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent memory engineering，不会改你的 pretrain prior；若你做仓库级代码代理，只看状态表示和诊断回路设计即可。
recommendation.en: This is agent-memory engineering, not something that changes pretraining priors; if you build repo-scale coding agents, just inspect the state schema and diagnostic loop.

paper.title: Do Theorem Provers Need Theorem-Proving Agents? mini-Lean-agent: A Coding-Agent Baseline for Lean
paper.abstract: General-purpose coding agents use standard shell and file interactions, yet formal theorem-proving agents often rely on specialized, ad-hoc tooling. This makes it difficult to determine which components of theorem-proving agents provide benchmark gains: an improved base model, a specialized harness, a specific tool, or a combination of any of them. We introduce mini-Lean-agent, a deliberately minimal agent for Lean tasks whose only model-visible tool is bash. The model must use bash to inspect a

summary.core_problem: 形式化定理证明 Agent 的工具链过于专用，导致很难判断性能提升来自模型、执行脚手架、检索工具，还是它们的组合。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个刻意极简的 Lean Coding-Agent baseline，用通用 shell/file 交互替代专用定理证明工具。它的价值在于把 Lean 任务拉回通用 coding agent 设定，便于做更干净的组件归因。
summary.technical_approach: mini-Lean-agent 只向模型暴露 bash。模型需要通过 bash 查看和编辑仓库、搜索本地库、调用 Lean、管理中间文件；最终产物由独立可信 evaluator 验证。方法重点不是新模型，而是限制工具接口，减少专用 harness 带来的混杂因素。
summary.experiments: 在 Putnam 2025 benchmark 上，与 AxProverBase 和 Numina-Lean-Agent 比较。使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 时，mini-Lean-agent 在每题 2 美元预算下解出 7/12，AxProverBase 为 4/12。使用 Astra 作为 base model 时，摘要显示 mini-Lean-agent 解出 12/12，并报告平均成本但摘要被截断。
summary.authors_note: Sanjeev Arora 是 Princeton 理论计算机科学和机器学习方向的知名研究者；Alex Kontorovich 是数论和数学方向知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Specialized theorem-proving agents make it hard to attribute benchmark gains to the base model, the harness, the tools, or their interaction.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a deliberately minimal Lean coding-agent baseline that replaces theorem-proving-specific tooling with standard shell and file interactions. Its main value is cleaner attribution for Lean-agent results.
summary_en.technical_approach: mini-Lean-agent exposes only bash to the model. The model must inspect and edit repositories, search local libraries, invoke Lean, and manage intermediate work through bash, while a separate trusted evaluator checks the final artifact. The novelty is in the constrained agent interface rather than a new model.
summary_en.experiments: On the Putnam 2025 benchmark, mini-Lean-agent is compared with AxProverBase and Numina-Lean-Agent. With Gemini 3.8 Flash, it solves 7/12 problems under a $2-per-problem limit, versus 4/12 for AxProverBase. With Astra as the base model, the abstract reports 12/12 solved, with the cost details truncated.
summary_en.authors_note: Sanjeev Arora is a well-known Princeton researcher in theoretical computer science and machine learning; Alex Kontorovich is a well-known mathematician.

recommendation.zh: Lean agent 的 clean baseline，读实验表即可；它提醒别把专用 harness 的收益误判成模型能力。
recommendation.en: A clean Lean-agent baseline; read the experiment table, mainly as a warning against confusing harness gains with model gains.

paper.title: SWE-Critix: Post-Training Generalist Verifiers for Assessing Coding-Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for end-to-end software engineering tasks, where a readily available oracle evaluator that defines the success criteria is often absent. This motivates verifications for coding agents that can reliably judge and explain their behavior. However, verification is non-trivial as coding agents are increasingly capable of solving long-horizon software engineering tasks. Their execution trajectories can be extremely long, containing hundreds of iterative interact

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 在长轨迹软件工程任务中缺少可靠 verifier 的问题：不仅要判断是否完成任务，还要能解释轨迹质量。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测/验证方法，而不是代码 agent 本体。对 pretrain 研究员的价值在于：它把“长轨迹、无 oracle、需要可训练 verifier”这件事系统化，和 RL、process supervision、trajectory filtering 都有接口。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SWE-Critix，一个 post-training 管线，用来训练通用的 coding-agent trajectory verifier。输入任务与执行轨迹，输出完成度判断及解释，而不是只给标量 reward。方法重点在把长轨迹验证从通用 LLM judge 或单纯 reward critic，转成专门训练的 generalist verifier。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示评测对象是长时程软件工程轨迹，轨迹可包含数百步与仓库、工具的交互。对比基线包括未专门训练的通用 LLM judge，以及主要输出 scalar reward 的 critic。摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模和数值提升，但任务设定本身对 verifier 训练很有代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of reliable verifiers for coding agents on long-horizon software engineering tasks, where one needs not only a success judgment but also an explanation of trajectory quality.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is evaluation and verification rather than a coding agent itself. For pretraining researchers, the value is that it systematizes the need for trainable verifiers under long trajectories and missing oracles, which connects naturally to RL, process supervision, and trajectory filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces SWE-Critix, a post-training pipeline for training generalist verifiers of coding-agent trajectories. Given a task and an execution trajectory, the verifier predicts completion and provides explanations, instead of only emitting a scalar reward. The key move is to replace generic LLM judges or scalar critics with a specialized trained verifier.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation on long-horizon software engineering trajectories, potentially hundreds of steps with repositories and external tools. Baselines include untuned general-purpose LLM judges and critics focused on scalar rewards. The abstract does not provide benchmark names, model sizes, or exact gains, but the setup is representative for verifier training.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 process supervision 或 RL verifier，这篇可看；先看 verifier label 设计和长轨迹截断策略，若只是把 judge 微调一下，增量就比较明显。
recommendation.en: Read it if you care about process supervision or RL verifiers; start with the label design and long-trajectory handling. If it turns out to be just a finetuned judge, the contribution is mostly incremental.

paper.title: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
paper.abstract: As the production of software passes into the hands of software itself, coding agents are increasingly commissioned to build agents fitted to their users' own workflows. This delegation carries a quiet assumption, that the delivered agent will faithfully serve the requirement it was built for, rather than merely appear to. No existing benchmark tests that assumption. We introduce AgentSWE, a benchmark for agent software engineering spanning three stages of the agent development lifecycle: Creati

summary.core_problem: 现有 coding agent 评测大多考代码修补或题目求解，缺少对“代理是否真的按需求构建出可用 agent 软件”这一更接近真实委托场景的检验。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测贡献。它把 agent software engineering 从单点代码修改，扩展到从自然语言需求创建 agent、编辑已有 agent 代码库、以及围绕可测目标做优化三类任务，评测对象从“会不会写代码”转向“是否满足需求并在留出用例上可靠工作”。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgentSWE benchmark。每个任务被表述为一项真实委托而不是考试题：模型可以基于少量示例迭代开发，但最终验收在冻结提交上、用覆盖完整需求的 held-out cases 和 requirement-derived rubrics 做 hard pass/fail 或目标分数评估。核心设计点是把 agent 构建生命周期拆成 Creation、Editing、Optimization 三阶段，并强调表面通过示例与真实满足需求之间的差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出 25 个任务，覆盖 agent 开发生命周期三阶段。由于提供信息有限，无法确认完整参评模型、基线和具体分数；但从设计上看，它更像 SWE-bench 之后面向 agent-building 的补位 benchmark，重点不是追求大规模，而是提高验收信号的真实性和需求覆盖度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing coding-agent evaluations mostly test patching or problem solving, but do not ask whether an agent can actually build the agent software a user requested and make it work beyond visible examples.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. It shifts the target from “can the model write code” to “can it satisfy a software commission,” covering agent creation, editing, and optimization with held-out acceptance tests tied to the original requirements.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces AgentSWE, a benchmark where each task is framed as a commission rather than an exam. Builders iterate against a few illustrative cases, while final acceptance runs on frozen submissions using held-out cases and requirement-derived rubrics, with hard pass/fail gates or measurable optimization targets. The benchmark spans Creation, Editing, and Optimization stages of the agent development lifecycle.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states 25 tasks across three lifecycle stages. Full model roster, baselines, and quantitative results are not available from the provided text. The value appears to be in benchmark design and stronger acceptance criteria rather than scale.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 agent 训练信号质量，这篇值得看 benchmark 设计而不是榜单；重点看它如何把“看起来能用”和“留出验收真能过”分开。
recommendation.en: Read this for the benchmark design, not the leaderboard; the useful bit is how it separates looking functional from actually passing held-out acceptance tied to requirements.

paper.title: Quality, Not Just Outcome: A Structural Scoring Framework for Selecting Coding-Agent Trajectories for Supervised Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Open coding agents are commonly trained through supervised fine-tuning on interaction trajectories whose final patches pass the benchmark test suite. However, this outcome-level filtering criterion ignores process quality: trajectories that eventually succeed may still contain inefficient interaction patterns such as repetitive file inspection, unstable tool usage, or delayed modification behavior, all of which become part of the imitation target. We propose TQS (Trajectory Quality Score), a str

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent SFT 数据筛选只看最终测试是否通过、忽略交互过程质量的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练数据选择方法。它把轨迹的结构质量作为 imitation target 的过滤信号，提醒代码智能训练不能只把成功结果当作干净监督。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TQS，一个不依赖 LLM judge、线性时间运行的轨迹结构评分框架。评分围绕 structured convergence 组织，包含信息聚焦、意图-动作一致性、策略动态等信号，用来识别重复检索、工具使用不稳定、修改时机滞后等低质量成功轨迹。
summary.experiments: 使用公开开放许可语料中的 155,144 条成功 coding-agent 轨迹，按 TQS 排序并用不同过滤子集进行 SFT。摘要显示 top-ranked 轨迹训练出的模型优于未过滤或低质量子集，但具体模型规模、baseline 和提升幅度需看正文确认。
summary.authors_note: Xu Sun 是北京大学 NLP 方向研究者，长期关注语言模型、代码智能与训练数据方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses trajectory selection for coding-agent SFT when final test success ignores poor interaction processes.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training data selection method. It argues that successful patches are not automatically clean imitation targets, because inefficient or unstable tool-use patterns are also learned during SFT.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes TQS, a linear-time structural scoring framework that does not use an LLM judge. TQS scores trajectories through structured convergence signals, including information focus, intent-action alignment, and policy dynamics, to detect repetitive inspection, unstable tool use, and delayed edits.
summary_en.experiments: The study ranks 155,144 successful trajectories from a public open-license corpus and fine-tunes coding agents on filtered subsets. The abstract reports better models from top-ranked trajectories, but exact model sizes, baselines, and gains require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Xu Sun is a Peking University NLP researcher known for work on language models, code intelligence, and training data methods.

recommendation.zh: 过程质量筛 trajectory 的信号可迁移到 agent SFT 数据清洗；只看 TQS 指标定义和过滤曲线即可。
recommendation.en: The transferable part is trajectory-quality filtering for agent SFT data; read the TQS definition and filtering curves, not the narrative.

paper.title: Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that

summary.core_problem: 研究 coding agent 失败恢复时，是否应从完整开发环境快照而非仓库初始状态重新开始搜索。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在软件工程 agent 的执行环境设计，而不是 LLM 本体；对通用 pretrain 的直接价值有限，但对长时程 agent 的状态表示与外部环境依赖有一些启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把失败恢复建模为搜索问题，借鉴 Go-Explore，在 Daytona 全量 sandbox snapshot 上做恢复与分支，而不是每次 retry-from-scratch。核心点是保留仓库之外的机器状态，例如数据库、服务进程和运行时上下文，并比较这种 full-snapshot search 对 solve rate 的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark 名称、模型或样本规模。主要结论是：更高且更高效的求解率主要来自仓库外状态的保留，而非代码 diff 本身；当任务跨多个服务、状态无法由单次代码改动重建时，full snapshot 最有效。这更像 agent system ablation，而不是新的建模范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether coding agents should recover from full development-environment snapshots instead of repeatedly restarting from the initial repository state after failure.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly about execution environment design for software agents rather than the language model itself. Its direct value for foundation-model pretraining is limited, though it offers some signal on state representation and external-environment dependence in long-horizon agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors cast failure recovery as a search problem and apply a Go-Explore-style strategy over full Daytona sandbox snapshots, allowing restoration and branching from intermediate machine states instead of retrying from scratch. The key idea is to preserve non-repository state such as databases, services, and runtime context, and measure how much this matters for solve rate.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify benchmark names, model sizes, or dataset scale. The main finding is that higher and more efficient solve rates come primarily from preserving state outside the repository rather than from code diffs alone; full-snapshot search helps most when tasks span multiple services and state cannot be reconstructed from a single patch. This is better viewed as an agent-system ablation than a new modeling paradigm.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不大，知道结论即可：长程 coding agent 的瓶颈常在 repo 外状态，不在模型；读实验结论段就够，不必花时间啃正文。
recommendation.en: Only loosely relevant to pretraining: the useful takeaway is that long-horizon coding agents often fail on extra-repo state, not model capability; the results section is enough, no need to read deeply.

paper.title: SWE-Journey: Towards More Realistic Evaluation of Coding Assistants through Long-Horizon, Multi-Turn Interaction
paper.abstract: Coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex have become a major application of LLM agents, yet existing benchmarks remain far from real-world use, particularly in task horizon and interaction length. Code assistants require completing long chains of development work in continuously evolving repositories, while repeatedly clarifying requirements and adapting implementations through multi-turn interaction. To address these gaps, we introduce SWE-Journey, a benchmark for more realistic evaluati

summary.core_problem: 现有 coding assistant benchmark 对真实软件开发中的长时程、多轮交互覆盖不足，导致评测结果与真实使用场景脱节。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测资产与协议设计：把长链任务构造和用户交互模拟同时纳入 SWE 评测，对代码 agent 的能力边界给出更接近真实开发流程的测量。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 SWE-Journey：一方面用 weak-to-strong 合成流水线自动构造 long-horizon coding tasks；另一方面从真实交互数据中挖掘四类用户 persona，并构建 user-simulation agent 复现多轮需求澄清、修改和适配过程。整体重点是 benchmark 设计，而非新的 agent 架构。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整 benchmark 规模，但报告了不同 persona 下的显著性能差异：面对 software architect，模型平均可通过超过 75% 的功能测试；面对 non-coder，成功率低于 25%。这说明交互对象分布会显著改变 coding assistant 的表观能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing coding-assistant benchmarks underrepresent long-horizon development and multi-turn interaction, making them a poor proxy for real software engineering use.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol: it combines long-horizon task construction with realistic user interaction simulation, yielding a more faithful measurement of coding-agent capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces SWE-Journey. It uses a weak-to-strong synthesis pipeline to build long-horizon coding tasks, and mines four representative user personas from real interaction data to drive a user-simulation agent for realistic multi-turn exchanges. The contribution is benchmark design rather than a new agent method.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full benchmark scale, but reports large persona-dependent gaps: models pass over 75% of requested-functionality tests with software architects, but fewer than 25% with non-coders. This suggests user interaction style materially changes measured coding-agent performance.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 post-train 后的代码 agent 评测失真，这篇值得看；重点读 persona 设计和长链任务合成，能帮助你判断现有 SWE 分数有多乐观。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care about how post-trained coding agents are being overestimated; the persona design and long-horizon synthesis are the parts that actually matter.

paper.title: SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. We argue that a benchmark should instead aim to be self-scaling: its tasks and oracles are created at evaluation time, so no content exists in advance to leak, and its difficulty is set by the participating agents rather than fixed at release. We introduce SWE-Duel, an arena in which two coding agents evaluate each other over mirrored Red-Blue turns. In each

summary.core_problem: 解决静态 coding benchmark 容易泄漏、被训练集污染，并随模型变强而逐渐饱和的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 评测范式设计。核心点是 self-scaling arena：任务和 oracle 在评测时由参赛 agent 生成，难度由 agent 之间的攻防能力决定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SWE-Duel。两个 coding agent 进行镜像 Red-Blue 回合：Red 在真实 repository 中跨三个上下文隔离 session 工作，提出并实现新 feature、编写 feature tests，再植入一个 subtle bug 和密封的 bug-triggering tests。PR 只有在通过 feature tests 和原仓库测试、且只在 bug tests 上失败时才被接纳；同时要求同一 agent 的新 session 能 blind repair 该 bug，用于排除不可解任务。Blue agent 随后尝试定位和修复。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述 arena protocol，未给出具体参评模型、胜率、任务规模或与 SWE-bench 等静态基准的数值对比。评测对象是动态生成的仓库级软件工程任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets leakage and saturation in static coding benchmarks, where tasks are fixed at release and may enter training data.
summary_en.importance: It is an evaluation-protocol contribution for coding agents. The central idea is a self-scaling arena in which tasks and oracles are generated at evaluation time and difficulty is set by the participating agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Duel runs mirrored Red-Blue turns. The Red agent works on a real repository across three context-isolated sessions, proposes and implements a feature with feature tests, then inserts a subtle bug together with sealed bug-triggering tests. A pull request is admitted only if it passes feature and existing tests while failing exactly the bug tests, and if a fresh session of the same agent can repair the bug blindly. The Blue agent then attempts the repair.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on the arena design and does not report evaluated models, win rates, task counts, or numerical comparisons with static benchmarks. The target setting is dynamically generated repository-level software engineering tasks.

recommendation.zh: 读协议细节就够；它对“防泄漏评测”比对 coding 能力本身更有价值，可影响内部 eval 设计。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol details; its main value is leakage-resistant evaluation design, not another coding score.

paper.title: Coding-Agent Benchmarks Should Match Their Users' Task Flows
paper.abstract: The evaluation of coding agents generally strives to be as realistic as possible. In our study, we collect 4,782 agent sessions of real software engineers in JetBrains IDEs, which we call Production Sessions. Since our subject is interactive agents, we study the sessions with at least three user messages (33% of the sample). These long sessions differ from issue-derived benchmark tasks in two ways: (i) user requests span a far wider mix of task types - questions about the project's code, plannin

summary.core_problem: 现有 coding-agent benchmark 是否真实反映软件工程师在 IDE 中与交互式代码智能体的实际任务流。
summary.importance: 贡献是基于真实 IDE 使用日志的 coding-agent 评测方法分析。它的重要性在于把“真实感”从 issue 级任务相似性推进到 session 长度、任务类型和任务转移分布的校准。
summary.technical_approach: 收集 4,782 个 JetBrains IDE 中真实软件工程师 agent sessions，称为 Production Sessions，并重点分析至少三轮用户消息的长会话。论文比较真实会话与公开交互语料、issue-derived benchmarks 的 Task Flows 差异，并提出 SWE-TaskFlow，将任意 issue-derived benchmark 按目标用户流重新变换和校准。
summary.experiments: 数据包含 4,782 个生产会话，其中 33% 至少有三条用户消息。作者发现长会话覆盖代码问答、规划、审查、重构、执行等更广任务类型，并且用户会在会话内切换任务类型；三个公开交互语料的长会话 Task Flow 分布也明显不同。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 JetBrains 相关研究/产品环境，论文使用 JetBrains IDE 中真实软件工程师与 agent 的交互日志。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether coding-agent benchmarks reflect the actual task flows of software engineers interacting with agents inside IDEs.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an evaluation analysis grounded in real IDE usage. The key move is to define realism not only by issue-level task content, but by session length, task-type mixture, and type-to-type transitions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors collect 4,782 real agent sessions from software engineers using JetBrains IDEs, called Production Sessions, and focus on long sessions with at least three user messages. They compare real sessions with public interaction corpora and issue-derived benchmarks, then propose SWE-TaskFlow to transform any issue-derived benchmark according to a target user flow.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 4,782 production sessions, with 33% having at least three user messages. Long sessions include code questions, planning, review, refactoring, and execution, and users switch among task types within a session. Three public long-session corpora show markedly different Task Flow distributions.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is tied to JetBrains and uses real software-engineer agent sessions from JetBrains IDEs.

recommendation.zh: 读真实 session 分布和 SWE-TaskFlow 定义即可；它会改变你怎么看 SWE-bench 类评测的“真实”。
recommendation.en: Read the real-session distributions and the SWE-TaskFlow definition; it changes how to interpret “realism” in SWE-bench-style evaluations.

paper.title: One Skill Too Many: How Co-Installed Skills Conflict in Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents are extended with agent skills, directories whose this http URL tells the model when and how to perform a task. Because skills come from independent sources (teams, developers, plugins, copied collections), an installed skill can be co-installed with a similar skill doing the same job, and the model picks between them by name and description alone. In a conflict, the installed skill loses core functions (e.g., a ban on touching git) because the similar skill runs instead or changes

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 在安装多个技能包后发生功能冲突的问题：模型会因名称和描述相似而调用错误技能，导致约束失效但任务表面上仍通过。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于揭示了一个被主流 benchmark 漏掉的 agent failure mode：任务完成不等于行为正确。对做 tool-use、agent training、甚至 post-train reward 设计的人都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先从 20,947 个仓库快照中挖掘 822,109 对候选相似技能，再用 LLM 对分层样本做判别，确认冲突对后，在三种模型上进行大规模 agent 运行实验，统计工具调用与行为偏差，分析冲突模式与后果。
summary.experiments: 实验规模较扎实：20,947 仓库、822,109 候选技能对、3,754 个 LLM 判别样本、312 个确认冲突对、三种模型、6,368 次运行、169,294 次工具调用、542 agent-hours。摘要给出的核心发现之一是近四分之一已安装技能存在冲突风险，而仅看任务完成率的 benchmark 会漏检。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in coding agents where co-installed skills conflict, causing the model to invoke the wrong skill or violate intended constraints while still completing the task.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in exposing an agent failure mode that mainstream benchmarks miss: task success does not imply behavior correctness. This matters for tool-use agents, post-training rewards, and evaluation design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors mine 822,109 candidate similar-skill pairs from 20,947 repositories, use an LLM to judge a stratified sample, confirm conflict pairs, and then run large-scale experiments across three models to measure tool-use behavior and conflict outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical setup is substantial: 20,947 repositories, 822,109 candidate pairs, 3,754 LLM-judged samples, 312 confirmed conflict pairs, three models, 6,368 runs, 169,294 tool calls, and 542 agent-hours. A key result is that nearly one in four installed skills is conflict-prone, and task-completion-only benchmarks miss these failures.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain prior，但它把“任务过了就算对”这个 agent 评测坏习惯拆得很干净；只看数据统计和 failure taxonomy 就值回时间。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining priors, but it cleanly breaks the bad habit of equating task success with correct agent behavior; the statistics and failure taxonomy are worth reading.

paper.title: ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used to build programs from scratch as software engineers do rather than to resolve issues within a repository or to generate a repository from a given requirements document. However, scalable verifiable training environments that force agents to discover what is required and to decide how the system should be designed remain scarce. Moreover, existing agent workflows also cannot sustain long-horizon development in which the agent explores the reference program bef

summary.core_problem: 现有 coding agent 多聚焦仓库内修 bug 或按需求生成代码，缺少可规模化、可验证、能支撑长时程“先探索参考程序再复现实现”的训练环境；这篇工作要补的是这类环境与 agent workflow。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的直接相关性一般，但对 post-train、agentic data generation 和可验证训练信号很有参考价值。贡献类型偏系统与训练环境创新：把长时程程序复现任务做成可扩展的训练场，核心价值在于可验证反馈和环境构造流水线。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProgramGym，由 Program-Env 和 Program-Agent 组成。Program-Env 从真实仓库构造训练环境，通过反馈驱动循环修复 sandbox build 与黑盒测试质量，尽量把环境变成可执行、可验证、可训练的任务。Program-Agent 则面向长时程程序复现，强调在实现前对参考程序进行探索，以支持更接近真实软件开发的 agent workflow。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出 1,648 个训练环境，覆盖 C、C++、Go、Rust 四种语言。实验重点应是：环境构造成功率、训练可扩展性、长时程复现任务上的成功率，以及相对现有 coding-agent workflow 的提升。由于摘要未给出具体 baseline 和绝对增益，阅读时应重点看环境清洗规则、测试修复质量，以及 agent 是否真的学到长期规划而非利用测试漏洞。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing coding agents mostly target repo-level bug fixing or requirement-to-code generation, but lack scalable, verifiable environments for long-horizon program reproduction where the agent must first inspect and understand a reference program before implementation.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is moderate, but it is useful for post-training, agentic data generation, and understanding how to obtain verifiable training signals. The main contribution is a system/training-environment innovation: turning long-horizon program reproduction into a scalable training setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces ProgramGym, consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent. Program-Env constructs training environments from repositories via a feedback-driven loop that repairs sandbox builds and improves black-box test quality, making tasks executable and verifiable at scale. Program-Agent is designed for long-horizon program reproduction, explicitly supporting exploration of the reference program before implementation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 1,648 training environments across C, C++, Go, and Rust. The key experimental questions are likely environment construction success rate, scalability of training, and gains on long-horizon reproduction compared with existing coding-agent workflows. Since the abstract omits exact baselines and margins, the main thing to inspect is whether the verifier quality is strong enough to prevent shortcut exploitation.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“可验证长时程环境怎么造”这件事做得比很多 agent paper 扎实；先看环境构造流水线和 verifier 质量，若测试修复干净，可借去做代码 RL 数据工厂。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is more serious than most agent work on how to build verifiable long-horizon environments; read the environment-construction pipeline and verifier-quality sections first.

paper.title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments
paper.abstract: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training fram

summary.core_problem: 解决 Text-to-SQL 模型训练时直接生成静态 SQL、部署时却要在真实数据库 harness 中多轮交互的 train-deploy mismatch。
summary.importance: 贡献是 SQL agent 的后训练流程改造。它把执行环境、schema inspection、probe query、错误诊断和修正轨迹保留在训练阶段，对工具型 agent 的 SFT/RL 数据形态有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 harness-native post-training：构建隔离且可执行的数据库环境，配套隐藏执行 oracle；让 teacher 在目标 SQL harness 中 rollout，保留 verified trajectories 做 full-sequence SFT，再用 execution reward 进行 RL。
summary.experiments: 在 Spider 2.0-SQLite 上评估。摘要报告 compact model 提升明显，Qwen3-8B execution accuracy 从 15.5% 起显著提高；给定摘要在提升终值处截断，无法确认完整数值和其他 baseline。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the train-deploy mismatch where Text-to-SQL models are trained to emit static queries but deployed as stateful agents interacting with live databases.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training pipeline for SQL agents. Preserving schema inspection, probe queries, error diagnosis, and revision trajectories during training is a useful pattern for tool-using agents, though the domain is narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: HarnessSQL introduces harness-native post-training: it builds isolated executable database environments with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers inside the target SQL harness, keeps only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, and then applies execution-reward RL.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is on Spider 2.0-SQLite. The abstract reports a large execution-accuracy gain for compact models, with Qwen3-8B starting from 15.5%; the provided abstract is truncated before the final number and full baseline details.

recommendation.zh: 只看 trajectory 过滤和 full-sequence SFT 设计；SQL 域较窄，结论别外推太远。
recommendation.en: Read only the trajectory filtering and full-sequence SFT design; the SQL domain is narrow, so do not overgeneralize the gains.

paper.title: Chronos Enables Code Agents to Reason over Software Evolution
paper.abstract: Historical pull requests record the design decisions, compatibility constraints, and implementation patterns behind a codebase's current state. Experience relevant to a new task can span related changes whose descriptions emphasize different concerns. We introduce Chronos, a test-time framework that makes this connected history available to large language model (LLM)-based code agents. Chronos distills merged pull requests into structured experience cards and connects them through a typed graph

summary.core_problem: 代码 agent 处理新 issue 时通常只看当前仓库状态，缺少历史 PR 中的设计决策、兼容性约束和实现习惯。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 的 test-time memory / retrieval 系统创新。它不直接推进基座预训练，但对仓库级代码任务中的长期上下文、经验压缩、检索图结构有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Chronos 把已合并 PR 蒸馏成结构化 experience cards，并用代码级关系、开发者意图关系和组织关系构建 typed graph。推理时先语义检索入口卡片，再做加权多跳扩展，选择相关历史供 agent 阅读。系统包含 patch-focused change agent、validation-strategy agent 和 evolution steward，由 steward 结合历史在候选 patch 间选择。
summary.experiments: 在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，Chronos workflow 相比 SWE-Agent 在 6 个被评估 LLM backbone 上均有提升。摘要未给出具体解题率、模型列表和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Code agents often solve a new issue using only the current repository state, without access to historical pull requests that encode design decisions, compatibility constraints, and implementation patterns.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a test-time memory and retrieval system for coding agents. It does not directly advance foundation-model pretraining, but it is useful for thinking about long-horizon repository context, experience compression, and graph-structured retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: Chronos distills merged pull requests into structured experience cards and links them with a typed graph covering code-level, developer-intent, and organizational relations. At inference time, semantic search finds entry cards and weighted multi-hop expansion retrieves connected changes. A patch-focused change agent and a validation-strategy agent produce candidates, while an evolution steward uses history to select between them.
summary_en.experiments: On SWE-Bench Verified, the full workflow improves SWE-Agent across all six evaluated LLM backbones. The abstract does not provide exact solve rates, model names, or gain sizes.

recommendation.zh: 这是工程记忆层改进，不必细读；做代码数据或仓库级训练时，可借它的 PR history schema。
recommendation.en: This is mostly an engineering memory layer; skip the full paper unless you need a PR-history schema for code data or repo-level training.

paper.title: Tracing the Thoughts of a Coding Agent Playing ARC-AGI-3: Lessons for Continual Learning
paper.abstract: We study how a coding agent learns across a sequence of abstract reasoning tasks. The agent runs on a frozen foundation model inside a fixed harness and acts by writing and running Python and shell scripts. It retains no state across turns other than its written artifacts, so every thought it forms, carries, corrects or abandons leaves a trace, where a thought is any belief, rule or plan committed to a file. We let the agent play ARC-AGI-3, a set of interactive reasoning games that provide no in

summary.core_problem: 分析一个冻结基础模型驱动的 coding agent 在连续 ARC-AGI-3 任务序列中，如何形成、修正和遗忘“外化到文件中的思路”，并据此研究持续学习行为。
summary.importance: 这更像测量协议与行为分析，而不是新 agent 算法。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它把 agent 的外部记忆和中间产物当作可追踪学习痕迹，为研究 test-time adaptation、artifact memory 和 continual learning 提供了一个较干净的观察窗口。
summary.technical_approach: agent 运行在固定 harness 中，底座模型冻结，通过编写和执行 Python、shell 脚本解决 ARC-AGI-3 交互推理游戏。模型不保留隐状态式跨轮记忆，唯一跨任务保留的是写下来的脚本和文本笔记。作者提出一个 measurement protocol，追踪每个 thought 在文件中的形成、迁移、修正或废弃过程，并在多次运行中分析其演化。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在 7 次评测运行、3 个底座模型上应用该协议，但没有给出模型名称、成功率、对照 baseline 或统计显著性。实验重点显然是行为 tracing，而非提升 ARC 成绩。对方法结论的外推要谨慎，因为 setup 很依赖“thought 被完整外化到文件”这一假设。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how a coding agent powered by a frozen foundation model forms, revises, and abandons externally written 'thoughts' across a sequence of ARC-AGI-3 tasks, as a lens on continual learning.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a measurement/analysis paper than a new agent method. Its value to pretraining researchers is indirect: it treats external artifacts as observable traces of learning, offering a relatively clean setup for studying test-time adaptation, artifact memory, and continual learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The agent operates in a fixed harness with a frozen base model, solving ARC-AGI-3 by writing and executing Python and shell scripts. It carries no cross-turn state except written artifacts. The authors introduce a measurement protocol that tracks each thought through files as it is formed, transferred, corrected, or abandoned across tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions seven evaluation runs with three base models, but provides no model names, success rates, baselines, or significance tests. The focus is clearly on tracing behavior rather than improving ARC performance. Any conclusions should be treated cautiously because the setup relies heavily on the assumption that thoughts are fully externalized into files.

recommendation.zh: 有点意思，但更像 agent 行为学而不是方法论文；只看测量协议定义和 failure case，别把它当 continual learning 结论本身。
recommendation.en: Interesting, but this is closer to agent behavior analysis than a method paper; read the measurement protocol and failure cases, not the grand continual-learning framing.

paper.title: EvoAlloc: A Self-Evolving Resource Allocation Agent for Efficient Program Evolution
paper.abstract: LLM-based program evolution relies on evaluation feedback to guide the iterative search for high-performing programs. However, evaluation is often computationally expensive, making it essential to allocate limited resources to candidates that can most effectively advance the search. Existing LLM-based methods typically rely on fixed allocation strategies throughout the search, potentially wasting resources on low-value candidates while overlooking promising ones. We propose EvoAlloc, a self-evol

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 程序进化中评估成本高、固定资源分配策略容易浪费计算的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent / program search 的系统方法改进。它关注 test-time search 中如何把有限评估预算分给更可能推进搜索的候选程序，对推理时计算分配有轻度参考意义，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EvoAlloc，一个自演化资源分配 agent。它周期性把历史搜索、分配和评估结果压缩成可复用经验，用这些经验改写后续资源分配策略；同时加入 counterfactual exploration，偶尔评估原本被拒绝分配资源的候选，从而获得反事实反馈并修正分配器偏差。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明在多个程序进化任务上验证，没有给出任务名称、模型规模、评估预算、baseline 和提升幅度。主张是相比固定分配策略，EvoAlloc 能更有效利用评估计算并推进高性能程序搜索。
summary.authors_note: Jürgen Schmidhuber 是长期从事神经网络、元学习和强化学习研究的知名研究者；摘要未提供作者机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses expensive evaluation in LLM-based program evolution, where fixed resource-allocation policies can waste compute on low-value candidates.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent and program-search systems contribution. It is mildly relevant to test-time compute allocation, but it is not directly about base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoAlloc is a self-evolving resource-allocation agent. It periodically distills prior search, allocation, and evaluation outcomes into reusable experience that guides later strategy revisions. A counterfactual exploration mechanism occasionally evaluates candidates that were denied resources, giving feedback on missed opportunities and reducing allocator bias.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the method is evaluated across program evolution tasks but does not provide task names, model sizes, baselines, budgets, or improvement numbers. The claimed result is better use of evaluation compute than fixed allocation strategies.
summary_en.authors_note: Jürgen Schmidhuber is a well-known researcher in neural networks, meta-learning, and reinforcement learning. The abstract does not provide institutional affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 作为 test-time compute 分配的旁支了解即可；没有规模律或干净预算曲线时，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a side signal on test-time compute allocation; without clean budget curves or scaling analysis, the full paper is optional.

paper.title: Trajectory-Guided Fault Localization for Agent Skill Evolution
paper.abstract: Agent skills provide reusable guidance for code agents, but incomplete or unsuitable guidance can impair task execution. To reduce the manual effort of skill refinement, recent approaches use LLMs to generate revisions from execution feedback. However, grounding these revisions in explicit behavioral evidence remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose SkillMorph, a skill-evolution approach based on trajectory-guided fault localization in agent skills. Its core idea is to link execution

summary.core_problem: 在代码Agent的“技能(可复用提示/脚本)”迭代中，把失败执行轨迹的证据定位到具体技能片段，从而更可靠地自动修订技能。
summary.importance: 属于coding agent的技能进化/自改写：核心贡献是把“基于反馈改提示”变成“先做轨迹级fault localization再改”，对构建可持续自我改进的agent有工程启发，但与基座预训练关联较弱。
summary.technical_approach: SkillMorph：多轮运行收集成功/失败轨迹并抽象化；对比成功与失败证据以及迭代轮次间变化，识别可疑动作并映射到技能内容中的编辑位点；再用LLM生成针对这些位点的修订，实现更有根据的技能演化。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-Skills-Bench与CannBot上评估；指标为多次试验成功率/完成率提升（摘要未给出具体提升数值与对比方法细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Evolve code-agent skills by localizing failures in execution trajectories to specific skill content before generating revisions.
summary_en.importance: A coding-agent skill evolution method: turns feedback-based prompt editing into trajectory-guided fault localization + targeted edits. Useful engineering idea for self-improving agents, but weak linkage to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillMorph collects repeated success/failure runs, abstracts trajectories, contrasts evidence across outcomes and evolution loops to identify suspicious actions, maps them to edit sites in the skill, then uses an LLM to generate targeted revisions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on SWE-Skills-Bench and CannBot; reports higher trial-level success/completion (exact gains and baselines not in abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把“让LLM凭感觉改技能”改成“先做轨迹对比定位再编辑”，工程上更靠谱；但偏agent流程改进，读实验设置确认是否真有因果隔离即可。
recommendation.en: More credible than free-form skill rewriting by doing trajectory-based localization first, but it’s mostly an agent workflow tweak—check the experimental controls for real causal isolation.

paper.title: Before They Can Solve: Predicting Post-Training Coding-Agent Performance from Base Models
paper.abstract: How can we predict which base checkpoint is worth an expensive round of agentic post-training? End-to-end pass@$K$ tests whether successful behavior already appears in a base model's distribution, but it is a poor fit for agentic coding: many base checkpoints cannot reliably produce the well-formed tool invocation required to complete a task end-to-end. Single-shot or short-horizon tasks avoid these tool-calling failures by collapsing a multi-step interaction into a fixed prompt and a single pat

summary.core_problem: 在投入昂贵的 coding-agent 后训练之前，预测哪个 base checkpoint 更可能在后训练后获得好的仓库级代码 Agent 能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 pretrain-posttrain 接口上的评测方法。它针对一个真实痛点：base model 的原始 pass@$K$ 往往被工具调用格式失败污染，不能干净反映后训练潜力。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把成功的 post-trained agent trajectories 当作 lookahead signal。它重放每条轨迹，并在每个会修改代码的步骤之后重新运行测试，找出 decisive step，即累计 patch 首次把仓库从 failing 翻到 passing 的步骤。这个步骤用于判断 base model 是否已经在分布中包含可被后训练放大的关键行为，而不要求 base model 自己完成完整多轮工具交互。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要没有报告模型参数量、训练数据规模或具体提升幅度。实验核心是用 post-trained agent 成功轨迹和逐步测试重放来构造预测信号，对比端到端 pass@$K$ 与 single-shot/short-horizon 任务在 base checkpoint 排序上的局限。
summary.authors_note: Ashish Vaswani 是 Transformer 原始作者之一。给定信息未确认作者机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to predict which base checkpoint is worth expensive coding-agent post-training before running the full training cycle.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation method at the pretrain–posttrain interface. It targets a practical failure mode: raw base-model pass@$K$ is confounded by malformed tool use and therefore may not reflect post-training potential.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses successful post-trained agent trajectories as a lookahead signal. Each trajectory is replayed, tests are rerun after every code-changing step, and the decisive step is identified as the first cumulative patch that flips the repository from failing to passing. This estimates whether the base model distribution contains the key behavior without requiring the base model to execute the entire multi-step tool loop.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model sizes, training data, or numeric gains. The experimental design centers on trajectory replay and stepwise test reruns, comparing this signal against end-to-end pass@$K$ and single-shot or short-horizon proxies for ranking base checkpoints.
summary_en.authors_note: Ashish Vaswani is one of the original Transformer authors. The provided information does not confirm the authors' institutions.

recommendation.zh: 应加入 base checkpoint 选择流程；它把“会不会调工具”的噪声从代码能力信号里剥开。
recommendation.en: Add this to base-checkpoint selection; it separates code-skill signal from the noise of whether the model can format tool calls.

paper.title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon coding agents need timely corrections, yet feedback can be ineffective or even harmful when it misjudges ongoing work or fails to address the underlying problem. Existing critics focus on evaluating trajectories and generating feedback, but rarely track what happens after feedback is delivered. We present Opera, a verbal critic framework that treats each correction as a persistent note, followed until the diagnosed problem is resolved. Opera decides when to review through periodic a

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 coding agent 中 critic 反馈不持续、不追踪修复结果，导致纠错无效甚至误导的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 测试时控制框架。它把 verbal critic 从一次性评价器改成可追踪、可审计的纠错流程，对长程软件任务中的反馈质量控制有实际价值；对预训练侧主要是理解 agentic test-time supervision 的失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: Opera 将每次 correction 记录为 persistent note，并持续跟踪直到被诊断的问题解决。它通过周期性和事件驱动触发决定何时复查，用 typed operators 诊断问题，在反馈交付前根据可见证据进行 audit，并在后续动作中区分表面遵循和真正解决。
summary.experiments: 作为 test-time critic，Opera 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1、SWE-Bench Pro 子集和 DeepSWE v1.1 上，跨四个 policy model 分别把非 critic agent 的 resolve rate 最高提升 12.4、15.0 和 8.9 个百分点。摘要还称其在比较的 critic 方法中取得最高平均 resolve rate。
summary.authors_note: Dimitris N. Metaxas 和 Silvio Savarese 是计算机视觉与机器人/具身智能方向知名研究者；给定条目未提供完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses ineffective or harmful critic feedback in long-horizon coding agents, especially when feedback is not tracked after delivery.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a test-time control framework for coding agents. It turns a verbal critic from a one-shot evaluator into a tracked and audited correction process. For pretraining researchers, its value is mainly in exposing failure modes of agentic test-time supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: Opera records each correction as a persistent note and follows it until the diagnosed issue is resolved. It decides when to review using periodic and event-driven triggers, diagnoses issues with typed operators, audits feedback against visible evidence before delivery, and tracks later actions to distinguish superficial compliance from actual resolution.
summary_en.experiments: As a test-time critic, Opera improves non-critic agents by up to 12.4, 15.0, and 8.9 percentage points in resolve rate on Terminal-Bench 2.1, a SWE-Bench Pro subset, and DeepSWE v1.1, respectively, across four policy models. The abstract also reports the highest mean resolve rate among compared critic methods.
summary_en.authors_note: Dimitris N. Metaxas and Silvio Savarese are well-known researchers in computer vision and embodied AI/robotics; the provided entry does not include full affiliation details.

recommendation.zh: 只看反馈追踪机制和三组 resolve-rate 表；这是 agent 控制工程，不是模型训练信号设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the feedback-tracking mechanism and resolve-rate tables; this is agent-control engineering, not model-training signal design.

paper.title: Large-scale Repository Engineering via Agent-Native Reusable Code Primitives
paper.abstract: Large language models equipped with development environments have moved code generation toward repository-scale construction, yet building complete repositories remains difficult because interacting modules, interfaces, configurations, tests, and dependencies must work together. We introduce Code Primitives, agent-native reusable executable components with interface contracts, dependency closures, validation tests, and provenance. Each primitive uses a resident LLM to assess relevance and adapt

summary.core_problem: 解决仓库级代码生成中模块依赖、接口契约、配置与测试联动导致的整体构建困难问题。
summary.importance: 这是代码代理方向里偏系统化的一类工作，贡献不在基础模型本身，而在把“可复用、可执行、带验证”的代码原语组织成仓库构建单元，并给出相应任务与评测设定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Code Primitives：每个原语不仅包含代码，还包含接口契约、依赖闭包、验证测试和来源信息，并由驻留 LLM 判断与目标仓库的相关性并做适配。基于此构建 1,424 个验证过的原语库 CodeFace，并提出 LEGO 框架：检索相关原语、适配实现与依赖、整合任务特定代码、执行测试并迭代修正。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者构建了约 1,424 个 validated primitives，并围绕 repository construction 设计评测。实验重点应是与直接仓库级生成或普通 agent coding pipeline 对比，考察完整仓库构建成功率、测试通过率和跨组件约束处理能力；但从摘要看，这些结果更偏软件工程 agent 系统增益，而非对基座预训练给出新结论。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets repository-scale code generation, where interacting modules, interfaces, configs, tests, and dependencies make end-to-end construction brittle.
summary_en.importance: This is a systems-oriented coding-agent paper rather than a foundation-model paper. Its contribution is to package reusable, executable, validated code units for repository construction and to build an accompanying task setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Code Primitives: reusable components with interface contracts, dependency closures, validation tests, and provenance. Each primitive is paired with a resident LLM that judges relevance and adapts implementation, interfaces, and dependencies to the target repository. On top of a library of 1,424 validated primitives called CodeFace, LEGO retrieves relevant primitives, integrates them with task-specific code, resolves cross-component constraints, and revises outputs against executed tests.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates a library of 1,424 validated primitives and a benchmark for repository construction. The likely comparisons are against direct repo-level generation or standard coding-agent pipelines, measuring repository completion and test pass rates. For a pretraining researcher, the empirical value is mostly indirect and system-level.

recommendation.zh: 更像代码代理系统工程，不改 pretrain prior；只需看 primitive 设计和评测定义，判断“可执行可复用单元”是否值得转成训练数据资产。
recommendation.en: This is mostly coding-agent systems work, not a pretraining paper; skim the primitive abstraction and benchmark setup, then decide whether executable reusable units are worth turning into training assets.

paper.title: Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving via Agent Orchestration in Program Verification
paper.abstract: Program verification establishes software correctness through machine-checkable proofs constructed in theorem provers. It's a guarantee especially valuable for code generated by large language models (LLMs), which is fluent but carries no assurance of correctness. Almost all existing provers, however, pursue pass rates alone at whatever sampling or search budget it takes, and overlook the success-vs-cost frontier; yet real software often carries hundreds of interdependent proof obligations, so w

summary.core_problem: 在程序验证中，不只追求定理证明成功率，而是在给定推理和搜索成本下最大化可经济完成的证明数量。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding agent / theorem proving 场景下的成本敏感编排方法。它对 LLM 生成代码后的验证闭环有意义，也可作为 test-time compute 分配的一个窄场景案例，但不直接影响基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: CoCo-Prover 把程序证明建模为带成本的元决策问题：每个声明内部用 AND/OR proof hypergraph 表示目标分解，声明之间用 lemma-dependency graph 表示依赖；系统在每一步选择哪些 open goals，以及为这些 goals 购买哪些动作。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调现有 prover 通常只看 pass rate、忽略 success-vs-cost frontier，并指出真实软件包含大量相互依赖的 proof obligations；具体模型、数据集、成本指标和提升幅度未在摘要中完整给出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to maximize economically completed proofs in program verification, rather than only maximizing theorem-proving pass rate at arbitrary search cost.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a cost-sensitive orchestration method for coding agents and theorem proving. It is relevant to the verification loop around LLM-generated code and offers a narrow case study of test-time compute allocation, but it does not directly affect base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoCo-Prover formulates program proving as cost-aware metalevel decision-making. It represents goals inside each declaration with an AND/OR proof hypergraph and dependencies across declarations with a lemma-dependency graph, then decides which open goals to select and which actions to purchase for them.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract argues that existing provers optimize pass rate while ignoring the success-versus-cost frontier, and that real software contains many interdependent proof obligations. Specific models, datasets, cost metrics, and gains are not fully visible in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为 test-time compute 编排的小样本参考可看摘要；没有证据表明能反哺预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Useful as a narrow reference for test-time compute orchestration; the abstract gives no reason to expect feedback into pretraining recipes.

paper.title: Package Hallucination Attacks on Coding Agents through Prompt Injection in Rule Files
paper.abstract: Modern agentic coding frameworks increasingly rely on community-shared rule files (e.g., this http URL or .cursorrules) to guide autonomous code generation, yet the security risks of this pipeline remain underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce the package hallucination attack, where an attacker injects malicious prompts into benign rule files to induce coding agents to replace legitimate dependencies with attacker-controlled packages. To obtain effective malicious prompts injected into r

summary.core_problem: 研究社区共享 rule files 中的提示注入，如何诱导 coding agent 将合法依赖替换为攻击者控制的虚假包。
summary.importance: 这是 coding agent 安全方向的攻击论文。价值在于揭示 agent 框架中一个此前讨论不多的供应链入口，并提出可迁移的攻击生成方法；对预训练本身帮助有限，但对 post-train agent 系统边界条件有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 package hallucination attack，并设计 PackHallu：一个基于进化优化的攻击框架，利用轨迹级反馈和 LLM 引导的 mutation，不断重写注入到 rule files 的恶意提示，以提高诱导 agent 选错依赖包的成功率与跨模型迁移性。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在多个 benchmark、多个 LLM 和多个 agent framework 上评估，显示较高攻击成功率和较强 transferability，但未在摘要中给出具体模型规模、数据量和数值表。实验重点是跨框架泛化，而不是训练或建模分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how prompt injection in community-shared rule files can make coding agents replace legitimate dependencies with attacker-controlled hallucinated packages.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent security paper. Its value is in exposing an underexplored supply-chain attack surface in agent frameworks and proposing a transferable attack-generation method; it has limited direct value for pretraining, but some relevance for post-training agent system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces the package hallucination attack and proposes PackHallu, an evolutionary optimization framework that rewrites malicious prompts injected into rule files using trajectory-level feedback and LLM-guided mutations to improve attack success and transferability.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, the method is evaluated across multiple benchmarks, LLMs, and agent frameworks, showing high attack success rates and strong transferability. The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, dataset sizes, or exact numbers. The emphasis is on cross-framework attack generalization rather than training or modeling analysis.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不大，但如果你在看代码 agent 的对齐边界，这篇能提醒你：外部规则文件会把“包幻觉”从模型缺陷放大成供应链漏洞；读攻击设定即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but useful if you care about coding-agent alignment boundaries: external rule files can turn package hallucination from a model quirk into a supply-chain vulnerability; the attack setup is the main thing to read.

paper.title: TestGRAD: Evolving Test Suites via Failure Pattern Momentum for SWE-Agent Ensemble
paper.abstract: SWE-agent ensembles improve issue resolution by combining candidate patches from different agents with complementary strengths. The central problem is therefore test-based selection: generate tests, execute candidate patches, and identify the best patch. We formulate this process as test-space optimization: evolving an executable repository test suite until it distinguishes competing patches. Existing test-generation methods are limited optimizers. They usually lack an explicit loss for ensemble

summary.core_problem: 解决 SWE-agent ensemble 中“如何自动生成能区分候选补丁优劣的测试集”这一选择难题。
summary.importance: 属于代码智能/软件工程 agent 的方法改进。贡献点不在语言模型本身，而在把测试生成表述成带反馈的优化问题，对 agent-based patch selection 有一定方法启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TestGRAD，把测试套件演化看作 test-space optimization。核心包括：用 differential loss 显式衡量测试是否能区分候选补丁；用 CRUD 风格操作扩展测试更新方向；引入 failure pattern momentum，利用反复执行中的失败模式累积信号来指导后续测试生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法面向 SWE-agent ensemble 的补丁选择，但未给出参数规模、具体基座模型、数据集和量化提升细节。可确认的是评估围绕候选补丁区分能力与 issue resolution 展开，属于仓库级代码修复场景。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the test-based selection problem in SWE-agent ensembles: how to automatically evolve tests that can separate competing candidate patches.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent method paper rather than an LLM pretraining paper. The useful idea is framing test generation as a feedback-driven optimization problem for patch selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: TestGRAD formulates test-suite evolution as optimization in test space. Its key pieces are: a differential loss that rewards tests which behaviorally separate candidate patches; full CRUD-style update directions over the suite; and failure-pattern momentum that accumulates repeated execution failures to guide future test generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation on SWE-agent ensemble patch selection, but does not expose model sizes, base models, datasets, or exact gains. The setup is repository-level issue resolution with executable tests as the selection signal.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不大，但把“测试生成”写成带动量的优化问题还算像样；只看 loss 定义和 failure momentum 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining, but the optimization view of test generation is decent; read the loss formulation and failure-momentum mechanism, then move on.

paper.title: ParanoiaEval: Benchmarking Unnecessary Defensive Work in Agentic Coding
paper.abstract: As coding agents increasingly undertake real-world work autonomously, judging whether their risk treatments are warranted has become important. Existing work evaluates related agent behaviors from separate perspectives, but lacks a systematic framework for unifying these behaviors. To bridge this gap, we introduce ParanoiaEval, the first benchmark for unified evaluation of risk-treatment capabilities in coding agents. Grounded in the well-established Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance fram

summary.core_problem: 编码代理在仓库级任务中常出现“过度防御/不必要的风险处理”（paranoia），如何用可控证据的设置系统评测其风险处理是否与证据匹配。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark + 指标 + judge：把软件工程风险管理的 Avoidance/Transfer/Mitigation/Acceptance 框架落到 coding agent 评测，并用“证据只差一点”的成对任务测量 evidence responsiveness；对 agentic coding 的对齐与评测信号质量有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ParanoiaEval：200 个 evidence-controlled 的仓库级任务对，每对任务仅在“是否存在触发某种风险处理的证据”上不同；定义风险处理违规指标与证据响应指标；使用 human-calibrated 的 agentic judge 提升评测一致性，并配合事后人工复核。
summary.experiments: 对 8 个代表性模型做大规模实验，并进行 post-hoc human study 验证 judge/结论（摘要未给出模型名单与具体分数差距）。

summary_en.core_problem: Coding agents often perform unnecessary defensive work (paranoia) in repo-level tasks; how to systematically evaluate whether risk treatments are warranted given the available evidence.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark + metrics + judge contribution: operationalizes the Avoidance/Transfer/Mitigation/Acceptance risk-treatment framework for coding agents, using evidence-controlled paired tasks to measure evidence responsiveness—useful for alignment and evaluation-signal quality in agentic coding.
summary_en.technical_approach: ParanoiaEval contains 200 evidence-controlled repo-level task pairs differing only in treatment-defining evidence; introduces metrics for risk-treatment violations and evidence responsiveness; uses a human-calibrated agentic judge plus a post-hoc human study.
summary_en.experiments: Large-scale evaluation on 8 representative models with an additional human study to validate reliability (no concrete model list or deltas in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 评测设计比方法更值钱：成对“证据最小差异”能把 agent 的过度保守/乱加防护从能力里剥离出来；只看任务构造与指标定义就够。
recommendation.en: The value is the eval design: minimal-evidence-difference pairs separate paranoia/over-defensiveness from actual coding ability; read the task construction and metrics, not the model comparisons.

paper.title: Catching Developers in the Flow: Low-Latency Agentic Program Repair at Google Scale
paper.abstract: Manual repair of program failures is time-consuming and disruptive for software developers, particularly during the pre-submit phase where test failures occur within continuous integration systems. While Automated Program Repair has seen significant advancement through Large Language Models, existing state-of-the-art techniques primarily focus on post-submit workflows, operating offline without the low-latency requirements necessary to assist developers in real-time within their flow before they

summary.core_problem: 在 Google 级别的持续集成环境里，如何让代码修复 agent 在 pre-submit 阶段以低延迟给出可用补丁，而不是像多数 APR 系统那样离线处理 post-submit 故障。
summary.importance: 价值主要在真实部署与系统约束：它说明 coding agent 真正落地时，延迟、abstention 和执行前后过滤比单纯追求修复率更关键。对预训练研究员的启发有限，但对 post-train 数据构造和 agent 评测设定有一点参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FlowAgent，采用 ReAct 风格的 generate-and-validate 循环，并加入严格的 pre-execution 与 post-execution abstention filters，在低延迟约束下只输出高置信建议。系统集成到 Google 内部开发工具 Critique 和 Cider 中，重点是在线 outer-loop 修复而非离线大搜索。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调案例研究、Google 内部部署和低延迟场景，但未给出公开 benchmark、模型规模或与 SWE-bench 类基线的标准化对比。更像一篇 deployment/system paper，而不是 clean research setup。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Google 相关工程环境；论文代表的是大规模内部开发工具中的在线 program repair 部署经验，而非纯 benchmark 刷分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to make a program-repair agent useful in Google-scale CI by delivering low-latency fixes during pre-submit, rather than handling failures offline after submission.
