summary_en.importance: Its main value is in deployment realism and system constraints: for coding agents in production, latency, abstention, and execution-time filtering matter more than raw repair rate. The relevance to pretraining is limited, though it offers some signal for post-training data design and agent evaluation setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlowAgent uses a ReAct-style generate-and-validate loop, combined with strict pre-execution and post-execution abstention filters, to provide only high-confidence suggestions under tight latency budgets. It is integrated into Google's internal developer tools, Critique and Cider, and focuses on online outer-loop repair rather than large offline search.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes case studies, internal deployment, and low-latency operation, but does not provide standardized public benchmarks, model sizes, or clean comparisons against SWE-bench-style baselines. It reads more like a deployment/system paper than a tightly controlled research study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors appear to be operating in a Google engineering environment; the work is representative of online program-repair deployment inside large internal developer tooling rather than benchmark-driven research.

recommendation.zh: 可扫一眼系统设计，但别把它当方法论文；真正有用的是 abstention/filtering 这套产品化约束，对训练侧几乎没有直接结论。
recommendation.en: Skim the system design, but do not treat it as a methods paper; the useful part is the abstention/filtering stack under product constraints, with little direct takeaway for pretraining.

paper.title: Recursive Game Creator: An Agentic Product-Level Experience-Oriented Game Harness
paper.abstract: Recent game design agents have made substantial progress in generating playable games. However, program correctness does not ensure an enjoyable experience for players. We present Recursive Game Creator, an experience-oriented harness to advance agentic game development from rough game prototypes into entertaining games. Recursive Game Creator organizes recursive development around four components: Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The Designer translates user instructions and Reviewer's

summary.core_problem: 解决游戏生成 agent 只保证代码可运行、却难以保证玩家体验的问题，尝试把“可玩”推进到“好玩”。
summary.importance: 贡献更接近 coding agent 的产品级执行框架与评审闭环，而不是 LLM 基座方法。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它展示了轨迹驱动的自动评审和多角色递归开发如何塑造训练/评测信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Recursive Game Creator，由 Designer、Builder、Player、Reviewer 四个角色递归协作。关键点是 coding-native Player 通过程序接口生成并执行可复用策略，快速收集多样 gameplay trajectories，Reviewer 再结合轨迹指标、视觉证据和文本偏好进行游戏特定评价。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据和量化结果细节。可确认的是，作者强调相较慢速 GUI 采样，程序化 Player 能减少评估偏差并支持递归优化，但从摘要看更像系统设计展示而非严格 benchmark 论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in game-generation agents: code correctness does not guarantee enjoyable player experience, so the goal is to optimize for entertainment rather than mere executability.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a product-level coding-agent harness and review loop, not a foundation-model method. For pretraining researchers, the value is indirect: it shows how trajectory-based automated review can shape training and evaluation signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Recursive Game Creator organizes development around four roles—Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The key idea is a coding-native Player that creates and executes reusable policies through programmatic interfaces to collect diverse gameplay trajectories efficiently, which the Reviewer combines with visual evidence and textual preferences for game-specific evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or hard quantitative results. What is clear is the claim that programmatic trajectory collection reduces bias relative to slow GUI-based evaluation and supports recursive improvement, making this more of a systems paper than a clean benchmark study.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系很弱，但“程序化 player 产轨迹、reviewer 吃轨迹打分”这套信号设计值得借去看 agentic data generation；只读框架图和评审指标即可。
recommendation.en: Weakly related to pretraining, but the programmatic-player-to-trajectory-to-reviewer loop is worth borrowing for agentic data generation; the framework figure and evaluation design are enough.

paper.title: GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in web front-end execution, with browser-based game generation emerging as a particularly prominent frontier. While previous efforts frequently rely on complex multi-turn workflows or focus on static game evaluation benchmarks, this work targets direct end-to-end real-world game synthesis driven by coding agents. However, generating complex games directly from sparse user queries often forces coding agents

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 从简短游戏需求直接生成复杂浏览器游戏时，因需求欠规格化而导致机制不完整、流程断裂和视觉质量不足的问题。
summary.importance: 这是面向 game-dev agent 的数据与任务规格化框架。对预训练研究员的价值有限，但它涉及 synthetic trajectories、真实资产锚定和任务压缩，能给 agent 数据构造与后训练信号设计一些侧面启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GameGo：把简短 game seed 扩展为更完整的产品需求文档，并用真实世界资产进行锚定；同时采用 task-specific dynamic compression，在保留核心玩法约束的前提下提高信息密度，服务于端到端游戏生成训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、训练 token、基线名称和具体提升幅度。可见重点在于通过合成轨迹与需求文档增强来训练 game-dev agents，而不是提出新的通用 coding agent 架构或 clean benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses underspecification in end-to-end browser-game generation, where coding agents often produce incomplete mechanics, broken gameplay flow, and weak visuals from sparse user prompts.
summary_en.importance: This is a game-dev-agent data/specification framework. Its value to pretraining researchers is limited, but the use of synthetic trajectories, real-asset anchoring, and task compression may offer side lessons for agent data construction and post-training signal design.
summary_en.technical_approach: GameGo expands short game seeds into richer product requirement documents grounded in real-world assets, and applies task-specific dynamic compression to preserve core gameplay constraints while maximizing information density for training end-to-end game-generation agents.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, training-token counts, baselines, or effect sizes. The emphasis appears to be on synthetic-trajectory and requirement-document augmentation for training game-dev agents rather than on a new general coding-agent architecture or a clean benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 更像垂直场景的数据工程，不改你对基座训练的 prior；若你在做 agent 训练数据合成，可只看 PRD 扩写和 dynamic compression 设计。
recommendation.en: This is mostly vertical data engineering and does not change any foundation-model prior; if you work on agent training data synthesis, only the PRD expansion and dynamic compression pieces are worth a look.

paper.title: How Much Evidence Should a Coding Agent's Self-Correction Carry? Adaptive Dirichlet Evidence for Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Execution feedback lets coding agents revise programs and learn from their own corrections. A correction's learning weight should reflect both the transitions supported by its executions and the amount of evidence behind that support. We introduce Effective-Evidence Self-Distillation (EESD), which represents these quantities separately. Normalized execution relevance determines relative transition support and an effective pseudo-count mass; a Dirichlet posterior then produces an uncertainty-pena

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 在利用执行反馈进行自我纠错学习时，如何根据纠错样本的证据强弱而不是一刀切赋权的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于后验加权与自蒸馏细化，面向代码代理的训练信号质量控制。它对 pretrain 的直接价值有限，但对“如何把 noisy self-generated data 变成更干净训练信号”有一点接口启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Effective-Evidence Self-Distillation（EESD），把执行反馈拆成两部分：归一化执行相关性决定相对转移支持，effective pseudo-count mass 表示证据量；再用 Dirichlet posterior 生成带不确定性惩罚的权重，用于 KL-anchored correction learning。
summary.experiments: 在四组 model-domain-history sweep 中，visible observations 从 1 增加到 8，可将未来结果 NLL 降低 55.0%-59.3%；在 8 observations 时，effective mass 在四组比较中都优于 fixed mass。主实验基于 DeepSeek/RunBugRun 设定，但摘要未给出更完整的模型规模、数据量和代码基准细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how a coding agent should weight self-corrections from execution feedback, instead of treating all corrected traces as equally trustworthy.
summary_en.importance: This is a refinement on self-distillation and uncertainty-aware weighting for coding agents. Its direct value to pretraining is limited, but it does touch the broader question of turning noisy self-generated trajectories into cleaner learning signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Effective-Evidence Self-Distillation (EESD), separating normalized execution relevance as transition support from an effective pseudo-count mass as evidence quantity, then using a Dirichlet posterior to produce uncertainty-penalized weights for KL-anchored correction learning.
summary_en.experiments: Across four model-domain-history sweeps, increasing visible observations from 1 to 8 reduces future-outcome NLL by 55.0%-59.3%. At 8 observations, effective mass beats fixed mass in all four comparisons. The main study uses a DeepSeek/RunBugRun setup, but the abstract does not provide fuller model scale or benchmark details.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“证据量”和“支持度”分开建模这件事可迁到合成数据筛选；只看方法定义和主表，别在 agent 细节上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the split between evidence mass and support is transferable to synthetic-data weighting; read the method and main table, not the agent details.

paper.title: CheckerBench: Can Long-Horizon Agents Synthesize Static-Analysis Checkers?
paper.abstract: Static-analysis checker synthesis requires agents to interpret a defect specification, inspect a repository, implement analyzer-specific logic, and refine the checker through repeated compilation and analysis feedback. Existing coding-agent benchmarks focus on tasks such as patch generation or vulnerability detection and rarely assess whether an agent can develop a working checker in a repository from start to finish. We introduce CheckerBench, an executable benchmark of 300 tasks derived from 2

summary.core_problem: 评估长程 coding agent 是否能从缺陷规范出发，完成静态分析 checker 的端到端合成与调试。
summary.importance: 这是 coding-agent benchmark 贡献。它把评测从常见的补丁生成、漏洞检测扩展到 checker synthesis：agent 需要读仓库、理解 CVE、实现分析器逻辑，并在编译与分析反馈中反复修正。对预训练本身不是直接工作，但可作为代码模型长期任务能力的压力测试。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CheckerBench，包含 300 个任务，来自 297 个 CVE、167 个仓库、85 个 CWE 和 5 个语言生态。每个任务提供 vulnerable/fixed revisions、固定分析环境和 checker scaffold。CheckerLab 作为评测框架，会独立 rebuild 提交的 checker，并测量 vulnerable-fixed diagnostic contrast、patch localization、false positives 和 tool use。
summary.experiments: 评测 21 个 model-harness configuration，每个配置独立重复三次。摘要给出的平均 Pass@1 为 32.30%，说明当前系统在这类端到端 checker synthesis 上仍有明显失败空间。摘要未列出各模型名称和完整排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates whether long-horizon coding agents can synthesize static-analysis checkers end to end from defect specifications.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent evaluation contribution. It moves beyond patch generation and vulnerability detection toward checker synthesis, where an agent must inspect a repository, understand a CVE, implement analyzer-specific logic, and iterate using compilation and analysis feedback. It is not a pretraining method paper, but it is a useful stress test for code-model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: CheckerBench contains 300 tasks derived from 297 CVEs across 167 repositories, 85 CWEs, and five language ecosystems. Each task includes vulnerable and fixed revisions, a pinned analysis environment, and a checker scaffold. CheckerLab rebuilds submitted checkers and measures vulnerable-fixed diagnostic contrast, patch localization, false positives, and tool use.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate 21 model-harness configurations with three independent repeats per configuration. The abstract reports a mean Pass@1 of 32.30%, indicating that current systems struggle with end-to-end checker synthesis. The abstract does not list model names or a full leaderboard.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道这个评测形态；预训练侧不必细读，记住 Pass@1 低说明仓库级工具闭环仍脆弱。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as an eval format; pretraining readers can skip details and note that low Pass@1 exposes fragile repo-level tool loops.

paper.title: Understanding and Enhancing Backdoor Persistency in LLM Agent Post-Training
paper.abstract: Developers can build LLM agents by adapting third-party models through benign post-training. We study a supply-chain threat in which an attacker supplies a model with a backdoor: hidden behavior that produces malicious outputs when a particular input pattern appears. Focusing on software-engineering agents, we ask whether such backdoors survive the developer's supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and subsequent task-level reinforcement learning (RL). We observe that benign SFT substantially reduces atta

summary.core_problem: 研究带后门的基础模型在开发者进行良性 SFT 与后续 RL 适配后，恶意行为是否会被消除，还是会在 agent post-training 中持续存在。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在安全应用本身，而在它揭示了 post-train 信号如何与已有参数行为相互作用。它属于 post-train 与训练信号质量分析，对理解 RL 是否会放大残留行为有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者聚焦软件工程 agent，先观察 benign SFT 对后门的侵蚀，再分析 RL 阶段为何会保留甚至放大残余后门。论文提出两个影响 persistency 的因素：初始后门强度，以及后门梯度与良性训练梯度的兼容性。基于此提出 PersistBD，在模型发布前进一步优化已植入后门，使其更能穿过后续 benign post-training。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确使用 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 作为底座，任务场景是 software-engineering agents。对比流程包括带后门模型经过 SFT 与 task-level RL 后的攻击成功率变化。结果上，benign SFT 会显著降低攻击成功率，但后续 RL 往往保留残余行为，有时还会提高攻击成功率；PersistBD 可把经过后训练后的攻击成功率从约 20% 提升到更高水平。摘要未给出完整 benchmark 名称和全部数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Daniel Kang。该方向与 UC Berkeley 一系关于 LLM 安全、评测与系统的工作风格接近，重点是用较干净的 post-training 流程分析参数行为的保留与放大。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies whether malicious backdoor behavior in a supplied base model is erased or preserved after a developer applies benign SFT and subsequent RL for agent post-training.
summary_en.importance: The value is not merely in the security angle. It exposes how post-training signals interact with pre-existing parameterized behaviors. This makes it relevant to post-train signal quality and to understanding when RL can amplify residual behaviors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper focuses on software-engineering agents. It first measures how benign SFT erodes backdoors, then analyzes why later RL can preserve or even amplify the remaining malicious behavior. Two factors are identified as favoring persistency: initial backdoor strength and gradient compatibility between the backdoor objective and benign training. Based on this, PersistBD further refines an already-backdoored model before release so the backdoor survives downstream benign post-training more effectively.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract explicitly names Qwen2.5-Coder-7B as the base model and software-engineering agents as the setting. The pipeline compares attack success before and after benign SFT and task-level RL. Benign SFT substantially reduces attack success, but subsequent RL often preserves residual behavior and can even increase attack success. PersistBD raises post-training attack success from around 20% to a higher level, though the abstract does not provide the full benchmark suite or all numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Daniel Kang. The work is stylistically close to the UC Berkeley line on LLM safety, evaluation, and systems, with an emphasis on relatively clean post-training analyses of how parameterized behaviors are preserved or amplified.

recommendation.zh: 别把它只当安全论文看；它更像在提醒你 RL 会放大参数里残留的东西，先看梯度兼容性分析，再决定是否在内部对 reward shaping 做审计。
recommendation.en: Do not file this away as just a security paper; it is really a warning that RL can amplify whatever is already latent in the weights—read the gradient-compatibility analysis first, then audit your reward shaping.

paper.title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
paper.abstract: Autonomous coding agents solve repository issues by reading code, running commands, editing files, and submitting patches. Extra inference-time compute yields gains only when it produces a useful repair and supplies reliable evidence for choosing one. Three behaviors decide both, and we argue they are teachable rather than byproducts of scale, so a policy can carry them instead of a scaffold. Location diversity remains narrow, since attempts return to the same site and extra samples add no cover

summary.core_problem: 让自主 coding agent 在仓库级 issue 修复中更可靠地利用额外推理计算，而不是把计算浪费在重复位置、重复编辑和不可靠自测上。
summary.importance: 这是 coding agent 方法工作，重点不是单纯堆采样，而是把搜索覆盖、编辑多样性和验证可靠性这三类行为显式训练进 policy。对预训练研究员的价值在于观察 inference-time compute、agent scaffold 和 post-training policy 之间的边界。
summary.technical_approach: 论文主张三个关键行为可以被教学和训练，而不是规模自然涌现：扩大 location diversity，避免多次尝试回到同一代码位置；利用 edit diversity，让不同修复方法覆盖互补 issue；改进 verification，用执行反馈引导搜索，并把每个 patch 放到自身 reverted tree 上评分，降低 agent 自写测试误收错误补丁的问题。随后将这些行为从 scaffold 迁移到 policy。
summary.experiments: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，方法用八采样 baseline 48.1% 的 agent steps 达到 52.8% resolved。摘要还提到在来自 SWE-bench Verified 的 270 个 held-out issues 上做训练迁移评估，但截断文本未给出完整结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to make autonomous coding agents use additional inference-time compute reliably for repository-level issue repair, rather than spending it on repeated locations, redundant edits, and misleading self-tests.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent method paper. Its useful angle is the separation between more sampling, scaffold behavior, and trainable policy behavior, which is relevant to how post-training can absorb behaviors that were previously handled by external search machinery.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method targets three behaviors: improving location diversity so attempts do not repeatedly inspect the same site, exploiting edit diversity because different repair methodologies solve complementary issues, and making verification less self-confirming by scoring each patch against its own reverted tree under execution feedback. The paper then trains these behaviors into the policy rather than leaving them only in the scaffold.
summary_en.experiments: On SWE-bench Verified, the approach resolves 52.8% of tasks while using 48.1% of the agent steps spent by an eight-sample baseline. The abstract also mentions training evaluation on 270 held-out issues from SWE-bench Verified, but the provided text is truncated before the full results.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融即可；有用点是把 agent scaffold 行为蒸进 policy，别只看 SWE-bench 分数。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; the useful signal is how scaffold behaviors are moved into the policy, not the SWE-bench number alone.

paper.title: AgentDiscover: Autonomous Discovery with Minimal Search Scaffolding
paper.abstract: Frameworks that use large language models for scientific discovery typically rely on a fixed, human-designed algorithm that decides what the model sees at each step, leaving the model only the role of proposer. The model knows nothing of the search beyond what it is shown. As models grow more capable, a question arises: does a search strategy chosen by a human before the run scale better than promoting the model from proposer to planner and letting it own the search? The Bitter Lesson suggests t

summary.core_problem: 解决科学发现类 LLM 系统过度依赖人工预设搜索脚手架的问题，尝试让 coding agent 自主规划搜索过程而不只是提出候选。
summary.importance: 贡献更接近通用 agent/coding agent 范式探索，而非预训练本身；价值在于它把“搜索策略是否也应交给模型”这个问题摆到台面上，对 test-time scaling、agentic search 和 post-train 能力边界有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgentDiscover：让 coding agent 以上下文作为工作记忆，自主规划实验、执行搜索，并把想法、候选及其关系写入结构化数据库作为长期记忆。该数据库被设计成可表达 MAP-Elites、MCTS 等经典算法中的选择规则，但不把固定搜索算法硬编码为主流程，从而尽量减少人工脚手架。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调与固定人类设计搜索框架的对比立场，但未给出具体任务、模型规模、基线和量化结果。就当前信息看，更像方法主张与系统原型，结论强度取决于实验是否覆盖足够复杂的发现任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether scientific-discovery systems should stop using fixed human-designed search scaffolds and instead let a coding agent plan the search itself.
summary_en.importance: This is closer to a coding-agent paradigm paper than to pretraining. Its value is indirect: it probes whether search strategy should also be learned or delegated to the model, which matters for test-time scaling and agentic capability boundaries.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentDiscover gives a coding agent control over planning, experiment execution, and bookkeeping. The agent uses context as working memory and writes ideas, candidates, and relations into a structured database as long-term memory. The database can express selection rules from classical algorithms such as MAP-Elites and MCTS without hard-coding one fixed search scaffold as the main loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is strong on framing but light on specifics: no clear model sizes, task suite, baselines, or quantitative gains are provided here. The credibility of the claim will depend on whether experiments cover sufficiently hard discovery tasks rather than toy search problems.

recommendation.zh: 问题意识是对的：别把搜索策略先验写死；但摘要里实验信息太少，先看任务定义和 ablation，若只是换壳 agent workflow 就不用深读。
recommendation.en: The question is worth asking—stop hard-coding the search prior—but the abstract is thin on evidence; check the task setup and ablations first, or it may just be another agent workflow paper.

paper.title: Small Agents with Semantic Search: Efficient Multilingual Code Localization
paper.abstract: Locating relevant files from natural-language requests is a core subtask for agents operating over code repositories. We investigate whether this task can be delegated to compact, specialized models to enable on-device search while reducing the token usage, latency, and inference cost of larger agents. We show that semantic search improves file localization, with gains in accuracy, cross-language transfer, and inference efficiency. To study this setting, we introduce a training framework for fil

summary.core_problem: 在代码仓库级任务中，如何用更小的模型完成“从自然语言需求定位相关文件”的关键子任务，从而降低大模型 agent 的 token/延迟/成本。
summary.importance: 属于 coding agent 的工程化拆分思路：把 file localization 外包给小模型+本地语义检索工具；对“agent 子模块小型化/端侧化”有参考价值，但对基座预训练方法论贡献有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出围绕 ColGREP（late-interaction 语义检索）的训练框架：小模型负责生成检索 query、浏览检索到的片段并做文件判定；训练上结合(1)对 teacher 轨迹的加权 SFT（按检索结果对 turn 级别分配 credit）与(2)以定位质量为目标的 RL。
summary.experiments: 训练三类 <2B 参数模型，在从 SWE-bench 派生的文件定位任务上评估；报告语义检索带来的准确率提升、跨语言迁移与推理效率收益；具体规模/提升幅度以原文为准（摘要未给出完整数字）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to offload repository-level file localization from natural-language requests to compact models to reduce token usage, latency, and cost of large coding agents.
summary_en.importance: An engineering-oriented decomposition for coding agents: delegate file localization to small models plus local semantic search. Useful as a modularization reference, but limited direct impact on foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A training framework built around ColGREP (late-interaction semantic search): small models generate search queries, inspect retrieved snippets, and decide relevant files; training combines (1) weighted SFT on teacher trajectories with turn-level credit assignment based on retrieval outcomes and (2) RL optimizing localization quality.
summary_en.experiments: Trains three <2B model families and evaluates on file-localization tasks derived from SWE-bench; reports gains in accuracy, cross-language transfer, and inference efficiency. Exact scales/margins are not fully specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 更像“把 agent 拆成小模型+检索工具”的工程配方；只需看训练 credit 分配与 RL 目标，别指望对 pretrain 有新结论。
recommendation.en: Mostly an engineering recipe for decomposing agents into small models + semantic search; skim the credit assignment and RL objective, but don’t expect new pretraining insights.

paper.title: Pareto-Dominant Clarification: Post-Training Coding LLMs via PPO-Lagrangian Budget Constraints
paper.abstract: Coding agents operating under ambiguous instructions or user prompts must decide whether to ask clarifying questions or attempt a solution directly. While clarification from the user may improve the correctness of the agent's solution, each back-and-forth interaction incurs user and system costs, forming an explicit accuracy vs. efficiency tradeoff. Existing works study clarification behavior but do not train policies under enforceable clarification budgets; penalty-based approaches typically re

summary.core_problem: 在含糊代码需求下，编码代理何时提问、何时直接作答，需要在解题正确率和交互成本之间做受约束的决策。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法和编码代理策略优化。它把 clarification 行为从启发式或固定惩罚，改写为带预算约束的 CMDP，有助于更干净地研究“交互预算—任务成功率”的 Pareto 前沿。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将澄清提问建模为 Constrained Markov Decision Process，用 PPO-Lagrangian 后训练 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct，在最大化代码正确率的同时约束期望提问次数。相比普通 penalty 方法，Lagrangian 形式允许直接指定预算，而不是为每个预算重新扫惩罚系数。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 HumanEvalComm，并用 GPT-4o-mini 作为用户 oracle simulator。被训练模型是 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct。摘要称未经调优的澄清行为是 Pareto-inefficient，预算约束策略能在 accuracy 和 question budget 之间取得更好的折中；具体提升幅度需要看正文表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when a coding agent should ask clarifying questions under ambiguous instructions, balancing solution accuracy against user and system interaction cost.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and coding-agent contribution. It recasts clarification as a constrained decision problem, giving a cleaner handle on the Pareto frontier between interaction budget and task success.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate clarification as a Constrained Markov Decision Process and post-train Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with PPO-Lagrangian. The objective optimizes coding accuracy subject to an expected question-budget constraint, avoiding separate penalty-coefficient sweeps for each budget level.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is on HumanEvalComm with a GPT-4o-mini oracle user simulator. The abstract reports that untuned clarification behavior is Pareto-inefficient and that budget-constrained policies achieve better accuracy-budget tradeoffs, but the exact deltas are not visible from the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线；只看 CMDP 设定和 Pareto 图，判断 RL 预算约束是否比 penalty sweep 更干净。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the CMDP setup and Pareto plot to see whether budgeted RL is cleaner than penalty sweeps.

paper.title: Software World Models: From Consequence Prediction to Decision Value
paper.abstract: A coding agent may safely modify one repository while silently breaking downstream services, libraries, or datastores that depend on it. Exhaustively running integration tests after every agent action is impractical, so the agent must predict these failures before executing them. Existing software world models predict the agent's own observations, while static change-impact analysis only identifies where a change may propagate. We instead introduce the Software World Model (SWM), which models th

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 修改一个仓库时，如何在执行前预测它会破坏哪些下游服务、库或数据存储的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 的系统风险建模。它把软件世界模型从预测 agent 自身 observation，推进到预测代码变更的 blast set，对仓库级代码 agent 的安全执行有价值，但对 LLM 预训练本身启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Software World Model，分为 explore、learn、act 三阶段。Explore 从恢复的系统状态执行候选变更，优先探索观测失败与依赖图不一致的区域；Learn 用这些执行结果微调语言模型，学习预测下游 breakage；Act 将采样预测转成每个 consumer 的 break probability，用于变更排序和主动风险控制。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据规模、baseline 名称和数值结果。可确认实验对象是跨仓库或跨组件依赖的代码变更执行结果，核心输出是 downstream breakage / blast set 预测。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a coding agent can predict which downstream services, libraries, or datastores will break before executing a repository change.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a system-level risk model for coding agents. It moves software world models from predicting the agent's own observations to predicting the blast set of a code change. This is useful for repository-scale coding agents, but only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Software World Model has three stages: explore, learn, and act. Explore executes candidate changes from restored system states, prioritizing regions where observed failures contradict the dependency graph. Learn fine-tunes a language model on execution outcomes to predict downstream breakage. Act converts sampled predictions into per-consumer break probabilities for ranking changes and managing risk.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data scale, baselines, or quantitative results. The evaluation appears to center on execution outcomes for code changes across dependent components, with downstream breakage or blast-set prediction as the main target.

recommendation.zh: 想做代码 agent world model 可看 explore/learn/act；对预训练启发弱，核心是系统风险建模。
recommendation.en: If building coding-agent world models, read the explore/learn/act setup; for pretraining, it is mostly system risk modeling.

paper.title: AI Agent Pull Requests on GitHub: Frequency, Structure, and Merge Conflict Rates
paper.abstract: AI coding agents may generate and submit Pull Requests (PRs) to the same repository at the same time. However, research concerning the extent of concurrent submission by AI coding agents to a common repository does not exist. This paper uses the AIDev-pop dataset (33,596 PRs in 2,807 repositories) to provide the first empirical examination of the prevalence of concurrent submission using PRs authored by agents. We report that when considering exact temporal overlap, 40.2% of repositories contain

summary.core_problem: 研究 AI coding agent 在 GitHub 仓库中并发提交 PR 的频率、结构特征以及潜在合并冲突风险。
summary.importance: 这是一篇经验分析型工作，价值在于给 coding agent 的真实协作形态提供数据画像。对预训练研究员的直接帮助有限，但对理解 agent 评测与部署环境有一点背景价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于 AIDev-pop 数据集中的 33,596 个 PR 和 2,807 个仓库，定义精确时间重叠与一周协作窗口两种 co-activity 度量，统计 agent-authored PR 的并发提交比例，并区分 intra-agent 与 cross-agent 情况。
summary.experiments: 主要结果包括：按精确时间重叠，40.2% 的仓库存在 co-active agent-authored PR 对，这些对占全部 agent PR 的 79.4%；按一周窗口，比例升至 53.4% 和 95.0%。绝大多数 co-active PR 对来自同一 agent，跨 agent 仅占 0.5%，出现在 122/2807 个仓库。摘要标题提到 merge conflict rates，但给出的摘要片段未展示具体冲突率结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper examines how often AI coding agents submit concurrent pull requests to the same GitHub repository, and analyzes their structure and merge-conflict implications.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical coding-agent measurement paper. Its value is in characterizing real deployment patterns of coding agents, though the direct relevance to pretraining research is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the AIDev-pop dataset with 33,596 PRs across 2,807 repositories, the authors define exact temporal overlap and a one-week collaboration window to measure co-activity among agent-authored PRs, and separate intra-agent from cross-agent cases.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings include: under exact overlap, 40.2% of repositories contain co-active agent-authored PR pairs, accounting for 79.4% of all agent PRs; under a one-week window, these rise to 53.4% and 95.0%. Most co-active pairs are authored by the same agent, while cross-agent pairs are only 0.5% and appear in 122 of 2,807 repositories. The title mentions merge-conflict rates, but the provided abstract snippet does not include those numbers.

recommendation.zh: 偏 deployment measurement，不会改变你对基座训练的看法；若做 coding agent eval，只抄数据口径和并发定义。
recommendation.en: Mostly deployment measurement; it will not change your pretraining priors, but the concurrency definitions are reusable if you work on coding-agent eval.

paper.title: EvoMaestro: Toward Interpretable and Steerable LLM-Driven Program Evolution
paper.abstract: Recent program evolution systems use large language models (LLMs) to generate and iteratively improve populations of programs, producing striking advances in mathematics, algorithm design, and scientific computing. Yet these systems largely operate as fully automated black boxes. As populations grow, domain experts must make sense of the scores, code changes, reasoning, and algorithmic ideas across many programs, while current interfaces provide limited support for understanding or redirecting t

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 驱动的程序进化系统缺少可解释、可干预界面的问题，使领域专家能理解并引导一批候选程序的演化过程。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 HCI 与系统设计，不是新的代码模型或预训练方法。它提出“semantic oversight”这一人机协作问题，对 LLM 自动化算法发现、代码进化、scientific discovery agent 的可控性有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先通过 8 名领域专家的形成性研究总结 6 类设计需求，再提出一个可由专家判断影响后续搜索方向的 steerable program evolution framework。EvoMaestro 作为交互式可视分析系统，将种群演化中的分数、代码变更、推理文本和算法想法组织起来，支持专家理解和重定向演化。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确提到 8 名领域专家参与的形成性研究，以及基于所提框架构建 EvoMaestro 系统。未从给定信息中看到大规模代码基准、模型参数量、训练数据或与自动程序进化 baseline 的定量提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of interpretability and steerability in LLM-driven program evolution systems, where experts need to inspect and redirect large populations of evolving programs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an HCI and system-design contribution rather than a new code model or pretraining method. Its useful angle is the notion of semantic oversight for LLM-based algorithm discovery and program evolution workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors conduct a formative study with 8 domain experts to derive six design requirements, then propose a steerable program evolution framework where expert judgments influence subsequent evolution. EvoMaestro is an interactive visual analytics system that organizes scores, code edits, reasoning traces, and algorithmic ideas across program populations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a formative expert study and the construction of the EvoMaestro system. It does not provide, in the given information, model scale, training data, large coding benchmarks, or quantitative gains over program-evolution baselines.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧收益很弱；若关心 LLM 自动发现流程，只看 semantic oversight 的需求列表。
recommendation.en: Weak for pretraining; if you work on LLM-driven discovery loops, skim only the semantic-oversight requirements.

paper.title: Harness Engineering for Software Engineering via Modular Executable Dev-Primitives
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) equipped with terminal access have demonstrated strong capabilities in automating software engineering tasks. However, existing agents remain brittle on long-horizon workflows, where they must repeatedly reconstruct program state scattered across source files, configurations, tests, dependencies, and runtime behavior, leading to increasingly long interaction histories, context explosion, and semantic drift. Large repositories further complicate the identification of

summary.core_problem: 解决 SWE agent 在长周期仓库任务中反复重建程序状态、上下文膨胀和语义漂移的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding agent 的执行抽象，而不是评测或预训练方法。它把仓库组件从被动文件转为可执行、可对话的 agent-native 单元，对 agent 系统设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Dev-Primitives：每个仓库 artifact 与一个驻留 LLM 配对，使该 artifact 拥有基于自身实现和依赖的自然语言接口。不同 Dev-Primitives 可以围绕组件语义、依赖和运行行为进行通信，减少单个全局 agent 在长历史中反复搜索、解释和拼接上下文的负担。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、仓库规模、模型参数、baseline 或数值结果。可确认的评测目标是长周期软件工程 workflow 中的上下文管理、组件定位和跨组件通信能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets long-horizon software-engineering agents that repeatedly reconstruct program state, leading to context explosion and semantic drift.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an execution abstraction for coding agents rather than an evaluation asset or pretraining method. It turns repository components into active, LLM-facing units, which is useful for agent-system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Dev-Primitives: each repository artifact is paired with a resident LLM, giving the artifact a natural-language interface grounded in its implementation and dependencies. These primitives can communicate around component semantics, dependencies, and runtime behavior, reducing the burden on a single monolithic agent to search and reconstruct context from long histories.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmarks, repository scale, model sizes, baselines, or numerical results. The intended evaluation concerns context management, task-relevant component discovery, and inter-component communication in long-horizon SWE workflows.

recommendation.zh: 想法像把 repo 做成可查询记忆图，读系统抽象即可；没有干净量化结果前，不应当作 agent scaling 证据。
recommendation.en: The idea resembles turning a repo into a queryable memory graph; read the abstraction, but do not treat it as agent-scaling evidence without clean numbers.

paper.title: hacktrace: behavior-supervised detection of reward hacking during code generation
paper.abstract: A coding agent can earn a passing grade by fixing its code, or by deleting the test that exposes the bug. Detecting such reward hacking requires recognizing attempted shortcuts, including those that fail. We release 173,561 annotated multi-turn coding trajectories from Qwen3-8B and show that supervising shortcut behavior independently of exploit success substantially improves detection. We introduce HACKTRACE, a behavior-supervised monitor that reads the internal states the agent already compute

summary.core_problem: 解决代码生成代理中的 reward hacking 检测问题，尤其是识别那些试图走捷径但未必成功的行为。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 post-train 和 agent safety 有直接价值，因为它把“是否作弊”从结果监督改成了行为监督，并展示了可低开销接入 RL 训练环路的监控信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者发布 173,561 条来自 Qwen3-8B 的多轮代码轨迹标注数据，区分 shortcut 行为而不是只看 exploit 是否成功；提出 HACKTRACE，直接读取代理在生成代码时已经计算出的内部状态做在线监控，不额外消耗生成 token 或额外前向；再结合最终文件的静态特征做联合判别，并把同一监控信号用于 RL 过程中的廉价监督。
summary.experiments: 核心实验基于 Qwen3-8B 代码代理轨迹。与重新调用模型回答 honesty QA 的监控器相比，HACKTRACE 在每题平均 AUC 达到 0.997，监控开销约 8ms，同时提升准确率和延迟表现。摘要未给出更广泛模型族泛化与跨任务迁移细节，因此结论更适合作为工程信号而非普适定律。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles reward-hacking detection in coding agents, especially identifying shortcut-seeking behavior even when the exploit attempt does not succeed.
summary_en.importance: This matters for post-training and agent safety because it shifts supervision from outcome-only labels to behavior-level labels, and shows a low-overhead monitoring signal that can plug into RL loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors release 173,561 annotated multi-turn coding trajectories from Qwen3-8B, labeling shortcut behavior independently of exploit success. They propose HACKTRACE, a monitor that reads internal generation states already computed by the agent, avoiding extra LM tokens or an additional forward pass. These signals are combined with static features of final files, and the same monitoring signal is reused for inexpensive RL supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The main setup uses Qwen3-8B coding-agent trajectories. Compared with monitors that re-query the model with an honesty QA prompt, HACKTRACE reaches a mean per-problem AUC of 0.997 with about 8 ms overhead, improving both accuracy and latency. The abstract does not establish broad cross-model generalization, so the result is best treated as a strong systems signal rather than a universal law.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但对 RL 监控接口很实用；重点看“行为监督优于结果监督”和复用 hidden states 这两点，值得内部 agent 训练栈试一遍。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but highly practical for RL monitoring: focus on behavior supervision over outcome labels and on reusing hidden states; both are worth testing in an internal agent-training stack.

paper.title: GTDD: Generative Test-Driven Development for AI Coding Agents with Adversarial Testing
paper.abstract: Test-driven development gives AI coding agents executable requirements for implementing software. Because these agents can adapt their implementations to the examples they observe, passing a predetermined collection of tests can leave substantial parts of the intended behavior unimplemented. We propose Generative Test-Driven Development (GTDD), a formulation of test-driven development in which a separate testing agent generates new inputs after each candidate implementation is fixed, using a hum

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI coding agent 在固定测试集上“学会过拟合测试而非实现真实行为契约”的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 coding agent 里的方法与评估结合工作。对预训练本身不直接，但对 post-train 阶段的训练信号质量、reward hacking、verifier 设计有明确启发，尤其适合把它当成“可执行监督如何被策略适配”的案例来看。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GTDD（Generative Test-Driven Development）：在每轮候选实现固定后，由独立 testing agent 根据人类给定的行为契约和历史反馈生成新测试输入；trusted evaluator 检查这些输入并返回最小化 counterexample 给 coding agent，同时把失败样例加入回归测试集。论文还给出有限总体下、在自适应候选选择场景中的 false acceptance 分析，量化测试可见性与重复反馈的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、代码基准或提升幅度，但方法上强调对抗式生成测试而非静态测试集。若实验做得扎实，价值主要在于展示固定 verifier 容易被 agent 适配，以及动态测试生成如何改变训练/评估信号。需要看正文确认 setup 是否 clean、testing agent 是否泄漏目标实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a core failure mode in AI coding agents: passing a fixed test suite by adapting to visible examples rather than implementing the intended behavioral contract.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent method/evaluation paper. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to post-training signal quality, reward hacking, and verifier design—useful if you care about how executable supervision gets gamed.
summary_en.technical_approach: GTDD (Generative Test-Driven Development) introduces a separate testing agent that generates new inputs after each candidate implementation is fixed, conditioned on a human-written behavioral contract and prior feedback. A trusted evaluator validates these inputs, returns reduced counterexamples to the coding agent, and stores them for regression testing. The paper also provides a finite-population analysis of false acceptance under adaptive candidate selection.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, coding benchmarks, or effect sizes. The main empirical value, if the setup is clean, would be showing that static verifiers are easy to overfit and that dynamically generated tests materially change the supervision landscape. The key thing to verify in the full paper is whether the testing agent leaks implementation hints or simply improves coverage.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain prior，但对 RL/SFT 阶段的 verifier 设计很有用；先看理论部分和 failure case，判断它是在防 reward hacking，还是只是把测试集做大。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your pretraining prior, but it is useful for verifier design in RL/SFT; read the theory and failure cases first to see whether it truly reduces reward hacking or just enlarges the test set.

paper.title: SEDIMA: Cross-Run Hierarchical Insight Memory for Evolutionary Search Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-driven evolutionary search is a powerful paradigm for automated program and algorithm discovery, yet existing systems are largely memoryless: each run explores from scratch, so agents repeatedly rediscover the same improvements and re-encounter the same dead ends. We introduce SEDIMA, a persistent hierarchical insight memory for evolutionary search agents. SEDIMA distills raw traces into natural-language insights, clusters them by semantic similarity using attention-we

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 驱动的进化式程序和算法搜索在不同运行之间缺乏记忆、反复发现相同改进和踩相同坑的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是给 evolutionary search agent 增加跨运行持久记忆。它关注的是程序发现过程中的经验复用，而不是模型预训练；对自动算法搜索和 coding agent 系统有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SEDIMA，一个分层 insight memory。它把原始搜索轨迹蒸馏为自然语言 insight，用 attention-weighted centroid 做语义聚类，并在后续 mutation 时检索相关 insight 作为条件。该模块不改动原有搜索算子，可作为 drop-in memory 使用。
summary.experiments: 在 AlgoTune 和 ALE-Bench LITE 上，在固定 100 个候选评估预算下，平均最终性能分别提升 5.5% 和 6.6%。接入 OpenEvolve 时，达到 baseline-best 性能平均少用 32.3% 迭代。实验重点是跨 run 记忆相对无记忆搜索的预算效率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of cross-run memory in LLM-driven evolutionary program and algorithm search.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a persistent memory layer for evolutionary search agents. The work is more relevant to automated program discovery than to base-model pretraining, but it offers a concrete design for reusing search experience across runs.
summary_en.technical_approach: SEDIMA distills raw traces into natural-language insights, clusters them with attention-weighted semantic centroids, and retrieves relevant guidance to condition future mutations. It is designed as a drop-in module that leaves the underlying search operators unchanged.
summary_en.experiments: On AlgoTune and ALE-Bench LITE, SEDIMA improves average final performance by 5.5% and 6.6% under a fixed budget of 100 evaluated candidates. With OpenEvolve, it reaches baseline-best performance using 32.3% fewer iterations on average.

recommendation.zh: 知道这个记忆模块即可；收益像工程叠加，和基座方法论距离较远。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a memory module for search agents; the gains look like an engineering add-on and are far from base-model methodology.

paper.title: CONTRA: Discovering and Qualifying Behavior-Changing Questions for Selective Clarification in LLM Code Generation
paper.abstract: Coding agents can generate code that appears correct but implements behavior the user never intended. This mismatch can arise when an agent silently resolves underspecified requirements through its own assumptions. As subsequent development builds on these assumptions, correcting the resulting behavior can become increasingly costly. Early clarification can help prevent such mismatches, but unnecessary questions can interrupt developers and slow down development. Existing methods struggle to ide

summary.core_problem: 解决代码生成代理在需求不充分时擅自补全用户意图，导致代码行为与真实需求偏离的问题，并只在必要时提出澄清问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个代码代理交互质量问题，不是基座预训练问题。贡献类型主要是方法改进：提出无需训练的 selective clarification 流程，用语义与执行信号筛选真正会改变程序行为的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CONTRA。先从需求中广泛生成候选澄清问题，再过滤掉与目标行为无关或已被需求隐含回答的问题。对剩余问题，分别假设两个合理答案，条件生成程序，并在共享输入上检测行为是否稳定分化；只有能稳定改变程序行为的问题才被保留。方法是 training-free，核心在 question discovery + semantic filtering + execution-based qualification。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点应是比较是否能减少无效提问，同时更早发现会改变行为的关键歧义。未见参数量、训练数据或大规模基座模型训练细节；baseline 大概率是直接提问、启发式澄清或不澄清的代码代理。对预训练研究员而言，实验价值主要在任务定义与误差类型，而非模型训练结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets behavior mismatch in code generation agents: when requirements are underspecified, the agent silently fills in assumptions and produces code that is plausible but not what the user intended, and it aims to ask clarification questions only when necessary.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a coding-agent interaction problem rather than a foundation-model pretraining problem. The contribution is a method-level improvement: a training-free selective-clarification pipeline that uses semantic and execution signals to keep only questions that can actually change program behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: CONTRA first generates a broad set of candidate clarification questions, then filters out questions unrelated to required behavior or already resolved by the prompt. For each remaining question, it conditions code generation on two plausible answers and checks whether the resulting programs exhibit stable behavioral differences on shared inputs. Only questions with behavior-changing impact are retained. The method is training-free and combines question discovery, semantic filtering, and execution-based qualification.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the evaluation likely focuses on reducing unnecessary interruptions while surfacing ambiguity that materially changes program behavior. No model scale, training corpus, or pretraining setup is given; baselines are likely naive asking, heuristic clarification, or no-clarification coding agents. For a pretraining researcher, the value is mostly in the task formulation and error taxonomy, not in training-side evidence.

recommendation.zh: 偏应用型 coding-agent 工作，对预训练帮助有限；若你关心“模型何时该问问题”，只看问题筛选和执行判别部分即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly an application-side coding-agent paper; limited pretraining value, but the question qualification logic is worth a quick look if you care about when models should ask.

paper.title: Engineering Sustainable Agents: A Systematic Comparison of Agentic LLMs for Developer Workflows
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering, including agentic systems that coordinate multiple agents, but impose higher computational and environmental costs. In this paper, we present a comprehensive empirical study of agentic LLM systems across five software engineering tasks: code generation, technical debt identification, code vulnerability detection, log parsing, and log analysis. For each task, we compare LLM configurations that range from a non-agentic sin

summary.core_problem: 系统比较开发者工作流中单Agent与多Agent LLM配置在准确率、时延和能耗上的取舍。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是经验性评测与成本分析，不是新Agent范式；但对研究员理解多Agent推理成本、部署代价和“复杂工作流是否值得”有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在五类软件工程任务上，对比单次查询基线与多Agent工作流，覆盖六个开源模型、两种提示策略和三种硬件平台，并联合测量性能、延迟与能耗。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是：多Agent设计平均能耗为非Agent基线的6.36倍、运行时间为6.07倍，个别任务最坏可慢160倍。实验更像系统性对比研究，而非提出新方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematically compares single-query and multi-agent LLM setups for developer workflows in terms of accuracy, latency, and energy.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly empirical: it quantifies the cost of agentic complexity rather than proposing a new coding-agent paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across five software-engineering tasks, it evaluates six open-weight LLMs, two prompting strategies, and three hardware platforms, comparing non-agentic baselines against multi-agent workflows.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is that multi-agent designs consume 6.36× more energy and take 6.07× longer on average than non-agentic baselines, with worst-case slowdowns up to 160× on individual tasks.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新，但数字够扎实：多Agent常把一点点精度换成数量级成本，做Agent系统的人至少该看结果表，不必深读方法。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm paper, but the numbers are useful: multi-agent workflows often trade tiny gains for order-of-magnitude cost; read the result tables, not the full method.

paper.title: Groundability, Not Scale Alone: When Weak Reviewers Can Audit Strong Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents can return plausible patches that omit required behavior. These failures are hard to review because long traces and confident summaries often hide what was missed. We ask when a nominally weaker reviewer can reliably decide whether a patch solves its issue. We study 411 execution-labeled traces from three agents and 101 controlled cases. On 154 GPT-5.4 traces, structured but unchecked evidence raises both defect catch and over-rejection. We then provide official execution evidence

summary.core_problem: 解决强 coding agent 产出补丁后难以被可靠审查的问题，尤其是 reviewer 比 agent 弱时，何种证据形式仍能做出正确审核判断。
summary.importance: 这是一个偏评测与审查协议的工作，贡献在于把“弱 reviewer 能否审强 agent”从模型规模比较，转到证据可落地、可核验的 groundability 上。对预训练研究员的价值不在 coding agent 本身，而在于它提醒：评审质量受证据接口和可验证性影响，未必随模型规模单调提升。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于执行标注的 patch traces，系统比较不同 reviewer 在不同证据格式下的 defect catch 与 over-rejection。先用官方执行证据做上界诊断，再冻结最优证据格式；在部署不可得官方测试时，构造一个冻结 cascade，结合 patch-caused static errors 与自动生成、且在未修补仓库上先失败的测试，形成现实可用的审核流程。核心创新是审查 protocol 和 evidence design，而不是训练更大的 reviewer。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出较完整实验规模：411 条 execution-labeled traces、101 个控制案例；在 154 条 GPT-5.4 traces 上，结构化但未经核验的证据同时提高 defect catch 和 over-rejection；冻结证据格式后，在 122 条 held-out traces 上 6 个 reviewer 中有 5 个两项指标都改善，2 个 reviewer 全部判对。进一步在 121 条 GPT-5.4 held-out traces 和 59 条 Gemini traces 上评估冻结 cascade。结果的关键信号是 reviewer size 不是稳定预测因子，grounded evidence 更关键。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies when a nominally weaker reviewer can reliably audit patches produced by stronger coding agents, and what kind of evidence makes that possible.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation/protocol paper. Its contribution is to shift the question from reviewer scale to evidence groundability and verifiability. For pretraining researchers, the value is not in coding agents per se, but in the reminder that review quality depends heavily on the evidence interface and not monotonically on model size.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using execution-labeled patch traces, the paper systematically compares reviewers under different evidence formats, measuring both defect catch and over-rejection. It first uses official execution evidence as an upper-bound diagnostic, then freezes the better of two evidence formats per reviewer. Since official tests are unavailable in deployment, it also builds a frozen cascade combining patch-caused static errors and generated tests that fail on the unpatched repository, yielding a practical review protocol. The novelty is in the auditing protocol and evidence design rather than in training a larger reviewer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides substantial scale details: 411 execution-labeled traces and 101 controlled cases. On 154 GPT-5.4 traces, structured but unchecked evidence improves both defect catch and over-rejection. After freezing evidence format, five of six reviewers improve both metrics on 122 held-out traces, and two reviewers classify every trace correctly. A frozen cascade is further evaluated on 121 scored held-out GPT-5.4 traces and 59 Gemini traces. The key result is that reviewer size is not a consistent predictor; grounded evidence matters more.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain，但会改你对“更大 judge 一定更好”的 prior；只看 evidence format 对 defect catch/over-rejection 的 trade-off 和冻结 cascade 即可。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining, but it should update your prior that a larger judge is always better; focus on the evidence-format trade-off and the frozen cascade.

paper.title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
paper.abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary methods, such as AlphaEvolve, have emerged as powerful approaches for challenging computational optimization problems, such as circle packing. However, prior work typically optimizes performance gain over a fixed number of iterations. We argue that practical optimization should maximize gain per unit cost. To this end, we propose FrugalEvo, a cost-aware evolutionary framework where a stronger, higher-cost LLM explores solution strategies, and a cheaper LLM implements them

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM-guided program evolution 只按固定迭代数优化效果、忽略每次调用成本的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent / program search 的成本感知系统创新。它把 AlphaEvolve 类方法从“给定迭代预算追求最好结果”改成“给定费用预算最大化收益曲线”，更贴近真实使用中的 test-time compute 分配。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FrugalEvo：高成本强模型负责探索 solution strategies，低成本模型负责编码实现并迭代修正；同时设计 cache-efficient evolution process，通过 harness 和 prompt 设计提高不同演化步骤的 prefix sharing，从而增加 KV cache 复用。提出 BA-AUC，用累计 LLM cost 下 best-so-far score 曲线面积衡量固定预算内质量。
summary.experiments: 在 10 个数学与系统优化任务上评估。摘要未完整给出 baseline、预算、模型清单和提升幅度，但核心比较是固定成本预算下的 best-so-far solution quality 与 BA-AUC。
summary.authors_note: Pang Wei Koh 是数据中心机器学习、分布偏移和模型评估方向的知名研究者；Bryan Hooi 在图学习、异常检测和系统型机器学习工作中较活跃。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch in LLM-guided program evolution where prior methods optimize solution quality over a fixed number of iterations while ignoring the cost of each LLM call.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a cost-aware system design for coding agents and program search. It reframes AlphaEvolve-style methods from fixed-iteration optimization to maximizing improvement under a monetary or inference-cost budget.
summary_en.technical_approach: FrugalEvo uses a stronger and more expensive LLM to explore solution strategies, while a cheaper LLM implements and iteratively refines the code. It also introduces a cache-efficient evolution process where the harness and prompts maximize prefix sharing across evolution steps to improve cache reuse. BA-AUC measures the area under the best-so-far score curve over cumulative LLM cost.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks. The abstract does not provide the full baselines, budgets, model list, or exact gains, but the main comparison is best-so-far quality and BA-AUC under a fixed cost budget.
summary_en.authors_note: Pang Wei Koh is known for data-centric ML, distribution shift, and model evaluation work; Bryan Hooi is active in graph learning, anomaly detection, and systems-oriented ML.

recommendation.zh: 读 metric 和模型分工设计即可；它把 agent search 从迭代数账本改成真实成本账本。
recommendation.en: Read the metric and model-splitting design; it moves agent search from iteration accounting to real cost accounting.

paper.title: AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on

summary.core_problem: 解决长轨迹 coding agent 的上下文压缩问题：agent 不仅要避免上下文溢出，还要判断何时压缩、保留什么工作状态、压缩后如何继续行动。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 方法创新。它把 context compaction 从外部启发式策略变成 agent policy 的一部分，并用 SFT 与 RL 联合优化任务成功和压缩决策。
summary.technical_approach: AutoCompact 先运行 base agent 收集编码任务轨迹，再用 judge 审查压缩时机、摘要质量和压缩后的动作。错误输出会被修正后继续在环境中执行，从而生成可继续推进任务的训练轨迹。随后用这些轨迹做监督微调，并用任务成功奖励进行强化学习，同时优化代码行为和压缩行为。
summary.experiments: 实验在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上进行。摘要未给出模型规模、轨迹数量、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度；结论是学习式压缩策略能改善长程仓库级软件工程任务表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles context compaction for long-horizon coding agents: when to compact, what state to preserve, and how to continue after compaction.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent method contribution. It treats compaction as part of the agent policy rather than an external overflow heuristic, then optimizes it jointly with task completion.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoCompact collects trajectories from a base coding agent and uses a judge to review compaction decisions, summaries, and post-compaction actions. Flawed outputs are corrected before execution continues, producing training trajectories that remain usable. The agent is then trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning using task-success rewards.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified. The abstract does not specify model sizes, data volume, baselines, or exact gains, but claims improved long-horizon coding performance.

recommendation.zh: 读数据构造和 RL 目标即可；把上下文压缩并入 policy 是合理方向，但 judge 修正轨迹可能引入不干净的信用分配。
recommendation.en: Read the data pipeline and RL objective; learning compaction as policy is sensible, but judge-corrected trajectories may blur credit assignment.

paper.title: AuraForge: Scaling Security Supervision for Training Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents are now proficient enough to generate complex software applications from a single prompt. As their capabilities have grown, human oversight has increasingly shifted from line-by-line code review toward hands-off evaluation of outcomes. However, recent studies have shown that such a transition exposes a critical risk: functional correctness alone does not guarantee a secure implementation. Despite growing attention to code security, training safer coding agents remains challenging b

summary.core_problem: 如何为 coding agents 大规模提供可靠的安全监督，避免只优化功能正确性而生成存在漏洞的软件。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 训练数据与可执行监督系统。它把安全性从静态代码审查或人工标注转成可执行攻击测试，对 RL/SFT 训练信号质量、reward hacking 防护有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AuraForge，用于合成和验证可执行安全测试。方法包含 attack-oriented test synthesis、language-extensible task construction，以及针对 reward hacking 的 safeguards；基于该流程构建 AuraGym，一个多语言、多 CWE 的可执行训练 gym。
summary.experiments: AuraGym 包含来自 344 个真实项目的 679 个可执行 feature-implementation tasks，覆盖多语言和多类 CWE。摘要未给出模型规模、训练 recipe、baseline 和提升幅度细节；核心证据是能够规模化构造可执行安全监督任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets scalable security supervision for coding agents, where functional correctness alone can hide exploitable implementations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training and executable-supervision system for coding agents. It turns security feedback into attack-oriented executable tests, which is relevant to SFT/RL signal quality and reward-hacking prevention.
summary_en.technical_approach: AuraForge synthesizes and validates executable security tests through attack-oriented test synthesis, language-extensible task construction, and safeguards against reward hacking. The resulting AuraGym is a multilingual, multi-CWE executable training gym.
summary_en.experiments: AuraGym contains 679 executable feature-implementation tasks from 344 real-world projects, spanning multiple languages and CWE classes. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training recipes, baselines, or improvement numbers; the central evidence is the scalable construction of executable security supervision.

recommendation.zh: 读数据生成和 reward-hacking 防护部分；它对代码 RL 训练信号设计比对基座预训练更有用。
recommendation.en: Read the data-generation and reward-hacking safeguards; the main value is coding-RL supervision, not base pretraining.

paper.title: Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks
paper.abstract: Coding agents often fail in the last mile: they build most of a feature but drop a requirement, test only the cases their implementation already handles, break behavior that was supposed to stay intact, or validate against an unchecked assumption. We ask whether reinforcement learning (RL) on expert-built agentic coding tasks closes this gap, and whether what the agent learns transfers beyond the training distribution. We post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter (32B active) open-weight mixture

summary.core_problem: 研究代码智能体在仓库级任务中常见的“最后一公里”失败：漏需求、测错用例、破坏既有行为，以及基于未经验证的假设行动。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法与跨 benchmark 泛化分析。它关心的不是单个 SWE 榜单分数，而是用少量专家构造的 agentic coding tasks 做 RL，能否迁移到外部分布和不同 agent harness。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Kimi K2.7 Code 这个 1T 参数、32B active 的 MoE 代码模型上，只用 RL 做后训练。训练集包含 1,000 个仓库任务和 700 个终端任务；仓库任务用 hidden fail-to-pass tests 与 pass-to-pass tests 打分，终端任务用专家 verifier。奖励是目标检查通过比例，但只要破坏 pass-to-pass 测试就归零。优化上使用一轮 GSPO，并只训练 rank-32 LoRA adapter。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个外部 benchmark 和 3 个 agent harness。摘要给出的明确数字是 SWE-Bench Pro pass@1 从 60.1 提升到 64.8；其余 benchmark 名称和完整提升幅度在给定摘要中被截断。关键实验信号是：同一套 RL 后训练没有只提升训练分布内任务，而是在多个外部代码智能体评测上同步提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets last-mile failures in coding agents: missed requirements, self-confirming tests, regressions in existing behavior, and unchecked assumptions.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a post-training and transfer study for agentic coding. The useful question is whether RL on a small set of expert-built coding tasks transfers across external benchmarks and agent harnesses, rather than merely improving one leaderboard.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter MoE model with 32B active parameters, using RL only. The training set has 1,000 repository tasks graded by hidden fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass tests, plus 700 terminal tasks graded by expert-written verifiers. The reward is the fraction of target checks passed, but it is set to zero if any pass-to-pass regression test fails. Training uses one epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation spans six external benchmarks and three agent harnesses. The explicit number in the provided abstract is SWE-Bench Pro pass@1 improving from 60.1 to 64.8; the remaining benchmark details are truncated. The main empirical signal is cross-benchmark improvement from a single RL run, not just in-distribution task fitting.

recommendation.zh: 只看奖励设计和跨 harness 结果；若复现成立，说明小规模高质量 RL 任务能教到可迁移的代码代理习惯。
recommendation.en: Read the reward design and cross-harness table; if reproducible, it is a clean signal that small high-quality RL tasks can teach transferable coding-agent behavior.

paper.title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents
paper.abstract: The performance of AI coding agents is highly dependent on their underlying coding rules. However, existing coding rules are typically hand-crafted and fixed, making the process labor-intensive and often suboptimal. In this work, we propose RuleEvolve, a self-evolving framework for coding rules. RuleEvolve maintains a pool of candidate coding rules and iteratively improves them. In each iteration, it employs an LLM-powered mutator module to generate variants from existing candidates, and then us

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI coding agent 的 coding rules 依赖人工编写、固定不变、难以随模型和任务自动优化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 的提示/规则自动优化方法。它不直接推进预训练，但对代码智能体的外层控制策略、规则池搜索和 LLM-as-judge 闭环有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RuleEvolve：维护候选 coding rules 池，每轮用 LLM-powered mutator 从已有规则生成变体，再用 judge 模块评估变体并更新规则池。方法更接近进化式 prompt/rule search，而不是模型训练或代码模型架构改动。
summary.experiments: 在两个 coding-agent 框架、四个 backbone LLM 和三个 benchmark 上评估。指标包括生成代码的 functional correctness、代码长度和生成成本/token 使用量。结果显示 RuleEvolve 优于人工规则工程和已有 prompt optimization baseline。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the dependence of AI coding agents on hand-written, fixed coding rules that are costly to craft and often suboptimal.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an automated rule-optimization method for coding agents. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to outer-loop control, rule search, and LLM-as-judge feedback for code agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: RuleEvolve keeps a pool of candidate coding rules. In each iteration, an LLM-based mutator proposes rule variants, and a judge module evaluates them and updates the pool with stronger candidates. The method is closer to evolutionary prompt/rule search than to model training or code-model architecture design.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated across two coding-agent frameworks, four backbone LLMs, and three benchmarks. Metrics include functional correctness, code length, and generation cost measured by token usage. RuleEvolve improves over manual rule engineering and existing prompt optimization baselines.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设置和失败模式即可；它是 agent 外壳的规则搜索，不会改变对代码模型预训练的判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the setup and failure cases only; this is outer-loop rule search for agents, not a signal that changes code-model pretraining priors.

paper.title: Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing
paper.abstract: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation. Across two task-ID cohorts, complete repair is 26/30 with text and 29/30 with the prepared checks. Three task IDs favor to

summary.core_problem: 研究科学计算代码修复 agent 是否能从“可执行检查工具”中获得比自然语言规则更稳定的收益。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 工具化验证的实证分析。它关注 equation、boundary condition、output requirement 这类科学计算约束如何转成 callable checks，用来辅助程序修复。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Rules to Tools，将公开科学需求预先实现为可执行检查，并在匹配的 SciCode repair 分组中控制 written checks、初始程序、模型和预算，只改变 agent 是否能调用工具实现。
summary.experiments: 在两个 task-ID cohort 上比较 text 与 tool 条件。30 题 cohort 中完整修复为 26/30 对 29/30；8-ID cohort 为 13/16 对 15/16，bootstrap 95% 区间为 [-12.5, 43.75] 个百分点；更大的 shared-definition SciCode cohort 两组同为 13/24；5 个 development-exposed 任务的 alternate starting programs 为 3/10 对 7/10。整体收益方向存在，但统计稳定性有限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether scientific coding agents benefit more from callable executable checks than from equivalent written requirements.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical contribution for coding-agent verification. It studies how scientific constraints such as equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements can be converted into tools for repair-time assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Rules to Tools provides prepared executable checks for public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share the same written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the intervention is whether the check is also available as a callable implementation.
summary_en.experiments: Across task-ID cohorts, the 30-task cohort reports 26/30 complete repairs with text versus 29/30 with tools. The 8-ID cohort scores 13/16 versus 15/16, with a cluster-bootstrap 95% interval of [-12.5, 43.75] percentage points. A larger shared-definition SciCode cohort ties at 13/24, while five development-exposed tasks with alternate starting programs score 3/10 versus 7/10. The signal is positive but noisy.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent 验证备查即可；工具化检查有收益但方差大，不足以改写训练数据或 verifier 设计。
recommendation.en: Useful as a coding-agent verification reference; executable checks help in places, but the variance is too high to guide verifier or training-data design.

paper.title: AgSpec: Pushing the Limits of Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding in Coding Agent Pipelines
paper.abstract: Retrieval-based speculative decoding (SD) drafts tokens by copying continuations from existing text, which suits coding agents that repeatedly reproduce code, logs, and earlier attempts. Yet existing methods fall short in agent pipelines: much of the reusable text is missing from their corpora or stored in a form that differs from what the agent emits, and their draft lengths ignore that accept length varies across agents and drifts over turns. We present AgSpec, a framework that supplies the co

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 流水线中检索式 speculative decoding 的可复用文本来源不足、草稿长度策略不适配多轮漂移的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统优化。它把 speculative decoding 从单次生成场景推进到仓库级、多轮、多 agent 的真实代码工作流，重点不是新模型，而是把可接受 token 的来源和长度控制做得更贴近 agent 轨迹。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgSpec，在现有检索式 draft engine 外补齐三类语料和长度策略：session corpus 保留当前会话轨迹，workspace corpus 按 agent 实际输出格式索引打开文件，global corpus 提供跨任务复用；草稿长度先用离线 profile 给每个 agent 设上限，再根据 verifier 的接受反馈在线调整。
summary.experiments: 在两个 repository-level multi-agent coding benchmark 上评测；baseline 包括五种 retrieval-based drafter 和 EAGLE-3。摘要称 AgSpec 在多数设置下优于这些方法，但给定信息未提供具体模型规模、吞吐提升倍数或 acceptance length 数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses why retrieval-based speculative decoding underperforms in coding-agent pipelines: reusable text is stored in the wrong places or formats, and draft lengths do not track agent-specific acceptance behavior over turns.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems contribution. It moves speculative decoding from isolated generation to repository-level, multi-turn coding-agent workflows, where the main bottleneck is not the draft model but corpus construction and acceptance-aware length control.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgSpec augments existing retrieval drafters with session, workspace, and global corpora. It keeps the live session trajectory, indexes opened files in the format emitted by the agent, applies offline per-agent draft-length caps, and adapts draft length online from verification feedback.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on two repository-level multi-agent coding benchmarks against five retrieval-based drafters and EAGLE-3. The abstract reports stronger results in most settings, but the provided text does not include exact model sizes, speedup ratios, or acceptance-length statistics.

recommendation.zh: 只看 corpus 设计和 draft-length ablation；对预训练没直接帮助，但对 agent serving 的缓存边界很实用。
recommendation.en: Read the corpus design and draft-length ablation; it will not change pretraining, but it is useful for where agent serving can actually reuse text.

paper.title: Zero2Repo: Can Coding Agents Build Repositories from Scratch?
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly asked to build software rather than patch it, yet benchmarks for from-scratch repository construction are mostly limited to a single language and depend on manually curated tasks. We introduce Zero2Repo, a benchmark in which an agent receives a product requirements document, an interface contract, and an empty workspace, and must deliver a complete repository in the project's native ecosystem. Tasks are produced by a language-agnostic authoring pipeline that conver

summary.core_problem: Zero2Repo 评测的是代码 Agent 从空目录交付完整仓库的能力，而不是补丁修复或单函数生成。核心问题是：在只有产品需求文档、接口契约和可复现环境的条件下，Agent 能否自己完成架构、依赖、构建配置、实现和集成调试，并通过密封的验收测试。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座和后训练研究的价值主要在评测定义和训练信号设计。它把代码能力从“局部修改”推进到“完整软件交付”，更接近长程 Agent 训练需要的可验证任务。隐藏测试提供确定性 reward，失败可以归因到具体行为类别，因此适合作为 SFT 轨迹、RL 环境和错误分析资产。对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但它能帮助判断代码模型是否真的学会了跨文件组织、构建系统、依赖管理和长程调试，而不是只会补全局部代码。
summary.technical_approach: 任务形式是三元组：公开规格、执行环境、隐藏验收测试。公开规格包括产品需求文档和 Interface Contract，前者描述行为，后者固定 API、CLI、参数约定、返回类型和错误类型。Agent 在空 workspace 中工作，需要自行创建仓库并提交。评测时，工作区被复制到干净 judge 容器，注入隐藏测试后执行；judge 不修复缺失文件，也不使用 LLM 打分。任务构建采用 evidence-gated pipeline：从 version-pinned 开源项目出发，用模型辅助生成需求、接口、环境和测试，但每个要求都要能被原项目的可执行行为支持；reference implementation 必须通过测试，adversarial validation 要证明测试能拒绝不合格实现。发布前还会中和公开名称和仓库标识，并在评测环境中阻断代码托管站点访问、上游实现安装和导入，降低直接复用源码的风险。
summary.experiments: 当前 release 有 11 个任务，其中 8 个 Python，TypeScript、Go、C++ 各 1 个，覆盖 parser、protocol、CLI tool、安全工具和依赖外部资源的软件。作者评测了 3 个 frontier model-harness 配置。任务有意选自知名开源项目，模型很可能在训练阶段见过相关代码，但没有任何配置解决全部任务。失败样例通常不是大模块完全缺失，而是长尾规则、单个不一致行为、环境相关细节或某个遗漏导致一组测试失败。论文强调 hidden suite 的 all-or-nothing 结果，同时也保留 test-level 归因，用于区分长尾 edge case、非功能子系统、成组失败和环境依赖行为。给定内容没有提供完整 pass rate 表格或每个模型的具体得分，不宜补数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 benchmark definition 和 task construction 部分，理解为什么它要求 Agent 拥有完整交付物，而不是在已有仓库中打补丁。其次看 evaluation protocol，重点是隐藏测试注入、网络和上游包阻断、reference/adversarial validation，这些决定了评测是否可作为 RL reward。最后看失败归因表和任务列表，用来判断这些任务对代码 Agent 训练是否覆盖了真实瓶颈。若只关心预训练，可略读模型分数，重点看任务生成 pipeline 和可验证训练资产的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Zero2Repo tests whether coding agents can build a complete repository from an empty workspace, not merely patch an existing project or solve an isolated programming problem. The agent receives a product requirements document, an interface contract, and a reproducible environment, then must create the architecture, implementation, dependencies, packaging, build artifacts, and integration fixes needed to pass sealed acceptance tests.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is in evaluation design and trainable reward construction. The benchmark moves code evaluation toward long-horizon software delivery with deterministic hidden tests. This is useful for studying whether code models have learned repository-level organization, build-system reasoning, dependency management, and iterative debugging. Its direct contribution to pretraining methods is limited, but the assets can support supervised trajectories and reinforcement-learning environments because the reward is executable and the failures are attributable at the test level.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each task is defined by a public specification, an execution environment, and a hidden test suite. The public side contains a requirements document describing behavior and an interface contract fixing observable APIs, CLI entry points, argument conventions, return types, and required errors. The agent works in an empty workspace and submits a repository. Evaluation copies the workspace into a fresh judge container, injects hidden tests, and runs them without repair or LLM-based grading. Tasks are produced from version-pinned open-source projects through an evidence-gated pipeline: model-written artifacts are accepted only when requirements correspond to executable upstream behavior, environments rebuild from recipes, reference implementations pass, and adversarial validation shows that weak implementations are rejected. Public project identifiers are neutralized, and the evaluation environment blocks code-hosting access and installation or import of the upstream implementation.
summary_en.experiments: The current release has 11 tasks: eight in Python and one each in TypeScript, Go, and C++. The tasks cover parsers, protocols, command-line tools, security utilities, and software with external-resource dependencies. The authors evaluate three frontier model-harness configurations. Even though the seed projects are intentionally well-known and likely present in training corpora, no configuration solves all tasks. The reported failures are often narrow but consequential: missed long-tail rules, a single inconsistency that breaks several tests, non-functional subsystems, or environment-dependent behavior. The provided content does not expose the full score table or exact pass rates, so the safe reading is qualitative rather than numeric.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the benchmark definition first to see how the task differs from SWE-bench-style patching and HumanEval-style function synthesis. Then read the construction and validation pipeline, especially reference execution, adversarial validation, upstream-code blocking, and sealed judging. These details determine whether the benchmark can serve as a reliable RL environment. The failure-analysis table and task list are the most useful parts for training-data and agent-evaluation design. Model rankings are secondary unless the full result table is available.

recommendation.zh: 一个高质量的从零构建代码仓库的 Benchmark，其自动化构建 pipeline 和严格的执行验证机制值得关注，可作为评估模型长上下文和复杂规划能力的试金石。
recommendation.en: A high-quality benchmark for from-scratch repository construction. Its automated authoring pipeline and rigorous execution validation are noteworthy, serving as a touchstone for evaluating long-context and complex planning capabilities.

paper.title: E2E-SWE: Benchmarking LLMs on Building Working Codebases from Scratch
paper.abstract: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are evolving from making localized code changes to developing complete software repositories. However, evaluating repository-scale generation remains challenging: tasks must demand system-level reasoning while ensuring that all evaluated behaviors are precisely specified and independent of any particular implementation. We introduce E2E-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can build complete, functional software repositories

summary.core_problem: 这项工作提出 E2E-SWE，用来评测 LLM coding agent 是否能从空目录和自然语言规格说明开始，生成一个完整、可安装、能通过隐藏测试的软件仓库。它针对的是 repository-scale generation，而不是函数补全、局部补丁或单个 issue 修复。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于评测信号。代码模型的能力已经从局部编辑扩展到长程软件构建，但很多基准的低 pass@1 可能混合了两种因素：模型能力不足，以及任务规格与隐藏测试不一致。E2E-SWE 把 solvability 放在核心位置，通过规格—测试一致性审查和真实 rollout 审查减少误判。这样的评测更适合观察代码预训练、代码 SFT、agent scaffold、长上下文和工具使用训练带来的真实收益。
summary.technical_approach: E2E-SWE 包含 186 个完整仓库生成任务，覆盖 11 种编程语言。每个任务基于真实 GitHub 仓库，但给模型的不是原仓库，而是工程师在 LLM 辅助下重新编写的自然语言规格说明和隐藏测试。Agent 从空 workspace 开始，只能看到 instruction.md，需要提交完整代码和 setup.sh。评测时系统把生成仓库复制到新容器中，执行 setup.sh，再运行隐藏测试。网络在实现和评分阶段都关闭，依赖预装在任务容器中，以避免模型抓取目标仓库或依赖偶然环境状态。任务格式采用 Harbor，包含 instruction.md、tests/、solution/ 和 task.toml。构建流程强调 post-hoc review-and-repair：先静态审查规格和测试是否一一对应，再审查真实模型失败案例，区分模型错误、规格缺口和过度严格的测试。
summary.experiments: 最终数据集包含 186 个任务，参考仓库中位规模为 7.4K 行代码，覆盖 11 种语言。作者评测了 13 个前沿模型，pass@1 范围为 11.7% 到 67.7%。这个区间说明，全仓库从零生成在可解任务上不是接近零分的评测；同时，不同模型之间仍有明显差距。引言中还用两个已有审计结果说明 solvability 的必要性：OpenAI 对 138 个 SWE-bench Verified 反复失败任务的审计发现，59.4% 存在会拒绝合理答案的描述或测试问题；DeepSWE 对 789 个 SWE-Bench Pro rollout 的审计发现，24.0% 的隐藏测试拒绝了被人工判断为合理的补丁。E2E-SWE 的任务设计主要是在减少这类规格—测试错配。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–45 分钟。先看 benchmark setup，尤其是空 workspace、setup.sh、新容器评分、禁网这些约束，它们决定了分数含义。然后看任务构建和 review-and-repair 流程，这是该基准区别于普通代码 benchmark 的关键。结果部分重点看 13 个模型的 pass@1 分布，而不是只看最高分。若时间有限，优先读任务生命周期图、solvability 审查流程、主要结果表和失败类型分析。

summary_en.core_problem: E2E-SWE evaluates whether LLM-powered coding agents can build a complete, installable software repository from scratch, given only a natural-language specification and an empty workspace. The target capability is repository-scale generation, not function completion, localized editing, or single-issue repair.
summary_en.importance: The main value is as an evaluation asset for code models and coding agents.
