Existing repository-level benchmarks can produce very low pass@1, but that number is hard to interpret when hidden tests reject reasonable solutions or require behavior not specified in the prompt. E2E-SWE makes task solvability a central design constraint. This makes the benchmark more useful for measuring improvements from code pretraining, code SFT, agent training, long-context modeling, and tool-use scaffolds.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 186 whole-repository tasks across 11 programming languages. Each task is grounded in a real GitHub repository, but the visible task is a newly written natural-language specification, paired with a hidden executable test suite. The agent starts from an empty workspace containing only the specification and must produce the full codebase plus a setup.sh script. During grading, the generated repository is copied into a fresh container, setup.sh is executed, and the hidden tests are run. Network access is disabled during both implementation and grading, and dependencies are preinstalled in the task image. The task format follows Harbor, with instruction.md, tests/, solution/, and task.toml. A major methodological contribution is the post-hoc review-and-repair loop: static audits check specification-test correspondence, and rollout audits inspect real model failures to identify missing requirements or overly rigid tests.
summary_en.experiments: The final benchmark has 186 tasks, with reference repositories having a median size of 7.4K lines of code. Across 13 frontier models, pass@1 ranges from 11.7% to 67.7%. This shows that whole-repository generation is measurable when task solvability is controlled, while still leaving enough spread to distinguish model capability. The motivation is supported by prior audit numbers: an OpenAI audit of 138 recurring-failure SWE-bench Verified tasks found material specification or test-design issues in 59.4% of them, and DeepSWE reported that 24.0% of audited SWE-Bench Pro rollouts were rejected by hidden tests despite being judged reasonable. E2E-SWE is designed to reduce this source of evaluation noise.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is sufficient. Read the benchmark setup first, especially the empty workspace, setup.sh, fresh-container grading, and no-network constraints, because they define what pass@1 measures. Then read the task construction and review-and-repair procedure; this is the main methodological contribution. In the results section, focus on the pass@1 distribution across 13 models rather than only the top score. If time is limited, prioritize the task lifecycle figure, the solvability audit process, the main results table, and the failure analysis.

recommendation.zh: 提出了一个极具挑战性的端到端仓库级代码生成 benchmark，对于研究 coding agent 的系统级规划和长上下文生成能力非常有价值，建议关注其评测协议设计。
recommendation.en: Proposes a highly challenging benchmark for end-to-end repository-scale code generation, valuable for studying system-level planning and long-context generation in coding agents; the evaluation protocol design is worth noting.

paper.title: DoGBench: Can Agents Meet Expert Standards for User-Facing Documentation?
paper.abstract: We introduce DoGBENCH (Documentation Generation Benchmark), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for generating and maintaining real user-facing software documentation. It asks whether an agent can produce documentation that experienced technical writers would accept in review. The benchmark contains 292 items from open source projects, including Helm, PostHog, and Mautic. Each item gives the agent a pre-change repository and a trigger, such as a code pull request or a reported documentation ga

summary.core_problem: DoGBench 评测软件文档生成 agent 是否能达到真实维护者和技术写作者可接受的标准，包括什么时候应该修改文档、什么时候应该 abstain。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练的直接关联较弱，主要价值在 agent evaluation。它提醒模型评测不能只看代码生成或摘要相似度，还要评估检索证据、判断修改范围、避免不必要编辑、满足用户任务完成条件等能力。对训练数据和 post-training 来说，它提供了一类更接近真实工作流的监督信号：不是生成一段看起来合理的说明，而是在仓库约束、产品行为和用户目标之间做取舍。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark 包含 292 个来自开源项目的样本，项目包括 Helm、PostHog、Mautic 等。每个样本给 agent 一个变更前仓库和一个 trigger，trigger 可以是代码 pull request，也可以是用户报告的文档缺口。agent 需要先判断是否需要文档更新；205 个样本要求提交 patch，87 个样本要求 abstain。评价不依赖与人类合并文档的文本相似度，而是使用任务特定 rubric，并经过项目维护者验证。为降低污染风险，运行环境使用身份脱敏仓库、Docker 容器，并限制网络访问；作者还做了事件日期、仓库 footprint 和相似度检查。
summary.experiments: 论文评估了 7 条 agent lane。主要 held-out split 为 117 个样本，公开 dev split 为 175 个样本。最佳 agent 在 held-out split 上得到 47.3/100。幻觉内容不是最主要问题，只有 6.1% 的提交包含 fabricated content。更常见的问题是 patch 表面合理，但用户仍无法完成任务：在 1,267 份提交中，45.5% 存在 task-completion gap。错误归因也比较清楚：36.0% 的提交在没有检查用户如何使用产品接口的情况下解释接口；33.1% 太早停止调查，没有找到决定性证据；30.1% 修改了第一个看起来合理的文档位置，却遗漏了其他受影响页面。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Benchmark Design，了解 patch-or-abstain 的任务设计、污染控制和 rubric 构造；再看实验分析中的失败类型统计。对 LLM 研究者最有用的是错误分类部分，因为它把 agent 文档写作失败拆成 evidence gathering、scope selection 和 user-task completion 三类问题。若只关心预训练，可快速浏览，不需要细读全部项目案例。

summary_en.core_problem: DoGBench evaluates whether agents can generate and maintain user-facing software documentation at a standard that experienced maintainers and technical writers would accept, including the decision to make no change when documentation should be left untouched.
summary_en.importance: The paper is only indirectly related to pre-training, but it is useful for agent evaluation and post-training data design. It shows that documentation work is not well captured by code-generation metrics or text similarity to a merged human patch. The task requires evidence gathering, deciding the right documentation surface, abstaining when no user-facing change is needed, and ensuring that a reader can complete the target task. These are relevant signals for training agents that operate in real repositories rather than isolated prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 292 items from open-source projects such as Helm, PostHog, and Mautic. Each item provides a pre-change repository and a trigger, either a code pull request or a reported documentation gap. The agent must decide whether documentation needs an update. There are 205 patch-required items and 87 abstention items. Scoring uses task-specific rubrics validated with project maintainers, rather than rewarding textual similarity to the human-written merged documentation. The benchmark also includes contamination controls: agents run in fresh Docker containers with identity-masked repositories and no network access except to the model provider, and the authors inspect potential overlap with merged human patches.
summary_en.experiments: The primary evaluation uses a stratified 117-item held-out split, with 175 public development items. Seven agent lanes are evaluated. The best agent scores 47.3 out of 100 on the held-out split. Fabrication is relatively uncommon: 6.1% of submissions contain fabricated content. The dominant failure mode is more practical: 45.5% of 1,267 submissions leave a task-completion gap, meaning the patch looks plausible but does not let the reader finish the task. The trajectory analysis attributes failures to weak investigation behavior: 36.0% of submissions explain product interfaces without checking how readers use them, 33.1% stop before finding decisive evidence, and 30.1% edit the first plausible documentation surface while missing other affected surfaces.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the benchmark design, especially the patch-or-abstain setup, rubric construction, and contamination controls. Then read the failure analysis, which is the most transferable part for LLM agent research. The useful lesson is that repository agents fail less by obvious hallucination and more by incomplete evidence gathering, poor scope selection, and patches that do not support user task completion. Readers focused strictly on pre-training can read it lightly.

recommendation.zh: 评测设计比任务本身更值得看：把 abstain 和 patch placement 纳入评分是对 coding agent 评估的纠偏；读 rubric 和任务定义即可。
recommendation.en: The benchmark design is the real contribution: adding abstention and patch placement corrects a common flaw in coding-agent evals; read the task definition and rubric, not every experiment.

paper.title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?
paper.abstract: Delegating complete application development to coding agents requires preserving the intended design rather than simply producing plausible outputs through naive prompting. Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating inte

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：coding agent 能否按照长篇游戏设计文档完整实现一个游戏，而不是只生成一个看起来可玩的近似产物。难点不在编译通过，而在规则、视觉表现、交互行为以及规则之间的依赖关系是否同时满足。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接贡献有限，它更接近 coding agent 评测资产。但它有两个有用启发。第一，复杂任务的评测不能只看局部 checklist，需求之间的前置关系会显著改变真实通过率。第二，面向 agent 训练或 post-train 的数据闭环，需要把自然语言规格、可执行测试、运行轨迹和错误归因连起来，而不只是收集最终答案。
summary.technical_approach: A2Z GameSpec-Bench 构造了 100 个长篇 GDD，其中 50 个 Small、50 个 Big。每个任务要求 agent 从 GDD 生成源码项目和可玩构建。评测端先把 GDD 转成 Dependency-Aware Contract，显式记录规则、约束以及规则之间的前置依赖。然后用多种证据检查同一组需求：源码检查、视觉评估、场景回放、trace-guided frame selection，以及基于 Code-as-Policy 的自适应 playtesting bot。normal play 用来检查从初始状态自然展开的行为链，targeted adversarial tests 用来主动建立前置条件，再验证后续效果。这个设计的关键区别是：它不把需求当作独立条目，而是用依赖图约束 GDD Fidelity 评分，并把失败证据绑定回具体需求，便于后续修复。
summary.experiments: 实验显示，编译和运行通过并不代表规格忠实。Claude-Fable-5.1 在 compile/runtime 检查下 verifiable rate 达到 98.7%，但整体 GDD Fidelity 只有 77.0。依赖关系会进一步放大局部评测的乐观偏差：在 100 个 GPT-5.6-Sol 生成游戏上，dependency-linked rules 的本地源码判断平均通过率为 72.4%，但要求所有上游规则也通过后，dependency-adjusted pass 只有 22.7%，相差 49.7 个百分点。工作还指出，仅靠源码检查会漏掉运行时视觉和交互层面的设计违例，例如状态链接缺失导致奖励触发前的移除步骤被跳过。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15–20 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 GDD Fidelity、Dependency-Aware Contract 和多证据评测的定义；再看 Figure 1、Figure 2 和 Table 1，理解为什么 compile/runnable、源码检查、局部规则通过率都不够。若关注 agent 训练数据或 verifier 设计，可以继续看 Appendix A 的 GDD 构造流程和 Appendix B.7 的依赖图 reachability 评分。无需深读具体游戏内容，价值主要在评测协议。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether coding agents can implement a complete game from a long-form Game Design Document, rather than producing a plausible playable artifact. The hard part is not compilation. It is preserving rules, visual behavior, player interaction, and dependencies among requirements.
summary_en.importance: Its direct value for base-model pretraining is limited; this is mainly an evaluation benchmark for coding agents. The useful signal is methodological. Complex agent evaluations need dependency-aware scoring, because local requirement checks can badly overestimate real task completion. It also points to a useful post-training data loop: connect natural-language specs, executable tests, runtime traces, and requirement-level error attribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: A2Z GameSpec-Bench contains 100 long-form GDD tasks, split into 50 Small and 50 Big designs. Each agent must produce a source project and a playable build. The evaluator converts each GDD into a fixed Dependency-Aware Contract, which records individual rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations between rules. The same requirements are then checked through source inspection, visual assessment, scenario replay, trace-guided frame selection, and adaptive playtesting with Code-as-Policy bots. Normal play tests whether behavior chains emerge from the initial state; targeted adversarial tests establish missing preconditions and then verify downstream effects. The main design choice is to score GDD Fidelity over a requirement graph, not over an independent checklist.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results show a large gap between runnability and specification faithfulness. Claude-Fable-5.1 reaches a 98.7% verifiable rate under compile and runtime checks, while its overall GDD Fidelity is 77.0. Dependency adjustment changes the picture even more: across 100 GPT-5.6-Sol games, dependency-linked rules have a 72.4% local source-code pass rate, but only 22.7% pass when all upstream prerequisites must also pass. The paper also gives examples where source inspection misses runtime design violations, such as a missing state linkage that skips a required removal step before reward gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, about 15–20 minutes. Read the Introduction for the definitions of GDD Fidelity, Dependency-Aware Contract, and the multi-evidence evaluation setup. Figure 1, Figure 2, and Table 1 are the most useful parts for understanding why compilation, source inspection, and local rule pass rates are insufficient. For verifier or agent-training-data work, Appendix A on GDD construction and Appendix B.7 on dependency-graph scoring are worth checking. The individual game cases are less important than the evaluation protocol.

recommendation.zh: 针对长文本和复杂依赖关系的代码生成评测，对评估 LLM 的长上下文理解和复杂指令遵循能力有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Code generation evaluation targeting long contexts and complex dependencies, offering reference value for assessing LLM's long-context understanding and complex instruction following.

paper.title: TomasuLLM: Out-of-Order Speculative Execution for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-running tools can dominate coding-agent latency: compilers, test suites, and repository commands take seconds to minutes while the agent idles. This observation stall presents the same tension that drove out-of-order processors -- asequential interface hides work that can be predicted and started early, but a speculative result may become visible only after it and every earlier step have been validated. We present TomasuLLM, a runtime that executes agent tool calls out of trajectory order w

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 在编译、测试、仓库命令等长耗时工具调用期间空等，导致端到端任务延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent runtime 层面的系统创新：把处理器中的乱序执行思想迁移到 LLM agent 工具调用，在保持轨迹语义正确的前提下提前执行可能的未来动作。
summary.technical_approach: TomasuLLM 会 draft 未来 tool calls，在 copy-on-write sandbox 中提前运行，记录依赖和副作用；只有当更早步骤和当前状态验证通过后，才按原始轨迹顺序提交结果，避免 speculative execution 污染真实状态。
summary.experiments: 在三个覆盖亚秒级到分钟级工具调用的 benchmark 上测试；100 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务平均提升 1.31x，28 个 Terminal-Bench 2.0 任务提升 1.35x，另一个长工具延迟设置中 matched progress 提升约 1.27x。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 HKUST、南京大学、KAUST 和之江实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets latency in coding agents, where compilers, test suites, and repository commands can take seconds to minutes while the agent waits.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a runtime-level systems idea for agents: importing out-of-order execution from processors into LLM tool use while preserving trajectory correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach: TomasuLLM drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces dependencies and side effects, and commits results only in trajectory order after validating them against the committed state.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on three benchmarks with tool latencies from sub-second to minutes. It reports 1.31x improvement on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and about 1.27x matched-progress improvement in a third setting.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with HKUST, Nanjing University, KAUST, and Zhejiang Lab.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和失败回滚部分；这不改预训练 prior，但对长工具链 agent 的推理时计算编排有参考。
recommendation.en: Skim the runtime design and rollback logic; it does not change pretraining priors, but it is useful for inference-time orchestration in long tool-chain agents.

paper.title: SecureVibe: Making Vibe Coding More Secure
paper.abstract: As vibe coding becomes increasingly capable and widespread, security vulnerabilities in even functionally correct solutions are a growing concern. When investigating functionally correct but insecure solutions, we find that the insecure agent is less than half as likely to conduct effective planning and testing for the hidden security risks behind the functional requirements. Motivated by this, we develop SECUREVIBE, a training recipe that explicitly targets planning and testing for code securit

summary.core_problem: SecureVibe 解决的是 coding agent 在“功能正确但安全错误”的场景中缺少安全规划和安全测试的问题，尤其是隐含安全需求不会被普通功能测试暴露。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练方向的直接价值不在基座训练，而在 post-train 信号设计。它把安全能力拆成可训练的行为：识别安全需求、提前规划防护、实现安全控制、生成安全测试。这个拆法比单纯用漏洞检测分数做 reward 更清楚，也更容易解释为什么某些 RL 训练会提高功能通过率但不能稳定提高安全通过率。对做代码模型和 agent post-train 的研究员，主要启发是：安全不是一个单一结果标签，训练信号需要覆盖中间行为，否则模型容易在通过功能测试后停止探索。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两层。第一层是 Security Suite SFT，混合四类任务：Functionality-Focused Coding、Security-Focused Coding、Security Planning、Security Testing。这个数据配比的目的不是只教模型写安全补丁，而是先触发 agent 在轨迹里显式考虑安全约束。第二层是两种 post-training。SecureVibe_rl 使用可执行反馈，围绕功能测试和安全测试给 outcome reward，适合 SFT 后模型已经能较常产生安全行为、正反馈密度不太低的情况。SecureVibe_hg 使用带实例级安全提示的 teacher 做自蒸馏，提供 token-level 的稠密监督，适合直接 RL 很难拿到足够正反馈的安全任务。和常见代码 RL recipe 相比，它的差别在于 reward 和监督都围绕安全规划、实现、测试三个行为链条组织，而不是只优化最终功能通过率。
summary.experiments: 实验以 Qwen 3.5 35B 为基座，在 AutoBaxBench 和 PatchEval-Gen 上训练，并在 SusVibes、BaxBench 上做跨基准评估。PatchEval-Gen 和 SusVibes 更接近真实仓库中的 feature implementation；AutoBaxBench 和 BaxBench 偏 repo-level backend from scratch。验证集上，SecureVibe_rl 相比 base model 的平均 FuncPass 提升 9.78 个百分点；SecureVibe_hg 的平均 SecPass 提升 8.23 个百分点。跨基准结果也有迁移，SusVibes 和 BaxBench 上报告的对应提升分别达到 10.9 和 4.8 个百分点。在 unseen-CWE 子集上，SecPass 在 SusVibes 提升 11.5 个百分点，在 BaxBench 提升 7.1 个百分点。安全训练没有明显牺牲通用代码能力，所有训练后 checkpoint 在 SWE-bench Verified 上都超过 base model，最高提升 4.1 个百分点。行为分析显示，训练后模型更频繁地产生安全规划、安全编码和安全测试轨迹。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3.1 的轨迹对比，它解释了功能正确和安全正确之间的行为差异；再看 Section 3.2 和 3.3 的训练 recipe，尤其是四类 SFT 数据和 SecureVibe_rl / SecureVibe_hg 的选择条件。Section 5 值得看，因为它讨论 reward density 对 post-training 方法选择的影响。若只关心基座预训练，可跳过 benchmark 细节，把重点放在“行为级训练信号如何补足 outcome reward 稀疏性”这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: SecureVibe studies why coding agents can pass functional tests while still introducing security vulnerabilities, and targets the missing behaviors: planning for hidden security requirements and testing security-sensitive paths.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is in post-training signal design rather than base pretraining. The work decomposes secure coding into trainable behaviors: recognizing security requirements, planning controls, implementing defenses, and writing security tests. This is more informative than treating security as a single pass/fail reward, especially when executable feedback is sparse and functional tests can give misleading confidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The recipe has two stages. First, Security Suite SFT mixes four task types: functionality-focused coding, security-focused coding, security planning, and security testing. The goal is to make the agent explicitly surface security constraints during its trajectory, not merely patch known vulnerabilities. Second, the work compares two post-training variants. SecureVibe_rl uses executable functional and security feedback as outcome rewards, which works better when the SFT checkpoint already produces enough security-aware behavior to receive positive feedback. SecureVibe_hg uses hint-guided self-distillation: a teacher with instance-specific security hints provides denser token-level supervision. Compared with standard code RL recipes, the key change is that supervision is organized around the planning–coding–testing chain for security, rather than final functional success alone.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments train Qwen 3.5 35B on AutoBaxBench and PatchEval-Gen, then evaluate on SusVibes and BaxBench. PatchEval-Gen and SusVibes involve feature implementation in real repositories, while AutoBaxBench and BaxBench ask agents to implement repo-level backends from scratch. On the validation sets of PatchEval-Gen and AutoBaxBench, SecureVibe_rl improves average FuncPass by 9.78 percentage points over the base model, while SecureVibe_hg improves average SecPass by 8.23 points. The reported cross-benchmark gains on SusVibes and BaxBench reach 10.9 and 4.8 points. On unseen-CWE subsets, SecPass improves by 11.5 points on SusVibes and 7.1 points on BaxBench. The trained checkpoints also improve general coding performance on SWE-bench Verified, with gains up to 4.1 points. Trajectory analysis shows more frequent security planning, secure implementation, and security test generation after training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20–30 minutes. Start with Section 3.1 for the trajectory comparison between secure and insecure agents, since it motivates the whole recipe. Then read Sections 3.2 and 3.3 for the four-part SFT mixture and the two post-training variants. Section 5 is useful for understanding when outcome-based RL is sufficient and when hint-guided dense supervision is needed. Readers focused on base-model training can skip most benchmark details and focus on the design of behavior-level training signals under sparse rewards.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“安全”拆成 planning/testing 行为信号这点值得借鉴；只看训练信号设计和 ablation，别把 benchmark 提升看得太重。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the decomposition of security into planning/testing signals is worth stealing; read the signal design and ablations, not the headline benchmark gains.

paper.title: How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?
paper.abstract: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made significant progress on public leaderboards. Often motivated by progress stagnation over long-horizon cycles and limited Large Language Model (LLM) primitives, modern MLE agents are deployed on top of increasingly elaborate machinery: multi-agent orchestrators, dedicated retrieval subagents, and more. While such harnesses expand, the use of more primitive but improved coding agents - where LLMs have direct access to the execut

summary.core_problem: 当前自主机器学习工程（MLE）Agent 倾向于使用越来越复杂的脚手架（Harness，如多智能体编排、专用检索等），但这些复杂设计是否真的比一个具备基础工具访问权限的强大单体编码 Agent 更好？
summary.importance: 通过严格控制变量的消融实验，挑战了当前 MLE Agent 领域“堆砌复杂脚手架”的趋势，证明了随着基座模型能力的提升，简单的编码 Agent 循环足以胜过复杂的硬编码工作流，呼应了“苦涩的教训（The Bitter Lesson）”。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了一个名为 Malena 的极简基线（单体会话、最少工具集），并在统一的代码库中对各种脚手架干预措施（执行环境、搜索、自主性、多智能体编排）进行了系统性的消融实验。在控制时间预算、硬件和基座模型（如 GLM 5.2）一致的前提下，对比了 Malena 与四种开源 SOTA 脚手架的性能。
summary.experiments: 在 MLE-bench 和 NatureBench 上，赋予模型编码 Agent 环境（读写执行权限）是带来最大性能提升的因素。在此基础上，增加搜索、多智能体等复杂干预措施并未带来统计学上的显著提升。在所有测试的前沿基座模型下，极简的 Malena 均持平或超越了复杂的 SOTA 脚手架。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 4 的消融实验设计和结果，理解不同干预措施的实际贡献。Section 5.2 的轨迹分析（Trace Analysis）非常有价值，展示了强大的单体 Agent 如何自发地进行适应性搜索，而无需脚手架的硬编码约束。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current autonomous Machine Learning Engineering (MLE) agents tend to use increasingly complex harnesses (e.g., multi-agent orchestration, dedicated retrieval). But are these complex designs really better than a strong, single coding agent with basic tool access?
summary_en.importance: Through strictly controlled ablation studies, this paper challenges the trend of 'stacking complex harnesses' in the MLE agent field. It proves that as foundation model capabilities improve, a simple coding agent loop is sufficient to outperform complex hard-coded workflows, echoing 'The Bitter Lesson'.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a minimal baseline named Malena (single session, minimal toolset) and conducts systematic ablation studies on various harness interventions (execution environment, search, autonomy, multi-agent orchestration) within a unified codebase. Under controlled time budgets, hardware, and foundation models (e.g., GLM 5.2), it compares Malena with four open-source SOTA harnesses.
summary_en.experiments: On MLE-bench and NatureBench, providing the model with a coding agent environment (read/write/execute permissions) is the factor that brings the largest performance improvement. Beyond this, adding complex interventions like search or multi-agent orchestration does not yield statistically significant gains. Across all tested frontier foundation models, the minimal Malena matches or outperforms complex SOTA harnesses.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the ablation study design and results in Section 4 to understand the actual contribution of different interventions. The trace analysis in Section 5.2 is highly valuable, showing how a strong single agent spontaneously performs adaptive search without the hard-coded constraints of a harness. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 harness 消融表；若 setup 干净，它会降低对复杂 Agent 外壳的 prior，提高对底座能力评估的权重。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental setup and harness-ablation tables; if clean, it should lower your prior on elaborate scaffolds and raise the weight on backbone capability.

paper.title: Approval Laundering: Systematizing Approval--Execution Binding Failures in AI Coding-Agent Harnesses
paper.abstract: Modern AI coding-agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor) rest their security boundary on a largely unexamined assumption: that the action A a human approves is the same action A' the harness executes, where A is fixed by a stated policy for what a scope grant or session-scoped approval authorizes. We show this assumption fails systematically and reproducibly. We introduce Approval Laundering, a taxonomy of six failure modes by which a harness's enforcement mechanism silently substitutes

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是 AI coding-agent harness 的 approval 机制是否真的把“用户批准的动作”准确绑定到“系统实际执行的动作”。作者指出，当前 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor 这类系统把安全边界几乎全部压在一次 approval checkpoint 上，但默认假设 A=A'：用户批准的动作与后续执行动作一致。论文要解决的核心问题，是把这种绑定失败系统化、可复现地定义出来，并证明它不是零散 bug，而是一类结构性失配。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究没有直接贡献，也不属于基座模型训练方法、数据或架构层面的工作。启发主要在 agent/eval/security 接口：如果后训练把模型放进一个有 approval、tool、delegation 的执行环境里，系统安全性并不只取决于模型是否“听话”，还取决于 harness 是否把授权语义绑定正确。对做 foundation model 的人，这篇文章更像是 agent harness 安全评测与系统设计问题，而不是 LLM pretrain 问题。若研究重点是通用 agent 评测、安全边界、tool-use execution semantics，可以了解；若聚焦预训练，可低优先级处理。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，论文提出 Approval Laundering 这一总类，并按 credential-binding surface 划分六种 failure mode：Scope、Argument、Temporal、Tool、Delegation、Semantic laundering。其共同特征是：系统在没有重新请求 approval 的情况下，把用户批准的动作 A 静默替换成了更宽、更晚、不同工具、不同代理或语义上不同的执行动作 A'。作者强调，这不是传统 prompt injection 视角，也不是简单的危险命令分类问题。很多失败案例里，模型发出的命令字符串本身没有变化，问题出在 harness 如何解释 scope grant、如何绑定 session/agent-scoped approval、如何处理 repository-local hooks、工具别名、后续委托执行、以及 UI 呈现与底层实际调用之间的语义偏差。论文的技术贡献主要是形式化和 taxonomy：先给出一个可证伪的 approval policy 定义，再围绕不同绑定面设计可复现实验，测量批准动作与执行动作的偏离。它和已有 AmPermBench、OverEager-Bench 这类工作不同，后者更偏风险分类或 scope 推断，而这里关注的是 approval credential 到 downstream effect 的绑定正确性。
summary.experiments: 从给出的全文片段看，实验是围绕生产级 coding-agent harness 的系统性测量，而不是模型能力评测。作者在多个真实 harness 上复现六类 laundering failure，并报告发生率与置信区间。文中举的一个具体例子是 Argument Laundering：用户批准精确命令 `git commit -m "wip"`，但仓库本地 pre-commit hook 会执行 `git add -A`，导致未预期文件被一并提交。这个场景下，命令字符串与任务语义都看似合理，传统危险命令分类和 scope 检查都不一定能发现，但实际 side effect 已经超出批准范围。论文报告该场景在 N=20 次运行中发生率为 45%，Wilson 95% CI 为 [0.258, 0.658]。从结构上看，全文应还包含其余五类 failure mode 的复现实验、不同 harness 的覆盖情况，以及与现有安全基准的对照，重点不在模型差异，而在 harness enforcement mechanism 的系统缺陷。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合带着问题泛读。先看 Introduction 和 policy 定义部分，确认作者如何形式化 A 与 A'，以及为什么不用“用户主观意图”而用显式 stated policy 作为判定标准。然后直接看 taxonomy 章节，弄清六类 laundering 分别攻击哪个 binding surface。实验部分建议重点看每类 failure 的最小复现、成功率、以及作者如何排除 prompt injection 等混杂因素。若只想判断是否与你的研究相关，30 分钟内读完定义、taxonomy 和一两个代表性实验就够了。若你做 agent harness、tool-use sandbox 或 approval protocol 设计，则值得细看方法学和 case study；若你主要做预训练，这篇不需要深挖。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether approval checkpoints in AI coding-agent harnesses actually bind the operator-approved action to the action that gets executed. Current systems such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor effectively place their entire security boundary on this assumption. The paper argues that the assumption is systematically false: even without prompt injection or overt model misbehavior, the harness can silently substitute a broader, later, differently scoped, or semantically different action for the one that was approved.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining contribution, and it is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model research. Its value lies in the agent systems layer: once a model is embedded in a tool-using harness, safety depends not only on model behavior but also on whether the harness preserves the semantics of human authorization. For researchers focused on pretraining, the paper is peripheral. For those working on coding agents, tool-use protocols, or agent evaluation and security boundaries, it is more relevant because it identifies a failure class that is not captured well by dangerous-command classifiers or scope-inference checks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Approval Laundering as a taxonomy of approval–execution binding failures. It organizes the space into six failure modes: Scope, Argument, Temporal, Tool, Delegation, and Semantic laundering. The unifying idea is that a human approves action A under an explicit policy, but the harness executes A' without requesting renewed approval. The contribution is primarily formal and empirical rather than algorithmic. The authors define a falsifiable approval policy, distinguish it from subjective operator intent, and then design reproducible tests around different credential-binding surfaces. A key point is that many failures do not involve the model changing the literal command string at all. Instead, the mismatch arises from repository-local hooks, session-scoped grants, tool indirection, delegated execution, or UI/rendering mismatches that alter the downstream effect of an otherwise approved action. This makes the work different from prior benchmarks centered on command risk classification or over-broad scope inference.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments appear to be system-level measurements on production coding-agent harnesses rather than model capability evaluations. The paper reports reproducible failures across the proposed laundering categories and quantifies their incidence with confidence intervals. One concrete example is Argument Laundering: the operator approves the exact command `git commit -m "wip"`, but a repository-local pre-commit hook runs `git add -A`, causing unintended files to be committed. In this case, the literal command remains unchanged and the task context still looks benign, so standard command-risk or scope checks may not flag it, yet the executed side effect exceeds the approved action. The paper reports a 45% occurrence rate for this scenario over N=20 runs, with a Wilson 95% confidence interval of [0.258, 0.658]. The full paper likely includes analogous measurements for the other five failure modes and comparisons across harnesses.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this selectively. Start with the introduction and the formal policy section to understand how the paper defines A versus A' and why it uses explicit stated policy rather than subjective user intent. Then read the taxonomy section carefully, since the six laundering modes are the main conceptual contribution. In the experiments, focus on one or two representative case studies and how the authors isolate harness-level failures from prompt injection or model-side issues. If your main interest is pretraining, a 20–30 minute skim is enough. If you work on coding-agent harnesses, tool-use sandboxes, or approval protocol design, the methodology and case studies deserve closer attention.

recommendation.zh: 值得读 taxonomy 和实验协议；这类 approval-execution binding 比“模型是否拒答”更接近真实 coding agent 的安全边界。
recommendation.en: Read the taxonomy and protocol; approval-execution binding is a more realistic safety boundary for coding agents than refusal behavior alone.

paper.title: OpenCollab: A Multi-Agent Coding Framework with Programmable Collaboration and Controllable Runtime
paper.abstract: Multi-agent coding systems are designed to tackle complex software engineering tasks through collaboration. However, existing evaluations typically assume configured organizations are followed faithfully, whereas reality differs. This behavioral gap, combined with differences in underlying system components, prevents clear attribution of observed gains. To this end, we introduce OpenCollab, a multi-agent coding framework that provides a unified infrastructure for programmable collaboration and c

summary.core_problem: 解决多 Agent 编程系统中“声明的协作组织”和“实际执行行为”不一致的问题，并为不同协作配置提供可控、可归因的运行环境。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 框架和分析工具。它强调统一 runtime、可编程协作和执行事件追踪，并提出 Adherence 指标衡量组织设计是否真的被执行。对软件工程 Agent 评测和系统消融有参考价值，但与 LLM 基座预训练关联较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OpenCollab 框架，统一 organization design，控制共享 runtime 中的实验变量，并记录细粒度 event streams。基于这些执行日志，定义 Adherence 来量化声明组织与实际协作行为的一致性，从而把系统组件差异和协作模式差异拆开分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告，不同配置下 Agent 协作行为差异明显；改变任一单独维度都会改变 Adherence，数值从 47.2% 到 97.2% 不等。论文还在 agentic coding benchmarks 上做了较大规模实验，但摘要未给出具体 benchmark 名称、模型、任务数或性能提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Jiao Tong University、University of Cambridge、Nanyang Technological University、The University of Hong Kong、Imperial College London；输入信息另标注 Peking University 为强机构，但摘要机构行未能确认其具体归属。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap between the declared collaboration structure of multi-agent coding systems and the behavior that actually happens at runtime.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent framework and analysis contribution. It provides programmable collaboration, controlled runtime, fine-grained event tracing, and an Adherence metric to measure whether the intended organization is realized. It is useful for agentic coding ablations, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenCollab unifies organization design, enforces experimental control over a shared runtime, and records fine-grained event streams. The proposed Adherence metric quantifies the match between the declared multi-agent organization and the observed collaboration behavior, enabling clearer attribution across system components and collaboration patterns.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that agents collaborate very differently across configurations: changing any single dimension shifts Adherence from 47.2% to as high as 97.2%. It also mentions extensive experiments on agentic coding benchmarks, but does not provide concrete benchmark names, model choices, task counts, or performance deltas in the provided text.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University, University of Cambridge, Nanyang Technological University, The University of Hong Kong, and Imperial College London. The input also marks Peking University as a strong institution, but the provided institution line does not confirm the exact affiliation.

recommendation.zh: 适合作为 coding-agent 消融框架参考；Adherence 指标比榜单分数更有诊断性，但不必读全篇。
recommendation.en: Useful as a coding-agent ablation framework; the Adherence metric is more diagnostic than leaderboard scores, but the full paper is optional.

paper.title: Fyan: A Human--AI Harness with Semantic Auditing for Document-Level Formalization
paper.abstract: We present FYAN, a human--AI harness for document-level mathematical formalization. Rather than treating theorems in isolation, FYAN coordinates an end-to-end workflow spanning specification, proof planning, logical review, Lean proof construction, knowledge curation, and validation, with support for independent supervision and human guidance. A central component is evidence-grounded semantic auditing, which assesses whether formal statements faithfully preserve their informal specifications. A

summary.core_problem: 解决文档级数学形式化中，LLM 容易只证明孤立定理、但形式陈述与原始非形式化文本语义不一致的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是形式化工作流和人机协作系统。它的价值不在预训练，而在展示 Lean 证明构造中如何把语义审计、人工监督和知识整理接入同一执行链。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FYAN，一个覆盖 specification、proof planning、logical review、Lean proof construction、knowledge curation 和 validation 的 human-AI harness。核心组件是 evidence-grounded semantic auditing：模型生成局部对应、遗漏、作用域和逻辑关系的结构化证据，确定性 validator 再给出可复现判断；若接受实质但允许的偏差，需要显式 proof-transfer obligation。
summary.experiments: 使用同一个模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 贯穿各阶段。在严格协议下，FYAN 在 FormalTCS 上证明 143 个定理中的 86 个。摘要未给出与其他 formalization agent 的完整对比或人工成本细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses document-level mathematical formalization, where LLM systems may prove isolated Lean theorems while drifting from the semantics of the informal source.
summary_en.importance: This is a workflow and human-AI system contribution for formal proof construction. Its relevance to pretraining is indirect: it shows how semantic auditing and deterministic validation can structure long-horizon formal reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: FYAN coordinates specification, proof planning, logical review, Lean proof construction, knowledge curation, and validation. Its central component is evidence-grounded semantic auditing: an LM produces structured evidence about local correspondences, omissions, scope, and logical relations, while a deterministic validator produces reproducible judgments. Accepted deviations require explicit proof-transfer obligations.
summary_en.experiments: The system uses DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash in every stage and proves 86 out of 143 FormalTCS theorems under a strict protocol. The abstract does not provide full comparisons with other formalization agents or detailed human-effort accounting.

recommendation.zh: 作为形式化 agent 工程备查即可；semantic auditing 思路有用，但不是基座训练问题。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a formalization-agent reference; the semantic auditing idea is useful, but this is not a base-model training paper.

paper.title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?
paper.abstract: Agents increasingly build on code written by other agents, and they reimplement rather than reuse, growing the codebases later agents must work in. To measure how well agents design libraries for other agents, we introduce LibraryDesignBench, a two-phase benchmark in which an agent implements a full-featured library from a specification that defines required capabilities and potential use cases without prescribing the design. We evaluate the library through the correctness and simplicity of prog

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要评测一个更贴近 agentic coding 的问题：一个代码 Agent 生成的库，是否真的能让后续 Agent 更容易写出正确、简洁的程序。普通单元测试只能检验库是否可用，不能检验 API 抽象是否方便下游 Agent 使用；人工评审也未必反映 Agent 的使用偏好。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接启发有限，但对 coding agent 评测有参考价值。它把“代码质量”从实现正确性推进到“可复用抽象是否能降低后续 Agent 的工作量”。如果后续训练 coding agent，需要构造更长链条的软件工程反馈，这类两阶段评测比只看 pass rate 更接近真实开发流程。
summary.technical_approach: LibraryDesignBench 采用两阶段设计。Design Phase 中，被测 Agent 根据开放式规格实现一个完整库，规格给出必须支持的能力和少量可见用例，但不规定接口和抽象。Evaluation Phase 中，多个较弱的 user agents 使用该库完成下游编程题。评分同时看正确性和简洁性；简洁性用参考解与生成程序在多种静态复杂度指标上的比例来衡量，并做 capped aggregation，避免少数极端样例主导分数。这个设计的关键点是，库的质量不直接由库测试决定，而由下游 Agent 写出的程序质量决定。
summary.experiments: 基准包含 15 个 library-design tasks、242 个专家验证的下游编程问题，覆盖 4 种语言。结果显示，15 个任务中有 11 个任务里，Agent 设计者会复现人类生产库的主要抽象。Opus 5.5 的 LibraryDesignBench 分数最高，为 48.9，比生产库高 2.3 分。错误审计显示，过长代码案例中 64% 来自僵硬或难用的接口，只有 14% 来自能力缺失。固定使用生产库的 LibraryUseBench 评测了 8 个实现模型，Opus 5.5 得分 66.9；即使使用生产库，实现者的 simplicity 也只有 61.5，说明瓶颈同时来自库设计和库使用能力。对 GPT-5.6 Luna，提高 reasoning effort 主要提升正确率，更强的提示约束主要提升库使用质量，但生成程序仍显著长于专家参考解。额外的 agent-first prompting 让 GPT-6 Astra 先草拟 consumer programs，再提供 runnable usage examples，并用 subagents 测试设计，使总分提升 2.3 分，主要来自 simplicity 提升 6.8%，但仍未稳定超过生产库。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 2 的两阶段评测定义和 simplicity metric，因为这是可复用的评测设计；再看 Section 3.2 的失败归因，尤其是 rigid / hard-to-use interface 与 missing capability 的区分。Section 3.3 对 LibraryUseBench 的拆分有助于理解库设计能力和库使用能力的耦合。Section 3.4 的 consumer-first API sketch 和 runnable examples 可以作为训练 coding agent 时构造反馈信号的参考。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether coding agents can design libraries that later agents can actually use well. Correctness tests can verify that a generated library works, but they do not measure whether its abstractions reduce downstream coding effort. Human review is also not a faithful proxy for agent usability.
summary_en.importance: The direct connection to foundation-model pretraining is modest, but the evaluation idea is useful for coding-agent research. It shifts the target from isolated pass rate to reusable software abstractions. For training or evaluating code agents, this kind of two-stage feedback can expose failures that unit tests and static code metrics miss.
summary_en.technical_approach: LibraryDesignBench has a design phase and an evaluation phase. In the design phase, the evaluated agent builds a full library from an open-ended specification that lists required capabilities and a few visible use cases, without prescribing the API. In the evaluation phase, several weaker user agents solve downstream programming problems with that library. The score combines correctness with simplicity. Simplicity is computed by comparing generated programs against reference solutions written with real production libraries, using capped ratios over multiple static size and complexity measures. The main design choice is to judge the library through downstream agent behavior rather than through library-level tests alone.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 15 library-design tasks and 242 expert-validated downstream problems across four languages. On 11 of the 15 tasks, agent designers reproduce the abstractions used by human-written production libraries. Opus 5.5 obtains the highest LibraryDesignBench score, 48.9, reported as 2.3 points above the production library baseline. An audit of excess-code cases attributes 64% to rigid or hard-to-use interfaces and only 14% to missing capabilities. The authors also define LibraryUseBench by fixing the library to the production library and evaluating eight implementer models. Opus 5.5 scores 66.9 there, while implementers reach only 61.5 simplicity even with the production library. For GPT-5.6 Luna, more reasoning effort mostly improves correctness, whereas a more prescriptive prompt improves library usage. A consumer-first intervention for GPT-6 Astra, using API sketches, runnable examples, and subagent testing, improves the score by 2.3 points, mainly through a 6.8% simplicity gain, but does not fully solve the design problem.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Read Section 2 for the two-phase protocol and the simplicity metric. Then read the failure audit in Section 3.2, which is the most informative part for understanding why generated libraries hurt downstream agents. Section 3.3 is useful for separating library design quality from library use ability. Section 3.4 is worth a quick pass if the goal is to design training signals or prompts for coding agents.

recommendation.zh: 只看 benchmark 设计和 failure analysis；它测到的是代码复用能力，不是 SWE-bench 那类补丁能力。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark design and failure analysis; it measures reusable library design, not the usual SWE-style patching skill.

paper.title: LoLBench: Evaluating Coding Agents with Long-Horizon Proposals on Large Software Systems
paper.abstract: Modern coding agents can deliver increasingly large repository-level changes, and recent benchmarks reflect this by emphasizing long-horizon tasks with large reference implementations. Many benchmarks evaluate coding agents' implementation capability to produce correct code edits from detailed specifications. However, practical modular development tasks also require the perception capability of grounding user intent and high-level design to derive a specification. We introduce LoLBench to evalua

summary.core_problem: 现有的代码 Agent 评测基准（如 SWE-bench）通常提供详细的实现规范或局部 bug 报告，忽略了真实软件开发中从“用户意图/高层设计”到“具体实现”的感知与规划过程。
summary.importance: 提出了一个更贴近真实开源社区协作模式的评测基准 LoLBench，强调了代码 Agent 在大型软件系统中处理高感知复杂度（理解意图、跨模块依赖）和高实现复杂度（回归测试、系统兼容）的能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了包含 100 个模块化开发任务的基准，这些任务来源于 29 个大型开源项目（如 CPython、Kafka）的增强提案（EPs）。任务输入是包含用户意图和高层设计的提案文本（平均 5000 词），要求 Agent 在离线 Docker 环境中生成代码。评测指标包括系统级和端到端的 Fail-to-Pass (F2P) 测试、Pass-to-Pass (P2P) 回归测试，并通过提案变异和覆盖率引导的测试生成来增强 F2P 测试，支持细粒度的部分进度评估。
summary.experiments: 在 5 种脚手架上评估了 6 种强 LLM。表现最好的组合（Claude Code + Opus 5）仅达到 14% 的解决率（Resolved Rate）和 26.3% 的完成率（Completed Rate）。失败分析表明，最大的瓶颈在于代码定位不完整。当提供参考派生的文件树和 API 规范时，解决率可提升 16-22 个百分点（最高达 34%）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注图 1 中关于“感知复杂度”与“实现复杂度”的二维分类框架，以及失败分析部分（Failure Analysis）对当前 Agent 瓶颈的剖析。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing coding agent benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench) typically provide detailed implementation specifications or local bug reports, neglecting the crucial perception and planning process from "user intent/high-level design" to "concrete implementation" in real-world software development.
summary_en.importance: Introduces LoLBench, a benchmark that closely mimics real open-source collaboration, highlighting the capability boundaries of coding agents in handling high perception complexity (understanding intent, cross-module dependencies) and high implementation complexity (regression testing, system compatibility) within large software systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructed a benchmark of 100 modular development tasks derived from enhancement proposals (EPs) across 29 large open-source projects (e.g., CPython, Kafka). The input is a proposal text (averaging 5,000 words) containing user intent and high-level design, requiring the agent to generate code in an offline Docker environment. Evaluation metrics include system-level and end-to-end Fail-to-Pass (F2P) tests, Pass-to-Pass (P2P) regression tests, and augmented F2P tests via proposal mutation and coverage-guided test generation for fine-grained partial progress evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 6 strong LLMs across 5 scaffolds. The best-performing combination (Claude Code + Opus 5) achieved only a 14% resolved rate and a 26.3% completed rate. Failure analysis indicates that incomplete code localization is the primary bottleneck. Providing reference-derived file trees and API specifications increased the resolved rate by 16-22 percentage points (up to 34%).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the two-dimensional classification framework of "perception complexity" vs. "implementation complexity" in Figure 1, and the Failure Analysis section detailing the bottlenecks of current agents. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: SWE-bench 的进阶版，强调从高层 Proposal 到代码实现的端到端能力，任务上下文极长，是评估长上下文和复杂规划能力的优质 benchmark。
recommendation.en: An advanced version of SWE-bench, emphasizing end-to-end capabilities from high-level Proposals to code implementation. With extremely long task contexts, it's a high-quality benchmark for evaluating long-context and complex planning abilities.

paper.title: LEGO-Anything: Coding Agents for 3D Scene Reconstruction
paper.abstract: A 3D scene reconstructed from a single image is most useful when represented not as a rendering or a fixed 3D output, but as an explicit scene program whose execution yields a scene that can be inspected, edited, and queried. We present LEGO-Anything, an Image-to-Code framework in which a coding agent iteratively writes and executes Blender code, inspects scenes and renderings, and revises the program. To evaluate end-to-end scene recovery, we introduce LEGO-Bench, a simulator-grounded benchmark

summary.core_problem: 把单张图像恢复为可执行、可编辑、可查询的 3D 场景程序，而不是固定渲染图或静态 3D 输出。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在 agentic code generation 与 3D 场景表示交界处：用代码作为显式场景中间表示，并提供 LEGO-Bench 评估端到端场景恢复。对 LLM 预训练不是直接贡献，但对“模型生成可执行世界模型”的评测形式有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Image-to-Code 框架 LEGO-Anything，让 coding agent 迭代生成 Blender 代码、执行代码、检查场景与渲染结果，再修订程序。方法依赖执行反馈闭环，而不是一次性图像到 3D 重建；输出是可运行的 scene program。
summary.experiments: 提出 LEGO-Bench，包含 104 个室内外场景的 208 张图像，分别评估 artifact validity、visible-surface geometry 和 rendered appearance。文摘称 GPT-6-astra 在评测 agent 中整体最好，室内得分 53.4%，室外得分 39.6%；同时显示生成有效场景文件与准确恢复几何和外观之间仍有明显差距。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Maryland, College Park 和 AWS。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets single-image 3D scene recovery as executable scene code rather than a fixed mesh, rendering, or implicit 3D artifact.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is at the boundary of coding agents and 3D scene representation: explicit programs become the editable scene interface, and LEGO-Bench provides a simulator-grounded evaluation setup. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant as a signal for executable world-model evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: LEGO-Anything is an Image-to-Code loop where an agent writes Blender code, executes it, inspects the resulting scene and renderings, and revises the program. The key design choice is using execution feedback and scene programs instead of one-shot 3D prediction.
summary_en.experiments: LEGO-Bench contains 208 images from 104 indoor and outdoor scenes and scores artifact validity, visible-surface geometry, and rendered appearance separately. The abstract reports GPT-6-astra as the strongest evaluated agent, with 53.4% indoor and 39.6% outdoor scores, while leaving a large gap between valid artifacts and faithful geometry or appearance recovery.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Maryland, College Park and AWS.

recommendation.zh: 不需要细读；看 benchmark 定义即可，代码执行反馈比 3D 结果更像有用的 agent 评测信号。
recommendation.en: No need to read deeply; scan the benchmark design, since execution feedback is the useful agent-evaluation signal here.

paper.title: Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies
paper.abstract: Coding agents can now write, run, and debug programs with little human help. Robot tasks, however, are usually specified by a sentence that leaves out how to grasp, in what order to make contact, and what the result should look like, and an agent given only the sentence must find these details by trial and error. We introduce ENCORE, which gives the agent a few demonstrations as evidence to read rather than as training data. A deterministic builder distills each demonstration into a pack of mult

summary.core_problem: 如何让代码智能体（Coding Agent）在仅有少量演示的情况下，自主发现并编写复杂的机器人操作策略代码？
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的范式，将机器人演示转化为代码智能体可读的“证据”，而不是传统的训练数据，使得智能体能够通过编写代码来解决复杂的物理操作任务，桥接了代码生成与机器人控制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 ENCORE 框架。首先，将少量演示提取为包含多视角关键帧、夹爪事件、帧序列和完整轨迹的“证据包”。然后，代码智能体分析这些证据，针对固定的感知和动作 API 编写策略程序，并在几次开发 rollout 中迭代改进，最终冻结程序进行评估。
summary.experiments: 在 LIBERO-PRO 基准测试上，ENCORE 生成的程序在受到扰动的任务中表现出色，甚至在没有演示的任务中也能成功，优于现有的强基线方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校（UT Austin）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to enable a coding agent to autonomously discover and write complex robot manipulation strategies given only a few demonstrations?
summary_en.importance: Introduces a novel paradigm that translates robot demonstrations into 'evidence' readable by coding agents, rather than traditional training data, enabling agents to solve complex physical manipulation tasks by writing code, bridging code generation and robot control.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the ENCORE framework. First, a few demonstrations are distilled into an 'evidence pack' containing multi-view keyframes, gripper events, frame strips, and full trajectories. A coding agent then analyzes this pack, writes a policy program against a fixed perception and action API, iteratively refines it over a few development rollouts, and freezes it for evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: On the LIBERO-PRO benchmark, programs generated by ENCORE perform exceptionally well in perturbed tasks, even succeeding in tasks without demonstrations, outperforming strong baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from UT Austin.

recommendation.zh: 将机器人演示转化为代码智能体的上下文输入，属于特定领域的 Agent 应用，对通用 LLM 预训练启发有限，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Translates robot demonstrations into context for coding agents. A domain-specific Agent application with limited insights for general LLM pretraining. Good for literature reference.

paper.title: StateTape: Action-Conditioned Evidence Lifecycle Modeling for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Despite the recent success of coding agents built on large language models, it remains challenging to run them over long horizons, since every observation is appended to the context and the context grows with each one. History-based maintenance is a common remedy, which masks or summarizes old observations, or prunes what a model reads as useless, and bounds the context at little cost. However, it decides from the text of the history alone and sees nothing of how the code is connected. Since a c

summary.core_problem: 解决长周期Coding Agent中，由于上下文不断累积导致的上下文窗口溢出和历史信息维护困难的问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于代码图（code graph）的上下文维护框架StateTape，相比于传统的基于文本历史的截断/总结方法，能更准确地维护代码状态。
summary.technical_approach: 将代码仓库建模为符号级别的代码图，随着仓库的变更（而不是上下文的增长）来重写Agent的上下文，从而保留有效信息并丢弃失效信息。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中详细说明实验结果，但强调了框架的可扩展性和新颖性。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing context window overflow and history maintenance difficulties in long-horizon coding agents due to continuous context accumulation.
summary_en.importance: Proposes StateTape, a context maintenance framework based on code graphs, which maintains code state more accurately than traditional text-history-based truncation/summarization methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models the repository as a symbol-level code graph and rewrites the agent's context as the repository changes (rather than as context grows), retaining valid information and discarding invalid ones.
summary_en.experiments: Experimental results not detailed in abstract, but emphasizes the framework's scalability and novelty.

recommendation.zh: 针对Coding Agent的长上下文维护做工程优化，思路是用代码图代替纯文本历史，做Agent系统的同学可以参考。
recommendation.en: Engineering optimization for long-context maintenance in Coding Agents using code graphs instead of plain text history; useful for Agent system builders.

paper.title: Evaluating Name-Only Directory Routing for One-Shot Code Search
paper.abstract: Finding the right files is an early challenge for coding agents. We test whether a language model can follow directory and file names to find annotated code files missed by fixed lexical queries. Across 82 audited issues from 11 repositories at pinned pre-fix commits, name-only directory routing recovered 0.465 of gold files within eight candidates, compared with 0.352 for FTS5 and 0.245 for a fixed full-issue rg query. The paired gain over FTS5 was 0.113 (95% repository-cluster bootstrap interv

summary.core_problem: 评估 coding agent 是否能只依赖目录名和文件名，在一次检索中找到需要修改的代码文件。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 repo-level coding agent 的检索分析。它不是新的模型训练方法，但对 agent 上下文构建和文件路由策略有实用参考。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 name-only directory routing：让语言模型根据目录和文件路径名称选择候选文件，而不是读取代码内容或依赖固定关键词查询。对比 FTS5 全文检索、固定 rg 查询，以及一个成本更高的 flat path control。
summary.experiments: 在 11 个代码仓库、82 个已审计 issue、固定修复前 commit 上评估。8 个候选文件内，name-only routing 找回 0.465 的 gold files，FTS5 为 0.352，固定 full-issue rg 为 0.245；相对 FTS5 的配对增益为 0.113，95% repository-cluster bootstrap 区间为 0.053 到 0.168。16K token 预算下，在 55 个完整对齐标注案例中 routing 覆盖 0.443 的标注行，FTS5 为 0.246。flat path control 达到 0.572 recall，但平均每个 issue 需要 24.6 次模型调用，routing 为 8.9 次。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether a coding agent can locate relevant files in one shot using only directory and file names.
summary_en.importance: It is a retrieval study for repository-level coding agents. It does not propose a new training method, but it gives practical evidence for context construction and file-routing policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses name-only directory routing, asking a language model to select candidate files from path names rather than code content or fixed lexical queries. It compares against FTS5, a fixed full-issue rg query, and a more expensive flat-path control.
summary_en.experiments: On 82 audited issues from 11 repositories at pinned pre-fix commits, routing recovers 0.465 of gold files within eight candidates, versus 0.352 for FTS5 and 0.245 for a fixed rg query. The paired gain over FTS5 is 0.113 with a 95% repository-cluster bootstrap interval of 0.053 to 0.168. Under a 16K-token budget, routing covers 0.443 of annotated lines versus 0.246 for FTS5 on 55 aligned cases. The flat-path control reaches 0.572 recall but uses 24.6 model calls per issue, compared with 8.9 for routing.

recommendation.zh: 这是工程检索小结，不是模型研究；记住路径名含强先验即可，正文可不读。
recommendation.en: This is an engineering retrieval note, not model research; keep the path-name prior in mind and skip the full paper.

paper.title: Is manual software optimization a thing of the past?
paper.abstract: Scientific software is increasingly required to process larger datasets while maintaining acceptable execution times. Software optimization traditionally requires substantial expertise in programming, algorithms, and numerical methods. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer the possibility of automating much of this process. We investigate whether LLM-based agents can autonomously achieve substantial performance improvements in scientific software, including mature implementations

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM-based agents 是否能自动优化科学计算软件，甚至改进已经由人类维护者优化过的成熟实现。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 能力研究，关注自动性能优化而非代码生成正确性。对 LLM 基座预训练的直接价值有限，但可作为代码智能体在长时程、可验证工程任务上的能力信号。
summary.technical_approach: 人类定义优化边界、正确性标准和验证机制，随后让 LLM agent 自主工作数小时，对 t-SNE、ssGSEA 和 graphlet counting 三类科学计算问题进行性能优化；最终由代码维护者审查实现并验证正确性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个计算问题，包括成熟实现。摘要称优化实现通过维护者正确性审查，并取得显著执行时间改进，但未给出具体模型、agent 框架、加速倍数或失败案例分布。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLM-based agents can autonomously optimize scientific software, including mature implementations already optimized by human maintainers.
summary_en.importance: It is a coding-agent capability study focused on performance optimization rather than code correctness alone. It has limited direct value for LLM pretraining, but it is a useful signal about long-running, verifiable engineering tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Humans define the optimization scope, correctness criteria, and verification mechanism, after which an LLM agent works autonomously for hours on t-SNE, ssGSEA, and graphlet counting. Code maintainers review the resulting implementations and verify correctness.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover three computational problems, including mature codebases. The abstract reports maintainer-verified correctness and substantial runtime improvements, but does not provide the model, agent framework, speedup numbers, or failure distribution in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 能力展示多于方法贡献；看任务设置和验证协议即可，不必按预训练信号解读。
recommendation.en: More capability demo than method contribution; read the task setup and validation protocol, not as a pretraining signal.

paper.title: OptiArena: Can LLMs Improve Executable Algorithms under Fixed Resource Budgets?
paper.abstract: Static QA and code-generation benchmarks only partially capture the role that large language models (LLMs) now play as coding agents and research tools. We introduce OptiArena, a budget-controlled testbed for studying whether LLMs can improve executable game-playing algorithms through five rounds of code edits within a fixed minimal scaffold and under bounded evaluator feedback and fixed resource budgets. The testbed uses two optimization regimes, surface obfuscation controls, calibrated referen

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 是否能在固定资源预算和有限反馈下，通过多轮代码编辑改进可执行算法，而不只是生成静态答案或代码片段。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding-agent / research-agent 评测资产。它把评测对象从单次 QA 或代码生成转向“在预算内优化一个可运行算法”，更接近 LLM 作为研究工具和算法改进器的使用方式。
summary.technical_approach: OptiArena 设计了一个预算受控 testbed：模型在最小 scaffold 内进行五轮代码编辑，收到有界 evaluator feedback，并在固定资源预算下改进游戏算法。评测包含两个优化 regime、surface obfuscation controls、calibrated references、held-out/stress splits，以及退化和异常失败诊断；API 成本与本地评测 wall-clock 分开报告。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 12 个 frontier LLM 和 5 个游戏任务，问题包括：能否从弱 starter 缩小到 competent baseline 的差距，能否继续优化 competent baseline 而不破坏它，以及收益能否在 surface obfuscation 后保持。摘要未给出完整数值结果。

summary_en.core_problem: OptiArena evaluates whether LLMs can improve executable algorithms through iterative code edits under fixed resource budgets and bounded evaluator feedback.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation testbed for coding and research agents. It moves beyond static QA or code-generation benchmarks toward measuring budgeted algorithm improvement, which is closer to how LLMs are used as optimization assistants.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark gives models five rounds of code edits inside a minimal scaffold, with bounded feedback and fixed compute/resource budgets. It includes two optimization regimes, surface-obfuscation controls, calibrated references, held-out and stress splits, and diagnostics for degradation and exceptional failures. API cost is reported separately from local evaluator wall-clock.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers twelve frontier LLMs across five games. It asks whether models close the gap between a weak starter and an editable competent baseline, whether they refine competent baselines without damage, and whether improvements survive surface obfuscation. The abstract does not include detailed numeric results.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark design 和 obfuscation control；它比普通代码题更接近 test-time search，但先别把结果外推到真实科研。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark design and obfuscation controls; it is closer to test-time search than ordinary coding tasks, but do not overgeneralize to real research automation.

paper.title: Do Coding Agents Reuse Existing Code or Reinvent the Wheel?
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for iterative development on real repositories, yet existing evaluation barely answers a basic question: \emph{do coding agents reuse existing code or reinvent the wheel?} The question matters: every duplicated implementation is a fix applied twice and agents produce code far faster than humans can audit, so redundancy accumulates unsupervised. Thus, we present \textbf{RepoReuse}, a multi-turn benchmark for auditing code reuse in real repositories, where r

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 coding agent 评测只看 pass rate，却几乎不衡量 agent 在真实仓库里是复用已有代码还是重复造轮子的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测资产工作。它的价值在于把“代码复用”从模糊工程偏好变成可量化指标，并且放到多轮、工作区累积的真实仓库环境里测。对做 coding agent、repo-level modeling、以及训练数据去重/复用偏好的研究都有关联。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RepoReuse，一个多轮 benchmark。任务需求按轮次逐步揭示，workspace 跨轮累积。数据构建采用全自动流水线：基于 AST 的依赖图、引导式证据收集、执行验证的任务合成。评测不仅看 pass rate，还测 reuse rate、相关代码召回率，以及跨轮结构冗余，专门审计 agent 是否忽视仓库已有实现并重复生成相似代码。
summary.experiments: 作者在 3000+ turns 上做审计，发现 agent 会随着轮次推进逐渐停止探索相关仓库代码，更倾向复用自己历史上下文而不是仓库已有实现，导致结构性冗余累积。摘要未给出具体参评模型名单和数值，但核心结果是现有 agent 在 repo reuse 上存在系统性缺陷，而不是偶发失败。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a blind spot in coding-agent evaluation: existing benchmarks mostly track pass rates, but rarely measure whether agents reuse existing repository code or keep reinventing it.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation asset. Its main value is turning code reuse from a vague engineering preference into measurable metrics, and doing so in a multi-turn, accumulating-workspace setting over real repositories. That matters for coding agents, repo-level modeling, and even data-reuse preferences in training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces RepoReuse, a multi-turn benchmark where requirements are revealed incrementally and the workspace persists across turns. It is built with a fully automated pipeline combining AST-based dependency graphs, guided evidence collection, and execution-verified task synthesis. Evaluation goes beyond pass rate to include reuse rate, recall of relevant repository code, and cross-turn structural redundancy.
summary_en.experiments: An audit over more than 3,000 turns shows that agents progressively stop exploring relevant repository code, increasingly reuse their own prior context instead of existing implementations, and accumulate structural redundancy. The abstract does not list the evaluated models or exact numbers, but the key result is a systematic failure mode rather than isolated errors.

recommendation.zh: 评测点选得准：pass rate 掩盖了 repo-level 退化。做 coding agent 的该看指标设计；不做这方向，记住“会做题不等于会复用代码”就够了。
recommendation.en: The benchmark targets the right blind spot: pass rate hides repo-level degeneration. If you work on coding agents, read the metric design; otherwise just remember that solving tasks is not the same as reusing code.

paper.title: Toward Interactive Understanding of Code APIs
paper.abstract: Empowered by advances in Language Model agents, systems have made substantial strides in code generation and understanding. However, these approaches often rely on read access to the relevant code, an assumption which does not hold when dealing with external APIs. In this work, we introduce the PAU (Python API Understanding) benchmark, where we provide models with black-box, API-level access to code snippets. Models must query the API with exploratory inputs and draw insights from the resulting

summary.core_problem: 构造一个评测：模型不能读源码，只能通过调用黑盒 Python API 来推断代码片段的真实功能。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark。它把代码理解从“读仓库/读文件”推进到“交互式工具理解”，更接近真实外部 API 使用，也能暴露 coding agent 和 tool-use agent 的盲区。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PAU（Python API Understanding）benchmark。模型获得 API 级访问权限，需要主动设计输入、观察输出、归纳函数行为，并生成对代码片段功能的描述。这个设置把 Python 方法当作未知工具，考察无监督探索和功能归纳能力。
summary.experiments: 评测多个前沿模型；摘要给出的核心结果是最佳模型 Claude-4-Opus 仍无法理解超过 45% 的 PAU 测试集。说明当前 coding agent 在黑盒 API 语义归纳上仍明显不足。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark tests whether models can infer the true behavior of Python code snippets when they only have black-box API access and cannot read the source.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution. It shifts code understanding from reading files or repositories to interactive tool understanding, a setting closer to real external API use.
summary_en.technical_approach: PAU gives models API-level access to Python methods. Models must choose exploratory inputs, observe outputs, infer semantics, and describe the hidden snippet's functionality. The task frames code snippets as tools that must be understood through interaction alone.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates frontier models. The abstract reports that the best model, Claude-4-Opus, fails to understand more than 45% of the PAU test set, indicating a substantial gap in black-box API understanding.

recommendation.zh: 读任务定义和失败案例即可；它提醒工具使用能力不是会调 API，而是会主动实验并归纳 API 语义。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and failure cases; the lesson is that tool use requires active experimentation and semantic induction, not just API calling.

paper.title: SecProbe: Adaptive Evaluation of Coding Agents on Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities
paper.abstract: Assessing cybersecurity vulnerability awareness in coding agents requires evaluations that reveal capability gaps and remain informative as models evolve. Static benchmarks offer fixed coverage and difficulty, while scarce vulnerable repositories and costly expert authoring limit their renewal at scale. We introduce SecProbe, a framework for adaptive evaluation that combines Item Response Theory (IRT) with on-demand synthesis of repository-scale vulnerability-repair tasks. From observed performa

summary.core_problem: 评估 coding agents 对网络安全漏洞识别与修复的真实能力，同时避免静态 benchmark 随模型进步快速失效。
summary.importance: 这是 coding agent 安全能力的自适应评测框架贡献：把 Item Response Theory 用到任务选择和能力估计，并支持按需合成仓库级漏洞修复任务。它的价值在于评测协议，而不是单个漏洞数据集本身。
summary.technical_approach: SecProbe 根据 agent 已有表现估计能力水平，选择最能减少不确定性的已有任务，或合成新的 repository-scale vulnerability-repair tasks；任务覆盖多语言和 CWE 类型，并在两个 agent harness 下测试模型。
summary.experiments: 构建 353 个任务，覆盖 6 种编程语言和 151 个 CWE 类型；评估 9 个 frontier models 与 2 个 agent harness。最高成功率只有 28.33%，说明当前 coding agents 在漏洞识别与修复上仍有明显缺口；摘要称相较 random 和 one-shot baseline，自适应策略更有效，但片段未给出完整提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether coding agents can recognize and repair cybersecurity vulnerabilities in a way that remains informative as models improve.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an adaptive evaluation protocol for coding-agent security, combining Item Response Theory with on-demand synthesis of repository-scale vulnerability-repair tasks. The value is in the evaluation design rather than in another fixed security dataset.
summary_en.technical_approach: SecProbe estimates agent ability from observed outcomes, then selects existing tasks or synthesizes new ones where additional evidence is most informative. The tasks span multiple programming languages and CWE types and are run under two agent harnesses.
summary_en.experiments: The study builds 353 tasks across 6 languages and 151 CWE types, evaluating 9 frontier models with 2 harnesses. The best success rate is 28.33%, indicating substantial remaining gaps; the abstract states improvements over random and one-shot baselines but the provided fragment omits the full numeric comparison.

recommendation.zh: 读评测设计即可，IRT 驱动的自适应采样比固定题集更干净；模型排名别过度解读。
recommendation.en: Read the evaluation design: IRT-based adaptive sampling is cleaner than a fixed task set; do not over-read the model ranking.

paper.title: Codoku: Renewable Program-Reasoning Challenges for Frontier Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Existing program-reasoning benchmarks ask large language models to predict a program's behavior on a given input. Coding agents break two assumptions on which these benchmarks rest: an agent can recover the answer by executing the program instead of reasoning about it, and fixed task sets drawn from existing programs are increasingly exposed to contamination, yet costly to renew. We introduce Codoku (code sudoku), a renewable benchmark in which a solver fills typed cells in a partial program to

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个防污染且能真正测试Coding Agent程序推理能力（而非仅仅依赖执行或记忆）的Benchmark？
summary.importance: 提出了Codoku，一个可再生的程序推理Benchmark，通过将代码补全转化为满足静态和动态约束的数独式谜题，有效防止了数据污染和Agent通过简单执行工具作弊。
summary.technical_approach: Codoku要求求解器在部分程序中填充类型化单元格，以满足全局静态和动态约束（如规定的控制流图和执行路径）。由于部分程序无法执行，且有效填充在指数级大的空间中很稀疏，因此工具使用或枚举都无法替代程序推理。谜题通过语义具体化从头合成，可以按需生成具有可控复杂性的新谜题，并保证可解性。
summary.experiments: 评估了前沿模型，发现即使是强大的模型在Codoku上也表现出显著的推理困难，证明了其作为严格推理测试的有效性。
summary.authors_note: Zhendong Su团队工作，关注软件工程和程序分析与LLM的结合。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a contamination-resistant benchmark that truly tests the program reasoning abilities of Coding Agents (rather than just relying on execution or memorization)?
summary_en.importance: Introduces Codoku, a renewable program-reasoning benchmark that effectively prevents data contamination and agent cheating via simple execution tools by transforming code completion into Sudoku-style puzzles satisfying static and dynamic constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: Codoku requires solvers to fill typed cells in a partial program to satisfy global static and dynamic constraints (e.g., prescribed control-flow graph and execution path). Because partial programs cannot be executed and valid fillings are sparse in an exponentially large space, neither tool use nor enumeration can substitute for program reasoning. Puzzles are synthesized from scratch via semantic reification, allowing on-demand generation of fresh puzzles with controllable complexity and guaranteed solvability.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated frontier models and found that even powerful models struggle significantly on Codoku, proving its effectiveness as a rigorous reasoning test.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by Zhendong Su's team, focusing on the intersection of software engineering, program analysis, and LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 设计思路很巧妙，通过构造无法直接执行的'代码数独'来强迫模型进行静态分析和逻辑推理，是评估Code LLM深度推理能力的一个好工具，值得关注其数据合成方法。
recommendation.en: The design is clever. By constructing unexecutable 'code Sudoku', it forces models to perform static analysis and logical reasoning. It's a good tool for evaluating the deep reasoning capabilities of Code LLMs. The data synthesis method is worth noting.

paper.title: Shockingly Simple Self-retrospection Improves Agentic Models Without RL
paper.abstract: People learn not only by repeating successful actions, but also by recounting and explaining their experiences, revising their understanding to guide future behavior. Can a language-model agent improve its future actions by training only on explanations of its own experience? We investigate this question by studying Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT), a minimal online procedure designed to isolate the effect of explanation-only training on subsequent behavior. The agent attempts a task, obser

summary.core_problem: 研究 Agent 是否能只通过训练自己对经历的事后解释，而不使用 RL、外部教师或成功动作 imitation，来改进后续行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练/Agent 学习机制创新。它把 policy improvement 的训练目标从动作 token 或 reward update 转到 explanation token，若结果稳健，会影响自训练、经验回放和 agentic continual learning 的设计。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning，流程很小：Agent 先尝试任务，观察可用反馈，再生成 retrospective explanation；模型只在解释文本 token 上做 next-token prediction fine-tuning，不训练原始动作轨迹，也不使用 verifier 或 reward-based policy update。训练数据包含成功和失败的 base-model 尝试。
summary.experiments: 软件工程实验使用 Qwen3.5-4B，在混合成功/失败尝试的问题上做 20 次更新。摘要报告在 held-out SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 上分别达到 49.2% 和 26.8% solve rate，且不使用 verifier。摘要被截断，baseline 具体数值和统计显著性需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Alessandro Sordoni、Marc-Alexandre Côté 和 Xingdi Yuan，相关团队长期做语言模型 Agent、强化学习与交互式学习。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether an agent can improve future behavior by fine-tuning only on its own retrospective explanations, without RL, external teachers, or imitation of successful actions.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and agent-learning mechanism contribution. It shifts the policy-improvement signal from action tokens or reward updates to explanation tokens, which could affect how self-training, experience replay, and continual agent learning are designed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning. An agent attempts a task, observes available feedback, writes a retrospective explanation, and is fine-tuned with next-token prediction only on the explanation tokens. It does not train on the action trajectory and does not use a verifier or reward-based policy update. Training uses a mix of successful and unsuccessful base-model attempts.
summary_en.experiments: In software-engineering experiments with Qwen3.5-4B, ROFT is trained through 20 updates on problems containing mixed successful and failed attempts. The abstract reports held-out solve rates of 49.2% on SWE-bench Verified and 26.8% on SWE-bench Pro without using a verifier. The provided abstract is truncated, so exact baselines and significance checks require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Alessandro Sordoni, Marc-Alexandre Côté, and Xingdi Yuan, whose prior work is closely related to language-model agents, reinforcement learning, and interactive learning.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现一个小 ablation；若 explanation-only 真的改 policy，它会改变我们对失败轨迹利用方式的 prior。
recommendation.en: Run a small internal ablation; if explanation-only updates truly move policy behavior, it changes how failed trajectories should be reused.

paper.title: Marathoner: Ultra-Long-Horizon Autonomous Intelligence
paper.abstract: Humans naturally possess the ability to work persistently toward long-term goals. Given a challenging task, humans can continuously work for months or even years to accomplish a specific objective. In this paper, we propose Marathoner, an autonomous agentic model possessing the ability of ultra-long-horizon execution. Specifically, we propose a comprehensive post-training pipeline to instill this critical capability into base model. For Ultra-Long-Horizon Task Synthesis, we leverage major releas

summary.core_problem: 解决现有智能体难以在超长时间跨度内持续执行复杂软件任务的问题，目标是把“长周期自主完成任务”的能力通过后训练注入基座模型。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏后训练与代码智能体方向的工作，贡献不在预训练本身，而在于把超长时程任务分解、数据合成和轨迹蒸馏结合起来，尝试把 agent 从短回合提升到长周期执行。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它提供了一个较清晰的 post-train 信号构造范式，可反向启发如何设计更接近真实长期任务分布的训练目标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是一个完整的 post-training pipeline。首先从 GitHub 中包含 1000+ 行新增代码的大型 release PR 抽取素材，合成高难度 task-level 数据；然后提出 Multi-Task Chaining，把多个生成任务串成更长、更难的复合任务，显式拉长任务 horizon；最后结合强教师模型与多种 harness 生成执行轨迹，采用 rejection sampling finetuning 进行监督微调。整体上属于“任务合成 + 教师轨迹蒸馏 + 长时程 curriculum”的组合，而不是新架构。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可确认，实验重点是 ultra-long-horizon autonomous intelligence，任务来源主要是 GitHub 大型 PR，难度通过 task chaining 提升到 frontier-level。摘要未给出模型参数量、训练 token、具体 baseline 名称和量化提升幅度，因此目前更适合把它当作方法信号而非定量结论。若正文实验设计干净，最值得看的是不同 horizon 合成策略、拒绝采样过滤标准，以及长任务成功率随任务链长度变化的曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a key weakness of current agents: they fail to persist and execute complex software tasks over very long horizons, and it aims to inject such capability into a base model via post-training.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training and coding-agent paper rather than a pretraining one. Its value lies in how it constructs long-horizon supervision: task synthesis, chaining, and trajectory distillation are combined into a coherent recipe. For pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is not the agent result itself but the shape of the training signal it creates for long-duration competence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is a full post-training pipeline. It mines major GitHub release PRs with 1000+ added lines as seeds for synthesizing difficult task-level data, then introduces Multi-Task Chaining to compose multiple generated tasks into a single longer and harder task. A strong teacher model plus diverse harnesses are used to generate trajectories, and rejection-sampling finetuning is applied for supervised training. This is a training-signal and curriculum design contribution, not a new model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the evaluation centers on ultra-long-horizon autonomous intelligence, with tasks synthesized from large GitHub PRs and difficulty increased via chaining. The abstract does not expose model size, training scale, baselines, or exact gains, so the work should currently be treated as a methodological signal more than a settled empirical result. The most useful parts to inspect are likely the horizon scaling setup, filtering criteria for trajectories, and success-vs-horizon curves.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“长期任务能力”具体化成可训练信号，这点比多数 agent 口号更实；先看数据合成和 horizon ablation，结果先别全信。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it operationalizes long-horizon ability into a trainable signal; read the task synthesis and horizon ablations first, and treat headline results cautiously.

paper.title: Counterfactual Rollout Replay: Forkable Environments as Free Process Rewards for Software Engineering Agents
paper.abstract: Outcome-only reinforcement learning gives software engineering (SWE) agents a terminal success signal but little direct guidance about intermediate decisions. We introduce Counterfactual Rollout Replay (CRR), a training-time procedure that uses forkable executable environments to obtain step-level return contrasts. CRR selects a small set of decision points, restores each state, samples an alternative action, and rolls the branch forward under the policy. It retains the realised training traject

summary.core_problem: 解决软件工程 Agent 的 outcome-only RL 只有终局成功信号、难以给中间决策分配信用的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RL 训练信号设计和 coding agent 训练方法。关键点不是新的 SWE benchmark，而是利用可 fork 的执行环境构造 step-level return contrast，绕开人工过程标注和 learned process reward model。
summary.technical_approach: Counterfactual Rollout Replay 在训练轨迹中选取少量决策点，恢复到该状态，采样替代动作，并让分支继续 rollout 到终局；随后用真实轨迹终局回报与反事实分支终局回报之差，替换被选步骤的 advantage。方法保留原训练轨迹，不需要人工过程标签或训练 PRM，但需要额外 replay compute。
summary.experiments: 使用 14B policy，在 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Live 和 SWE-rebench 上提升 pass@1；摘要还说明它能与 process-reward 和 trajectory-search 方法叠加，并在 SWE-bench Verified 上做了同等 wall-clock 的 hard subset 对比，但未给出完整数值。
