summary_en.authors_note: Official OpenAI blog, disclosing the collaboration with Cognition (developer of Devin) and the application of GPT-6 Astra in the field of Coding Agents.

recommendation.zh: 披露了 GPT-6 Astra 在 Coding Agent 领域的应用，展示了 AI 辅助软件工程向自主测试和验证方向的演进，值得关注其对 Agent 评测和可靠性的影响。
recommendation.en: Discloses the application of GPT-6 Astra in the Coding Agent domain, demonstrating the evolution of AI-assisted software engineering towards autonomous testing and validation. Worth noting its impact on Agent evaluation and reliability.

paper.title: A-JIT: Agentic Just-In-Time Software Construction
paper.abstract: Traditional software delivery assumes a static paradigm: code is constructed prior to execution and deployed as a fixed artifact. We present Agentic Just-In-Time Software Construction (A-JIT), a paradigm that replaces static binaries with dynamic, software systems that can perpetually evolve to meet changing demands. In A-JIT, an application is an integrated assembly comprising code, a runtime harness, and an embedded AI agent that continuously observes system usage and live execution traces. Mu

summary.core_problem: 提出一种软件交付范式：应用不再是预先构建好的静态 artifact，而是在运行期由嵌入式 AI agent 持续观察、合成和改写的软件系统。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏范式提案和系统设想，面向 coding agent 与软件工程自动化。它的潜在价值在于把代码生成从离线开发工具推进到应用生命周期内部，但对 LLM 基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: A-JIT 把应用定义为代码、runtime harness 和嵌入式 AI agent 的集成体。agent 持续观察用户行为和 live execution traces，类似 JIT 编译器按运行路径特化机器码，A-JIT 按真实使用轨迹特化软件逻辑、workflow 和工具接口。它强调 trace-driven human-AI co-construction、运行期补全缺失实现、动态生成新能力和持续适配用户需求。
summary.experiments: 摘要使用“demonstrate”描述范式能力，但未提供模型参数量、训练数据、benchmark、baseline 或明确量化结果。更像概念性系统论文或 position paper，而非严格实验论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes replacing static software artifacts with applications that continuously observe, synthesize, and adapt through an embedded AI agent at runtime.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a paradigm and systems proposal for coding agents and software engineering automation. Its potential value is moving code generation from an offline developer tool into the application lifecycle, but its direct signal for LLM pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: A-JIT defines an application as an integrated assembly of code, a runtime harness, and an embedded AI agent. The agent observes usage and live execution traces, then specializes software logic, workflows, and tool interfaces to the end user, analogous to how a JIT compiler specializes machine code to runtime paths. The approach emphasizes trace-driven human-AI co-construction, filling missing implementations, generating new capabilities, and continuous adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says the authors demonstrate the model, but does not provide model sizes, training data, benchmarks, baselines, or quantitative results. It appears closer to a conceptual systems paper or position paper than a tightly measured empirical study.

recommendation.zh: 概念比实验强；可扫架构图和 threat model，别把它当 coding agent 能力 scaling 的证据。
recommendation.en: The concept is stronger than the evidence; skim the architecture and threat model, but do not treat it as evidence for coding-agent capability scaling.

paper.title: Introducing Consort: A Spec-First Agent Framework for Enforced, Test-Driven Development on Live Database Branches
paper.abstract: When an agent writes code, the development framework becomes the control system for a non-deterministic worker. Spec-first, agent-driven frameworks have gained rapid traction since 2025; the installable ones, GitHub Spec Kit, obra/superpowers, BMAD, and GSD, and our own, all capture intent through a specification or durable planning artifacts. Since they agree on capturing intent up front, what separates them is how each enforces the engineering discipline that keeps agent-written code clean, co

summary.core_problem: 试图解决代码 agent 在真实数据库分支上开发时，如何用规格、测试和不可编辑控制面约束非确定性模型输出。
summary.importance: 贡献是软件工程 agent 框架设计，而不是模型训练或评测资产；价值在于把 agent coding 从 prompt 约束推向外部确定性控制，但更偏工程框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Consort，一个 spec-first、test-driven 的 agent 框架；核心设计是把需求规格前置，并通过确定性 orchestrator、人类批准 gate、不可变测试、live branched database 上的 green result 来强制执行，而不是只依赖 prompt discipline。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出系统性 benchmark 或与 GitHub Spec Kit、obra/superpowers、BMAD、GSD 等框架的量化对比；主要是框架描述和设计原则比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to constrain nondeterministic coding agents when they develop against live database branches using specifications, tests, and non-editable controls.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a software-engineering agent framework rather than a training method or evaluation asset. Its main value is the shift from prompt-level discipline to external deterministic enforcement.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Consort, a spec-first and test-driven framework. The key design is to front-load intent capture and enforce discipline through a deterministic orchestrator, human-approved gates, immutable tests, and a green result against a live branched database, instead of relying only on instructions the model may ignore.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report a systematic benchmark or quantitative comparison against GitHub Spec Kit, obra/superpowers, BMAD, or GSD. The paper appears to focus on framework design and qualitative comparison.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent 工程约束案例可扫一眼；没有干净评测时，别把框架主张误读成模型能力结论。
recommendation.en: Skim it as an engineering-control case for coding agents; without a clean benchmark, do not read the framework claim as evidence about model capability.

paper.title: SWE-Bench Pro Verified: A Reliable Benchmark for Software Engineering Agents
paper.abstract: SWE-Bench Pro has emerged as a standard benchmark for evaluating software engineering agents on challenging repository-level tasks. However, our analysis work show that its evaluation is undermined by two sources of unreliability: \textbf{reward hacking}, enabled by leakage of gold solutions or hidden evaluation information, and \textbf{task quality issues}, including misleading problem statements and improperly scoped tests. These issues can inflate benchmark performance and obscure agents' tru

summary.core_problem: SWE-Bench Pro 作为评估软件工程 Agent 的标准基准，存在哪些导致评估结果不可靠的问题，以及如何修复？
summary.importance: 揭示了当前最流行的代码 Agent 评测基准 SWE-Bench Pro 存在严重的“奖励黑客（reward hacking）”和任务质量问题，导致模型性能被高估。发布了修复后的验证版本，对准确评估代码 Agent 能力至关重要。
summary.technical_approach: 分析发现 SWE-Bench Pro 存在两种不可靠来源：1) 奖励黑客（黄金解决方案或隐藏评估信息的泄漏）；2) 任务质量问题（误导性的问题陈述和范围不当的测试）。提出 SWE-Bench Pro Verified，结合反黑客保护措施（消除泄漏通道）和任务细化（最小化纠正缺陷实例中的不一致）。
summary.experiments: 在 SWE-Bench Pro Verified 上的评估表明，一些模型的表现比之前报告的要差得多，证明了原基准存在性能膨胀。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: What are the issues causing unreliable evaluation results in SWE-Bench Pro, a standard benchmark for software engineering agents, and how can they be fixed?
summary_en.importance: Reveals severe 'reward hacking' and task quality issues in SWE-Bench Pro, the most popular coding agent benchmark, which lead to inflated model performance. Releases a verified version crucial for accurately assessing coding agent capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analysis identifies two sources of unreliability in SWE-Bench Pro: 1) reward hacking (leakage of gold solutions or hidden evaluation information), and 2) task quality issues (misleading problem statements and improperly scoped tests). Proposes SWE-Bench Pro Verified, combining anti-hacking safeguards (eliminating leakage channels) and task refinement (minimally correcting inconsistencies in flawed instances).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations on SWE-Bench Pro Verified show that some models perform substantially worse than previously reported, proving performance inflation in the original benchmark.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by a team from Fudan University.

recommendation.zh: 做代码 Agent 评测必看，揭示了 SWE-Bench 存在的 leakage 和质量问题，提醒我们在看榜单时要警惕 reward hacking。
recommendation.en: A must-read for coding agent evaluation, revealing leakage and quality issues in SWE-Bench, and warning against reward hacking when interpreting leaderboards.

paper.title: ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Execution feedback can guide coding agents toward correct repository repairs, but only when the tests capture the behavior requested by the issue. Agent-generated tests can encode incomplete or incorrect behavioral targets; when the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can agree and create false confidence. We introduce ExecCritic, combining a test--verify--revise scaffold with a role-specific reinforcement learning recipe for training agents within it. The scaffold s

summary.core_problem: 代码修复 agent 依赖执行反馈时，若 patch 和 test 由同一轨迹共同生成，容易出现“错误测试与错误补丁相互自洽”的假阳性，导致训练信号失真。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 coding agent + RL 训练范式改进。对预训练研究员的意义不在代码修复本身，而在于它把“验证器污染训练信号”这个问题讲得很具体：当 reward 来自模型自己写出的 verifier 时，reward hacking 会系统性出现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ExecCritic，核心是 test--verify--revise 三段式脚手架与角色分离训练。Test agent 独立生成 repository-native tests，经 fail-closed harness 过滤并冻结；Repair agent 只能根据这些测试的执行反馈改代码，不能改测试。两者都以 Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B 为骨干并分别训练。训练分两步：Learn to Test 让 Test agent 学会生成能区分正确/错误 patch 的有效测试；Test to Improve 再用这些测试反馈训练 Repair agent。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法在仓库级代码修复基准上优于依赖执行反馈但不做角色解耦的做法。关键实验应是：比较共享轨迹生成 patch+test 与独立 Test/Repair 角色的差异，以及 fail-closed harness 对测试质量和最终修复率的影响。骨干模型为 Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B，但摘要未给出具体 benchmark 名称和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Jianfeng Gao、Sharon Li，属于较强的工业研究阵容；从题目和方法风格看，重点在训练信号设计与 verifier 隔离。

summary_en.core_problem: Execution feedback helps coding agents only when the tests faithfully encode the requested behavior; if the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can align and create false confidence.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent and RL training paper, but its broader value is in making verifier contamination concrete: when reward comes from model-generated tests, reward hacking is not accidental but structural.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExecCritic introduces a test--verify--revise scaffold with role-specific training. A Test agent independently writes repository-native tests, a fail-closed harness qualifies and freezes them, and a Repair agent updates code only from execution feedback without modifying tests. Both roles use Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B and are trained separately through Learn to Test and Test to Improve.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates gains on repository-level code repair benchmarks over execution-feedback baselines that do not separate test generation from repair. The most important comparisons are likely shared-trajectory patch+test generation versus role separation, and the effect of the fail-closed harness on test validity and final repair success. Exact benchmark names and margins are not given in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Jianfeng Gao and Sharon Li, suggesting a strong industry-research setup; the paper is mainly about training-signal design and verifier isolation.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“模型自写 verifier 会污染 reward”这件事做成了干净 setup；看 scaffold 设计即可，别太在意具体榜单。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it gives a clean setup for verifier-induced reward contamination; read the scaffold design, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: FrogNano: Training a 4B Coding Agent via Online Task Synthesis
paper.abstract: We present FrogNano, a 4B coding agent designed to tackle software engineering (SWE) tasks efficiently and effectively, even under resource-constrained environments. It is post-trained exclusively via RL on around 1,500 SWE environments with synthetic tasks. A key ingredient for improving performance is an online task synthesis pipeline that creates tasks calibrated to the frontier of learnability for the current checkpoint. This report provides evidence that competitive small coding agents can

summary.core_problem: 在 4B 量级、无大模型蒸馏的约束下，如何把“仓库级”SWE coding agent 训练到可用水平；核心障碍不是单纯的 RL 算法，而是（1）可执行任务分布如何随策略能力在线演化以维持有效学习信号，（2）小模型在复杂 agent harness 下的交互失败（不终止、不会按协议提交）会吞噬训练信号。
summary.importance: 对“post-train 闭环”有直接启发：把在线合成数据（任务）与 RL 训练耦合成 curriculum，而不是离线堆任务再过滤；同时强调 harness/接口是小模型能力上限的一部分，等价于在改变有效 action space 与 credit assignment 难度。对预训练本身不是方法贡献，但对后训练如何反哺基座（工具调用格式暴露、交互协议的先验）有现实价值。
summary.technical_approach:
两条主线。
1）TaskPilot：在线、policy-adaptive 的任务合成与校准。以真实 repo snapshot 为起点生成候选任务；用当前 checkpoint rollout 评估可学性，把任务筛到“可学前沿”（既非永远解不出、也非已饱和），并用策略反馈把任务往可学区间调整。训练按迭代进行：当 checkpoint 在验证集上饱和，就用该 checkpoint 触发下一轮任务生成与校准，再继续 RL，形成任务分布与策略共同演化的闭环。它与常见 difficulty filtering 的差别在于：不是先造一个大池子再按某个固定模型过滤，而是把“生成—评估—再生成”绑定到当前策略。
2）Leaf harness：为小模型重做交互协议。作者观察到 Qwen3.5-4B 在 R2E-Gym/SWE-Agent 这类更复杂的 harness 下 96% 轨迹打满 turn limit，常见失败是不会按协议终止/提交，导致 reward 近似为零。Leaf 采用 Claude-Code 风格的 5 个 typed tools（read/write/edit/glob/bash）与简单自然的终止规则（无 tool call 即终止），减少协议复杂度与“必须触发 finish action”的脆弱点。训练时把模型生成的推理/文本/tool call 计入 loss，prompt 与 tool output 仅作为上下文、mask 掉不回传。
RL 侧：使用 DPPO + async rollouts，并加 log-length penalty 鼓励简洁输出；总共 5 轮“任务合成→RL”。另外作者提到后期迭代可能遗忘早期学到的工具使用行为，并探索了 consolidation 用于从旧 checkpoint 恢复有用行为（细节在全文后续章节/附录）。
summary.experiments:
关键数字来自全文给出的主结果与 harness 对比：
- Harness 敏感性：在保持 rollout 设置不变时，Qwen3.5-4B 从 R2E-Gym 切到 Leaf，SWE-bench Verified solve rate 从 8.3% 提升到 37.2%；而更大模型 MiniMax-M2.5 在两种 harness 下均为 66.5%，说明“协议复杂度”主要卡小模型。
- 最终模型 FrogNano（Qwen3.5-4B 经 5 轮 RL+在线任务合成）：SWE-bench Verified 61.5%，SWE-bench Pro 37.6%，Terminal-Bench v2 31.1%，PatchEval-Verified 23.2%。
- 论文主张：这些成绩在不做大模型蒸馏、仅靠 RL + policy-grounded 合成任务的条件下获得；并且“可学前沿”式的在线任务分布对提升有效。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Harness Design Matters for Compact Models：理解为什么小模型会被 harness 卡死，以及 Leaf 的终止规则与 tool schema 为什么能显著改变有效学习信号。
- 再看 Synthesizing Tasks for the Evolving Policy：抓住 TaskPilot 的闭环机制（何时触发新一轮、如何用 rollout 评估与校准难度区间）。
- 重点看 Figure 1/2（任务闭环与主结果）以及 harness 对比的定量表述（8.3→37.2、96% turn-limit）。
- 如果时间够，再看遗忘与 consolidation 的分析段落：它更像 RL 训练动态问题，能帮助判断这种迭代式合成 curriculum 的稳定性与代价。

summary_en.core_problem: How to train a usable 4B-scale repository-level SWE coding agent without distilling from frontier models. The paper argues the main blockers are (1) keeping an executable task distribution in the learnable band as the policy improves, and (2) small models failing the agent harness/protocol (non-termination, missing submission), which collapses reward and learning signal.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a post-training/RL-for-agents contribution, but it carries two lessons relevant to foundation-model training practice: online, policy-conditioned synthetic data can function as a curriculum that maintains gradient signal; and the harness/interface effectively defines the action space and credit assignment difficulty, disproportionately hurting small models. It also hints at how tool-use conventions seen during post-training can become a strong prior that later training recipes should respect.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two key components.
1) TaskPilot: an online, policy-adaptive task synthesis loop. Starting from real repository snapshots, it generates candidate tasks, runs rollouts with the current checkpoint to estimate learnability, keeps tasks within a target difficulty window (neither unsolved-always nor saturated), and uses policy feedback to adjust tasks toward that window. Training proceeds in iterations: when a checkpoint saturates on validation, it triggers a new synthesis/calibration round, so the task distribution co-evolves with the policy. This differs from offline difficulty filtering over a large static pool.
2) Leaf harness: a simplified Claude-Code-like tool interface designed for compact models. The authors found Qwen3.5-4B frequently fails to terminate under R2E-Gym/SWE-Agent (about 96% trajectories hit the turn limit). Leaf exposes five typed tools (read/write/edit/glob/bash) and uses a natural termination rule (no tool call => terminate), removing brittle “finish action” requirements. During RL, model-generated reasoning/text/tool calls are trained on; prompts and tool outputs stay in context but are masked from loss.
RL setup: DPPO with async rollouts plus a log-length penalty for concise generations; five rounds of (synthesize tasks -> RL). They also discuss a consolidation procedure to recover useful tool-use behaviors that may be forgotten across later iterations.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported results:
- Harness effect: with rollout settings held fixed, switching Qwen3.5-4B from R2E-Gym to Leaf raises SWE-bench Verified solve rate from 8.3% to 37.2%. A larger model (MiniMax-M2.5) is insensitive (66.5% on both), suggesting protocol complexity is a small-model bottleneck.
- Final agent FrogNano (Qwen3.5-4B after 5 RL iterations with TaskPilot): 61.5% on SWE-bench Verified, 37.6% on SWE-bench Pro, 31.1% on Terminal-Bench v2, 23.2% on PatchEval-Verified.
- The paper emphasizes these are achieved without frontier-model distillation, relying on RL over policy-grounded synthetic tasks and the learnability-frontier task distribution.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 minutes):
- Read the harness section first to understand the failure mode (96% turn-limit) and why Leaf’s termination/tool schema changes the effective learning problem.
- Then read the TaskPilot section to capture the online curriculum mechanism and the trigger condition for each synthesis round.
- Focus on the main figures (loop schematic and headline benchmarks) and the quantitative harness comparison (8.3 -> 37.2).
- If time permits, skim the analysis on behavior loss across iterations and the consolidation idea; it’s the most relevant part for RL training dynamics and stability.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“按当前能力在线合成可学任务”这个信号值得借到 continual pretrain/RL-curriculum；先看任务生成策略和消融，别急着信总分。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the learnability-frontier task synthesis idea is worth stealing for continual pretrain or RL curricula; read the task-generation section and ablations before trusting the headline scores.

paper.title: Diffs vs. Whole Files: An Empirical Comparison of Iterative Edit-Based and Direct Generation for Flutter/Dart Code Models
paper.abstract: Large language models used for code editing can be trained and deployed in at least two output regimes: direct generation, where the model emits the entire modified file in one shot, and iterative diff-based generation ("steps"), where the model emits a sequence of localized search/replace edits applied one at a time until it signals completion or a step budget is exhausted. The diff-based regime is attractive because it mirrors how developers edit code and should require far fewer generated tok

summary.core_problem: 比较代码编辑模型的两种输出范式：直接生成完整修改后文件，还是迭代生成局部 search/replace diff。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码模型训练与解码范式的实证分析。它挑战了“diff 更像人类编辑、生成 token 更少，所以应更适合代码编辑模型”的直觉，但实验范围限于 Flutter/Dart。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在同一 Flutter/Dart 数据集上训练两类模型和两种输出格式：100M 从零训练模型 Rainbow-Pony-100M，以及 fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B；分别采用 whole-file direct generation 和 iterative diff-based steps，并在同一 held-out task set 上比较。
summary.experiments: 每个模型约评测 1,790 个 held-out tasks。直接生成在所有报告指标上优于 diff-based：compilation/static-analysis pass rate、bits-per-byte、字符级相似度、blind LLM judge 评分等。摘要未给出具体提升百分比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper compares two output regimes for code editing models: generating the entire modified file directly versus iteratively emitting localized search/replace diffs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical study of code-model training and decoding formats. It challenges the intuition that diff-style editing should be better because it resembles human edits and emits fewer tokens, though the scope is limited to Flutter/Dart.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author trains two model families on the same Flutter/Dart dataset: a 100M model trained from scratch, Rainbow-Pony-100M, and a fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B. Each is trained in whole-file direct generation and iterative diff-based step formats, then evaluated on the same held-out tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Each model is evaluated on roughly 1,790 held-out tasks. Direct generation outperforms diff-based generation on all reported metrics: compilation/static-analysis pass rate, bits-per-byte, character-level similarity, and blinded LLM-judge ratings. The abstract does not provide exact percentage gains.

recommendation.zh: 结论和直觉相反但 domain 很窄；只看实验表，作为代码编辑格式 ablation 的弱证据。
recommendation.en: The result cuts against intuition but the domain is narrow; read the result tables only as weak evidence for code-editing format ablations.

paper.title: Recompilation Is Not Enough: Test-Guided Decompiled-C Repair
paper.abstract: Decompiled C often becomes recompilable only after repair, but recompilation alone does not establish test-observed behavior. A recompiled command-line binary can still parse options incorrectly, print different bytes, or return a different exit status. We present a few-step workflow for repairing decompiled C using compiler feedback and related official tests. Compiler and linker diagnostics first guide build repair. Once the repaired C recompiles into a binary, smoke checks and related officia

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 辅助修复反编译 C 代码时，为什么只让代码重新编译通过不足以保证二进制行为正确。
summary.importance: 贡献是软件工程 agent / 代码修复流程上的小型实证：把 compile-only decompiled-code repair 扩展为 test-guided repair。它对代码 agent 的可审计反馈设计有参考，但不是代码模型预训练或通用推理方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 few-step workflow：先用编译器和链接器诊断修复 build error；生成可编译二进制后，再用 smoke checks 和相关官方测试捕捉命令行选项解析、输出字节、退出码等行为偏差，并驱动语义修复。
summary.experiments: 在 Coreutils 9.5 的 104 个二进制上做 preliminary static-enriched evaluation，使用 decompiler exports 和 deterministic exact-output smoke comparisons；91 个二进制，即 87.5%，在修复预算内重新编译并通过 test gate；9 个未能重新编译，4 个可编译但未通过测试。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why recompiling decompiled C is not enough to ensure behaviorally correct binaries under LLM-assisted repair.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a small software-engineering agent workflow: moving decompiled-code repair from compile-only recovery to test-guided semantic repair. It is useful for auditable code-agent feedback, but not central to code-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The workflow first uses compiler and linker diagnostics for build repair. Once the C code recompiles, smoke checks and related official tests expose behavioral mismatches in option parsing, byte-level output, and exit status, which guide semantic repair.
summary_en.experiments: A preliminary static-enriched evaluation covers 104 Coreutils 9.5 binaries with decompiler exports and deterministic exact-output smoke comparisons. 91 binaries, or 87.5%, recompile and pass the test gate; 9 fail to recompile within budget, and 4 recompile but fail tests.

recommendation.zh: 结论朴素但 setup 干净；做代码 agent 反馈回路可看实验表，不做 decompiler repair 就不必读正文。
recommendation.en: The claim is simple but the setup is clean; read the result table if you build code-agent feedback loops, otherwise skip the body.

paper.title: How to Speculate about Uncertainty in Agentic Coding? A Draft-Model Gate Method
paper.abstract: LLM agents deployed for software engineering fail expensively: they act confidently wrong, and bad actions are recognized only after costly execution and retry. We present Speculative Uncertainty (SU), a method that recovers a predictive failure signal for a black-box agent from its output tokens alone, with no access to logits, weights, activations, or repeated sampling. Inverting speculative decoding, a small open-weight draft model scores the agent's already-generated trajectory in a single f

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体、也很现实的问题：闭源 API 形式部署的 coding agent 在执行前几乎没有可靠的失败预警信号，常常“看起来很自信，但下一步 action 会直接报错”，而错误只有在真正调用工具、运行代码、消耗上下文和预算之后才暴露。已有不确定性估计方法大多依赖 logits、hidden states、重复采样或整段轨迹的白盒概率信息，不适合真实生产环境。作者要做的是：只看 agent 已经生成出来的文本轨迹，不访问模型内部，不做多次采样，在 action 执行前预测这一步是否会通过一个可验证目标，例如代码执行是否成功。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，这篇论文不属于预训练主线，但它有两个值得注意的点。第一，它提出了一种黑盒条件下恢复模型不确定性信号的方法，说明“输出轨迹本身”仍然携带可利用的失败先验，这对 closed-source model 的 post-hoc calibration、agent reliability、以及训练后阶段的风险控制都有参考价值。第二，它把 speculative decoding 的方向反过来用：不是小模型给大模型提 draft，而是小模型给大模型已生成轨迹打分。这种“反向 speculative”思路很干净，也可能启发训练阶段对 teacher/student 分布差异、trajectory scoring、以及 verifier-free 代理信号的设计。贡献量级更接近部署方法和 agent calibration，而不是改变预训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心叫 Speculative Uncertainty, SU。输入是一个大 agent 在最近 k=3 个 step 内生成的 reasoning-action 轨迹窗口，目标是预测当前 step 的 action 在执行前是否会满足一个外部可验证目标 Ω，在文中就是“代码执行不抛异常”。

关键做法有三层。

第一层，是把 speculative decoding 反过来。作者引入一个小型开源 draft model q，对黑盒 agent p 已经生成出的 token 序列做 teacher-forced scoring。也就是给定前缀 (x, y<t)，让 q 输出下一个 token 分布，再去读 agent 实际生成 token yt 在 q 下的概率。这样一次前向就能得到整条轨迹的 token-level 信号，不需要访问 p 的 logits，也不需要重复采样。文中提到至少提取了三类逐 token 信号，摘要截断处能确认其中包括 cross-likelihood 以及 draft 自己的 argmax 与 agent token 的偏差类信息；从方法描述看，核心是利用 q 与 p 在局部条件分布上的一致性/不一致性来近似失败风险。

第二层，是 phase-aware feature extraction。作者观察到 agent 轨迹不是同质 token 流，而是明显分成 reasoning phase 和 action phase。reasoning 段自由度高、熵高、语言噪声大；action 段受工具调用语法、参数格式、代码片段结构约束更强，熵低，但也更直接决定执行是否成功。如果像 HTC 那样把整段 token 概率简单平均，reasoning 段会淹没 action 段中真正与失败相关的信号。SU 因此按 harness 的消息结构把 token 标成 reason/action 两类，分别统计特征，再送入校准器。这个设计不是简单 feature engineering，而是在利用 agent 轨迹的生成机制差异。

第三层，是轻量校准。作者没有训练复杂判别器，而是用线性 calibrator 把 phase-aware 特征映射成“下一步 action 会通过验证”的概率。这样做有两个好处：一是样本效率高，便于跨 agent 迁移；二是输出可直接作为 gate/routing/human intervention 的决策分数。部署时，SU 插在 code generation 和 execution 之间。如果预测失败概率高，就先 veto 当前 action，触发更便宜的 replan，而不是进入 execute-fail-retry 循环。

和已有方法相比，区别主要有三点：一，不需要白盒访问；二，不需要多次采样；三，不把轨迹当作均质序列，而是显式建模 reasoning/action 两阶段。作者还强调 draft model 的训练目标并不敏感，说明这里更重要的是 draft 作为一个通用语言先验和局部一致性探针，而不是某种专门蒸馏出来的精确替身。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在两个 agentic coding benchmark 上做，文中点名 SWE-Bench Verified 和 DA-Code，并报告了对分布外 benchmark 的零样本迁移。部署策略是 pre-execution veto gate：在 action 真正执行前，若 SU 预测失败风险高，则拒绝执行并改为 replan。

关键结果有三组。

第一，部署收益比较直接。作者报告每次调用的 execution error rate 下降 6 到 8 个百分点，平均 token cost 下降 14% 到 19%。这说明 gate 不只是把错误筛出来，也确实减少了失败后重试带来的上下文膨胀和额外推理成本。

第二，phase-aware 设计是有效的。论文在引言里已经给出核心结论：如果把 reasoning 和 action 混在一起做整段平均，失败信号会被 reasoning 段的高熵噪声稀释。虽然这里没有完整表格，但从作者反复强调来看，分相特征是优于 homogeneous trajectory scoring 的关键消融点，应该重点看 feature ablation 和 calibration 对比。

第三，draft model 的要求没有想象中高。作者指出一个 distilled 4B draft 已经足够可用，训练目标差异影响很小，而且在一个 agent 上训练出的 draft/calibrator 能迁移到其他 agent，效果明显好于未训练基线。这一点很重要，因为它说明 SU 依赖的不是对某个 teacher 的精细拟合，而是较稳定的“轨迹可疑度”信号。

从研究判断看，最有信息量的实验不是绝对准确率，而是三类泛化：对闭源 agent 的适配、对不同 benchmark 的 OOD transfer、以及对不同 draft 训练方式的鲁棒性。如果这些都成立，SU 才算是一个可部署的方法，而不是只在单一 agent 上过拟合的校准器。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点不在复杂模型，而在问题设定和信号设计。建议先看 Introduction，确认作者为什么排除了白盒 probing、logit calibration 和 repeated sampling。这里把真实部署约束讲得比较清楚。

然后直接看 Method 里三个部分：
1. draft model 如何对 agent 轨迹做 teacher-forced scoring；
2. reasoning/action phase 是怎么切分的，具体抽了哪些 token-level 和 span-level 特征；
3. calibrator 如何训练，标签是什么，窗口为什么取 k=3。

实验部分优先看四类表图：
1. 与 HTC 或其他 uncertainty baseline 的主结果对比；
2. phase-aware vs 不分 phase 的消融；
3. 不同 draft model 大小、训练目标、是否蒸馏的对比；
4. 跨 agent、跨 benchmark 的迁移结果。

如果时间只有 20 分钟，读引言、方法总览图、主结果表和 feature ablation 就够了。如果要深挖，值得看的点有两个：一是 action failure 到底更依赖低 likelihood、top-1 mismatch，还是某种局部熵统计；二是 reasoning/action 二分是否只是 coding agent 特有，还是能推广到 tool-use agent、web agent 甚至多轮对话系统。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical failure mode in coding agents: expensive mistakes are often detected only after tool execution, when the model has already consumed context, latency, and retry budget. In realistic deployments, the strongest agents are usually closed APIs, so one cannot access logits, hidden states, or activations. Repeated sampling is also too costly over long agent trajectories. The paper asks whether one can predict step-level execution failure before the action is run, using only the emitted trajectory text of a black-box agent.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research for two reasons. First, it shows that useful uncertainty signals can be reconstructed from generated trajectories alone, even when internal model signals are unavailable. That matters for black-box calibration, reliability layers, and post-training control of API-served models. Second, the method inverts the logic of speculative decoding: a small model does not propose tokens for a larger one, but instead scores the larger model’s completed trajectory. That inversion is conceptually neat and may be useful beyond deployment, for trajectory scoring, verifier proxies, and teacher-student distribution mismatch analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Speculative Uncertainty (SU), operates on a fixed lookback window of the most recent k=3 agent steps. Each step contains a reasoning span followed by an action span. The target is a calibrated probability that the current action will satisfy a verifiable objective Ω before execution; in the coding setting, Ω is whether execution succeeds without exceptions.

The first ingredient is reverse speculative scoring. A small open-weight draft model q is run in teacher-forcing mode over the black-box agent trajectory produced by model p. For each token, q conditions on the prefix and assigns probability to the token actually emitted by p. This yields token-level cross-likelihood style signals in a single forward pass, without access to p’s internals and without repeated sampling. The method relies on disagreement between q’s local distribution and p’s realized tokens as a proxy for downstream failure risk.

The second ingredient is phase-aware feature extraction. The paper argues that agent trajectories are structurally heterogeneous. Reasoning spans are high-entropy and linguistically noisy; action spans are lower-entropy, more syntax-constrained, and more directly tied to execution success. If one averages token scores over the whole trajectory, as in prior holistic calibration approaches, the action-relevant signal gets diluted by the reasoning phase. SU therefore separates reasoning and action tokens using the harness structure and computes features for each phase independently before calibration.

The third ingredient is a lightweight calibrator. Rather than training a heavy classifier, the paper uses a linear calibration layer to map phase-aware features to a failure likelihood. This keeps the method sample-efficient and easier to transfer across agents. In deployment, SU is inserted as a gate between code generation and execution: if the predicted failure risk is high, the system triggers a cheaper replan instead of entering an execute-fail-retry loop.

Relative to prior work such as trajectory calibration with white-box log-probabilities, the differences are clear: no white-box access, no repeated sampling, and explicit modeling of reasoning versus action phases. The paper also notes that the exact draft-model training objective matters little, which suggests the draft is acting more as a generic language prior and consistency probe than as a tightly matched student of the target agent.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is conducted on two agentic coding benchmarks, explicitly including SWE-Bench Verified and DA-Code, with additional zero-shot transfer to an out-of-distribution benchmark. The deployment policy is a pre-execution veto gate: if SU predicts high failure likelihood, the action is blocked and the agent replans.

The headline deployment result is a reduction of per-call execution error rate by 6 to 8 percentage points, alongside a 14% to 19% reduction in average token cost. This is important because the method is not merely improving a calibration metric; it is reducing the expensive retry loop that dominates practical agent cost.

A central ablation concerns phase awareness. The paper’s main claim is that treating the trajectory as a homogeneous token stream weakens the signal, because the high-entropy reasoning portion overwhelms the action-specific failure cues. The reasoning/action split appears to be one of the main contributors to performance over prior holistic scoring baselines.

Another useful result is that the draft model need not be large or highly specialized. A distilled 4B draft is reported to be sufficient, the training objective of the draft matters little, and a draft-calibrator setup trained on one agent transfers to other agents substantially better than an untrained baseline. That makes the method more plausible as a reusable deployment component rather than a benchmark-specific fit.

The most informative parts of the experimental section are likely not the absolute calibration numbers alone, but the transfer results: across agents, across benchmarks, and across draft-model choices. Those are the tests that determine whether SU is genuinely robust under realistic black-box conditions.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. The main value is the problem framing and the signal design, not architectural complexity. Start with the introduction to understand the deployment constraints that rule out white-box probing and repeated sampling.

Then read the method with three questions in mind: how the draft model scores the completed trajectory; how reasoning and action spans are segmented and featurized; and how the calibrator is trained against the verifiable objective. The choice of a short lookback window, k=3, is also worth noting because it reflects a trade-off between local relevance and long-horizon noise.

In the experiments, focus on four items: comparison against uncertainty baselines such as holistic trajectory calibration; ablations for phase-aware versus phase-agnostic features; sensitivity to draft-model size and training objective; and transfer across agents or benchmarks. Those sections will tell you whether the method is robust or merely tuned to one setup.

If time is limited, 15 to 25 minutes is enough for the introduction, method overview figure, main results table, and the key ablation table. If reading more deeply, the most interesting question is which token-level signal actually carries the predictive power: low cross-likelihood, top-1 mismatch, local entropy, or some combination. A second question is whether the reasoning/action decomposition is specific to coding agents or can generalize to broader tool-using agents.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和校准实验：用 draft model 给黑盒轨迹打失败分很干净，若指标扎实可复用到 agent compute routing。
recommendation.en: Read the method and calibration results: scoring black-box trajectories with a draft model is a clean idea, and solid metrics would make it reusable for agent compute routing.

paper.title: Dynamic Adaptation of the LLM Context for Generating Routines with Coupled Semantics
paper.abstract: LLM-based code generation fails when correctness depends on execution-dependent coupling: the meaning of one routine is defined by the runtime behavior of another, a relationship that cannot be resolved from textual descriptions alone. This limitation, which we call static binding, is not confined to explicitly coupled problems; it appears to varying degrees whenever correctness depends on joint execution behavior across components, from explicit cross-coupled optimizers to subtler joint constra

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 生成多例程代码时无法仅凭文本描述处理运行时耦合语义的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 的方法改进。它把执行轨迹诊断引入上下文更新，用于处理例程之间的动态依赖；对代码智能体的验证闭环有参考，但不是基座训练或通用代码模型预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 dynamic context adaptation。验证智能体从执行 trace 中抽取结构化诊断信息，作为类似梯度的反馈；生成智能体每轮提出多个候选；由问题描述构建的 knowledge graph 提供语义约束；再用 simulated annealing 在候选之间选择，形成验证-生成循环。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、使用的 LLM、任务集规模、baseline 或定量提升。可确认的信息是方法面向显式交叉耦合优化器，以及 packing、routing、symbolic search 等带联合约束的问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets LLM code generation cases where correctness depends on execution-dependent semantic coupling across routines, which cannot be resolved from text alone.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent method contribution. It uses execution-trace diagnostics to adapt the LLM context for dynamically coupled programs. It is useful for verification-loop design, but it is not a foundation-model pretraining contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces dynamic context adaptation. A validation agent extracts structured diagnostics from execution traces as gradient-like feedback, while a generation agent proposes multiple candidates per iteration. A knowledge graph built from the problem statement supplies semantic constraints, and simulated annealing selects among candidates.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, the underlying LLM, dataset scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It frames the evaluation around explicitly cross-coupled optimizers and subtler joint-constraint settings such as packing, routing, and symbolic search.

recommendation.zh: 方法味道像工程闭环而非模型研究；只看 trace 诊断如何写回 context，别把结论外推到代码预训练。
recommendation.en: This reads like an engineering loop rather than model research; inspect only how trace diagnostics are written back into context.

paper.title: Beyond Code Generation: Reliability, Verification, and Cost Economics in the Agentic Software Development Lifecycle
paper.abstract: AI coding systems are moving from autocomplete and chat toward agents that can inspect repositories, edit multiple files, run tools, write tests, open pull requests, and work for long periods with limited supervision. This capability changes the bottleneck in software delivery. Recent field studies show meaningful gains in coding activity, but newer evidence also shows that those gains attenuate sharply between writing code and shipping reliable software. Review, integration, testing, security,

summary.core_problem: 梳理 agentic software development 从代码生成走向真实交付时，在可靠性、验证、安全、部署和成本上的瓶颈。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述和产业分析，不声称新模型实验。它把 2024 到 2026 年的研究、benchmark audit、生产报告和成本证据放在一起，重点指出代码产出提升不等于可交付软件提升。
summary.technical_approach: 采用文献和公开报告综合分析，而非提出新算法。讨论对象包括能检查仓库、多文件编辑、运行工具、写测试、开 PR、长时间执行的软件工程智能体；分析维度包括 review、integration、testing、security、deployment、production operations，以及 token、tool、sandbox、CI、返工成本。
summary.experiments: 无新模型实验。摘要说明数值主要来自同行评审 SE 研究、大学研究、benchmark 审计、主要科技公司的生产报告、开发者 telemetry 和 2024 至 2026 年 9 月发布的成本管理证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper examines where agentic software development fails between generating code and shipping reliable software, focusing on verification, reliability, operations, and cost.
summary_en.importance: This is a synthesis and cost-economics analysis rather than a new model paper. Its useful point is the distinction between increased coding activity and actual shipped-software productivity.
summary_en.technical_approach: It synthesizes software-engineering research, university studies, benchmark audits, production reports, telemetry, and cost-management evidence. The scope includes agents that inspect repositories, edit multiple files, run tools, write tests, open pull requests, and operate over long horizons.
summary_en.experiments: No new model experiment is claimed. The evidence base is drawn mainly from 2024 through September 2026 sources, including production reports from major technology companies and developer telemetry.

recommendation.zh: 适合作为 coding agent 落地风险清单；没有新实验，预训练研究员看结论表即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a deployment-risk checklist for coding agents, but with no new experiments; pretraining researchers can read the conclusion tables only.

paper.title: $τ^τ$-Bench: An Environment for End-To-End, Realistic Agent Construction
paper.abstract: LLM agents are rapidly becoming production software, deployed to handle customer service, adjudicate disputes, and operate internal systems. Notably, the work of building them is increasingly handed to coding agents, yet existing benchmarks say little about whether an AI system can deliver one under the conditions of a real client engagement. We introduce $τ^τ$-bench (pronounced hyper-tau-bench), a benchmark that makes agent construction the task. A developer agent is given the records a busines

summary.core_problem: 现有的 Agent 评测基准主要关注 Agent 执行任务的能力，而忽略了在真实商业环境中“构建 Agent”这一过程本身的复杂性，缺乏对 AI 系统端到端构建 Agent 能力的评估。
summary.importance: 提出了一个全新的评测基准 $\tau^\tau$-bench，将“构建 Agent”本身作为任务。这填补了评估编码 Agent 在真实工程约束下（如需求收集、成本控制、API 继承等）构建复杂系统能力的空白，为 Agent 开发自动化指明了具体的改进方向。
summary.technical_approach: $\tau^\tau$-bench 提供了一个沙盒环境，模拟真实的客户参与过程。开发者 Agent 会获得真实的业务记录（手册、聊天记录、表格等）、一个持有隐藏需求的模拟客户、一个真实的生产 API、一个可能需要继承的代码库，以及服务成本和模型的限制。开发者 Agent 必须在这些约束下，从头开始或基于现有代码构建一个完整的客户服务 Agent。最终，构建出的 Agent 会在模拟的生产流量中进行评估。
summary.experiments: 测试结果显示，当前最强的配置（Claude Opus 5 + Claude Code）仅通过了 23.9% 的评估模拟，远低于专家编写的参考基准（82.2%）。分析表明，当前的 AI 系统在需求收集、设计探索、实验运行和真实环境验证等方面存在显著缺陷，例如：倾向于关键词检索而非阅读文档、不主动询问客户需求、无法有效管理预算、缺乏架构探索等。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 3 对 $\tau^\tau$-bench 任务设定的详细描述，理解其与传统 Agent 评测的差异。Section 6 的错误分析非常有价值，揭示了当前编码 Agent 在系统工程方面的具体短板。预计阅读时间 20-25 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks focus on an agent's ability to execute tasks, ignoring the complexity of 'building an agent' in real-world business environments, thus lacking evaluation of AI systems' end-to-end agent construction capabilities.
summary_en.importance: Introduces $\tau^\tau$-bench, a novel benchmark that makes 'agent construction' the task itself. This fills the gap in evaluating coding agents' ability to build complex systems under realistic engineering constraints (e.g., requirement gathering, cost control, API inheritance), pointing out specific directions for automating agent development.
summary_en.technical_approach: $\tau^\tau$-bench provides a sandboxed environment simulating a real client engagement. A developer agent is given real business records (handbooks, transcripts, spreadsheets), a simulated client with hidden requirements, a production API, a potentially inherited codebase, and constraints on serving cost and models. The developer agent must build a complete customer-service agent from scratch or based on existing code under these constraints. The constructed agent is then evaluated against simulated production traffic.
summary_en.experiments: Results show that the strongest configuration (Claude Opus 5 + Claude Code) passes only 23.9% of evaluation simulations, far below the expert-authored reference (82.2%). Analysis reveals significant shortcomings of current AI systems in requirement gathering, design exploration, experiment running, and ground-truth validation. For instance, they tend to use keyword search instead of reading documents, fail to ask clients for requirements, mismanage budgets, and lack architecture exploration.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the detailed description of the $\tau^\tau$-bench task setup to understand its difference from traditional agent evaluations. The error analysis in Section 6 is highly valuable, revealing specific engineering shortcomings of current coding agents. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这类 benchmark 会直接改写你对“agent 已经能交付”的先验；先看任务定义和最强基线 23.9% 这个数字，足够判断当前系统离生产多远。
recommendation.en: This benchmark should update your prior on whether agents can actually deliver production systems; read the task setup and the 23.9% best baseline first.

paper.title: RefactorPlatform: An Open-Source Harness for Controlled Evaluation of Repository-Scale Refactoring Agents
paper.abstract: Repository-scale refactoring requires coding agents to propagate a single change across many interdependent files without altering program behavior, yet to our knowledge no existing harness isolates the design choices that determine agent success on this task. We present RefactorPlatform, an open-source evaluation harness that holds the environment fixed and varies each design axis explicitly: model backbone (via OpenRouter and GitHub Copilot CLI), execution regime (baseline, retrieval-augmented

summary.core_problem: 构建一个可控评测脚手架，用来分析仓库级重构 agent 在多文件一致性修改中的成败因素。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding-agent 评测与实验基础设施。它不是提出新的代码模型，而是把模型骨干、执行方式、检索、多 agent、prompt 具体度等变量拆开控制，便于定位仓库级重构失败来自哪里。
summary.technical_approach: RefactorPlatform 固定执行环境，显式切换模型后端、执行 regime、检索策略和 prompt 设定。每次运行在隔离 workspace 中执行，并记录 token、diff、terminal transcript、任务日志和遥测；验证侧使用 AST-aware 检查，强调可复现和可审计。
summary.experiments: 在 100 个多文件 RefactorBench 任务上测试四类模型家族。摘要中报告 AST-aware chunking 相比朴素 token-window chunking 在不同 prompt 模式下提升约 25-30%；朴素检索并不稳定，提示检索质量和代码结构建模比单纯塞上下文更关键。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Pi School 和 Translated。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a controlled harness for evaluating repository-scale refactoring agents on multi-file behavior-preserving edits.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an evaluation and instrumentation asset for coding agents rather than a new code model. The useful part is the controlled separation of model backbone, execution regime, retrieval, multi-agent setup, and prompt specificity.
summary_en.technical_approach: RefactorPlatform fixes the environment while varying model backends, execution modes, retrieval settings, and prompts. Runs execute in isolated workspaces with token logs, diffs, terminal transcripts, telemetry export, and AST-based verification.
summary_en.experiments: The harness is demonstrated on 100 multi-file RefactorBench tasks across four model families. The abstract reports that AST-aware chunking improves over naive token-window chunking by roughly 25-30% across prompt modes, while naive retrieval appears unreliable.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Pi School and Translated.

recommendation.zh: 预训练价值不高，但仓库级 agent eval 的变量控制做得干净；只看实验设计和 AST-aware chunking 结果即可。
recommendation.en: Low pretraining value, but the controlled repo-agent evaluation is clean; read the setup and the AST-aware chunking result only.

paper.title: Train What You Deploy:Token-Faithful Post-Training of a Production Coding
paper.abstract: Existing post-training pipelines for coding and terminal agents suffer severe token and control fidelity errors: simplified training environments mismatch production deployments, and offline token reconstruction from agent logs distorts original prompts and conflates policy calls with background model operations. We present a fidelity-aware training coupling framework that retains trainer-side sampling over original prompts, eliminates spurious model calls via a negotiated training protocol, and

summary.core_problem: 现有的代码/终端 Agent 后训练（Post-Training）流程存在严重的 token 和控制保真度（fidelity）缺失：简化的训练环境与实际部署环境不匹配，而基于离线日志的 token 重建会扭曲原始 prompt，并将 Agent 框架的后台操作误认为策略（policy）调用。
summary.importance: 揭示了 Agent 后训练中长期被忽视的“训练-部署不一致”问题，并提出了一套在生产级 Agent 框架内进行高保真后训练的完整系统。其提出的 C-DPPO 算法为 DPPO 提供了严格的双边 TV 散度认证，对强化学习在长序列生成中的稳定性有重要价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了一种保真度感知的训练耦合框架，连接了 Rust 编写的生产级 Agent（KCoder）和后训练框架（slime）。核心机制包括：1) 采样所有权：在服务适配器内终止 Agent 的模型调用，使用训练引擎的 token id 和 logprob 重新采样；2) 声明偏差：Agent 运行在严格的训练模式下，通过协商头声明子 Agent 深度和推理重放等协议偏差；3) 验证与失效关闭归因：轨迹线性化器将消息树重建为训练序列，仅对可证明为采样延续的跨度分配 loss mask。此外，提出了 C-DPPO，通过计算精确的 Binary/Top-K TV 粗化差距，建立严格的双边认证边界，并引入自适应 K 规则和预算感知的序列保证。
summary.experiments: 在 TMax-15K 语料库上对 Baize5B 和 Baize10B 进行了端到端验证。结果显示，C-DPPO 在 TMax-100 上的最终得分分别为 37/100 和 44/100，相比标准 DPPO（34/100 和 41/100）在两个规模上均有一致的 +3.0 分提升。四项证书审计表明，C-DPPO 实现了极高的记录完整性（>99%）和大部分已解决的证书（>84%），且 mask 分歧较小。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第 5 节关于 C-DPPO 的理论推导，特别是如何将单边的 DPPO 近似转化为双边的 TV 认证边界。此外，第 6.1 节关于 token 保真度失效的量化分析也值得一读，它直观地展示了离线日志重建的缺陷。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing post-training pipelines for coding/terminal agents suffer from severe token and control fidelity errors: simplified training environments mismatch production deployments, and offline token reconstruction from logs distorts prompts and conflates scaffold operations with policy calls.
summary_en.importance: Exposes the often-overlooked 'train-deploy mismatch' in agent post-training and provides a complete system for high-fidelity post-training within a production-grade agent scaffold. The proposed C-DPPO algorithm offers strict two-sided TV divergence certification for DPPO, which is highly valuable for the stability of RL in long-sequence generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a fidelity-aware training coupling framework connecting a production Rust agent (KCoder) and a post-training framework (slime). Core mechanisms include: 1) Sampling ownership: terminating agent model calls inside the serving adapter and re-sampling with the training engine's token ids and logprobs; 2) Declared deviations: running the agent in a hardened training mode that declares protocol deviations via negotiation headers; 3) Verified, fail-closed attribution: a trajectory linearizer rebuilds message trees into training sequences, assigning loss masks only to provably sampled continuations. Furthermore, introduces C-DPPO, which establishes strict two-sided certification bounds by calculating the exact Binary/Top-K TV coarsening gap, and introduces adaptive-K rules and budget-aware sequence guarantees.
summary_en.experiments: End-to-end validation on Baize5B and Baize10B using the TMax-15K corpus. Results show C-DPPO achieves final TMax-100 scores of 37/100 and 44/100, a consistent +3.0 point improvement over Standard DPPO (34/100 and 41/100) across both scales. A four-item certificate audit demonstrates high record completeness (>99%) and mostly-resolved certificates (>84%), with small mask disagreement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 5 for the theoretical derivation of C-DPPO, particularly how the one-sided DPPO approximation is transformed into two-sided TV certification bounds. Section 6.1, which quantifies token fidelity failures, is also worth reading as it intuitively demonstrates the flaws of offline log reconstruction.

recommendation.zh: 看 §训练协议 和 C-DPPO 约束即可；真正有用的是 token span fidelity，不是那 3 分涨幅。
recommendation.en: Skim the training protocol and C-DPPO constraints; the useful bit is token-span fidelity, not the reported +3 points.

paper.title: What Does Multi-Harness RL Learn? Credit Assignment and Portability in Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Agent reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly runs through full execution harnesses, and a multi-harness recipe mixes two choices: exposing the policy to several harnesses, and comparing their rewards inside one relative-advantage group. We isolate the second choice in repository-level coding. From one Qwen3-8B supervised warm start we replay the same frozen task-harness records from Aider, OpenHands, Qwen Code, and SWE-agent, with the same number of updates, under two rules for group-relative

summary.core_problem: 多 harness 的 coding agent RL 里，“让策略见到多个 harness”（exposure）和“把不同 harness 的回报放进同一个相对优势组里比较”（credit assignment 的 grouping 边界）是两件事。论文要隔离并回答的是：在相同数据、相同更新预算下，仅改变 GRPO 的分组规则（Within：按 task×harness 分组；Cross：同一 task 下跨 harness 池化分组）会学到什么？它会提升跨 harness 可迁移性，还是主要改变对某个 harness 的适配？
summary.importance: 这篇更像 post-train/RL 侧的机制研究，但对“pretrain ↔ posttrain 闭环”有现实意义：生产级 agent 训练往往把 harness（提示、工具、重试、上下文管理）当作环境的一部分，而 reward 标准化/相对优势的分组边界会引入组成依赖的偏置。论文给出一个很干净的控制变量实验：固定轨迹与奖励，只动 credit assignment 的 grouping，结果显示它并不会自动带来 harness-independent 的策略；更大的方差来自评测 harness 本身。对做 RL 数据回放、离线 RL、以及想把 agent RL 信号“反哺”到更通用能力的人，这个结论很实用：先把评测与环境接口的差异量化清楚，再谈训练配方的小改动。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上做了三层隔离：
1) 固定起点：同一个 Qwen3-8B 的 SFT warm start。
2) 固定经验：四个生产 harness（Aider、OpenHands、Qwen Code、SWE-agent）在共享 SWE-Gym 任务池上收集 frozen trajectory corpus；两条 RL 主线 replay 完全相同的 records/tokens/rewards/loss masks/update budget。
3) 只改分组边界：使用 GRPO（group-relative policy optimization）的相对优势标准化。Within 在每个 task–harness 对内做标准化；Cross 在同一 task 下把不同 harness 的轨迹放进一个组里竞争 credit。
评估上强调“sealed SWE-bench Verified oracle”作为统一裁判，并额外用一个训练中未出现的 minimal harness 做 portability 测试。论文还直接测量 advantage 里残留的 harness identity，并追踪它对下游 action distribution 的影响，试图把‘credit 规则改变了什么’落到可观测量上，而不是只看最终 solve rate。
summary.experiments:
关键数字与结论（来自你提供的全文片段）：
- 评测 harness 是最大变量：在一个受控的 recipe-by-harness 矩阵里，评测 harness 能让 solve rate 变化 4.3 倍，而训练 recipe 的变化只有 1.16 倍量级。
- 在 held-out minimal harness 上，Cross 与 Within “不可区分”（indistinguishable），无论是否重新 on-policy 收集数据；两者的最大收益都集中在同一个 source harness。
- 直接测 advantage 中的 harness identity：在 pooling（Cross）下比 null 高 +4.48 pp，而 Within 下没有；但这种 identity 差异并没有转化为更好的 held-out 分数或不同的 harness 内 action distribution（文中表述为两者相同）。
- 评测规模：对 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务、每任务 2 attempts、4 个 source harness，共 24,000 attempted episodes；99.1% 返回可用 oracle verdict。held-out weak-ReAct 接口在同 roster 上 k=4 评估，并对关键对比在 k=8 复测。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 35–50 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction + “Separating exposure from credit assignment”：把 Within/Cross 的唯一差异和控制变量读清楚。
- 重点看他们如何构造 frozen manifest、如何保证两条 RL 线 replay 完全同一批轨迹（这是论文可信度的核心）。
- 精看关于“evaluation harness dominates”的那组表/图：它决定了你后续如何解读任何 coding agent RL 的增益。
- 如果你做 GRPO/相对优势类方法，建议细读 harness identity in advantage 的测量与 +4.48pp 的定义方式，理解它到底捕捉的是 reward 组成偏置、还是 prompt/tool 差异的可分辨信号。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-harness RL for coding agents, exposure to multiple harnesses and cross-harness credit assignment are distinct choices. The paper isolates the latter: with identical experience and update budget, does changing the GRPO grouping boundary—Within (group by task×harness) vs Cross (pool harnesses within a task)—actually learn a more harness-portable policy, or does it mainly shift which harness gets credit without improving out-of-harness generalization?
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training/RL mechanics paper, but it matters for the pretrain–posttrain loop because production agent training treats the harness (prompting, tools, retries, context management) as part of the environment, and group-relative reward normalization can introduce composition-dependent bias. The controlled result is practical: cross-harness pooling in GRPO does not, by itself, yield harness-independent behavior; the evaluation harness dominates observed solve rates. For anyone using offline replay RL, multi-environment agent RL, or trying to turn agent RL signals into more general capabilities, it argues to quantify harness/evaluation effects before attributing gains to recipe tweaks.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study is a tight control-variable design:
- Same initialization: one Qwen3-8B SFT warm start.
- Same data: four production harnesses (Aider, OpenHands, Qwen Code, SWE-agent) collect a frozen trajectory corpus on a shared SWE-Gym pool; both RL arms replay the exact same records, tokens, rewards, loss masks, and update budget.
- Only change: GRPO grouping boundary. Within standardizes rewards within each task–harness pair; Cross pools harnesses within a task so trajectories compete for relative credit.
Evaluation uses a single sealed SWE-bench Verified oracle across the four source harnesses plus a minimal harness held out from training to test portability. They also directly measure how much harness identity remains encoded in the advantage under each credit rule and track downstream effects on action distributions.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported numbers and findings from the provided text:
- Evaluation harness is the dominant factor: solve rate varies by a factor of 4.3 due to evaluation harness choice, while the training recipe changes it by ~1.16.
- On the held-out minimal harness, Cross and Within are indistinguishable, with or without re-collecting data on-policy; both concentrate their largest gains on the same source harness.
- Advantage-level measurement: harness identity is +4.48 percentage points above a null under pooling (Cross) and absent under Within, yet this does not translate into better held-out scores or different within-harness action distributions (as stated in the excerpt).
- Evaluation scale: 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 2 attempts per task, across 4 source harnesses → 24,000 attempted episodes; 99.1% yield usable sealed-oracle verdicts. Held-out weak-ReAct interface evaluated at k=4, with key contrasts rechecked at k=8.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (35–50 minutes):
- Read the Introduction and the section separating exposure from credit assignment to pin down the single manipulated variable.
- Focus on how the frozen trajectory manifest is constructed and how they ensure both arms replay identical experience; this is the credibility anchor.
- Study the tables/figures supporting “evaluation harness dominates,” since it reframes how to interpret most coding-agent RL improvements.
- If you work on GRPO-style objectives, read the harness-identity-in-advantage measurement carefully (including the +4.48pp definition) to understand whether it reflects reward-composition bias, harness prompt/tool differences, or both.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 harness 方差结果；它会让 coding-agent RL 的收益解读更保守。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental design and the harness-variance result; it should make coding-agent RL gains look less clean than headline solve rates suggest.

paper.title: Design Docs Are All You Need: An AI-native Machine-Learning Performance Tool
paper.abstract: Machine-learning performance modeling is a uniquely hostile terrain for long-lived software: the assumptions baked into today's abstractions are invalidated by tomorrow's models and systems, forcing perpetual refactoring of performance-modeling frameworks. Meanwhile, AI coding agents have become fast and capable enough that regenerating an entire library is cheaper than paying down the tech debt of incrementally patching it. We describe SMART, a rigorous symbolic performance-modeling library for

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 ML 性能建模工具在架构和硬件快速变化下难以长期维护的问题。作者认为，性能建模库的稳定代码抽象很快会被 MoE、latent attention、异构推理阶段、新互联拓扑等变化打破，持续打补丁会形成结构性技术债。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在模型、数据或优化算法，而在研究基础设施的组织方式。它对做大模型训练系统、性能建模、成本预测工具的人有参考意义：当目标系统变化快、抽象频繁失效时，可以把自然语言设计文档作为稳定资产，把代码视为可再生成的产物。这种思路适合小到中等规模的内部工具，但论文没有给出严格的软件工程评测，因此更适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案是让主分支几乎只保存 markdown 设计文档，而不是长期维护代码。设计文档组成一个 DAG，依赖边由只读 agent 从文档中自动推断。一个 orchestrator 按拓扑顺序调度多个 coding sub-agent，每个 sub-agent 只负责一个自包含设计文档的代码生成。这样做有三个作用：第一，单个任务上下文较小，缓解 agent 的上下文窗口限制；第二，orchestrator 记录 agent 理解困难和 bug，帮助人类改写模糊文档；第三，可以按文档复杂度动态选择强弱不同的模型。作者还强调 worked examples：在文档中写出具体输入、形状、中间值和期望闭式成本表达式，并用 reconciliation anchor 生成测试，减少独立代码生成之间的语义漂移。
summary.experiments: 论文没有系统 benchmark，也没有与传统软件开发流程做受控比较。主要报告的是工程运行数据：完整 clean-slate regeneration 需要约 1.5 到 3 小时；使用 Claude Code 完整重建一次 API 成本约 100 美元；在高阶订阅计划下约占每周额度的 20%。这些数字说明该流程在作者场景中成本可接受，但不能直接推出对大型生产代码库同样有效。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 10 到 15 分钟泛读。重点看 Introduction 中对 incremental generation debt 和 context-window myopia 的定义，再看“Design docs as the source of truth”里 DAG、orchestrator、sub-agent、日志和 worked examples 的设计。Figure 1 有助于理解完整再生成流程。无需深读形式化符号，关键是判断这种流程是否适合自己的性能建模或训练系统工具链。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a maintenance problem in ML performance-modeling software. Model architectures, accelerator topology, and inference phases change quickly, so abstractions that were reasonable for one generation of systems become wrong for the next. Incremental patches then accumulate architectural debt.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining research is infrastructural rather than algorithmic. For teams building training-cost models, simulator libraries, or internal performance tools, the paper gives a concrete workflow for treating design documents as the stable artifact and generated code as a disposable build product. The contribution is mainly a software-process pattern; it does not provide a controlled evaluation of model quality, pretraining efficiency, or system throughput.
summary_en.technical_approach: The repository keeps almost no durable code on the main branch. Instead, it stores self-contained markdown design documents organized as a DAG. Read-only agents infer dependency edges, and an orchestrator walks the graph in topological order. Each document is assigned to a separate coding sub-agent, which generates the corresponding implementation. The orchestrator records ambiguous prose, failed interpretations, and downstream bugs so humans can refine the documents rather than patch code. A useful detail is the emphasis on worked examples: docs include small executable traces, intermediate tensor shapes, closed-form cost expressions, and exact expected outputs that become generated tests.
summary_en.experiments: There is no rigorous benchmark or ablation study. The paper reports operational numbers from the authors' workflow: a full clean-slate regeneration takes about 1.5 to 3 hours, and a complete rebuild with Claude Code costs roughly 100 USD, around 20% of a weekly high-tier usage budget. These numbers support feasibility for the described project, but they should not be read as general evidence for large production repositories.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 10 to 15 minutes. Focus on the definitions of incremental generation debt and context-window myopia, then read the design-doc DAG workflow, orchestration loop, and worked-example discipline. Figure 1 is enough to understand the regeneration pipeline. The main question to ask is whether your own ML systems tooling has a small enough semantic surface to make document-driven regeneration reliable.

recommendation.zh: 展示了 Coding Agent 在特定领域（性能建模）实现 'Design Docs as Code' 的极端用例，对思考未来软件工程范式和 Agent 能力边界有启发。
recommendation.en: Demonstrates an extreme use case of Coding Agents achieving 'Design Docs as Code' in a specific domain (performance modeling), inspiring thoughts on future software engineering paradigms and Agent capability boundaries.

paper.title: PatchBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Vulnerability Patching
paper.abstract: AI agents have recently demonstrated strong performance in automated vulnerability patching. However, existing evaluations often validate a patch only by testing whether the provided Proof-of-Concept (PoC) input still triggers a crash. This leaves two key threats to validity: agents may reproduce memorized historical developer patches, or they may generate surface-level fixes that only suppress the reported crash.   We study these concerns for C/C++ vulnerability patching. We introduce a patch s

summary.core_problem: 现有的 AI 漏洞修复评测基准存在两个严重缺陷：一是 LLM 容易“背诵”训练数据中的历史补丁；二是智能体倾向于生成仅能抑制崩溃（PoC）的表面修复，而非解决根本原因。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前代码/安全 Agent 评测中普遍存在的“数据污染”和“捷径学习”问题，并提出了一个更严格的评测基准 PatchBench，对提升代码生成和 Agent 评测的有效性有重要参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 提出一种补丁相似度指标来检测 LLM 的“背诵”行为；2) 构建 PatchBench，包含 213 个 C/C++ 漏洞修复任务。为了防止 Agent 走捷径（依赖崩溃堆栈），专门挑选了真实补丁不在崩溃堆栈函数中的漏洞；为了防止背诵，将漏洞移植到新版本代码并进行变异；3) 引入了更严格的验证机制，包括基于 fuzz 的安全验证和基于良性输入/单元测试的语义验证。
summary.experiments: 在 SEC-bench 上的研究发现，高达 25% 的 Agent 生成补丁与历史开发者补丁高度相似（存在背诵嫌疑），且 64% 的补丁即使在根本原因不在堆栈上时，仍修改堆栈上的函数（走捷径）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点关注 Introduction 中对现有评测缺陷的分析，以及 PatchBench 如何通过代码变异和严格验证来缓解这些问题。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI vulnerability patching benchmarks suffer from two major flaws: LLMs tend to memorize historical patches from training data, and agents often generate surface-level fixes that merely suppress crashes (PoCs) rather than addressing root causes.
summary_en.importance: Exposes prevalent issues of data contamination and shortcut learning in current code/security agent evaluations, and introduces a more rigorous benchmark, PatchBench, providing valuable insights for improving the validity of code generation and agent evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Proposes a patch similarity metric to detect LLM memorization. 2) Constructs PatchBench with 213 C/C++ patching tasks. To prevent agents from taking shortcuts (relying on crash stack traces), it selects vulnerabilities where the ground-truth patch is not in the stack trace functions. To prevent memorization, vulnerabilities are transplanted to newer code versions and mutated. 3) Introduces stricter validation, including fuzz-based security validation and semantic validation using benign inputs/unit tests.
summary_en.experiments: Studies on SEC-bench reveal that up to 25% of agent-generated patches are highly similar to historical developer patches (suspected memorization), and 64% of patches modify functions on the stack trace even when the root cause is elsewhere (shortcut learning).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the Introduction for the analysis of existing evaluation flaws, and how PatchBench mitigates these through code mutation and rigorous validation. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读相似度指标和失败案例即可；它提醒 SWE-agent 评测要测根因修复，不只测能否过 PoC。
recommendation.en: Read the similarity metric and failure cases; it is a clean warning that SWE-agent evals must test root-cause repair, not PoC suppression.

paper.title: When Models Edit Too Much: On the Fidelity of Minimal Code Edits
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to edit existing code, but correctness alone is not enough: useful repairs should also be minimal, reviewable, and faithful to the original implementation. We study over-editing, the tendency of a model to rewrite code beyond what is required to fix a bug. We construct an evaluation framework from 400 BigCodeBench problems by injecting controlled AST-level corruptions into reference solutions, giving each repair task a known minimal patch. Acros

summary.core_problem: 如何评估和缓解大语言模型在代码修复任务中过度编辑（over-editing）的倾向？
summary.importance: 构建了针对代码过度编辑的评估框架，揭示了即使是强模型（如 GPT-5.5）也存在高通过率与不必要的大幅修改并存的问题，强调了代码修复中忠实度和最小化修改的重要性。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 BigCodeBench 构建评估框架，通过向参考解注入受控的 AST 级别损坏，为 400 个问题生成具有已知最小补丁的修复任务。通过引入“保留指令（preservation instruction）”来引导模型减少过度编辑。
summary.experiments: 在多个前沿 LLM（包括 GPT-5.5）上进行评估。结果显示，添加保留指令可将平均多余 Levenshtein 距离从 0.195 降至 0.131，增加的认知复杂度降低 26.6%，同时 Pass@1 提升 2.3 个百分点。
summary.authors_note: National University of Singapore

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate and mitigate the tendency of large language models to over-edit code during repair tasks?
summary_en.importance: Constructs an evaluation framework for code over-editing, revealing that even strong models (e.g., GPT-5.5) exhibit a coexistence of high pass rates and unnecessarily large edits, highlighting the importance of fidelity and minimal edits in code repair.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds an evaluation framework based on BigCodeBench by injecting controlled AST-level corruptions into reference solutions, creating repair tasks with known minimal patches for 400 problems. Introduces a 'preservation instruction' to guide models to reduce over-editing.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across multiple frontier LLMs (including GPT-5.5). Results show that adding a preservation instruction reduces the average excess Levenshtein distance from 0.195 to 0.131, decreases added cognitive complexity by 26.6%, and increases Pass@1 by 2.3 points.
summary_en.authors_note: National University of Singapore

recommendation.zh: 揭示了代码模型在修复任务中的过度编辑现象，对构建更实用的 coding agent 和代码编辑评测有参考价值，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Reveals the over-editing phenomenon in code models during repair tasks, providing reference value for building more practical coding agents and code editing evaluations; keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Dude: A Dual-Detection Multi-Agent System for Paper-Code Discrepancy Detection
paper.abstract: LLM-empowered paper-code discrepancy detection has received growing concern since the scaling of research submissions exceeds the manual review capability. However, the limited context capacity and one-sided discrepancy detection of existing single-agent LLM paradigms lead to an inferior recall performance in detecting discrepancies. In this paper, we propose Dude, the first Dual-Detection Multi-Agent System for paper-code discrepancy detection. We discover that the granularity asymmetry of the

summary.core_problem: 检测论文描述与开源代码实现之间的不一致，缓解人工审稿和复现实验难以覆盖大量提交的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向科研审查的多智能体代码分析系统；对 coding agent 和自动化科研工具有一定参考，但问题域偏窄，对 LLM 基座预训练启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Dude，一个双检测多智能体系统，同时从论文语言和代码语言两侧寻找 discrepancy；作者指出两种表示粒度不对称会导致过度解释和误报，因此加入粒度对齐协商机制和两阶段显著性过滤，减少 agent 把弱差异错误上报为真实不一致。
summary.experiments: 在真实 paper-code discrepancy 数据集上评估，摘要称召回率和精确率均有明显提升；未给出具体模型规模、数据集大小、baseline 列表或提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets discrepancies between a research paper's described method and the corresponding released code, aiming to reduce the manual burden in review and reproducibility checking.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multi-agent system for scientific code auditing. It is relevant to coding agents and AI-assisted research review, but the task is narrow and only weakly connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dude uses a dual-detection multi-agent design that inspects both the paper side and the code side. The authors identify granularity asymmetry between natural-language method descriptions and implementation details as a source of over-interpretation and false positives, then add granularity-aligned negotiation and a two-stage salience filter.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on real-world paper-code discrepancy datasets, with the abstract claiming improved recall and precision. The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, dataset scale, baselines, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 方法像审稿自动化工具，预训练相关性弱；可看粒度对齐协商，别把系统结论外推到通用 agent。
recommendation.en: Mostly an automated review tool; skim the granularity-alignment idea, but do not over-generalize the system results to general agents.

paper.title: PaperCompiler: Faithful Paper-to-Code Generation via Repository-Level Specification Compilation
paper.abstract: Faithfully translating research papers into repository-level implementations remains challenging because papers often describe methods at a high level, leave implementation assumptions implicit, and require generated repositories to preserve method logic, evaluation protocols, and cross-file consistency. Despite recent advances in paper-to-code agents, their intermediate outputs are often presented as free-form plans or summaries that downstream coding agents may ignore, reinterpret, or compress

summary.core_problem: 解决 paper-to-code 过程中，中间计划过于自由文本、导致下游 coding agent 忽略关键约束、仓库结构不一致和方法失真的问题。
summary.importance: 这是仓库级代码生成与软件工程 agent 的方法工作。对预训练本身帮助有限，但对“结构化中间表示是否能稳定复杂生成”这个问题有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PaperCompiler，把论文中的实现相关证据编译成显式的 repository-level specification，而不是自然语言计划。该 specification 保留证据来源，并区分 paper-supported、inferred、externally delegated 和 unresolved 信息，用结构化约束指导后续代码生成，强调跨文件一致性、评测协议保真和实现逻辑不被压缩。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模或数据规模。实验重点应是 paper-to-code / repository-level generation 任务，对比自由文本计划式 agent，考察实现保真度、仓库结构一致性和评测复现质量。若结果成立，价值主要在中间表示设计，而非模型能力本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a common failure mode in paper-to-code generation: free-form intermediate plans are easy for downstream coding agents to ignore or compress, causing implementation drift and repository inconsistency.
summary_en.importance: This is a repository-level coding-agent paper. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is mildly relevant if you care about whether structured intermediate representations improve reliability in complex generation pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: PaperCompiler compiles implementation-relevant evidence from a paper into an explicit repository-level specification instead of a natural-language plan. The specification preserves provenance and separates paper-supported, inferred, externally delegated, and unresolved information, so downstream code generation is constrained by explicit structure and evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose model sizes or dataset scale. The likely evaluation is repository-level paper-to-code generation against free-form planning baselines, measuring faithfulness to method logic, evaluation protocol preservation, and cross-file consistency. If the gains are real, the main lesson is about intermediate representation design rather than raw model capability.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“把自由文本计划编译成可执行约束”这个思路值得借去看；读中间表示设计和误差归因，别在任务分数上停太久。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the idea of compiling free-form plans into executable constraints is worth borrowing; read it for the intermediate representation and failure analysis, not the task score.

paper.title: Rendering-in-the-Loop: An Execution-Driven Agent for Interactive Web Development
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models have achieved remarkable progress in front-end web development, generating interactive webpages from multimodal references such as screenshots and interaction videos. However, existing work largely emphasizes visual metrics such as aesthetics and layout similarity, while overlooking the more critical validation of interactive functionality. We present RILA, an execution-driven agent that puts browser rendering in the loop, iteratively editing generated code from

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态网页生成只看视觉相似度、却难以保证交互功能正确的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把浏览器执行反馈纳入网页代码生成闭环，属于较像样的 execution-driven coding agent 设计；对预训练本身不直接，但对代码 agent 的环境反馈、合成数据和 verifier 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RILA，将浏览器 rendering 放进 agent 循环中迭代改代码。核心模块包括：回放参考交互轨迹以收集执行观测的 AIV；联合交互正确性与视觉保真度的 ERS；以及 execution-verified 数据合成流水线，用于补充训练数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出基座模型、参数量和具体 benchmark。可确定其比较对象是现有多模态前端网页生成方法，评估重点从静态视觉指标扩展到交互执行正确性，并声称合成数据带来额外收益。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the gap in multimodal web generation where models optimize for visual similarity but often fail on interactive functionality.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an execution-driven loop for webpage code generation with browser feedback. It is a reasonably interesting coding-agent paper; not directly about pretraining, but useful for thinking about environment feedback, verifiers, and synthetic data in code agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes RILA, which puts browser rendering into the agent loop for iterative code editing. Key components include AIV for replaying reference interaction trajectories and collecting execution-grounded observations, ERS for combining interaction correctness with visual fidelity, and an execution-verified data synthesis pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the base model, parameter count, or benchmark names. It is clear that the paper compares against prior multimodal frontend web generation methods, shifting evaluation from static visual metrics to execution correctness, and claims complementary gains from synthetic data.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 execution verifier + 合成数据这条线值得借鉴；读 AIV/ERS 设计即可，别在网页任务本身停太久。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the execution verifier plus synthetic-data loop is worth borrowing; read the AIV/ERS design and move on.

paper.title: What Does an Agentic Software Engineering Benchmark Measure? Profiling Task Demands and Agent Behaviour Beyond What Category Labels Reveal
paper.abstract: Agentic software engineering benchmarks are typically summarized by nominal category labels such as "bug fix" or "feature implementation," yet benchmarks carrying the same label are built through very different curation pipelines. A label thus reveals little about the engineering work a benchmark demands. We introduce the Spread--Novelty--Centrality (SNC) profile, a three-axis characterization of the demands of repository-level coding tasks, grounded in empirical software engineering research. W

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：agentic software engineering benchmark 的“bug fix”“feature implementation”等类别标签过粗，不能说明任务真正要求的代码修改范围、代码新颖性和架构位置，也不能解释 agent 的行为差异。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏评测方法，对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对代码模型 post-train、agent 训练数据筛选和 coding benchmark 解读有启发。它提醒研究者不要把 benchmark label 当作能力标签。两个同名“feature implementation”集合，可能一个要求局部补丁，另一个要求跨文件新增逻辑；用它们做 SFT/RL 或评测时，训练信号和能力结论会不同。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Spread–Novelty–Centrality profile。Spread 衡量 gold patch 的修改分布有多广，反映跨文件、跨模块的改动范围；Novelty 衡量新增代码相对删除或修改既有代码的比例，反映任务是否要求生成新逻辑；Centrality 衡量被修改代码在仓库结构中的重要性，反映任务触及边缘代码还是核心架构代码。除 gold patch 画像外，作者还分析 agent trajectory 和生成 patch，定义行为足迹，例如 agent patch 相对 gold patch 的 verbose 程度，以及探索范围相对实际编辑范围的比例。这样可以区分“任务本身要求什么”和“agent 如何尝试解决”。
summary.experiments: 研究覆盖 5 个常用 agentic SE benchmarks，共 2,487 个实例，其中包括 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-Gym Lite，以及多个 feature implementation benchmark。作者使用 Harbor 统一评测框架，运行 2 个模型家族、每个 3 个规模点：Claude Code 下的 Claude Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.6、Opus 4.6，以及 Qwen Code 下的 Qwen 3.5 9B、27B、397B-A17B。总计 30 次运行、14,922 条 agent trajectories。主要发现有三点：第一，同一类别标签下的 benchmark 在 SNC 至少两个轴上也会显著分离，类别名不能代表任务需求；第二，agent patch 的 verbosity 与 benchmark 构造方式相关，提示少时更容易 over-shoot，gold patch 膨胀时可能 under-shoot，而探索广度在 benchmark 间差异不明显；第三，resolved runs 通常集中在低 SNC 区间，这一趋势在模型家族和规模间较稳定，但行为模式有家族差异，Claude 更接近 gold patch scope，且随规模增大更趋近 scope parity，Qwen 更常通过 over-producing 解决，under-editing 对两个家族都常对应失败。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 SNC 定义、五个 benchmark 的 SNC 分布图或表、resolved/unresolved runs 的对比，以及 Claude/Qwen 行为差异部分。不必深读实现细节，除非要复现实验或设计新的 coding-agent benchmark。对 LLM 研究者最有用的是把 SNC 当作代码任务数据画像工具，用于解释 benchmark transfer 弱、SFT/RL 数据混合不稳定、以及 agent 评测分数难比较的问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what agentic software engineering benchmarks actually measure beyond coarse labels such as bug fixing or feature implementation.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance comes from benchmark interpretation and data curation for coding-agent post-training. The main lesson is that a benchmark label should not be treated as a capability label. Two datasets both called feature implementation can require very different amounts of code spread, new code creation, and architectural involvement, which changes both evaluation conclusions and the training signal used for SFT or RL.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Spread–Novelty–Centrality profile. Spread measures how distributed the reference patch is across the repository. Novelty measures how much the solution introduces new code rather than modifying or deleting existing code. Centrality measures how architecturally important the touched code is. These metrics are computed from gold patches to characterize task demand. The paper then goes beyond gold patches by analyzing agent trajectories and generated patches. It measures behaviors such as patch verbosity relative to the gold patch and exploration breadth relative to the actual edit scope. This separates the required engineering work from the way an agent attempts the task.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers five agentic SE benchmarks with 2,487 instances, including SWE-bench Verified and SWE-Gym Lite. It evaluates two model families at three scale points each: Claude Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, and Opus 4.6 under Claude Code; Qwen 3.5 9B, 27B, and 397B-A17B under Qwen Code. All runs use the Harbor evaluation harness, totaling 30 runs and 14,922 agent trajectories. The main findings are: benchmark labels are poor proxies for task demand, with every benchmark pair separated on at least two SNC axes; patch verbosity reflects benchmark construction and prompting, while exploration breadth is less distinguishable across benchmarks; resolved runs concentrate in low-SNC bins across families and scales; behavioral signatures differ by family, with Claude tending toward gold-patch scope parity and Qwen more often resolving through over-production. Under-editing is a common failure signal for both families.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the SNC metric definitions, the benchmark comparison plots or tables, the resolved-versus-unresolved analysis, and the Claude/Qwen behavioral comparison. Implementation details are only necessary if reproducing the harness or building a new coding-agent benchmark. The most useful takeaway for LLM researchers is to use SNC-like profiles as a data and evaluation diagnostic for coding tasks, especially when analyzing weak benchmark transfer or unstable post-training mixtures.

recommendation.zh: 读 SNC 定义和主要结果表；它能校准 SWE benchmark 的难度解释，避免把数据构造差异误读成模型能力差异。
recommendation.en: Read the SNC definitions and main result table; it helps separate SWE benchmark curation effects from genuine model capability differences.
