institutions: Radin Shayanfar, Keheliya Gallaba, Ahmed E. Hassan

paper.title: Harness-of-Harness: Multi-Day Autonomous Software Development with Continual Improvement
paper.abstract: This paper studies autonomous software development, in which LLM-based coding agents transform high-level requirements into complete, functional, and usable software systems without human intervention. We introduce Harness-of-Harness (HoH), a framework that enables coding agents to continually improve software during autonomous development. HoH operates on existing coding-agent harnesses, and organizes their executions into iterative planning-coding-testing loops. To sustain improvement across l

summary.core_problem: 论文研究长周期自主软件开发中的一个工程问题：给定高层需求后，coding agent 如何在多天、多轮迭代中持续推进，而不是陷入局部修补、重复验证、上下文遗忘或过早宣布完成。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和基座预训练的关系较间接，主要价值在 agent harness 和长程任务评测。它不提出新的语言模型训练目标，也不是预训练数据或优化方法工作。可取之处在于，它把 agent 能力提升从“单次模型调用”转向“可验证产物、角色分工、迭代证据和版本回退”的系统设计。对研究训练数据合成、代码 agent 评测、长程任务环境的人有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: Harness-of-Harness 是套在已有 coding-agent harness 外层的框架。它把开发组织成 planning–coding–testing 循环。planner 根据需求和历史证据生成下一轮计划，每轮既要修复已有问题，也要交付一个小而可验证的新能力；developer 负责实现，并在实现中加入局部测试；tester 独立评估系统是否满足总体需求和当前计划，测试覆盖功能完整性、可用性，以及游戏场景中的视觉和音频质量。框架强调约束输出工件，而不是规定 agent 的完整思考流程。为避免上下文过载，它使用 progressive disclosure：把计划、测试报告、历史记录等持久化到文件系统，只先暴露摘要索引，需要时再检索细节。它还引入角色化工具、Markdown skills、项目状态版本记录和回退机制。
summary.experiments: 实验分两类。第一类是在 GameCraft-Bench、FrontierSWE 和 ProgramBench 上，把 HoH 加到现有 harness 之上，并与 standalone harness 对比。配置包括 Codex with GPT-5.5 high、OpenCode with DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Pi with MiniMax-M3。三轮迭代后，GameCraft-Bench 提升 16.62–22.08 分，FrontierSWE 提升 19–29 分，ProgramBench 提升 6.09–16.85 分。在 FrontierSWE 上，HoH + Codex/GPT-5.5 high 经过十轮从 22% 提升到 72.67%。第二类是开放式多天游戏开发，从高层产品需求开始构建复杂游戏，并加入角色专用工具和 skills，覆盖引擎交互、素材获取与生成、参考检索、测试和项目状态管理。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 对长程 coding agent 失败模式的归纳，以及 HoH 的 planning–coding–testing 循环设计。实验部分可关注三点：增益是否来自更多迭代次数，独立 tester 如何避免开发时测试的自我确认，版本记录和 progressive disclosure 对长程稳定性的作用。如果只关心基座训练，可跳过开放式游戏开发细节，保留其对长程 agent 数据生成和评测协议的启发。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses long-horizon autonomous software development: how an LLM-based coding agent can turn high-level requirements into a complete software system over multi-day execution without losing coherence, looping on local repairs, or declaring success prematurely.
summary_en.importance: The connection to foundation-model pretraining is indirect. The contribution is mainly at the agent harness and evaluation level, not in model training objectives, pretraining data, or optimization. It is still useful for researchers interested in long-horizon agent environments, coding-agent evaluation, and the generation of structured traces that may later become training data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Harness-of-Harness wraps existing coding-agent harnesses and imposes an iterative planning–coding–testing structure. The planner consumes the requirements and accumulated evidence, then proposes a small verifiable increment that combines repair with new capability growth. The developer implements the plan and performs local tests during implementation. An independent tester then evaluates the system against both the global requirements and the current plan, using white-box and black-box tests. The framework constrains required artifacts rather than prescribing the agent’s internal workflow. It uses progressive disclosure instead of a dedicated memory module: plans, reports, and histories are stored in the file system, exposed first through concise indexes, and retrieved in detail only when needed. It also supports role-specific tools, lightweight Markdown skills, versioned project states, and rollback after major regressions.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers three controlled benchmarks: GameCraft-Bench, FrontierSWE, and ProgramBench. HoH is tested on top of several harness–model configurations, including Codex with GPT-5.5 high, OpenCode with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Pi with MiniMax-M3. After three iterations, HoH improves over the corresponding standalone harnesses by 16.62–22.08 points on GameCraft-Bench, 19–29 points on FrontierSWE, and 6.09–16.85 points on ProgramBench. On FrontierSWE, HoH with Codex/GPT-5.5 high improves from 22% to 72.67% over ten iterations. A second setting studies open-ended multi-day game development from high-level product requirements, using role-specific tools and skills for engine interaction, asset acquisition and generation, reference retrieval, testing, and project-state management.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Focus on the failure modes of long-horizon coding agents in the introduction and the design of the planning–coding–testing loop. In the experiments, check whether the gains come from iteration depth, independent testing, version control, or progressive disclosure. If your main interest is foundation-model training, the open-ended game-building details can be skimmed; the more transferable parts are the artifact schema, evidence loop, and evaluation protocol for long-horizon agent behavior.

recommendation.zh: 读 framework 设计和 benchmark protocol；对预训练本身不直接，但可借来设计 coding RL 环境的可验证增量。
recommendation.en: Read the framework design and benchmark protocol; it is not pretraining work, but the verifiable-increment idea is useful for coding RL environments.

paper.title: CUDA-Harness: Harnessing Agentic CUDA Kernel Generation and Optimization from Natural Language
paper.abstract: Developing high-performance CUDA kernels demands specialized knowledge in algorithm implementation, correctness validation, and hardware-aware parallel optimization, creating a substantial expertise barrier and making generating CUDA kernels directly from natural language (Text2CUDA) essential. Meanwhile, the general-purpose code generation capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) prompts a series of works exploring LLM-based CUDA kernel generation. They mainly focus on transpilation from high

summary.core_problem: 解决从自然语言直接生成高性能 CUDA kernel 的难题，尤其是 Text2CUDA 场景下语义理解、正确性验证和硬件优化同时成立的问题。
summary.importance: 这更像代码生成 agent / 程序合成工作，而不是 LLM 基座预训练。价值主要在于 agentic code generation、验证闭环和 reward hacking 防护，对后训练和代码 agent 设计有一些参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CUDA-Harness 框架，核心是把自然语言到 CUDA 的生成拆成中间结构化表示，再结合 correctness validation 与性能优化环节形成 agentic harness，试图避免只靠固定测试输入带来的 reward hacking。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出完整数值，但对比对象应是已有 LLM-based CUDA generation / Torch2CUDA 方法。重点实验应围绕 kernel 正确率、性能优化幅度以及在更严格验证下的稳健性。
summary.authors_note: 上海交通大学的代码生成/程序语言方向工作。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles direct natural-language-to-CUDA generation, where semantic understanding, correctness, and hardware-aware optimization must all hold at once.
summary_en.importance: This is better viewed as a coding-agent / program synthesis paper rather than foundation-model pretraining. Its value lies in agentic code generation, validation loops, and reward-hacking mitigation, with some relevance to post-training setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: CUDA-Harness introduces an agentic framework that decomposes Text2CUDA into intermediate structured generation, then couples correctness validation with optimization stages to reduce the brittleness of predefined test-input rewards.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full numbers, but the likely comparisons are prior LLM-based CUDA generation and Torch2CUDA systems, focusing on correctness, optimization quality, and robustness under stricter validation.
summary_en.authors_note: A code generation / programming languages effort from Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 不直接相连，但 reward hacking 与 verifier 设计值得借鉴；只看中间表示和验证闭环，别把性能数字当通用结论。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but the reward-hacking and verifier design are worth borrowing; read the intermediate representation and validation loop, not the headline speedups.

paper.title: WiseSpec: Requirements-Driven Agents for Code Generation
paper.abstract: Code generation aims to automatically generate source code from task requirements and has attracted significant attention with the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs). Despite remarkable progress, LLMs often struggle to generate correct code for complex software engineering tasks because task descriptions are frequently incomplete, ambiguous, or lack critical contextual information. Existing approaches primarily improve the capabilities of coding agents through more sophisticated t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注仓库级代码生成里一个常被忽略的问题：任务需求本身不完整、含糊或缺少上下文，导致 coding agent 即使有工具链也难以生成正确代码。
summary.importance: 贡献点不在新模型，而在把 requirements engineering 引入 coding agent 流程，强调“先把需求写对”再生成代码。对基座预训练的直接关联不强，但对 post-train agent pipeline 有一点方法论启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 WiseSpec，一个 requirements-driven agent 框架。它先自动构造结构化、信息更充分的需求说明，再用 execution-based evaluation 评估需求质量，并迭代修正需求，最后用改进后的 spec 指导 repository-level code generation。核心创新是把需求构建与质量反馈放到代码生成前面，而不是只堆工具和 workflow。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整 benchmark 名称、模型规模和提升幅度，只能确认其在 repository-level code generation 场景做了实验，并通过执行反馈驱动 spec refinement。由于缺少 clean 的对比细节，目前更像一个合理的 pipeline 改造，而不是能改变 coding prior 的强证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a neglected bottleneck in repository-level code generation: task requirements are often incomplete or ambiguous, so coding agents fail even with better tools and workflows.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is not a new model but a shift in pipeline emphasis—improving the specification before generation. This has limited direct relevance to pretraining, but some value for post-training coding-agent design.
summary_en.technical_approach: WiseSpec is a requirements-driven agent framework that first constructs structured, information-rich requirements, then evaluates requirement quality using execution-based feedback, and iteratively refines the spec before code generation. The key idea is to optimize the task specification itself rather than only the downstream coding workflow.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide enough detail on benchmark names, model sizes, or exact gains. It appears to evaluate repository-level code generation with execution-guided spec refinement, but the evidence currently looks more like a sensible pipeline improvement than a strong prior-changing result.

recommendation.zh: 思路不差，但更像把 requirements engineering 接到 coding agent 前面；先看实验表和 error breakdown，若提升主要来自更多上下文，就别高估方法新意。
recommendation.en: The idea is sensible, but it may just be requirements engineering bolted onto a coding agent; check the tables and error breakdown first, because the gains may mostly come from adding context.

paper.title: A^2Agent: Action-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Repository-Level Code Localization Agents
paper.abstract: Localizing issue-relevant code regions is a critical step in automated software engineering. However, due to their reliance on sparse trajectory-level signals, existing methods cannot identify which per-turn actions are effective and often discover correct code regions during exploration but fail to commit them. To address these limitations, we propose an action-aware reinforcement learning method that combines a per-turn reward sequence rewarding both the discovery and commitment of gold code r

summary.core_problem: 解决仓库级代码定位 agent 只依赖稀疏 trajectory-level reward，无法判断每一步 action 是否有效，且常在探索到正确代码区域后未能提交的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 的 RL credit assignment 改进。它对软件工程 agent 有实际价值，也给 RL 训练中“发现”和“提交”这两个子目标如何拆 reward 提供了一个可迁移模板；但它主要服务代码定位任务，不是通用基座训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 A2Agent，即 action-aware reinforcement learning。方法包含两部分：一是 per-turn reward sequence，同时奖励发现 gold code regions 和最终 commit；二是 action-level advantage estimation，把共享同一 exploration context 的 turns 分组，从而隔离单个 action 的 credit，降低 trajectory-level sparse signal 的噪声。
summary.experiments: 在 SWE-Bench Verified 和 SWE-Bench Pro 上评估。摘要报告平均 F1 分别比已有强基线提高 1.58% 和 8.55%；其 4B 模型超过最多大 8 倍的 baselines。未给出训练数据规模和完整 baseline 名单。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Sungkyunkwan University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses repository-level code localization agents that rely on sparse trajectory-level rewards and therefore cannot identify useful per-turn actions or commit correct regions once found.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent reinforcement learning contribution focused on credit assignment. It is practically relevant for software engineering agents and offers a transferable reward decomposition between discovery and commitment, but it is not a general base-model pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: A2Agent uses action-aware reinforcement learning with two components: a per-turn reward sequence that rewards both discovery and commitment of gold code regions, and action-level advantage estimation that groups turns sharing the same exploration context to isolate each action's credit.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and SWE-Bench Pro. The abstract reports average F1 gains of 1.58% and 8.55%, respectively, and states that a 4B model outperforms baselines up to 8x larger. Training data size and full baseline details are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Sungkyunkwan University.

recommendation.zh: 读 reward 分解即可；小模型赢大模型说明 credit assignment 有用，但任务窄，别外推到通用 RL。
recommendation.en: Read the reward decomposition; the small-model result supports better credit assignment, but the task is narrow and should not be overgeneralized to general RL.

paper.title: Super Library Agent: Joint Generation and Maintenance of Multiple Applications Beyond the Single Codebase
paper.abstract: Organizations often develop and maintain portfolios of related applications: independently deployable codebases that share substantial domain logic, interface patterns, or operational conventions. As LLM coding agents are increasingly used to generate and maintain such software, a naive application-by-application workflow duplicates shared logic across codebases and allows prolonged agentic maintenance to accumulate verbosity, dead code, and structural erosion. We introduce the Super Library Age

summary.core_problem: 让代码 Agent 在连续生成和维护多个相关应用时，自动抽取共享组件并维护一个跨应用复用的 Super Library，而不是逐个代码库重复造轮子。
summary.importance: 贡献是提出 multi-application coding agent 的问题设定和执行脚手架；它把 coding agent 从单仓库编辑推进到应用组合维护，但对 LLM 基座训练的直接信息有限。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕顺序式 Agent 工作流展开：在生成第 N 个相关应用时维护共享库；针对朴素流程中共享代码召回低、依赖迁移脆弱的问题，使用基于代码块摘要的候选引导抽取、抽取前代码库整合，以及后续依赖迁移与库更新机制。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出任务规模、模型、基线名称或数值结果；其报告重点是相比逐应用生成和简单顺序脚手架，改进流程能更好地抽取共享逻辑、减少重复代码和长期维护中的结构退化。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 KAIST 和 DeepAuto.ai；Sung Ju Hwang 是 KAIST 机器学习方向研究者，长期发表在机器学习、视觉和泛化相关方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a coding agent can sequentially generate and maintain a portfolio of related applications while extracting reusable components into a shared Super Library.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a multi-application coding-agent setting and workflow. It moves beyond single-repository editing, but it is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed workflow maintains a shared library while applications are generated one after another. To fix weak extraction recall and brittle dependency migration in a naive scaffold, it uses candidate-guided extraction from code-chunk summaries, pre-extraction codebase consolidation, and mechanisms for migrating applications to the evolving library.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, task scale, named baselines, or numerical gains. It claims improvements over per-application workflows and minimal sequential scaffolds in shared-code extraction and long-term codebase health.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from KAIST and DeepAuto.ai. Sung Ju Hwang is a KAIST researcher known for machine learning, vision, and generalization-related work.

recommendation.zh: 预训练研究员只需看问题定义和失败模式；它对 Agent 评测有用，但不是能反哺基座训练的强信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the problem setup and failure modes; useful for coding-agent evaluation, but weak as feedback for base-model training.

paper.title: Beyond the Payload: How User Invocation Shapes Coding Agent Vulnerability to Repository Poisoning
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used for software engineering tasks, including bootstrapping projects from third-party repositories whose integrity cannot be assumed. Prior work on repository poisoning largely focuses on attacker-controlled injection and disguise, but developers also shape risk through everyday invocation choices: what task to delegate, how to phrase the request, and which skills or rules to supply. We term these user-side choices Prompt-Level Configurations (PLCs) and introduce

summary.core_problem: 用户在调用 Coding Agent 时的 Prompt 级配置（PLCs，如任务类型、请求措辞、提供的技能/规则）如何影响 Agent 对代码库投毒攻击的脆弱性？
summary.importance: 首次系统性地研究了用户侧的调用方式对 Coding Agent 安全性的影响，并提出了 CIPR Benchmark，揭示了漏洞的高度上下文依赖性。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 CIPR Benchmark，包含 1920 个实例，覆盖 20 个真实代码库、4 种任务类型、3 种 prompt 风格和 3 种技能/规则条件。通过自动化的运行时和基于 trace 的 oracle 测量攻击成功率 (ASR) 和 Agent 警报率 (AR)。
summary.experiments: 评估发现，脆弱性高度依赖于上下文，任务类型会导致高达 34.2% 的 ASR 差异；提供安全规则并不总是能提高安全性，有时反而会因为过度自信或注意力分散而增加脆弱性。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学和清华大学（互联网体系结构全国重点实验室）合作。

summary_en.core_problem: How do user Prompt-Level Configurations (PLCs, e.g., task type, phrasing, supplied skills/rules) when invoking Coding Agents affect their vulnerability to repository poisoning attacks?
summary_en.importance: The first systematic study of how user-side invocation choices impact Coding Agent security, introducing the CIPR Benchmark and revealing the highly context-dependent nature of vulnerabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructed the CIPR Benchmark with 1,920 instances across 20 real-world repositories, 4 task types, 3 prompt styles, and 3 skill/rule conditions. Measured Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Agent Alert Rate (AR) using automated runtime and trace-based oracles.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation reveals that vulnerability is highly context-dependent, with task type causing up to a 34.2% variance in ASR; supplying security rules does not always improve security and can sometimes increase vulnerability due to overconfidence or distraction.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Zhejiang University and Tsinghua University (State Key Laboratory of Internet Architecture).

recommendation.zh: 研究了 Prompt 配置对 Coding Agent 安全性的影响，结论（加安全 prompt 反而可能更脆弱）有一定反常识，但属于 Agent 安全评测范畴，对基座预训练启发有限。
recommendation.en: Studies the impact of prompt configurations on Coding Agent security; the finding that adding security prompts can increase vulnerability is somewhat counterintuitive, but it falls under Agent security evaluation with limited inspiration for foundation pretraining.

institutions: Affiliation:State Key Laboratory of Internet Architecture, Tsinghua University

paper.title: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
paper.abstract: Loop Engineering is emerging as a practice for organizing development work around coding agents. Instead of writing each prompt by hand, practitioners design loops that monitor progress, assign work, run checks, and decide what the agent should do next. Even with a capable coding agent, a loop may trust a stale progress note, skip needed verification, spend its budget in the wrong direction, or stop before the task is safe to submit. Yet the final outcome of one end-to-end run cannot tell whethe

summary.core_problem: 长程软件工程任务里，“写代码的 agent”之外还需要运行时控制器（loop/controller）做预算分配、验证与停机决策；端到端成败无法区分是 controller 还是 worker 的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测资产：把“模型作为运行时控制器”单独拉出来评估，能更干净地测 agentic loop 的决策质量，对 coding-agent/agent 评测与训练信号设计有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: LoopArena：固定一个 Worker（编码 agent），被测模型作为 Controller；每轮 Controller 只看结构化运行摘要（progress/检查结果/状态等）并决定下一步指令或是否停止，从而把“控制策略”与“执行能力”解耦评测。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务数量、worker 选择、对比 controller baseline（规则/LLM）与指标（成功率/成本/回合数/安全提交率等）的细节；但评测设定本身清晰可复用。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-running software engineering, a runtime loop/controller must allocate budget, enforce verification, and decide when to stop; end-to-end outcomes conflate controller quality with the coding agent’s execution ability.
summary_en.importance: Primary contribution is an evaluation asset: it isolates and benchmarks models as runtime controllers, enabling cleaner measurement of loop decision quality—useful for training/evaluating agentic control policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: LoopArena fixes a Worker coding agent and evaluates a Controller model that only sees structured run summaries after each round, then issues next-step instructions or stop decisions, decoupling control from execution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete task counts, worker choice, controller baselines, and metrics (success/cost/rounds/safe-to-submit); the benchmark framing is the main value.

recommendation.zh: 把“controller 决策质量”从“coding agent 能力”里剥离出来这点很干净；只读任务/指标定义与 controller 输入输出协议，够你复刻内部评测。
recommendation.en: The clean decoupling of controller policy from worker capability is the key; read the task/metric definitions and the controller I/O protocol—enough to replicate an internal eval.

paper.title: openJiuwen: Beyond Static Harnesses for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon coding agents operate over evolving repository states while increasingly relying on heterogeneous capabilities, delegated agents, and multi-agent coordination. These trends pose two complementary challenges for the agent harness. First, developers need to compose capabilities, reconfigure execution logic, and scale increasingly complex agent systems without repeatedly rebuilding orchestration. Second, complex coding tasks continuously produce new evidence---such as semantic diagnost

summary.core_problem: 解决长周期 coding agent 在动态仓库状态、多能力组合、子代理委派和多代理协作下难以编排的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 系统工程。它不是评测 harness，而是执行脚手架，重点在结构可组合性和运行时自适应，对构建复杂软件工程 agent 有实用价值，但对预训练研究主要是间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出开源 openJiuwen harness。系统提供共享执行 substrate，并用 Rail-based capability composition 组合单代理、delegated sub-agents 和 Swarm Flow；运行时利用语义诊断、执行结果、任务进度和上下文相关性等新证据调整后续决策。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型、任务数量和效果数字。可预期实验会展示在长周期代码任务中，openJiuwen 相比静态 harness 在组合复杂 agent、动态调整流程和执行效率上的优势。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses orchestration difficulties for long-horizon coding agents operating over evolving repository states with heterogeneous capabilities and multi-agent coordination.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a coding-agent systems framework. It is an execution harness rather than an evaluation harness, with practical value for building complex software-engineering agents and only indirect relevance to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: openJiuwen provides a shared execution substrate and Rail-based capability composition across single agents, delegated sub-agents, and Swarm Flow. It uses runtime evidence such as semantic diagnostics, execution outcomes, task progress, and context relevance to adapt subsequent decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report benchmarks, models, task counts, or numerical results. The expected evaluation would compare against static harnesses on composability, adaptive execution, and long-horizon coding-task performance.

recommendation.zh: 不按 eval 读，按 agent runtime 备查；预训练视角只需关注它如何把 execution feedback 变成控制信号。
recommendation.en: Do not read it as evaluation; keep it as an agent-runtime reference and focus on how execution feedback becomes control signal.

paper.title: Same Model, Different Harness: Different Coding-Agent Results
paper.abstract: A coding agent combines a model with a harness, which decides what the model sees, which tools it can use, and how the work continues. We ask whether changing the harness changes the result when the model and task stay fixed. We compare two configurations of the same harness on three coding benchmarks. The control supplies the full conversation in time order, while the treatment keeps the same record but mechanically shortens older tool results as the context fills and responds to repeated or st

summary.core_problem: 在代码智能体（Coding Agent）中，当模型和任务固定时，改变智能体的运行框架（harness，即决定模型看到什么、能用什么工具以及如何继续工作的机制）是否会改变最终的任务结果？
summary.importance: 通过严格的控制变量实验，证明了智能体框架的设计（特别是上下文管理和异常处理机制）对模型最终表现有显著影响，强调了在评估代码智能体时，框架本身也是一个关键变量。
summary.technical_approach: 对比了同一框架（Yuj）的两种配置：控制组（Control）将完整的对话历史按时间顺序提供给模型，直到上下文窗口填满；实验组（Treatment）采用闭环（closed-loop）策略，在保留完整运行记录的同时，通过机械规则（如半衰期策略）在上下文窗口填满时缩短较旧的工具返回结果，并对重复或停滞的工作模式（如重复执行失败的命令）进行机械响应。
summary.experiments: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 等基准测试中，在有限的上下文窗口（如 20,480 token）下，实验组（Treatment）在所有压力测试中均提高了平均每任务的失败转成功率（F2PF），并增加了完整解决任务的数量。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 'From a growing transcript to a closed loop' 章节，了解实验组（Treatment）中上下文缩短（半衰期策略）和异常检测机制的具体实现。预计阅读时间 10 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In coding agents, does changing the harness (the mechanism that decides what the model sees, which tools it can use, and how work continues) change the final result when the model and task remain fixed?
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates through controlled experiments that the design of the agent harness, particularly context management and exception handling, significantly impacts the model's final performance, highlighting that the harness itself is a critical variable when evaluating coding agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Compares two configurations of the same harness (Yuj): the Control group supplies the full conversation history in chronological order until the context window is full; the Treatment group uses a closed-loop strategy, maintaining a complete run record while mechanically shortening older tool results (e.g., via a half-life policy) as the context window fills, and mechanically responding to repeated or stalled work patterns (e.g., repeatedly executing failed commands).
summary_en.experiments: On benchmarks like SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro, under tight context windows (e.g., 20,480 tokens), the Treatment group increased the mean per-task fail-to-pass fraction (F2PF) across all pressure comparisons and increased the number of completely solved tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the 'From a growing transcript to a closed loop' section to understand the specific implementation of context shortening (half-life policy) and anomaly detection mechanisms in the Treatment group. Estimated reading time: 10 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 非常好的实证分析，证明了 SWE-bench 刷榜中 harness（上下文管理、重试逻辑）的巨大水分，提醒我们在看代码模型评测时必须剥离脚手架的增益。
recommendation.en: Excellent empirical analysis showing how much 'juice' in SWE-bench scores comes from the harness (context management, retry logic) rather than the model, a crucial caveat for evaluating coding models.

paper.title: SWE-Prime: Fewer Trajectories, Better Performance
paper.abstract: To improve large language models' ability to resolve real-world software issues, prior work has focused on constructing large-scale agent trajectory datasets and performing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on successful trajectories. However, task success does not guarantee high-quality supervision: successful trajectories may still contain ineffective, redundant, or risky steps. Directly using such trajectories for SFT can introduce noisy supervision and encourage models to imitate undesirable prob

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是代码 Agent SFT 数据里的一个具体噪声源：只按“任务是否成功”筛选轨迹，会把很多不适合模仿的行为也放进训练。成功轨迹可能包含无效探索、重复定位、工具调用失败、绕过式信息泄漏、以及过大的补丁。模型在 SFT 时会学习这些过程，而不只是学习最终 patch。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不强，但对 post-train 数据质量有参考价值。它把长轨迹监督从 outcome filtering 推到 process filtering，并进一步细化到语义片段级 loss mask。这一点对代码 Agent、工具使用模型、长上下文行为克隆都有启发：高成功率数据不等于高质量监督，训练信号需要按行为单元重新加权或屏蔽。贡献更偏工程化数据筛选方法，不是新的基座训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: SWE-Prime 是两阶段、多粒度的数据选择方法。第一阶段在轨迹级筛选，只从成功轨迹中保留过程质量、结果质量和代表性更好的样本。过程质量由四类日志信号刻画：是否形成 observe-edit-verify 工作流，工具调用是否可靠，是否存在连续冗余操作，是否有 Git hacking 这类利用版本历史泄漏的捷径。结果质量强调 patch 是否最小且充分，避免不必要文件修改带来回归风险。代表性用于避免只保留单一类型任务。第二阶段在语义片段级筛选，不按单步动作判断，而是把若干 action-observation 组成有意图和结果的行为片段，再判断这个片段是否对最终修复有贡献。训练时保留完整轨迹作为上下文，但只让被选中的片段参与 loss。这比直接截断轨迹更稳，因为上下文依赖还在；比全轨迹 SFT 更干净，因为低价值行为不会产生梯度。
summary.experiments: 论文在 SWE-Bench Pro 和 SWE-Bench Verified 上评估，覆盖三个模型。核心结果是：只使用 SWE-Prime 选择的 10% 轨迹进行训练，反而超过使用全部成功轨迹训练的模型。在两个 benchmark 上，相对提升最高分别为 12.2% 和 24.2%。这个结果支持一个重要现象：在长轨迹 SFT 中，数据量增加可能同时增加行为噪声；当成功轨迹内部质量差异很大时，小而干净的数据子集可以优于全量数据。给出的消融重点围绕轨迹级筛选、片段级筛选、以及完整上下文加 loss mask 的设计，说明收益不只来自简单缩小数据规模，而来自更准确地定位可学习行为。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对成功轨迹噪声的分类，Figure 1 对 outcome view、trajectory view、segment view 的区分，以及方法部分 Stage 1/Stage 2 的筛选信号定义。最值得细看的点是“完整轨迹保留为上下文、只对选中片段算 loss”，这对长链路工具数据训练比单纯过滤样本更有迁移意义。实验部分主要看 10% 数据超过全量数据的表格，以及各筛选维度的消融。无需深挖模型结构，因为方法核心在数据质量和 loss mask。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific noise pattern in SFT data for coding agents: selecting trajectories only by task success preserves many behaviors that should not be imitated. A successful trajectory may still contain ineffective exploration, repeated localization, failed tool calls, leakage-driven shortcuts, or overly broad patches. SFT trains on the process, not only on the final patch.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to post-training data quality than to base pretraining. Its useful lesson is that outcome filtering is too coarse for long-horizon agent traces. Supervision should be selected at the level of behaviors, not only at the level of completed tasks. This is applicable to coding agents, tool-use training, and long-context behavioral cloning. The contribution is mainly a practical data-selection recipe rather than a new foundation-model training objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Prime uses a two-stage, multi-granularity selection pipeline. Stage 1 operates at the trajectory level and keeps successful traces that are good in process quality, result quality, and representativeness. Process quality is measured from interaction logs using four signals: whether the trace follows an observe-edit-verify workflow, whether tool calls are reliable, whether there is continuous redundancy, and whether the trace uses Git-history leakage or similar shortcuts. Result quality favors minimal and sufficient patches. Representativeness prevents the selected set from collapsing to a narrow task type. Stage 2 operates at the semantic-segment level. Instead of judging isolated tool steps, it groups action-observation spans into behaviorally coherent segments and selects the segments that actually contribute to the final fix. During SFT, the full trajectory is kept as context, but only selected segments contribute to the loss. This avoids losing context while preventing low-value behavior from producing gradients.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses SWE-Bench Pro and SWE-Bench Verified across three models. The main empirical finding is that training on only the 10% subset selected by SWE-Prime outperforms training on all successful trajectories. The reported maximum relative gains are 12.2% on SWE-Bench Pro and 24.2% on SWE-Bench Verified. The result supports a practical point: for long-horizon SFT, more successful traces can still mean more process noise. A smaller but cleaner set may be a better learning signal. The ablations focus on trajectory-level filtering, segment-level filtering, and the design choice of preserving full context while masking the loss on unselected segments.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Read the Introduction for the taxonomy of noise inside successful traces, especially the separation between outcome view, trajectory view, and segment view. Then focus on the Stage 1 and Stage 2 definitions in the method section. The most transferable idea is the full-context plus selected-segment loss masking scheme. In the experiments, look for the tables where the 10% selected subset beats full-data SFT and for the ablations of the filtering dimensions. The model architecture details are not central.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 Agent 成功轨迹中包含大量噪声（冗余/试错步骤），提出了轨迹级+片段级的清洗策略，对构建高质量 Agent SFT 数据非常有启发，建议阅读方法部分。
recommendation.en: Points out that successful Agent trajectories contain significant noise (redundant/trial-and-error steps) and proposes a trajectory+segment level cleaning strategy; highly inspiring for building high-quality Agent SFT data, read the method section.

paper.title: Agents Don't Paginate: First-Chunk Selection for LLM Tool Responses
paper.abstract: Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs), such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Aider, receive tool responses that routinely exceed the agent's per-turn token budget. The standard remedy, pagination, is available in every protocol that produced these responses; yet across the corpus of session logs from a public Model Context Protocol middleware we observed no agent-initiated requests for a second chunk. The first chunk is what the agent reads, so we ask how o

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 coding agent 的工具返回结果过长时，应该如何选择第一块内容。作者的核心观察是：虽然工具协议通常支持分页，但真实日志中 agent 几乎不会主动请求第二页；因此问题不是“如何分页”，而是“如何把接下来会用到的条目放进第一块，最好排在最前面”。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对大模型系统和 agent 评测有直接启发。它提醒一个常被低估的瓶颈：上下文长度增加并不自动解决工具使用问题，工具响应的排序和压缩策略会影响 agent 能看到什么。对基座研究员来说，价值在于理解长上下文与工具交互之间的接口问题。模型如果只读第一块，训练和评测时就不能默认分页协议会被有效使用。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把工具响应压缩形式化为 0/1 knapsack。每个候选条目有 token 成本和一个由 value function 给出的价值分数，在预算 B 内选择条目。实际求解使用按价值密度排序的贪心算法，复杂度为 O(N log N)，并引用该策略对 0/1 knapsack 的 1/2 近似保证。评价指标是 p1，即 gold item 是否成为第一块中的 top-ranked item。作者比较六类 value function，包括生产环境的 FIFO 基线、参数免费的 keyword ranker，以及加入文件元数据的变体。方法上的重点不是复杂模型，而是把 agent 工具响应从“截断或分页”改写成“预算内选择和排序”。
summary.experiments: 生产日志显示，37% 的 get_epics 和 28% 的 get_merge_request_diffs 调用会超过 8K token 预算；在观测到的会话中，agent 主动请求第二块的比例为 0。结构化分析使用同一日志中抽取的 4,175 个 Bash 文件搜索 gold-selection 事件。离线基准使用 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务；候选数量分布为 57.6% 的任务不超过 5 个候选，31.4% 接近 50 个候选上限，11.0% 位于中间区间。FIFO 基线的 p1 约为 24.2%。作者还在 100 个任务上用 5 个模型做下游 probe。主要结果是：提升 p1 并没有稳定传导到最终任务准确率，因为真正限制下游表现的是 gold item 是否进入第一块，而不一定是它在第一块内的第一名；参数免费的 keyword ranker 可以提高 p1，但加入四类文件元数据信号后反而损害效果。另有两个独立生产语料复现了零分页行为和 keyword dominance。作者提到流水线可在一台 24GB GPU 工作站复现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。优先看 Section 2 的生产日志设定和零分页证据，Section 3 的 knapsack 建模，Section 4–6 的 p1 扫描与下游 probe。Appendix J/K/H 分别对应外部语料复现、证据来源和候选数量分布，适合检查实验可信度。需要重点留意一个负结果：优化 top-1 排序并不等价于提升 agent 成功率；更实用的目标可能是提高预算内 gold inclusion，而不是只追求 p1。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how a coding agent should handle oversized tool responses. Its central observation is empirical: although pagination is available, agents in the observed logs do not request the second chunk. This turns the problem from pagination into first-chunk selection—placing the item the agent will need next into the visible response, ideally near the top.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to LLM systems and agent evaluation. It shows that longer context is not the only bottleneck in tool-using agents. The ordering and compression of tool outputs determine what the model actually sees. For foundation-model researchers, the useful lesson is about the interface between model behavior, context budgets, and tool protocols: one should not assume that an available pagination mechanism will be used by the agent.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate first-chunk construction as a 0/1 knapsack problem. Each candidate item has a token cost and a value assigned by a scoring function; the compressor selects items under a response budget. They use a greedy value-density algorithm with O(N log N) complexity and a standard 1/2 approximation guarantee for 0/1 knapsack. The headline metric is p1, the probability that the gold item is ranked first in the compressed chunk. Six value functions are compared, including the production FIFO baseline, a parameter-free keyword ranker, and variants that add file metadata. The contribution is mainly the reframing of tool-response handling from truncation or pagination to budgeted selection and ranking.
summary_en.experiments: The production telemetry shows that 37% of get_epics calls and 28% of get_merge_request_diffs calls exceed an 8K-token budget, while the observed rate of agent-initiated second-chunk requests is zero. The structured analysis uses 4,175 Bash file-search gold-selection events extracted from the logs. The offline study runs on 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks. Candidate lists are bimodal: 57.6% of tasks have at most 5 candidates, 31.4% are near the 50-candidate cap, and 11.0% fall in between. The FIFO baseline places the gold file at rank one in about 24.2% of tasks. A downstream probe is run on 100 tasks across five language models. The main negative result is that improving p1 does not reliably improve downstream accuracy, because the binding condition is whether the gold item reaches the first chunk at all, not whether it is ranked first inside that chunk. A parameter-free keyword ranker improves p1 over FIFO, but adding four file-metadata signals reverses the gain. The zero-pagination behavior and keyword dominance are replicated on two independent production corpora. The released pipeline is reported to reproduce on a single workstation with a 24GB GPU.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Read the production setting and pagination evidence first, then the knapsack formulation, followed by the p1 sweep and downstream probe. Appendices J, K, and H are useful for checking replication evidence, source attribution, and candidate-list distributions. The most important point is the negative result: optimizing top-1 placement is not the same as improving agent success. For deployment, gold inclusion under budget may be a better objective than p1 alone.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看负结果：它直接动摇“把关键信息塞进首块就行”的工程直觉；先看实验设定和 preregistered hypothesis，别急着照搬到端到端 agent。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the negative result: it challenges the engineering intuition that putting the gold item in chunk one is enough; read the setup and preregistered hypotheses before extrapolating to full agents.

paper.title: Zero-Shot Self-Orchestration with Ledger-Based Control for Improved LLM Coding Performance
paper.abstract: Multi-agent large language model systems are widely reported to beat single-model baselines, but the evidence is mixed, and comparisons are usually confounded: pipelines change token budgets, tool calls, and prompts simultaneously, so an aggregate gain rarely reveals what actually helped. We investigate the effect of introducing the manager-worker scaffold over a shared filesystem workspace, with no training and no per-benchmark tuning, measured against the same model answering in a single pass.

summary.core_problem: 检验 manager-worker 多智能体脚手架在代码题上是否真的带来收益，而不是由 token 预算、工具调用或 prompt 改动造成的混杂提升。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是方法分析和实验控制。它把多智能体代码系统拆到一个较干净的变量：共享文件系统工作区上的 manager-worker 编排，并和同一模型的单轮回答对比。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 zero-shot self-orchestration 设置，不做训练、不做 benchmark 专门调参；多个模型共享同一套 ledger-based control 和文件系统工作区，由管理者分配、记录和协调子任务，再汇总代码解答。
summary.experiments: 在 100 道最新 hard LiveCodeBench 题上评估 9 个模型，包括 5 个开源权重模型，规模从 9B 到约 2.8T，以及 4 个闭源前沿模型。结果显示收益有条件：Qwen3.8-27B 提升 23.4，GPT-5.6-Luna 提升 10.6，GPT-5.6-Terra 提升 8.0；Kimi-K3 和 Minimax-M3 在 reasoning off 下分别提升 30.4 和 11.0，部分设置 p < 1e-4，但也存在无收益模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a manager-worker multi-agent scaffold actually improves coding performance, rather than benefiting from confounded changes in token budget, tools, or prompts.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is controlled analysis. It isolates one intervention: adding a manager-worker orchestration layer over a shared filesystem workspace, compared against the same model answering in a single pass.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed setup uses zero-shot self-orchestration with ledger-based control, no training, and no per-benchmark tuning. A manager coordinates worker-style subtasks through a shared workspace and aggregates the final solution.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates nine models on the 100 latest hard LiveCodeBench problems: five open-weight models from 9B to roughly 2.8T parameters and four closed frontier models. Reported gains are conditional: +23.4 for Qwen3.8-27B, +10.6 for GPT-5.6-Luna, +8.0 for GPT-5.6-Terra, and under reasoning-off settings +30.4 for Kimi-K3 and +11.0 for Minimax-M3, with several paired-pass results at p < 1e-4; some models show null gains.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体代码收益的结论比较克制；看实验控制方式即可，别把 scaffold 当成通用 scaling 规律。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance for the controlled setup; do not read the scaffold gains as a general agent-scaling law.

paper.title: SPECMINE: A Large-Scale Corpus of Spec-Driven Development Artifacts
paper.abstract: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) is a fast-emerging practice in which a structured natural-language specification, written by a developer, or (more often) drafted by an AI tool and then curated by the developer, drives an AI coding agent's implementation. A wave of tooling (GitHub Spec Kit [3], OpenSpec [4], AWS Kiro [5], and dozens of others) has appeared since 2025, yet the artifacts these tools produce have never been studied at scale. We present SPECMINE, a corpus that captures SDD in public Gi

summary.core_problem: 缺乏对规范驱动开发（Spec-Driven Development, SDD）产生的大规模工件的系统性研究和数据集。
summary.importance: 数据贡献。首次发布了大规模的 SDD 工件语料库 SPECMINE，为研究 AI 辅助编程中的规范到代码的转化过程提供了基础数据，对构建和评估 Coding Agent 有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 通过两次普查收集 GitHub 上的公开仓库数据：广泛普查覆盖了 17 种工具生成的 spec.md 文件；Kiro 普查专注于特定布局的文件。对收集到的规范文件进行了元数据丰富、提交历史提取和文档结构解析。
summary.experiments: 收集了超过 47 万个 spec 文件（广泛普查）和近 10 万个 Kiro 格式文件，并对 11 种工具的 Pull Request 进行了追踪。
summary.authors_note: Bogdan Vasilescu 团队在软件工程和开源社区挖掘方面有丰富经验。

summary_en.core_problem: Lack of systematic study and datasets for large-scale artifacts produced by Spec-Driven Development (SDD).
summary_en.importance: Data contribution. Releases SPECMINE, the first large-scale corpus of SDD artifacts, providing foundational data for studying the spec-to-code translation process in AI-assisted programming, valuable for building and evaluating Coding Agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Collected data from public GitHub repositories via two censuses: a broad census covering spec.md files generated by 17 tools, and a Kiro census focusing on specifically laid-out files. Enriched the collected spec files with metadata, commit history, and parsed document structure.
summary_en.experiments: Collected over 470K spec files (broad census) and nearly 100K Kiro-formatted files, tracking Pull Requests for 11 tools.
summary_en.authors_note: Bogdan Vasilescu's team has extensive experience in software engineering and open-source community mining.

recommendation.zh: 构建了一个大规模的规范驱动开发（SDD）数据集，对于做 Coding Agent 预训练或 SFT 数据合成的团队有参考价值，可作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Constructs a large-scale dataset for Spec-Driven Development (SDD), valuable as a reference for teams working on Coding Agent pretraining or SFT data synthesis.

paper.title: FuzzingBrain-Bench V1: Evaluating Open-Ended Bug Discovery by LLMs
paper.abstract: Evaluating the ability of large language models (LLMs) to discover software bugs is increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate this capability by asking the model to generate a proof-of-concept input that triggers a predefined target vulnerability. However, this setup may overlook valid crashes discovered by the model when they do not match the predefined target. As a result, the evaluation may not reflect the model's real capability.   We present FuzzingBrain-Bench, a benchm

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 在开放式软件漏洞发现中的真实能力，而不是只看是否触发预定义目标漏洞。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding / security agent benchmark；它指出传统 PoC-to-target 评测会漏掉模型发现的其他有效 crash，因此分数可能低估或误刻画模型的 fuzzing 能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FuzzingBrain-Bench：给模型一个开源项目和 sanitizer-instrumented harness，并封装在自包含 Docker 镜像中；模型目标是在 harness 下生成输入，触发尽可能多的 distinct crashes；按 distinct crash signatures 数量计分，并用上限和难度系数加权。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明 benchmark 面向开源软件 bug discovery，但未给出挑战数量、评测模型列表、基线表现或具体分数；核心信息是开放式 crash discovery 的任务设计和 scoring scheme。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates LLMs on open-ended software bug discovery rather than on generating inputs for predefined target vulnerabilities.
summary_en.importance: It is a coding/security agent benchmark contribution. The key point is that target-vulnerability benchmarks can miss valid crashes found by models and therefore misrepresent real bug-discovery capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: FuzzingBrain-Bench gives a model an open-source project and a sanitizer-instrumented harness inside a self-contained Docker image. The model generates inputs to trigger as many distinct crashes as possible, scored by distinct crash signatures with caps and difficulty weighting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes the benchmark design but does not report the number of challenges, evaluated models, baselines, or numerical results.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent eval 备查即可；开放式 crash 计分比定点 PoC 更干净，但和基座预训练距离较远。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a coding-agent evaluation reference; open-ended crash scoring is cleaner than target PoC matching, but it is far from base pretraining.

paper.title: Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain
paper.abstract: World models aim to simulate how complex environments evolve under actions and events, yet existing video-based world models primarily learn dynamics from visual observations, which reveal outcomes rather than the underlying knowledge, rules, and mechanisms governing world evolution. This makes it difficult to maintain persistent consequences and support coherent, open-ended evolution. We introduce Code World Model, a framework that separates world evolution from visual realization by combining

summary.core_problem: 视频 world model 只从像素学习动态，难以表示规则、持久状态和长期后果；作者尝试用 coding agent 维护显式世界状态，再交给视频模型渲染。
summary.importance: 贡献属于多模态生成与 world model 架构设计：把“世界演化”与“视觉实现”解耦。对做统一建模或 agent+generator 结合的人有启发，但离 LLM 基座预训练主线较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Code World Model：让 coding agent 作为 world brain，基于事件与规则生成可执行代码，维护 persistent world state 并驱动规则一致的演化；再设计 proxy representation，把逐帧时空约束编译成 proxy video，作为条件输入给视频生成模型完成视觉呈现。核心思想是用程序状态承载因果与长期一致性，用生成模型负责外观细节。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据和量化结果，只描述框架层面的能力目标：支持 persistent consequences、coherent open-ended evolution。缺少足够实验细节来判断其结论是否稳固。
summary.authors_note: Westlake University AGI Lab 与南洋理工合作，方向接近 world model、代码代理和视频生成结合。

summary_en.core_problem: Video world models learn dynamics from pixels, which makes it hard to represent rules, persistent state, and long-term consequences; this paper uses a coding agent to maintain explicit world state and lets a video model render it.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in multimodal generation and world-model architecture: decoupling world evolution from visual realization. It may interest researchers working on unified modeling or agent-plus-generator systems, but it is not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Code World Model uses a coding agent as the world brain. The agent reasons about events and rules, generates executable code, and maintains persistent world state for rule-consistent evolution. A proxy representation then encodes frame-wise spatiotemporal constraints and is compiled into a proxy video that conditions a video generation model. The key idea is to let program state carry causality and persistence while the generator handles appearance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or quantitative results. It mainly states capability goals such as persistent consequences and coherent open-ended evolution. There is not enough experimental detail to judge how solid the claims are.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between Westlake University AGI Lab and Nanyang Technological University, at the intersection of world models, coding agents, and video generation.

recommendation.zh: 想法比证据更强，先别把它当 world model 新范式；若你做统一生成，只记住“程序状态负责因果，视频模型负责外观”这个分工。
recommendation.en: The idea is stronger than the evidence, so do not treat it as a new world-model prior yet; keep the division of labor in mind: program state for causality, video model for appearance.

paper.title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Self-evolving LLM coding agents write their own tools by imitating retrieved skills from shared skill libraries. We identify a vulnerability in this loop: during authoring, a retrieved malicious skill can become the template for a new skill that preserves the payload. We call this self-poisoning: the agent authors, stores, and runs the resulting malicious skill. We exploit it through EvoMal, an attack that amplifies self-poisoning by wrapping an interchangeable payload in a banner, a set of beni

summary.core_problem: 自进化 coding agent 会从共享 skill library 检索并模仿技能写新工具，这一闭环可能被恶意技能诱导产生自我投毒。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding agent 安全中的新攻击面：恶意技能即使不被直接调用，也能作为模板被模仿、复制、入库并继续传播；对训练 agentic coding model 和构建工具库治理有实际警示。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EvoMal 攻击，把可替换 payload 包在一组看似无害的结构元素 banner 中，使 agent 在 authoring 新 skill 时复现其中代码。论文定义 Agent Self-Poisoning Rate，衡量任务中新增恶意 skill 的比例。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、任务集和成功率数值；声称攻击者只需向 skill library 植入恶意技能，无需触发执行，随后 agent 会创作并运行带 payload 的新技能，且副本可重新进入库形成持久传播。

summary_en.core_problem: Self-evolving coding agents retrieve and imitate skills from shared libraries to write new tools, creating a loop that can be exploited for self-poisoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a new attack surface for coding agents: a malicious skill can be copied as a template even when it is not directly invoked, then stored, executed, and propagated. This matters for training agentic coding models and governing shared tool libraries.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoMal wraps an interchangeable payload inside a benign-looking structural banner that induces the agent to reproduce the enclosed code when authoring new skills. The paper defines Agent Self-Poisoning Rate as the fraction of tasks that add newly authored malicious skills.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide exact models, task sets, or attack success rates. It claims the attacker only needs to plant malicious skills in the library; the agent can then author and execute new payload-carrying skills, and copies can re-enter the library to persist after the original planted skills are removed.

recommendation.zh: 读威胁模型和 ASPR 定义即可；它不是 pretrain 论文，但会影响 coding agent 数据闭环设计。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model and ASPR definition; not a pretraining paper, but it matters for coding-agent data-loop design.

paper.title: Praxist: From Experimental Artifacts to Solution Lineages
paper.abstract: Autonomous R\&D agents now write, run, and improve executable artifacts under automated evaluation---but largely as laboratory instruments: shown on curated benchmarks, with gains that are hard to trace to a cause and costs well above what sustained engineering practice absorbs. The limitation is structural. Most systems treat each attempt as nearly self-contained, so logs, memories, and search trees record what happened without establishing which design element produced an improvement, whether

summary.core_problem: Praxist 解决的是长周期 autonomous R&D 系统如何继承实验经验的问题。它认为只保存候选 artifact、分数或搜索树不够，因为一次尝试中的局部机制、失败诊断、验证条件，可能要在后续组合中才显出价值。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练目标或数据配比，而在“自动化研究系统”的状态管理。若把 MLE 调参、数据过滤、训练 recipe 搜索、消融实验看成长期实验 campaign，Praxist 提供了一种比单纯 best-of-N 或树搜索更结构化的经验继承方式。启发点是：实验结果需要被转写成可复用、可验证、带角色的证据，而不是只进入日志或排行榜。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 artifact-to-lineage 流程。每一代从已有 frontier、agenda、Gems 和 lineage trace 开始，生成一批 design contracts。contract 在实验前固定机制、干预面、研究意图、父 lineage、证据签名和验证 hook。随后多个 peer 并行构造可复现实验 artifact，外部 evaluator 打分，再把结果解释成 typed findings。finding 不直接进入下一轮，而是被提升到不同 frontier lanes，例如 confirmed、candidate、diagnostic、validation。Chair 角色读取 panel memos 和 frontier，生成下一代 agenda，决定 continue、stop、validate、explore。Gems 用来压缩跨代稳定经验。它和传统 solution tree 的区别是：继承对象不是完整 artifact 或标量分数，而是带验证状态和操作角色的证据单元。
summary.experiments: 主要实验覆盖 75 个 MLE-bench 任务。Praxist 获得 60 枚 medal，占 80.0%，其中 49 个 gold；对照的本地 Claude Code on Opus 4.8 获得 55 枚 medal，占 73.3%，其中 34 个 gold。开放式案例包括量化交易、LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM、tokamak magnetic control 和 rocket landing。结果显示它在两个领域提升任务原生 headline metric；tokamak 控制中 survival 更好但 full-horizon precision 不占优；rocket landing 中在精度不变的情况下降低视觉计算成本。论文还强调 lineage 记录可展示机制发现、验证、重组和边界测试过程。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。建议先看 Figure 1 和 Algorithm 1，理解一代内部如何从 design contract 走到 findings、frontier、agenda。再看 frontier lanes、Gems、Quantified Diversity 的定义，这些是和普通 agent memory 最大的区别。实验部分重点看 MLE-bench 与 Claude Code baseline 的对比，以及四个开放案例中 lineage 是否真的帮助定位有效机制。若关心自动化预训练实验平台，可重点借鉴 schema 设计，而不是照搬多角色叙事。

summary_en.core_problem: Praxist addresses how long-running autonomous R&D systems should inherit evidence from prior attempts. The paper argues that keeping only scored artifacts or a search tree loses reusable mechanisms, diagnostics, and validation conditions whose value may appear only after later recombination.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining research is indirect but practical. Large-scale recipe search, data filtering campaigns, training stability investigations, and ablation sweeps all produce many partially useful outcomes. Praxist offers a structured way to turn those outcomes into typed, reusable evidence instead of leaving them as logs, scalar scores, or isolated experiment folders.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system runs a generational artifact-to-lineage loop. Each generation starts from a frontier, an agenda, durable Gems, and an accumulated lineage trace. It creates design contracts that specify the mechanism, intervention surface, research intent, parent lineage, evidence signature, and validation hook before artifacts are built. A cohort of peers then constructs reproducible artifacts, an evaluator scores them, and the outcomes are interpreted into typed findings. Findings are promoted into frontier lanes such as confirmed, candidate, diagnostic, and validation. A Chair synthesizes panel memos and the frontier into the next agenda, assigning actions such as continue, stop, validate, or explore. The main difference from solution-tree or ranked-artifact systems is that the inherited unit is not a raw artifact or a scalar score, but evidence with an explicit operational role and validation status.
summary_en.experiments: The main benchmark is the full 75-task MLE-bench suite. Praxist obtains 60 medals, or 80.0%, including 49 gold medals. The local Claude Code baseline on Opus 4.8 obtains 55 medals, or 73.3%, including 34 gold medals. The paper also reports four open-ended case studies: quantitative trading, LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM, tokamak magnetic control, and rocket landing. Praxist improves the headline task-native metric in two domains, improves survival but not full-horizon precision in tokamak control, and reduces visual compute cost at unchanged accuracy in rocket landing. The accompanying lineages are used to document mechanism discovery, validation, recombination, and boundary testing.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough for most pretraining researchers; allocate around 20–30 minutes. Focus on Figure 1 and Algorithm 1 to understand the generational loop. Then read the definitions of design contracts, frontier lanes, Gems, and Quantified Diversity. The useful part is the evidence schema and inheritance discipline, not the multi-agent framing by itself. For automated pretraining experimentation, the main question to ask is whether training runs, data interventions, and optimizer changes can be represented as typed findings with validation hooks.

recommendation.zh: 读系统设计和失败案例即可；若 evidence graph 真能做归因，适合迁移到内部自动 ablation 平台。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and failure cases; if the evidence graph supports attribution, it is worth adapting for internal ablation automation.

paper.title: Can your AI agent be cheaper? Investigating the effects of task specifications on token spend in agentic coding tasks
paper.abstract: Agentic coding workflows are now widely deployed in real-world systems. With long-horizon reasoning and tool use, token usage has become an important consideration for both cost and efficiency. Two engineers using AI will solve the same problem differently. How the specification of a task shapes an agent's token spend, and whether that spend can be predicted in advance, are open questions. Here, we study the effects of different task specifications on agentic token spend with the Kimi K3 model a

summary.core_problem: 研究 coding agent 的任务规格写法如何影响 token 消耗，以及能否在执行前预测成本分布。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 成本分析。它关注 long-horizon coding agent 的推理预算和 prompt 规格，而不是模型训练方法；对 serving 成本估算有参考价值，但对基座预训练启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Kimi K3 上改变任务规格粒度和 thinking effort，统计 token spend。进一步用一个 cheap probe 为未知任务估计不同规格和 thinking effort 组合下的 token 消耗分布。
summary.experiments: 共 2700 次运行。把完整任务规格缩减为 bare user story 会使 token 消耗增加 29.7%；不同 prompt 不改变 run-to-run variance；任务间 prompt-sensitivity 差异很大，从 13% 到 115%。一个简单预测器可用单次便宜 probe 在未知任务上预测配置分布，误差在 36% 以内，并优于文中比较的先验方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Study how task specifications affect token spending in coding agents and whether the cost distribution can be predicted before full execution.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-cost analysis rather than a training-method paper. It is useful for reasoning about long-horizon coding-agent budgets and prompt specification, but it has limited direct impact on foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study varies task-specification detail and thinking effort using the Kimi K3 model, then measures token spend. It also fits a simple predictor that uses one cheap probe on an unseen task to estimate token-cost distributions across specification and effort settings.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports 2,700 runs. Reducing a full task specification to a bare user story increases token spend by 29.7%; prompt changes do not affect run-to-run variance; prompt sensitivity is task-dependent, ranging from 13% to 115%. A simple predictor estimates unseen-task configuration distributions within 36% error and improves over the referenced prior baseline.

recommendation.zh: 成本结论可做 agent serving 备忘；单模型 Kimi K3 的 setup 太窄，不宜外推到训练策略。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-serving cost note; the single-model Kimi K3 setup is too narrow to extrapolate to training decisions.

paper.title: A Few Pages of Markdown: Committed AI Configuration and Lower Quality Cost after Coding-Agent Adoption
paper.abstract: Coding agents increase development velocity but also technical debt. Prior work reports only average effects across adopters, hiding wide differences between teams. We introduce RAMP (Repository AI Maturity Profile), a four-level cumulative maturity model grounded in version-controlled artifacts that teams commit to configure AI tools. RAMP runs from behavioral rules and coding standards through named agent definitions to multi-agent orchestration, with observed practice concentrated in the firs

summary.core_problem: 如何量化和评估不同团队在采用 AI 编程助手（Coding Agents）时的成熟度差异及其对开发速度和代码质量的影响？
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于版本控制工件的 AI 成熟度模型（RAMP），揭示了 AI 助手采用过程中的异质性影响，对理解 Coding Agent 在实际工程中的落地效果有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 RAMP 模型，将 AI 工具配置工件分为四个累积的成熟度级别。通过分析 441 个仓库的提交历史，评估不同成熟度级别下采用 AI 助手对提交频率（速度）和代码质量（技术债务）的影响。
summary.experiments: 在 441 个仓库上验证了 RAMP 模型的累积性，发现 AI 助手普遍提高了开发速度（提交增加 28-38%），但在高成熟度（Agent-first）仓库中，代码质量成本显著降低。
summary.authors_note: Sanmi Koyejo 团队，涉及斯坦福大学和卡内基梅隆大学的研究人员。

summary_en.core_problem: How to quantify and evaluate the differences in maturity among teams adopting AI coding agents and their impact on development velocity and code quality?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an AI maturity model (RAMP) based on version-controlled artifacts, revealing the heterogeneous effects of AI agent adoption, providing insights into the practical deployment of Coding Agents in software engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the RAMP model, categorizing AI tool configuration artifacts into four cumulative maturity levels. Analyzes commit histories of 441 repositories to evaluate the impact of AI agent adoption on commit frequency (velocity) and code quality (technical debt) across different maturity levels.
summary_en.experiments: Validated the cumulative nature of the RAMP model on 441 repositories, finding that AI agents generally increase development velocity (28-38% more commits), but quality costs diverge, with significantly lower costs in high-maturity (Agent-first) repositories.
summary_en.authors_note: Sanmi Koyejo's team, involving researchers from Stanford University and Carnegie Mellon University.

recommendation.zh: 偏软件工程实证研究，分析了 Coding Agent 落地时的配置成熟度与代码质量的关系，对基座模型研发无直接帮助，作为背景知识了解即可。
recommendation.en: An empirical software engineering study analyzing the relationship between Coding Agent configuration maturity and code quality; no direct help for foundation model development, useful only as background knowledge.

paper.title: Beyond Scaling: Self-Evolving LLM Agents for Hardware Kernel Optimization via an Experience-Driven Workflow and Experience Graph Memory
paper.abstract: Hardware kernel optimization requires repeated compilation, correctness testing, profiling, and revision. LLM agents can automate parts of this process, and stronger foundation models, longer context windows, and longer execution horizons have improved optimization within individual tasks. These advances alone do not enable an agent to learn from completed optimization runs. Existing kernel-optimization agents seldom preserve a decision, its observed execution feedback, and the later decisions t

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 代码优化代理在硬件 kernel 优化中无法跨任务积累经验的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 记忆与工作流设计。它关注的不是单次 kernel 生成能力，而是如何把编译、正确性测试、profiling 反馈沉淀为可检索经验，适合观察长周期 coding agent 的记忆机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 KOPE 框架，用 Experience Graph Memory 记录优化轨迹、决策顺序、执行反馈和后续依赖关系；再用 Active Context Management and Injection 在固定 token budget 下检索相关经验，避免把全部历史塞进上下文。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、kernel benchmark、baseline 和提升幅度。可确认实验围绕硬件 kernel 优化闭环，包含编译、正确性测试和性能 profiling 反馈。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the inability of LLM-based kernel-optimization agents to retain and reuse experience across completed optimization runs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory and workflow design rather than a stronger code model. It is relevant as a case study for long-horizon coding agents that must preserve execution feedback under a fixed context budget.
summary_en.technical_approach: KOPE records optimization trajectories in an Experience Graph Memory, including decisions, observed correctness and performance feedback, ordering, and later dependencies. Active Context Management and Injection then retrieves relevant experience without dumping all prior trajectories into the prompt.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, benchmark details, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears to be built around iterative hardware kernel optimization with compilation, correctness checks, and profiling feedback.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding agent 记忆设计备查即可；真正有用的是图式经验压缩，别把 kernel 任务结果外推到通用 agent。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for coding-agent memory design; the graph-based experience compression is the part to inspect, not the task-specific kernel scores.

paper.title: Paritok-4B: Intent-Conditioned Context Compression for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents re-send large file reads and tool outputs to a frontier LLM every turn, and this context dominates their token bill. General-purpose prompt compressors are trained on prose and suit code poorly: they paraphrase identifiers and drop the exact spans an agent needs to edit. We present Paritok-4B, a 4B LoRA compressor for coding-agent trajectories built on two commitments. It is extractive: it selects spans rather than rewriting them, and 96.0% of the identifiers, paths, and numbers it

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 coding agent 的一个很具体但很实际的问题：多轮交互里，真正烧 token 的往往不是模型生成，而是每一轮都要重发的大段上下文，包括文件读取、命令输出、traceback、历史编辑记录。通用 prompt compressor 在 prose 上还能工作，但放到代码场景会犯两个致命错误：一是改写标识符、路径、报错字符串，导致后续精确编辑失效；二是不理解当前 agent 的即时意图，保留了“看起来重要”的内容，却删掉了这一步真正要改的函数或报错位置。作者把问题重新定义成 intent-conditioned、segment-wise、尽量 extractive 的压缩，而不是自由摘要。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献不大，它更接近面向 coding agent 的小模型蒸馏与推理侧压缩系统。但有两个点对预训练研究仍有参考价值。第一，代码场景里的压缩目标和自然语言摘要目标并不一致，extractive bias 比 abstractive fluency 更重要，这对代码 tokenizer、代码建模目标、以及 agent memory 压缩训练信号设计都有启发。第二，作者把“压缩是否可用”落到了可审计的 copy fidelity、must-keep retention 和端到端 solve rate，而不是只看 ROUGE 一类表面指标，这种评估思路比很多压缩工作更扎实。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三个关键设计。其一是 extractive compression：模型不是重写代码和工具输出，而是从输入段落中选择要保留的 span，并配合一组固定的结构标记表示删除区域。这样做的目的很明确，不是追求语言自然，而是尽量保证 identifier、path、number、error string 这类 downstream edit 依赖的精确字符串不被改坏。文中对这一点做了审计，训练语料上 96.0% 的 identifier/path/number 来自输入拷贝，held-out SWE-bench Lite 上是 96.2%；如果排除作者刻意允许改写的一类对象，这个比例到 98.3%。

其二是 intent conditioning。每次压缩不是只看 segment 本身，而是同时输入当前任务 query，让模型优先保留 query 中点名的实体、文件、函数、报错线索。作者强调“什么重要”不是静态属性，而是相对当前 agent 目标定义的，这也是它和通用压缩器的主要区别。

其三是 pipeline 设计。系统先做 segmentation、kind classification 和 level labeling，再按 segment 单独压缩。压缩模型只看到 task + 单个 segment + kind/level tag，不直接接收数值 token budget；预算通过 system prompt 中的 level-to-ratio 表间接传达。作者原本设计了四级重要性标签 L0-L3，并希望不同 level 对应不同压缩率，但实验发现蒸馏后的 student 实际只学出了两个有效压缩带宽，四级设计没有按预期落地。这个负结果作者没有回避，反而是全文里比较有价值的部分。

数据方面，作者从 67,074 条 OpenHands 轨迹出发，经过五阶段流水线，构建出 45K segment distillation pool 和 40,606 条 teacher-validated compression examples，带有 intent-conditioned target、level label 和 must-keep annotation。训练上比较了三个匹配 backbone，最后选 4B；还尝试过对 drop supervision 加权，但结果适得其反，最终部署版本没有采用。更有意思的是，最终上线 checkpoint 不是训练 loss 最优，而是通过 OOD sweep 选出来的，说明这个任务里 loss 和真实可用性并不严格一致。
summary.experiments:
实验分成 intrinsic 和 end-to-end 两层。intrinsic 部分主要看 OOD holdout 上的压缩质量、must-keep 保留、identifier retention，并给出置信区间。一个值得注意的结果是，在相近预算下，student 在 must-keep identifier retention 上并不低于自己的 teacher，这说明蒸馏目标至少在“保留关键字符串”这个维度没有明显塌陷。

端到端部分把 Paritok-4B 接到 coding agent 流程里，在 raw-source 和 in-distribution line-numbered 两种设置下评估。核心结果是它做到 25.7% compression rate，也就是只保留约四分之一上下文，压缩强度大约是强 GPT compressor 的两倍，同时单次求解质量基本可比。作者原本预期更激进压缩会带来同质量下更难的 trade-off，但实际测到的是略微更软的压缩换来更高质量，而且在 300 个实例规模上没有分辨出成对退化。这说明代码场景里，面向意图的 extractive 选择可能比更“聪明”的自由重写更稳。

不过也要看到边界：这不是通用上下文压缩结论，而是建立在 coding-agent trajectory、特定分段方式、以及 teacher 生成 target 的前提上。四级 level 退化成两级，也说明预算控制能力还比较粗。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Task Formulation，抓住作者到底把问题改写成了什么：不是摘要，而是面向 agent 编辑可用性的 extractive selection。然后看数据流水线和训练 recipe，尤其是作者明确写出的几个 dead ends：四级 importance 没学出来、drop-supervision weighting 失败、loss 最优 checkpoint 没被部署。这几处比单纯看结果更有信息量。

实验部分建议重点看 intrinsic evaluation 里关于 must-keep retention、identifier audit、OOD holdout 的表格，再看 end-to-end evaluation 里 compression rate 与 solve quality 的关系。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。如果只想抓结论，优先看 6.1、6.2 和相关图表；如果想判断能否迁移到别的 agent memory 场景，再回头看 segmentation 和 teacher target 构造细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in coding agents: in multi-turn execution, the dominant token cost often comes from repeatedly resending large contexts such as file reads, command outputs, tracebacks, and edit history. Generic prompt compressors are a poor fit here because they paraphrase identifiers, paths, and exact error strings, and they do not condition on the agent’s current intent. That makes them unsafe for downstream code editing, where exact string preservation matters. The paper reframes the task as intent-conditioned, segment-wise, mostly extractive compression rather than free-form summarization.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper. It is closer to a task-specific distilled compressor for coding-agent inference. Still, it has two useful lessons for foundation-model researchers. First, the objective for code-context compression is different from prose summarization: extractive fidelity matters more than abstractive fluency. That is relevant to code modeling objectives, memory compression, and training signals for agent-facing small models. Second, the evaluation is grounded in copy fidelity, must-keep retention, and end-to-end solve quality rather than surface overlap metrics, which makes the work more informative than many compression papers.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main pieces. First, it uses extractive compression. Instead of rewriting code and tool outputs, the model selects spans from the input and uses a fixed set of structural markers to denote removed regions. The reason is straightforward: downstream edits depend on exact strings, so identifiers, paths, numbers, and error messages should be copied, not paraphrased. The paper audits this claim explicitly: 96.0% of emitted identifier/path/number-like tokens are copied from the input on the training corpus, and 96.2% on held-out SWE-bench Lite outputs; excluding the one category intentionally rewritten by design, the rate reaches 98.3%.

Second, the compressor is intent-conditioned. Each compression call receives both the current task/query and a single segment, so the model can prioritize entities, files, functions, and error clues named in the live task. The paper argues that importance is not intrinsic to a segment; it is defined relative to what the agent is trying to do now.

Third, the system is built as a pipeline. A gateway performs segmentation, kind classification, and level labeling, and the model compresses one segment at a time. The compressor sees the task plus one segment with kind/level tags, but no explicit numeric token budget. Budget control is only indirectly encoded through a static level-to-ratio table in the system prompt. The authors originally designed four importance levels, L0-L3, but report that the distilled student effectively learned only two usable compression bands. That negative result is one of the more informative parts of the paper.

On data, they start from 67,074 raw OpenHands trajectories and build a five-stage pipeline that yields a 45K-segment distillation pool and 40,606 teacher-validated compression examples with intent-conditioned targets, level labels, and must-keep annotations. On training, they compare three matched backbones and choose 4B. They also tried drop-supervision weighting, found that it backfired, and shipped without it. Notably, the deployed checkpoint was selected by an out-of-distribution sweep rather than by training loss, which suggests that lower loss did not reliably predict real utility.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation has two layers. The intrinsic evaluation focuses on OOD holdout performance, including compression quality, must-keep retention, and identifier retention, with confidence intervals. One notable result is that at comparable budgets, the student does not underperform its own teacher on must-keep identifier retention, which suggests that distillation preserved the key exact-copy behavior.

The end-to-end evaluation plugs Paritok-4B into a coding-agent workflow under both raw-source and in-distribution line-numbered settings. The headline result is a 25.7% compression rate, meaning roughly one quarter of the original context is retained, while maintaining comparable single-shot solve quality. The paper describes this as roughly twice as aggressive as strong GPT-based compressors. Interestingly, the expected trade-off did not appear in the predicted form: instead of harder compression at equal quality, they observed slightly softer compression with higher quality, and no paired degradation was statistically resolvable over 300 instances.

That said, the scope is narrow. The conclusions are tied to coding-agent trajectories, the specific segmentation pipeline, and teacher-generated targets. The collapse from four intended levels to two effective bands also shows that fine-grained budget control remains weak.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and task formulation to understand how the paper reframes compression: not as summarization, but as extractive selection optimized for editability. Then read the data pipeline and training recipe, especially the reported dead ends: the four-level importance scheme did not survive training, drop-supervision weighting failed, and the lowest-loss checkpoint was not the one deployed. Those details are more informative than the headline result.

In the experiments, focus on the intrinsic tables for must-keep retention, identifier audits, and OOD behavior, then move to the end-to-end results relating compression rate to solve quality. A useful skim should take about 20 to 30 minutes. If the goal is to judge transferability to other agent-memory settings, revisit the segmentation design and teacher-target construction.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Coding Agent 的上下文压缩，抽取式+意图条件的思路很务实，对优化 Agent 系统的长上下文成本有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Context compression for coding agents. The extractive + intent-conditioned approach is pragmatic and valuable for optimizing long-context costs in agent systems.

paper.title: Simthesizer: An Agent-Driven Simulation Framework for LLM Serving Systems
paper.abstract: System-level simulation is an essential tool for exploring the rapidly expanding design space of LLM serving systems, where real deployments remain costly and often infeasible. However, modern LLM serving now evolves faster than human-driven simulator development can track, and emerging workloads and mechanisms, from agentic workflows to disaggregated serving, no longer fit the monolithic simulation pipeline that existing simulators assume. Each new mechanism therefore demands an invasive rewrit

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LLM serving 系统模拟器跟不上真实 serving 形态变化的问题。传统模拟器通常假设一次请求对应一条固定、单体的推理流水线，但现在的 serving 已经出现 agentic workflow、外部工具调用、动态分支、prefill/decode 解耦、speculative decoding、KV cache 量化、混合 Mamba/Transformer 等机制。每加入一种机制，旧模拟器往往需要改执行引擎，维护成本高，也难以校准真实系统行为。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对大模型系统研究有参考价值。它关注 serving simulator 的可扩展性和自动生成，这会影响推理优化方案的早期设计、容量规划和系统 trade-off 分析。对基座研究员的启发主要在两点：第一，未来 serving 工作负载不再是单次 decode，而是由多个模型调用、控制逻辑和工具调用组成的执行图；第二，用 LLM coding agent 扩展系统模拟器，需要先把底层系统抽象做得足够结构化，否则 agent 只是生成难以验证的胶水代码。
summary.technical_approach: Simthesizer 由两部分组成。第一部分是 composable simulator infrastructure，把 serving 工作流表示为 DAG。DAG 中不只包含 compute 和 communication 节点，也包含 routing、batch formation、control decision 等逻辑节点。这样新增机制时，可以通过组合控制组件和重连节点来表达，而不是重写一条固定 pipeline。第二部分是 Synthesizer agent，一个受 harness 约束的 coding agent。它把自然语言 feature request 细化成规格说明，映射到模拟器抽象，补齐缺失组件，然后用真实系统测量或参考证据验证结果。论文强调的区别在于：agent 并不是直接改一个大代码库，而是在预设接口、模块边界和验证 harness 内做“lowering”，降低生成错误和集成失败的概率。
summary.experiments: 论文实现了端到端框架，并用 OpenAI Codex 作为 Synthesizer agent 来扩展模拟器。评估覆盖 KV cache quantization、speculative decoding、hybrid Mamba model support 等 serving 特性。与 vLLM-based real system 对齐时，Simthesizer 的平均吞吐误差为 2.51%，而在现有模拟器上用相同 harness 扩展后的平均吞吐误差为 6.03%。仿真速度方面，在相同 LLM workloads 下，相比 LLMServingSim2.0 最高快 284.96×，相比 Vidur 最高快 23.19×。这些结果说明，论文的主要收益来自模拟器抽象的可组合性，而不只是 coding agent 的代码生成能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 fast evolution 和 non-monolithic serving 的问题定义，以及 Figure 1 对整体流程的说明。方法部分重点看 DAG 抽象、logical/control nodes、modular control layer 如何表达 serving 行为。实验部分优先看三类 feature extension 的验证方式、吞吐误差的计算方法，以及与 LLMServingSim2.0、Vidur 的速度对比。若关注 agent-assisted systems engineering，可以细看 harness 设计：它决定了 agent 生成代码是否可控、可测、可维护。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical gap in LLM serving simulation. Existing simulators often assume a fixed, monolithic inference pipeline, while modern serving increasingly consists of dynamic workflows: agentic requests, tool calls, routing decisions, disaggregated prefill/decode, speculative decoding, KV-cache quantization, and hybrid model architectures. Under the old simulator design, each new mechanism tends to require invasive changes to the execution engine.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for researchers who care about the system side of large models. Serving workloads are becoming graph-structured rather than single-pass decoding jobs, and that changes how inference optimizations should be evaluated. The paper is also a concrete example of using coding agents in systems research: the useful part is not unconstrained code generation, but code generation constrained by clean abstractions, narrow interfaces, and validation harnesses.
summary_en.technical_approach: Simthesizer combines a composable simulator with an agent-driven lowering workflow. The simulator represents the full serving workflow as a DAG. Nodes include not only compute and communication operations, but also logical control decisions such as routing and batch formation. New mechanisms can then be expressed by composing control modules and reconnecting graph nodes, instead of rewriting a fixed simulation pipeline. The Synthesizer agent takes a natural-language feature request, refines it into a specification, maps it to the simulator abstractions, implements missing components, and validates the behavior against real-system measurements or reference evidence. The key design choice is to make the simulator extensible first, then use the coding agent within that structure.
summary_en.experiments: The implementation evaluates extensions for KV-cache quantization, speculative decoding, and hybrid Mamba model support. OpenAI Codex is used as the coding agent under the same harnesses for Simthesizer and existing simulators. Against a vLLM-based real system, Simthesizer reaches an average throughput error of 2.51%, compared with 6.03% for extensions built on existing simulators. On identical LLM workloads, it reports up to 284.96× faster simulation than LLMServingSim2.0 and up to 23.19× faster simulation than Vidur. The main empirical message is that composable simulator structure improves both extensibility and accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the problem setup in the introduction, especially the distinction between fast evolution and non-monolithic serving. Then read the simulator abstraction: the DAG representation, logical nodes, and modular control layer. In the evaluation, focus on how the three serving features are integrated and how throughput error is measured against the vLLM-based system. If interested in coding-agent infrastructure, read the harness design carefully; it is the part that makes agent-generated simulator extensions testable rather than ad hoc.

recommendation.zh: 读方法不读宣传：动态图抽象可能适合 internal serving what-if 模拟，agent 生成部分要看约束是否足够硬。
recommendation.en: Read the method, not the pitch: the dynamic-graph abstraction may help internal serving what-if simulation, but the agent-generated code needs hard constraints.

paper.title: AgentRoom: Concurrent Multi-Agent Coding in a CRDT-Backed Shared Workspace
paper.abstract: Concurrent multi-agent coding promises division of labor across modules, robustness through redundancy, and parallel exploration at the natural granularity of multi-file projects. Realtime collaborative editing protocols solve this coordination problem for human teams via Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs), but the LLMs underneath generate one token at a time and existing multi-agent coding systems inherit this serial limit: they either sequence agents through phase handoffs or pool ind

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是多智能体代码生成里的并发协作问题：多个 LLM coding agent 如果同时改同一个项目，单靠聊天约定或事后合并，很容易出现文件冲突、语义不一致和早退式失败。
