summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，更接近 agent runtime 和代码生成系统研究。可取的启发在于，它把多 agent 协作从“提示词里的软协议”推进到“运行时状态对象”：文件声明、状态广播、共享工作区都变成可观测、可约束的工具调用。这对用 agent 扩展代码数据生成、自动修复、长任务执行环境有参考价值。主要价值不是模型能力提升，而是说明在固定模型和固定 compute 下，协作 substrate 的设计会显著改变失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: AgentRoom 提供一个 CRDT 支持的共享文件系统，并在其上暴露一组 MCP 工具：room_claim、room_release、room_state、room_broadcast、room_read。CRDT 负责字符级并发编辑合并，作者使用 pycrdt/Yrs，并设置约 2 秒的 merge interval，还加了括号平衡一类的 sanity check。关键点是 CRDT 只保证字节层面的 strong eventual consistency，不能保证两个 agent 的修改在语义上兼容。因此系统额外引入文件级 claim 机制，给每个文件建立 advisory ownership，避免多个 agent 同时修改同一路径。与 CodeCRDT 这类隐式协调方法不同，AgentRoom 不预设 outliner / implementer 等固定角色，也不使用串行 handoff，而是让 agent 通过显式房间状态和广播日志自行分工。
summary.experiments: 实验关注 matched compute 下的多 agent coding 表现。作者报告，在 12 个 model × task strata 中，Solo 出现“stub-and-exit”早退失败的 odds 是 AgentRoom 的 13.7 倍，95% CI 为 [3.9, 48]，p < 1e-5，Tarone homogeneity p = 0.92；所有有事件的分层里 Solo 的 abandonment odds 都高于 AgentRoom。与 parallel-merge 相比，在连续 LLM-judge composite 质量指标上 AgentRoom 平均高 0.213，Welch p = 0.003；该比较使用 matched compute，文中提到 both Sonnet 的设置。附录的 substrate-only bundle probe 给出的排序是 shared-only < prompt-only < AgentRoom，但 n = 7，MCP coordination layer 的提升区间跨过 0，所以只能作为定性证据。作者还给出一个碰撞概率动机：在 N=2、候选文件数约 K=5 时，两个 agent 指向同一文件的概率约 0.20；CRDT 能保留两边字节，但不能消除编译或接口冲突。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 里对 sequential turn-taking、parallel-merge、implicit CRDT 的比较；Method 中关于 CRDT 能保证什么、不能保证什么的讨论；Section 4.1 的主结果和 Figure 6；Section 4.6 对 chat-only coordination 的对照；Appendix B.13 的 substrate-only probe 可快速扫一眼。预训练研究员不必细读 CRDT 形式化证明，除非关注大规模 agent 数据生产流水线中的并发状态管理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses coordination in concurrent multi-agent coding: when several LLM coding agents edit the same project at the same time, chat-only agreements or post-hoc merging often lead to file conflicts, semantic inconsistency, and early task abandonment.
summary_en.importance: This is not a direct pretraining contribution. Its relevance is mainly in agent runtime design and code-generation infrastructure. The useful lesson is that multi-agent collaboration improves when coordination is represented as runtime state rather than only as natural-language instructions. File claims, shared status, and broadcast logs become observable tools. This matters for agent-based code data generation, automated repair pipelines, and long-running coding environments. The main contribution is a systems result: with the same models and matched compute, the coordination substrate changes the failure distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentRoom builds a CRDT-backed shared filesystem and exposes a small set of MCP tools: room_claim, room_release, room_state, room_broadcast, and room_read. The CRDT layer performs character-level merging through pycrdt/Yrs with an approximately 2-second merge interval, plus simple syntax sanity checks such as brace and parenthesis balance. The important distinction is that CRDT strong eventual consistency only preserves concurrent byte-level edits; it does not ensure that two edits agree on APIs, signatures, or design intent. AgentRoom therefore adds file-level advisory ownership through atomic claims. This differs from implicit CRDT coordination and role-preassigned systems such as CodeCRDT: there is no fixed outliner/implementer split and no orchestrated sequential handoff.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare AgentRoom with solo agents and parallel-merge baselines under matched compute. Across 12 model-by-task strata, Solo has 13.7 times the odds of the “stub-and-exit” abandonment mode compared with AgentRoom, with a 95% confidence interval of [3.9, 48], p < 1e-5, and Tarone homogeneity p = 0.92. In every stratum with events, Solo shows higher abandonment odds. Against parallel-merge, AgentRoom reports a +0.213 mean-quality advantage on a continuous LLM-judge composite, with Welch p = 0.003 in the reported Sonnet setting. A small substrate-only probe gives the qualitative ordering shared-only < prompt-only < AgentRoom, but with n = 7 and an interval crossing zero for the coordination-layer step. The paper also motivates the design with a simple collision calculation: with two agents and roughly five candidate files, the chance of both targeting the same file is about 0.20.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the comparison against sequential turn-taking, parallel-merge, and implicit CRDT coordination. Then focus on the method sections explaining what CRDTs guarantee and where they fail semantically. The main empirical evidence is in Section 4.1 and Figure 6. Section 4.6 is useful for the contrast with chat-only coordination. Appendix B.13 is worth a quick pass for the substrate ablation. The formal CRDT algebra can be skipped unless the goal is to build a concurrent agent workspace.

recommendation.zh: 只看协议层和并发冲突分析；若 CRDT 合并真的稳，这比堆 prompts 的多 agent coding 更有工程含量。
recommendation.en: Skim the protocol and conflict analysis; if the CRDT merge is robust, this is more substantive than prompt-stacked multi-agent coding.

paper.title: DeepRepoQA: Code Repository Question Answering with Deep Agent Exploration
paper.abstract: Answering developer questions about a software repository is a critical yet under-explored problem in software engineering. While existing repository understanding methods have advanced the field, they predominantly rely on surface-level code retrieval and lack the ability for deep reasoning over multiple files, complex software architectures, and grounding answers in long-range code dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose DeepRepoQA, a novel question answering (QA) framework for

summary.core_problem: DeepRepoQA 解决的是仓库级代码问答中的深层证据搜索问题。普通 RAG 往往只召回局部代码片段，ReAct 类单路径 agent 又容易被早期检索结果带偏；当问题需要跨文件追踪调用链、理解目录结构、合并多处证据时，单次检索或单条推理轨迹都不够稳定。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练本身的直接增益有限，但对代码模型的 agentic evaluation 和工具使用训练有参考价值。它把 repository QA 明确建成一个多路径搜索与验证问题，而不是简单的长上下文塞入或向量检索增强。对代码模型研究者来说，价值主要在三点：一是提供了复杂代码理解任务中搜索策略的强 baseline；二是展示了 MCTS 与 LLM 反馈结合后如何降低检索偏置；三是给后续构造代码 agent SFT/RL 数据提供了可复用的轨迹生成框架。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是用 MCTS 管理仓库探索轨迹。系统先把代码仓库解析成可查询结构，包括目录、文件、类、函数和代码片段，并建立索引。问答时构造搜索树，每个节点代表当前已收集证据和推理状态，动作空间包括语义搜索、结构导航、定向代码检查和停止回答。每一步由四类 agent 分工：Perception Agent 读取当前状态和历史路径，判断还缺什么信息；Planning Agent 生成候选动作；Execution Agent 在索引化仓库上执行搜索、跳转或代码查看；Evaluation Agent 对新证据和状态打分，并把价值反馈回 MCTS。与 ReAct 的区别在于，ReAct 通常沿一条轨迹逐步行动，错误路径会持续累积；DeepRepoQA 同时保留多条候选路径，用价值评估在探索和利用之间切换。记忆设计也比较实用：系统把从根节点到当前节点的证据路径组织进 prompt，使回答可以引用具体代码跨度，而不是只给泛化解释。
summary.experiments: 实验在 SWE-QA 上进行，覆盖 Kimi K2、GLM-4.6、Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct 和 GPT-5.1 等后端模型。DeepRepoQA 在所有模型上都超过 ReAct 风格基线；在 Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct 上，相比 SWE-agent 的最大提升为 7.08 分。使用 GPT-5.1 和 Kimi K2 时，结果达到或接近 Cursor、通义灵码等商业工具。消融结果显示 MCTS 是主要增益来源；语义搜索、Evaluation Agent 和 Perception Agent 对稳定性和搜索效率也有贡献。效率分析表明，MCTS 增加了一定调用成本，但通过减少无效路径和更早聚合证据，质量与成本之间的折中较好。案例分析显示，多路径搜索能发现单路径 agent 容易漏掉的跨文件证据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中的动作空间、MCTS 节点状态定义、四个 agent 的 prompt/输入输出，以及 ablation 表。实验部分重点看不同 backbone 下的结果，而不是只看单个 GPT-5.1 配置。值得深挖的是 Evaluation Agent 的打分信号：它相当于一个轻量 verifier，如果后续用于代码 agent 的 SFT/RL 轨迹筛选，信号质量会直接影响训练数据质量。仓库解析和索引部分可以快速浏览，除非关注代码工具链实现。

summary_en.core_problem: DeepRepoQA targets deep repository-level question answering. Standard RAG often retrieves local code fragments, while single-trajectory ReAct agents can commit early to a wrong path. Many repository questions require following dependencies across files, inspecting architecture-level structure, and combining scattered evidence, which makes shallow retrieval insufficient.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not directly about foundation-model pretraining, but it is useful for code-model evaluation and agentic data generation. Its main contribution is to formulate repository QA as multi-path search and verification rather than as long-context stuffing or flat retrieval. For code LLM research, it offers a strong search baseline, a concrete example of using MCTS to reduce retrieval bias, and a possible trajectory generator for future SFT or RL training of code agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system uses MCTS to organize repository exploration. It first parses the repository into a queryable representation, including directories, files, classes, functions, and code spans. At inference time, it builds a search tree where each node stores the current evidence and reasoning state. The action space covers semantic search, structural navigation, targeted code inspection, and stopping. Four agents operate in each iteration: a Perception Agent summarizes the current state and missing evidence; a Planning Agent proposes candidate actions; an Execution Agent runs the selected action over the indexed repository; and an Evaluation Agent scores the new state and propagates value estimates back through the tree. Compared with ReAct, the key difference is multi-trajectory exploration. ReAct follows one path and can accumulate early mistakes; DeepRepoQA keeps multiple branches alive and uses value estimates to balance exploration and exploitation. Its memory path from root to current node also makes the final answer easier to ground in explicit code citations.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is conducted on SWE-QA with several backbones, including Kimi K2, GLM-4.6, Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct, and GPT-5.1. DeepRepoQA consistently improves over ReAct-style baselines. The largest reported gain is 7.08 points over SWE-agent when using Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct. With GPT-5.1 and Kimi K2, it matches or exceeds strong commercial tools such as Cursor and Tongyi Lingma in the reported setting. Ablations identify MCTS as the main contributor. Semantic search, the Evaluation Agent, and the Perception Agent further improve stability and efficiency. The case study shows that MCTS-guided verification can recover cross-file evidence that a single-path agent may miss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the methodology: action-space design, MCTS state definition, inputs and outputs of the four agents, and the ablation tables. In the results, compare behavior across backbones rather than relying on one strong proprietary model. The most useful part to inspect is the Evaluation Agent, because it plays the role of a lightweight verifier. If this framework is later used to generate SFT or RL trajectories for code agents, the quality of that value signal will matter more than the search wrapper itself. The repository parsing details can be read quickly unless implementation is the main interest.

recommendation.zh: 将 MCTS 引入代码库级别的 QA 搜索，是提升 Coding Agent 探索能力的一个合理尝试，关注其在 SWE-QA 上的具体提升幅度。
recommendation.en: Introducing MCTS into repository-level QA search is a reasonable attempt to enhance the exploration capability of Coding Agents. Pay attention to its specific performance gains on SWE-QA.

paper.title: ReproAgent: Contract-Guided Paper-to-Code Reproduction
paper.abstract: Paper-to-code reproduction asks scientific AI agents to turn research papers into executable repositories that preserve the paper's method, protocol and artifacts. This is difficult because the specification is split: explicit paper content such as algorithms, metrics and artifacts is often lost across long agent trajectories, while implicit details such as framework defaults and conventions inherited from related work are absent from the paper. We introduce ReproAgent, a four-stage Prepare--Pla

summary.core_problem: 解决 paper-to-code 复现中“长轨迹遗忘显式规格 + 论文缺失隐式实现细节”导致的复现偏差，提升仓库级生成的一致性与可修复性。
summary.importance: 方法贡献在 agent 工程化：用“持久化契约”把规格约束外显并贯穿生成/修复；对预训练本身不直接，但对代码代理的训练数据构造与 verifier 设计有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 四阶段 Prepare–Plan–Generate–Repair；核心是 persistent implementation contract（两通道）：(1) implementation-requirement 将论文片段转成代码义务；(2) reference-evidence 从相关仓库检索内容/结构证据；契约绑定 work packages，投影到 file-level contracts，贯穿生成与修复。
summary.experiments: 在 PaperBench Code-Dev 上评测；摘要称在“同 backbone 的 scaffolds”中取得最高均分（未给出具体模型、提升幅度与显著性细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets paper-to-code reproduction failures caused by long-trajectory loss of explicit specs and missing implicit implementation details, aiming for more consistent and repairable repo-level generation.
summary_en.importance: An agent-engineering contribution: a persistent contract to externalize constraints across generate/repair; indirect value for training-data and verifier design rather than pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: A four-stage Prepare–Plan–Generate–Repair pipeline centered on a persistent implementation contract with two channels: (1) implementation-requirement obligations extracted from paper snippets; (2) reference-evidence retrieved from related repos; contracts are bound to work packages and projected to file-level contracts used during generation and repair.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on PaperBench Code-Dev; claims the highest mean score among same-backbone scaffolds (model/backbone and effect sizes not specified in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 契约化约束贯穿生成/修复是对的，但更像脚手架工程；只读“contract 两通道+file-level 投影”即可，别期待新训练范式。
recommendation.en: The contract-through-generate/repair idea is solid but mostly scaffolding; read the two-channel contract and file-level projection, don’t expect new training paradigms.

paper.title: The Empire, Long Divided, Must Unite: Architectural Convergence in Three LLM Agent Harnesses
paper.abstract: An agent harness is what turns a language model into an autonomous agent: the surrounding code that builds the model's context, mediates its tools, runs the loop, and persists state across a long-horizon run. This layer, not the model it wraps, is increasingly the binding constraint on agent behaviour. We present a source-level, multi-case study of three open coding-agent harnesses built from deliberately opposing philosophies: LangChain's deepagents (batteries-included), Earendil's pi (radical

summary.core_problem: 研究 coding-agent harness 如何组织上下文、工具调用、执行循环和长程状态，并解释为什么不同设计哲学的开源 harness 会收敛到相近架构。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工程架构分析，而不是新模型或训练方法。它把 coding agent 的外部执行层拆成可复用组件，对理解 agent 能力瓶颈有帮助，但对基座预训练的直接影响较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 作者做 source-level multi-case study，固定版本阅读 LangChain deepagents、Earendil pi、DeepSeek dsh，并追踪 commit history。核心观察是两类成熟 harness 从相反方向演化：deepagents 减少手写脚手架，pi 增加持久化基础设施，最后都靠近一个五要素中间形态：通用执行循环、append-only 可回放会话记录、把模型 quirks 数据化、渐进式上下文披露、显式状态/控制边界。
summary.experiments: 论文不是标准实验型工作；摘要未报告模型参数量、训练数据、定量 benchmark 或提升幅度。证据主要来自三个开源 coding-agent harness 的源码阅读和版本演化对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how coding-agent harnesses organize context, tool use, execution loops, and persistent state, and why systems with different design philosophies converge architecturally.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering architecture analysis rather than a modeling or training contribution. It is useful for understanding where agent behavior is constrained outside the base model, but it has limited direct impact on LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author conducts a source-level multi-case study of pinned versions and commit histories for LangChain deepagents, Earendil pi, and DeepSeek dsh. The main observation is convergence toward five recurring elements: a commoditized loop, an append-only replayable session record, model quirks represented as data, progressive context disclosure, and explicit state/control boundaries.
summary_en.experiments: This is not a conventional empirical paper. The abstract does not report model sizes, training data, benchmark scores, or quantitative gains; the evidence comes from source inspection and evolutionary comparison of three open coding-agent harnesses.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent 工程形态备查即可；看五要素列表够了，不会改变预训练侧 prior。
recommendation.en: Useful as agent-engineering background; the five-element convergence is the part to read, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: A Literate Programming Environment for Human and Machine Agents
paper.abstract: This paper introduces an environment for constructing literate programs in concert with language-aware machine agents. This environment includes a grammar for executable program essays, a parser that treats names as first-class objects, an internal name-graph which relates prose, names and executable artifacts, and a binding mechanism for existing languages and testing toolsets. This supports co-location of code with its most relevant natural language and structured data context, making better u

summary.core_problem: 为人类程序员和 LLM coding agents 提供一种把代码、自然语言说明、结构化数据和测试工具放在同一可执行文档中的编程环境。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding-agent 工具环境设计，不是模型训练方法；价值在于讨论如何组织上下文和符号信息，让 LLM agent 更接近 IDE 中的 symbol-aware 搜索与使用关系。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出可执行 program essays 的语法、解析器、一等公民的 name objects、连接 prose、names 与 executable artifacts 的内部 name graph，以及对现有编程语言和测试工具的 binding 机制。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明已有工作实现，并支持三种成熟编程语言的 bindings，展示若干示例程序；没有给出 SWE-bench 类定量评测、agent 成功率或大规模对比实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a programming environment that colocates code, prose, structured context, and test tooling for both human programmers and LLM coding agents.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a coding-agent tooling and context-organization design, not a model-training result. Its relevance is in how symbolic program context can be exposed to agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The environment defines a grammar for executable program essays, a parser with names as first-class objects, an internal name graph connecting prose, names, and executable artifacts, and bindings to existing languages and test tools.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a working implementation with bindings to three established programming languages and several example programs, but no large-scale benchmark or quantitative coding-agent comparison.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent context 组织思路备查；缺少量化评测，不必读正文，扫 name-graph 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for coding-agent context organization; without quantitative evaluation, just skim the name-graph design.

paper.title: Repo2Skill-Evo: Repository Skills Go Stale in Silence
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over evolving software repositories, where success depends on repository-specific procedural knowledge: which APIs to call, which scripts to run, and which conventions the current release expects. Agent skills externalize this knowledge into reusable units, and prior work shows that they can improve agent performance. What remains unclear is whether that improvement is durable. The same version specificity that makes a skill useful also make

summary.core_problem: 当 LLM agent 把“仓库特定的过程性知识”外化成可复用的 skill（例如该跑哪个脚本、该调用哪个 API、遵循什么约定）后，仓库版本迭代会让 skill 在没有显式信号的情况下悄然过期（silent staleness）。论文要解决的是：如何系统性评测并量化 agent 维护这些 versioned skills 的能力，以及失败主要卡在什么环节（定位受影响文件 vs 在文件内选择正确编辑）。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究是间接相关：它不是训练新基座或新目标函数，而是给“长期使用的 agent 知识资产”引入了时间维度与版本漂移问题，并提供了可复现的评测资产。它的价值在于两点：
- 评测层：把 skill 维护定义成严格 patch-grounded 的编辑任务，能更清晰地区分“真的跟随仓库变化修对了”与“写得像但没对齐证据”。
- 训练信号层：这种任务天然对应持续学习/continual adaptation 的数据构造方式（release patch + 旧 skill → 新 skill），未来如果有人用它做 mid-train 或工具使用策略学习，会比泛泛的代码编辑数据更可控。
但就当前论文贡献而言，它更像一个 agent/评测工作，而不是直接推动预训练 scaling 或 tokenizer/数据配比的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
Repo2Skill-Evo 由三块组成：
1) 固定的 V1 skill 集：基于 Repo2Skill 流水线，用 staged distillation + expert refinement 从仓库中提炼过程性知识，形成技能包（SKILL.md + 可选脚本/引用），并记录每条 claim 的 provenance（来源路径、符号等元数据），保证后续能追踪证据。
2) 维护任务定义：给定 V1→V2 的官方 release patch，维护 agent 需要删除或修改已被 patch 证实过期的 skill 行，同时尽量不改动仍然有效的行。这里的关键取舍是：不让模型“重写一遍技能文档”，而是做最小必要编辑，才能测出定位与证据追踪能力。
3) 评测：核心是严格 patch-grounded headline metric——奖励对 patch-verified obsolete lines 的正确删除/修订，惩罚对其他行的编辑；并辅以一个 rubric-based 的自然语言 Judge，从五个维度评估 V2 skill 集质量。
论文进一步把失败拆成两类瓶颈：skill 文件定位不全（coverage 不够导致漏改）与 edit selection 不准（改多了导致 precision 下降）。并用 oracle localization 实验说明：只解决“找对文件”还不够，文件内证据追踪与选择性编辑仍是难点。
summary.experiments:
关键设置与结果（来自全文引言部分给出的数字）：
- 数据规模：57 个仓库、105 个 release transitions；每个 transition 都包含一个固定的 V1 skill 集，并有人/流程标注出 patch-verified 的过期行。过期行数量中位数约 92 行。
- 参评模型/agent：评测了 6 个 frontier agents（具体名单需以正文实验表为准）。
- 主指标：这些 agent 在 avg@3 macro F1 上约 29.9%–69.7%，显示维护并不可靠。
- 诊断实验：在 20 个最难的 transitions 上做 oracle skill-file localization 能提升表现，但仍有显著残余错误，支持“定位之外还有 within-file evidence tracing / edit selection 问题”的结论。
另外，论文还做了一个 utility study：在随机抽取的 10 个仓库上，skills 对 baseline 最弱的任务带来最大绝对增益，暗示维护问题在“原本就不熟仓库”的场景更关键。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（45–60 分钟）：
- 先读 Introduction 对 silent staleness 的定义与动机，理解为什么“外化知识”会让过期变得不可见。
- 重点看任务与指标定义：patch-grounded headline metric 的奖励/惩罚规则决定了它测的是“选择性维护”而不是“重写能力”。
- 看主结果表：关注不同 agent 的 precision/recall 取舍（论文提到更广泛编辑带来更高 recall 但更低 precision）。
- 看 oracle localization 与错误分析段落：它把问题拆成 localization 与 edit selection 两段，这对后续做数据合成或训练信号设计更有用。
如果你的关注点是 pretrain/posttrain 接口：把它当作一种可控的 continual adaptation 数据形态（patch 驱动的知识更新），思考是否能用来做 mid-train 或工具使用策略的持续训练。

summary_en.core_problem: When LLM agents externalize repository-specific procedural knowledge into reusable “skills”, repository releases can silently invalidate parts of those skills without any explicit signal. The paper studies how to benchmark and diagnose an agent’s ability to maintain versioned repository skills across releases—separating file localization failures from within-file evidence tracing and edit-selection failures.
summary_en.importance:
This is closer to an agent benchmark/maintenance study than a pretraining-method paper. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is indirect but concrete:
- Evaluation asset: a patch-grounded maintenance protocol that rewards evidence-aligned edits and penalizes unnecessary rewrites, making it harder to “sound plausible” without being correct.
- Training-signal shape: (release patch + old skill → updated skill) is a clean continual-adaptation data form; it could later support mid-training or continual post-training with controllable supervision.
It does not, by itself, advance scaling laws, tokenization, or core pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Repo2Skill-Evo is built as:
1) A fixed V1 skill set produced by Repo2Skill via staged distillation plus expert refinement. Each skill is packaged (e.g., SKILL.md, optional scripts/references) and augmented with provenance metadata (source paths/symbols) to enable traceability.
2) A maintenance task: given the official V1→V2 release patch, a maintenance agent must delete or revise patch-verified obsolete skill lines while preserving still-valid content. The design intentionally emphasizes minimal, selective edits rather than full regeneration.
3) Evaluation: a strict patch-grounded headline metric that rewards correct edits on verified obsolete lines and penalizes edits elsewhere, plus a rubric-based NL judge with five dimensions for overall quality.
The analysis frames two complementary bottlenecks: incomplete localization of affected skill files (coverage) and imperfect edit selection (precision/within-file evidence tracing). An oracle localization experiment tests how much of the gap is purely localization.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported setup and headline numbers:
- Scale: 57 repositories, 105 release transitions; each transition includes a fixed V1 skill set with patch-verified obsolete-line annotations. Median obsolete content is ~92 lines per transition.
- Models: six frontier agents (exact identities should be checked in the main experiment table).
- Performance: only ~29.9%–69.7% avg@3 macro F1, indicating maintenance is unreliable.
- Diagnostics: oracle skill-file localization on the 20 hardest transitions improves results but leaves substantial residual errors, supporting the claim that within-file evidence tracing and edit selection remain hard.
A utility study on 10 randomly sampled repos suggests skills help most where baseline agent performance is weakest, implying maintenance matters most in low-familiarity settings.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 min):
- Read the Introduction for the precise definition of “silent staleness” and why externalized skills can decay invisibly.
- Focus on the task/metric section: the patch-grounded scoring rules are the core contribution.
- Check the main results table and look for the precision–recall trade-off pattern (broader edits → higher recall but lower precision).
- Read the oracle localization and error analysis: it cleanly decomposes failures into localization vs edit selection.
If you care about pretrain/post-train interfaces, treat this as a well-scoped continual-update supervision format and consider how it could be used for mid-training or continual post-training.

recommendation.zh: 读任务定义和错误分析即可；它提醒外部 memory 不是免费午餐，版本漂移会把技能变成隐性负资产。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and error analysis; it is a useful warning that external memory can become a silent liability under version drift.

paper.title: What Process Evaluation of Coding Agents Actually Measures: Action, Task, and Step Are Three Different Levels
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly evaluated not only by whether they solve a task, but also by how they execute it. However, existing process-level evaluations often treat action prediction, task uncertainty, and step attribution as if they were the same problem, which makes it unclear what such evaluations actually measure. In this paper, we introduce a measurement framework for process evaluation in coding agents and instantiate step-level causal attribution with SCAE, a replay-based estimator de

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 coding agent 过程评测中的概念混淆：预测下一步动作、判断任务整体不确定性、归因某一步是否因果影响最终结果，是三个不同层级的问题，不能用同一类过程分数混在一起解释。
summary.importance: 对基座和 post-train 研究的启发主要在训练信号质量。很多 coding agent 的过程奖励、轨迹打分、LLM judge 归因，会被用来做 SFT/RL 数据筛选或奖励建模。论文指出，这些信号未必测到“某一步造成了成功或失败”，更可能测到语义相关性、后续轨迹证据或行动可预测性。这个结论会影响如何设计 process reward model、verifier、agent 轨迹蒸馏数据，以及如何解释长轨迹训练中的 credit assignment。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出一个三层测量框架。action level 关注下一步操作是否可预测；task level 关注同一任务在 replay continuation 下的整体不确定性；step level 关注某个具体动作对最终结果的局部因果效应。核心工具是 SCAE，一个基于结构因果模型的 replay estimator。它从已记录的 agent 前缀出发，重建执行环境，采样或重放后续轨迹，估计 prefix-conditioned causal effect。若局部轨迹有足够 overlap，则采用 observational 分支；若策略近似确定，则转向 intervention 分支。论文还通过控制 judge 可见的信息，观察 full-trace judge 的归因是否会随后续步骤可见性变化，从而检验评测机制自身的偏差。
summary.experiments: 实验场景是 file localization，包含 499 个任务轨迹，输入包括 issue、repository snapshot、agent action sequence 和可验证的目标文件集合。主要结果有三点。第一，下一步动作常常可预测，但最强信号不是代码依赖图，而是 agent 刚刚在工具输出中看过的路径，也就是 execution provenance。第二，执行方差主要由 instance 决定，而不是由单个 step 决定，说明很多不确定性是任务级属性。第三，在可承受的 replay 成本下，step-level causal effect 很难被稳定定位；但 full-trace LLM judge 在看到更多后续步骤时，会系统性改变 blame assignment。这说明常见过程评测更像是在读后验语义证据，而不是认证某一步的因果贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看三处：第一，问题定义部分，弄清 action/task/step 三个层级的目标量分别是什么；第二，SCAE 的识别假设和 replay/intervention 分支，这是论文最有方法含量的部分；第三，judge-information manipulation 的实验，它直接说明 full-trace judge 为什么容易把后续证据误当作前序步骤的因果贡献。若关心过程奖励或 agent RL，优先读 step attribution 的失败案例，而不是只看最终 benchmark 数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a measurement problem in coding-agent process evaluation: next-action prediction, task-level uncertainty, and step-level causal attribution are different targets, yet current evaluations often treat them as the same kind of process score.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is about the quality of training and evaluation signals. Process rewards, trajectory judges, and step annotations for coding agents are often reused for SFT, RL, verifier training, or data filtering. This work shows that such signals may not identify whether a specific step caused success or failure. They may instead capture semantic relevance, posterior evidence from later trace segments, or simple action predictability. That distinction matters for credit assignment in long-horizon agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a three-level measurement framework. At the action level, it studies what predicts the next operation. At the task level, it measures uncertainty under replayed continuations. At the step level, it defines a prefix-conditioned causal effect for a particular action. The concrete instrument is SCAE, a replay-based estimator derived from a structural causal model of agent execution. Given a logged prefix and a replayable repository environment, SCAE reconstructs the prefix and estimates local effects through replayed continuations. When local overlap is available, it uses an observational branch; when the policy is effectively deterministic, it switches to an intervention branch. The paper also manipulates the information available to full-trace judges to test whether their blame assignments are causally grounded or driven by later evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical setting is file localization, with 499 tasks containing issues, repository snapshots, agent action sequences, and verifiable target file sets. The results are consistent across three levels. Next actions are often predictable, but the strongest predictor is execution provenance—the file paths recently exposed in tool outputs—rather than code-graph structure. Execution variance is mostly instance-level rather than step-level, suggesting that uncertainty is primarily a property of the task. For step attribution, the identifiable causal quantity is too weak to localize reliably at feasible replay cost. However, full-trace LLM judges systematically shift blame when later steps are made visible, indicating that many process evaluations behave more like semantic relevance judgments than certified causal attribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on three parts: the formal separation between action, task, and step; the SCAE identification assumptions and the replay/intervention design; and the judge-information manipulation experiment. For readers working on process reward models or coding-agent RL, the most useful part is the negative result on feasible step-level causal localization, not the headline task setting.

recommendation.zh: 过程评测经常“测错对象”，这篇把层级拆清并用因果回放做归因；只读框架定义+关键实验结论就够。
recommendation.en: Process eval often measures the wrong thing; this paper cleanly separates levels and uses causal replay for attribution—read the framework + main findings only.

paper.title: Signal or Noise? A Benchmark Study of Agent Skills in Web Development
paper.abstract: Agent Skills are reusable procedural modules that are increasingly injected into coding-agent sessions to encode framework conventions, anti-patterns, and reusable tools. However, because each injected Skill expands the prompt of every query, an effective Skill benchmark must determine not only whether an agent can solve a task, but whether the Skill should have been injected at all. We introduce WebDev-Skills-Bench and use it for a controlled empirical study of 31 public WebDev Skills on 50 Web

summary.core_problem: 在代码 Agent 中注入可复用的 'Skill'（如框架约定、反模式、工具）会增加所有 prompt 的长度，这是否真的能提升 Web 开发任务的成功率，还是仅仅增加了 token 开销和干扰？
summary.importance: 揭示了 Agent Skill 注入的真实代价。指出当前许多 Skill 评测未分离'内容增益'与'长度干扰'，并证明盲目注入 Skill 往往弊大于利，对 Agent 框架设计和评测标准有重要警示作用。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 WebDev-Skills-Bench，包含 50 个项目、1000 个任务和 31 个公开 WebDev Skills。核心设计是四种对照条件：C0（无 Skill）、C1（目标 Skill）、C2（长度匹配的无关 Skill，用于分离长度效应）、C3（留一法消融，分析规则、反模式、示例代码的作用）。采用工作区感知注入协议，仅将 SKILL.md 放入 prompt，辅助文件挂载到文件系统，确保长度控制的精确性。
summary.experiments: 在四种模型上，目标注入（C1）导致平均 Pass@2 下降 1.3 到 4.2 个百分点，token 成本增加 72% 到 394%，仅 17% 到 36% 的 (Skill, project) 对有收益。C2 对照表明：Sonnet 和 Qwen 易受长度干扰（无关 Skill 导致类似性能下降），而 GPT-5.1 和 DeepSeek 易受内容误导。C3 消融发现：反模式规则最有效，而示例代码对强模型往往起反作用。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Benchmark Design 中的四种对照条件（C0-C3）设计，以及实验部分关于不同模型对'长度'和'内容'敏感度的差异分析。这对于设计更鲁棒的 Agent prompt 策略很有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Does injecting reusable 'Skills' (e.g., framework conventions, anti-patterns) into coding agents actually improve success rates on Web development tasks, or does it merely increase token overhead and prompt distraction?
summary_en.importance: Exposes the hidden costs of Agent Skill injection. It highlights that many current Skill evaluations fail to disentangle 'content gain' from 'length distraction', demonstrating that blind injection often does more harm than good. This serves as a crucial warning for Agent framework design and evaluation standards.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces WebDev-Skills-Bench, comprising 50 projects, 1,000 tasks, and 31 public WebDev Skills. The core design features four matched conditions: C0 (no Skill), C1 (target Skill), C2 (length-matched irrelevant Skill to isolate length effects), and C3 (leave-one-out ablation to analyze rules, anti-patterns, and example code). It employs a workspace-aware injection protocol, placing only SKILL.md in the prompt while mounting auxiliary files, ensuring precise length control.
summary_en.experiments: Across four models, target injection (C1) resulted in a negative average ΔPass@2 (between -1.3 and -4.2 pp) and increased token costs by 72% to 394%, with only 17% to 36% of (Skill, project) pairs showing gains. The C2 control revealed that Sonnet and Qwen are length-distracted, whereas GPT-5.1 and DeepSeek are content-misled. C3 ablation showed that anti-pattern rules are the most reliable benefit, while example code often hurts stronger models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the design of the four matched conditions (C0-C3) in the Benchmark Design section, and the experimental analysis regarding the differing sensitivities of models to 'length' versus 'content'. This offers valuable insights for designing more robust Agent prompt strategies.

recommendation.zh: 一个反直觉的实证研究，证明了给 Agent 强塞 Skill 往往适得其反（掉点且费钱），对设计 Agent 框架的 context 管理有直接警示。
recommendation.en: A counter-intuitive empirical study proving that force-feeding skills to Agents often backfires (performance drop and higher cost), offering a direct warning for context management in Agent framework design.

paper.title: Architecture as Capability Equalizer for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: LLM-based coding agents generate complete software systems from high-level descriptions, yet little is known about how the format of architecture specifications affects the quality of generated code or whether this effect depends on model capability. We present a controlled experiment comparing five informationally equivalent specification formats (informal prose, Mermaid diagrams with constraints and ADRs, OpenAPI, C4/Structurizr DSL, and TypeScript interface contracts with ArchUnit-style rules

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章研究的核心不是 coding agent 能不能写代码，而是同样的信息内容，用什么架构规格表示形式喂给 agent，会不会系统性影响生成质量，而且这种影响是否依赖模型能力。作者把“架构文档”当作一种输入表示问题来处理，考察 prose、Mermaid+约束+ADR、OpenAPI、C4/Structurizr DSL、TypeScript interface contracts 五种等信息量格式，对不同能力层级模型的作用差异。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“模型能力如何与输入表示耦合”有很好的实验价值。对基座研究员，最有启发的点有两个。第一，强模型对表示形式更不敏感，弱模型则高度依赖更结构化、更贴近代码的表示，这可以看作一种 capability equalization 现象。第二，token 成本和能力并不单调，存在中等能力模型反复修补、消耗更多 token 却产出更差结果的 valley。这个现象和训练后 agent 行为、工具使用稳定性、以及 instruction format 设计都有关系。虽然它不是 pretrain 论文，但对理解“表示工程是否能部分替代模型能力”很有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计很规整。作者先构造一个固定的 Task Management API 参考系统，包含 7 个组件：Router、5 个 domain services、Notification、Event Bus，并规定通信模式、数据所有权、6 条硬约束、25 条 HTTP 路由、3 条 ADR 和固定目录结构。然后把完全相同的系统规格写成五种格式，只改变表示，不改变信息量。接着用 6 个模型、来自 3 个厂商家族，在多轮 agent setting 下各自实现该系统。评测分三路：自动静态约束检查、自动 route coverage 分析、以及 LLM-as-judge 对 architectural adherence、constraint compliance、completeness 的打分。全文的关键不是某一种格式绝对最好，而是 format × model interaction：前沿模型几乎能吸收任何表示，较弱模型则明显受益于更结构化、代码邻近的格式，尤其是 TypeScript contracts。作者还总结了三类失败模式：compilation death spiral、premature termination、perfectionist iteration，并观察这些失败模式与规格格式之间的耦合关系。
summary.experiments: 实验规模不算大，但控制得比较严。作者报告了 90 次主实验 trial，并开放了 93 条完整 transcript、代码库和评测结果。核心结果有四点。1）格式与模型能力存在强交互：在 Sonnet 4.6 和 GPT-5 这类强模型上，格式带来的质量 spread 只有 0.17 到 0.92；在非前沿模型上，spread 达到 0.83 到 2.42 分。2）TypeScript contracts 对弱模型帮助最大：Gemini Flash 在 prose 下只实现 33% 的指定 API routes，换成 TypeScript interface contracts 后达到 100%，是 3 倍提升。3）成本曲线出现反直觉 valley：Haiku 消耗约 735K tokens，得分 6.50；Sonnet 约 640K tokens，得分 8.42。说明“更便宜的小模型 + agent 迭代”不一定更省。4）自验证能力明显分层：frontier 模型 demo run rate 为 100%，最小模型为 0%，弱模型甚至不会把自己生成的系统端到端跑通。评测方法上，自动 checker 与 LLM judge 互补，judge 的 constraint score 与自动 compliance 相关性只有 r=0.21，说明两者捕捉的是不同错误面。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看方法设计和结果表，不必陷入软件工程细节。优先看第 III 节，确认五种 specification 真的是信息等价，只是表示不同；否则后面的结论会被“信息不对称”污染。然后看 format × model interaction 的主结果，以及 Gemini Flash 在 TypeScript contracts 下 route coverage 从 33% 到 100% 的例子，这最能说明表示形式如何补偿能力不足。最后看 failure mode taxonomy 和 token 成本分析，理解为什么中等能力 agent 可能最不经济。预计 20 到 30 分钟足够。对做基座训练的人，重点不是具体软件架构 DSL，而是输入结构化程度、代码邻近性、以及 agent 自验证能力如何随模型能力变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but useful question: given the same architectural information, does the representation format of that specification materially affect coding-agent performance, and does the effect depend on model capability? Instead of asking whether architecture guidance helps at all, it treats architecture documents as an input-representation variable and compares five information-equivalent formats.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it isolates an interaction between model capability and input structure. Two findings matter. First, stronger models are much less sensitive to representation format, while weaker models benefit substantially from structured, code-proximate specifications. That is a concrete example of capability equalization through representation. Second, token cost is not monotonic with capability: mid-tier agents can spend more tokens in repair loops and still produce worse systems. That has implications for post-training, tool-use behavior, and prompt or interface design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is clean and controlled. The authors define a fixed Task Management API with seven components, explicit communication rules, data ownership constraints, six hard architectural rules, 25 HTTP routes, three ADRs, and a prescribed file layout. They then encode the exact same system in five formats: natural-language prose, Mermaid diagrams with constraints and ADRs, OpenAPI, C4/Structurizr DSL, and TypeScript interface contracts with ArchUnit-style rules. Six models from three vendor families are asked to implement the system in a multi-turn coding-agent setting. Evaluation combines three channels: automated static architecture checks, automated route-coverage analysis, and LLM-as-judge scoring for architectural adherence, constraint compliance, and completeness. The central result is not that one format universally wins, but that there is a strong format-by-model interaction. Frontier models can absorb almost any representation, whereas weaker models improve sharply when the specification is more structured and closer to executable code. The paper also identifies three recurring failure modes: compilation death spiral, premature termination, and perfectionist iteration.
summary_en.experiments: The study is modest in scale but well controlled: 90 main multi-turn trials are reported, and 93 full transcripts and codebases are released. Four results stand out. 1) Strong format-by-model interaction: on Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5, the quality spread across formats is only 0.17 to 0.92 points, while on non-frontier models it reaches 0.83 to 2.42 points. 2) TypeScript contracts strongly help the weakest model: Gemini Flash implements only 33% of specified API routes under prose, but 100% under TypeScript interface contracts, a 3x improvement from representation alone. 3) Inverted cost efficiency: Haiku consumes about 735K tokens for a score of 6.50, while Sonnet uses about 640K tokens for 8.42, showing that smaller iterative agents are not necessarily cheaper in practice. 4) Self-validation collapses with weaker models: frontier models achieve 100% demo run rate, while the smallest model reaches 0%, meaning it never successfully tests its own system end to end. The evaluation channels are complementary rather than redundant; the correlation between judge-based constraint scoring and automated compliance is only r=0.21.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the task design and make sure the five specification formats are truly information-equivalent; otherwise the main claim is hard to trust. Then read the main result tables on format-by-model interaction and the route-coverage example for Gemini Flash, which is the clearest demonstration of representation compensating for limited capability. Finally, read the failure-mode taxonomy and token-cost analysis to understand why mid-tier agents can be the least efficient operating point. You can get the main ideas in 20 to 30 minutes. If your interest is foundation models rather than software engineering, focus on structured input representations, code proximity, and the dependence of self-validation behavior on model capability.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 prompt 格式（架构规范）与模型能力之间的有趣交互：强模型不在乎格式，弱模型极度依赖接近代码的格式。对 coding agent 的 prompt 工程和数据合成有指导意义。
recommendation.en: Reveals an interesting interaction between prompt format (architecture specification) and model capability: strong models are format-agnostic, while weak models heavily rely on code-proximate formats. Instructive for prompt engineering and data synthesis in coding agents.

paper.title: SkillBloat: Token Amplification Attacks via Skill Injection in LLM Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Agent skills extend coding agents with task-specific instructions, scripts, and resources, but they also create a trusted instruction channel that can be abused beyond conventional security attacks. This paper studies token amplification through skill injection: an economic resource-abuse threat in which a malicious skill causes an agent to consume substantially more tokens than needed for normal task execution. We present SkillBloat, a two-phase framework that first screens a library of diverse

summary.core_problem: 研究 coding agent 的 skill 机制如何被恶意利用，导致 agent 消耗远超正常任务所需的 token。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding-agent 安全与资源滥用分析。它把风险从传统越权、数据泄露、错误代码扩展到经济成本攻击；对 agent serving 成本和 skill 供应链安全有参考意义，但不是基座训练方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillBloat，两阶段攻击框架。第一阶段在多个 token amplification 机制上筛选不同攻击条件；第二阶段用 LLM-guided full-document skill rewriting 迭代改写整份 skill 文档，强化最有效候选。
summary.experiments: 在真实世界 skill benchmark 和多个 coding-agent target configuration 上评估，SkillBloat 的平均最佳 token amplification 达到 5.4184x 到 10.1455x。消融显示，第二阶段迭代改写相较只做第一阶段攻击类型筛选能稳定提高放大效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how malicious agent skills can cause coding agents to spend far more tokens than necessary for normal task execution.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent security and resource-abuse contribution. It broadens the threat model from conventional security failures to economic token-amplification attacks, which matters for agent serving cost and skill supply-chain governance but not directly for pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillBloat uses a two-phase framework. It first screens diverse attack-type conditions across multiple amplification mechanisms, then applies LLM-guided full-document skill rewriting to refine the strongest candidate.
summary_en.experiments: On a real-world skill benchmark and multiple coding-agent target configurations, SkillBloat achieves 5.4184x to 10.1455x average best token amplification. Ablations show that the second-stage refinement loop consistently improves over attack-type screening alone.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent 成本攻击案例扫一眼；数字夸张但问题偏部署安全，对 pretrain 只提供 threat model。
recommendation.en: Glance at it as an agent cost-attack case; the numbers are large, but the main value for pretraining is only the threat model.

paper.title: AsmEvo: Agentic Assembly-Level Optimization of AMD GPU Kernels with Functional Equivalence Verification
paper.abstract: High-performance ML systems increasingly rely on GPU kernels whose editable source is unavailable, generated, or too distant from final machine code to expose remaining optimizations. Existing LLM kernel optimizers and autotuners mainly operate on CUDA, Triton, HIP, or tensor-program source and validate against reference implementations. We study a stricter setting: optimizing an already compiled AMDGPU code object, where the deployed binary is the only behavioral oracle.   We present AsmEvo, an

summary.core_problem: 解决在缺少可编辑高层源码时，如何直接对已编译 AMD GPU kernel 二进制做安全、可验证的自动优化。
summary.importance: 这是代码智能与系统优化交叉工作。对预训练研究员的直接价值不在 kernel 本身，而在 agent 处理长时程程序编辑、验证闭环和 correctness-gated search 的设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AsmEvo：从 AMDGPU code object 恢复可重组装表示，基于长时程 agent 提议汇编级编辑，重建保持 ABI 兼容的优化对象，并仅在与原始二进制差分验证通过后接受候选。系统结合 metadata-aware rebuilding、profiling-guided hot-window editing、correctness-gated timing 和保守的 in-place patch fallback。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整 benchmark 数字，但任务设定比常见 CUDA/Triton 源码级优化更严格，因为唯一行为 oracle 是部署二进制本身。若正文实验覆盖多类 kernel 并报告稳定 speedup，这会是 agent+verifier 闭环的一个扎实系统案例；否则更像工程展示。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 AMD 和南方科技大学。AMD 背景使其在真实 GPU kernel 优化场景上有一定代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how to safely optimize compiled AMD GPU kernels when editable high-level source is unavailable and the deployed binary is the only behavioral oracle.
summary_en.importance: This sits at the intersection of coding agents and systems optimization. Its value to pretraining researchers is not the kernel domain itself, but the long-horizon program-editing loop with strict verification and correctness-gated search.
summary_en.technical_approach: AsmEvo reconstructs a reassemblable representation from an AMDGPU code object, lets a long-horizon agent propose assembly-level edits, rebuilds an ABI-preserving optimized object, and accepts candidates only after differential verification against the original binary. The system combines metadata-aware rebuilding, profiling-guided hot-window editing, correctness-gated timing, and conservative fallback patching.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full benchmark numbers, but the setting is stricter than source-level CUDA/Triton optimization because the deployed binary is the only oracle. If the full paper shows robust speedups across diverse kernels, it becomes a solid case study for agent-plus-verifier loops; otherwise it is mainly an engineering system.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include AMD and Southern University of Science and Technology. The AMD affiliation gives the work some credibility in real GPU-kernel optimization settings.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 不直接相关，但 verifier-gated long-horizon editing 这套闭环值得借到 coding agent；只看系统设计图和验证协议，性能表别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but the verifier-gated long-horizon editing loop is worth borrowing for coding agents; read the system diagram and validation protocol, not just the speedup table.

institutions: Southern University of Science and Technology

paper.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection
paper.abstract: Static analyzers have been widely adopted for vulnerability detection in C/C++ programs. Query-based static analyzers (e.g., CodeQL) encode vulnerable code patterns in detection queries and match them against source code. However, existing queries still suffer from false positives (FPs, incorrectly flagging benign code as vulnerable) and false negatives (FNs, missing real vulnerabilities). We present ARQ, an agentic framework that automatically refines C/C++ CodeQL queries using execution-ground

summary.core_problem: 自动改进 C/C++ CodeQL 漏洞检测查询，降低误报和漏报。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个 execution-grounded 的 coding/security agent 循环：用合成程序的真实执行行为给查询 refinement 提供监督信号。它对代码 agent 的自举式验证有参考价值，但任务集中在 CodeQL 安全查询。
summary.technical_approach: ARQ 合成 C/C++ 程序并执行，比较程序真实安全状态与 CodeQL 查询判定。如果程序有漏洞但查询未触发，则暴露 FN；如果程序安全但查询触发，则暴露 FP。随后使用 LLM 根据这些分歧修补查询，形成自动 refinement loop。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整数据规模和提升幅度。实验应围绕 C/C++ 漏洞检测查询、合成程序、执行结果与查询 verdict 的不一致展开，并与既有 query refining 方法比较误报、漏报和检测质量。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Columbia University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to automatically refine C/C++ CodeQL vulnerability queries to reduce false positives and false negatives.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an execution-grounded coding/security agent loop: synthesized programs provide behavioral supervision for query refinement. This is relevant to self-verifying code agents, but the task is specialized to CodeQL-based vulnerability detection.
summary_en.technical_approach: ARQ synthesizes C/C++ programs and executes them, then compares the ground-truth behavioral outcome with the CodeQL query verdict. A vulnerable program missed by the query exposes an FN weakness, while a safe program flagged by the query exposes an FP weakness. An LLM-based loop then repairs the query using these disagreements.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full dataset sizes or improvement numbers. The evaluation appears to focus on C/C++ vulnerability queries, synthesized programs, execution-query disagreement, and comparisons against prior query-refinement methods on false positives, false negatives, and detection quality.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Columbia University.

recommendation.zh: 读方法 loop 就够了；execution disagreement 作为监督信号干净，但 CodeQL/C++ 场景太窄，不宜外推到通用代码模型。
recommendation.en: Read the refinement loop; execution disagreement is a clean supervision signal, but the CodeQL/C++ setting is too narrow to extrapolate to general code models.

paper.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
paper.abstract: Software increasingly functions as part of the scientific instrument itself, making failures in scientific code capable of compromising not only program behavior but also the evidence underlying scientific conclusions. Yet existing evaluations of coding agents largely emphasize aggregate task success, providing limited insight into why agents fail when repairing scientific software. We introduce \textbf{SWE-bench Science}, a repository-level benchmark for scientific software engineering comprisi

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 coding agent 评测过于看重总体通过率、却难以解释科学软件工程任务中失败原因的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 与 failure analysis 贡献。它把 SWE-bench 风格评测扩展到科学软件场景，并显式刻画失败机制，对理解 agent 在高专业度代码环境中的能力边界有帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 SWE-bench Science：包含 98 个 GitHub 仓库、119 个仓库级任务，覆盖 20 个科学领域，并将任务划分为 Issue-driven、Expert-exploratory、Engineering-integration 三类。除 pass@1 外，论文还总结四类常见失败机制，用于解释 agent 在科学代码修复中的薄弱点。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的关键信号是：最强代理 Claude Code with Opus-5 (max) 的 pass@1 仍低于 50%，说明科学软件工程比通用 SWE-bench 更难。实验应比较多种 coding agent 或模型配置，并按任务范式分析失败模式。对预训练研究员而言，价值主要在于知道现有代码模型在高专业知识密度仓库上的失效边界，而不是 benchmark 本身。
summary.authors_note: 机构为复旦大学与上海创新研究院。作者中可识别的资深学者是邱锡鹏，长期从事大模型与 NLP 研究。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of diagnostic evaluation for coding agents on scientific software, where aggregate success rates say little about why agents fail.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark plus failure-analysis contribution. It extends SWE-bench-style evaluation into scientific software engineering and makes failure modes explicit, which is useful for understanding agent limits in knowledge-heavy code environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces SWE-bench Science, a repository-level benchmark with 119 tasks from 98 GitHub repositories across 20 scientific domains. Tasks are grouped into Issue-driven, Expert-exploratory, and Engineering-integration paradigms. Beyond pass@1, the paper identifies four recurring failure mechanisms to characterize where coding agents break down.
summary_en.experiments: The key signal in the abstract is that even the best agent, Claude Code with Opus-5 (max), stays below 50% pass@1, suggesting scientific software engineering is substantially harder than generic SWE-style tasks. The full paper likely compares multiple coding agents and analyzes failures by task type. For a pretraining researcher, the value is mainly in understanding the failure boundary of current code models in high-specialization repositories rather than in the benchmark itself.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions are Fudan University and Shanghai Innovation Institute. Xipeng Qiu is a recognizable senior researcher in NLP and foundation models.

recommendation.zh: 这是评测资产，不直接改 pretrain；看任务分型和 failure taxonomy 就够，若你做代码预训练，可把它当高知识密度仓库分布的弱代理信号。
recommendation.en: This is an eval asset, not a pretraining paper; read the task taxonomy and failure modes, and treat it as a weak proxy for how code pretraining fails in knowledge-dense repositories.

paper.title: Loreley: Repository-Scale Program Evolution with Quality-Diversity Search
paper.abstract: Sequential agent search accumulates changes from its current champion but discards alternative branches; independent proposals preserve breadth but restart from the root. Loreley instead retains complete repository states in a Quality-Diversity (QD) archive and samples them as parents or supplies them as context for later edits. Candidates are Git commits produced in isolated worktrees and judged by a project-supplied evaluator. We compare configured Loreley QD, sequential champion editing, and

summary.core_problem: 改进仓库级代码演化中的搜索策略，避免 sequential agent 只沿当前最优分支前进、independent proposals 又每次从根状态重启的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 coding agent / repository-scale search 方法工作。贡献是把 Quality-Diversity archive 用作代码状态记忆和分支选择机制，探索 agent test-time search 的状态管理问题。与 LLM 基座预训练关系间接。
summary.technical_approach: Loreley 将完整 repository state 存入 Quality-Diversity archive，后续候选可以从 archive 中采样父状态，或把 archive 状态作为编辑上下文。每个候选是隔离 worktree 中的 Git commit，并由项目提供的 evaluator 打分。
summary.experiments: 主要实验是 Zstandard 仓库上的 matched comparison：7 个 paired blocks，每个 policy 和 block 各 48 个物理候选任务，总计 1,008 个候选。比较 configured Loreley QD、sequential champion editing 和 independent root proposals。48 jobs 时，QD 比 Sequential Champion 低 0.135%，95% BCa paired interval 为 -0.556% 到 +0.161%；比 Independent Root 高 0.320%，区间为 -0.082% 到 +0.686%。效果区间跨零，结论应保守解读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses repository-scale program evolution, where sequential agent search overcommits to the current champion and independent proposals lose continuity by restarting from the root.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent search method. Its contribution is using a Quality-Diversity archive as a memory of repository states and as a source of future branches. The connection to LLM pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: Loreley stores complete repository states in a Quality-Diversity archive. Later candidates can sample archived states as parents or use them as context for edits. Each candidate is a Git commit produced in an isolated worktree and judged by a project-provided evaluator.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiment is a matched Zstandard study with seven paired blocks, 48 physical candidate jobs per policy and block, and 1,008 total candidates. It compares configured Loreley QD, sequential champion editing, and independent root proposals. At 48 jobs, QD is 0.135% below Sequential Champion with a 95% BCa interval of -0.556% to +0.161%, and 0.320% above Independent Root with an interval of -0.082% to +0.686%. The intervals cross zero, so the empirical claim is weak.

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计和置信区间即可；QD archive 是合理 search prior，但当前 Zstandard 结果还不能证明优于 sequential champion。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental design and confidence intervals; the QD archive is a plausible search prior, but the Zstandard result does not prove superiority over sequential champion editing.

paper.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large language model agents have made substantial progress in code generation, yet most existing systems assume a predefined repository architecture. This assumption does not hold in zero-to-all code generation, where an agent must construct an entire software project directly from natural-language requirements while maintaining a modular repository architecture throughout development. We present Repo0, a continuous structural evolution framework for zero-to-all code generation. Repo0 maintains

summary.core_problem: 解决从自然语言需求直接生成完整软件仓库时，代码代理缺少可持续维护的仓库架构表示这一问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 方法改进。它把“先有架构、再写代码”的软件工程约束显式放进代理循环，对仓库级代码生成有一定参考价值，但距离 LLM 基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Repo0，一个连续结构演化框架。方法维护 Dual-DAG 架构状态，包括需求级 DAG、组件级 DAG 以及二者的对齐关系；从自然语言需求出发，使用结构动作和模块化指标迭代调整组件边界，待结构收敛后再用收敛架构指导测试驱动代码生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在 6 个真实世界仓库上评估 Repo0，但给出的片段未包含完整数据集名称、模型规模、基线、指标或提升幅度。可确认的实验重点是 zero-to-all repository generation，而不是单文件代码补全。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets zero-to-all code generation, where an agent must build an entire software repository from natural-language requirements without assuming a predefined architecture.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a coding-agent method rather than a pretraining result. It is useful as a structured repository-generation design, but its direct signal for foundation-model pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: Repo0 maintains an explicit architectural state as a Dual-DAG: a requirement-level DAG, a component-level DAG, and an alignment relation between them. It iteratively applies structural actions guided by modularity metrics until the architecture converges, then uses the converged structure to guide test-driven code generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states evaluation on six real-world repositories, but the provided text does not expose the full benchmark names, model sizes, baselines, metrics, or quantitative gains. The experimental setting is repository-level zero-to-all generation rather than local code completion.

recommendation.zh: 可看 Dual-DAG 的状态设计；对预训练没有直接动作，更多是代码代理工程里的结构先验。
recommendation.en: Skim the Dual-DAG state design; it offers a useful coding-agent prior, but no direct pretraining action.

paper.title: Compiler-Guided Adaptive Proof Search with Cross-Model Synergy on Context-Dependent Theorem Proving
paper.abstract: Theorem proving in real-world Lean 4 projects is challenging because proofs often depend on project-specific context. While iterative refinement can use compiler errors to repair failed proofs, reusing failed attempts requires careful search control: some proofs provide better starting points than others, and later revisions may degrade a partially correct proof. We propose a compiler-guided proof search framework that balances exploration and exploitation. It explores diverse starting points th

summary.core_problem: 解决真实 Lean 4 项目中上下文相关定理证明的搜索效率问题，尤其是如何利用失败证明和编译器错误而不让迭代修复退化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是方法改进。定理证明是代码智能和形式化推理的硬任务，编译器反馈提供了可验证训练/搜索信号；这类工作对理解 test-time search、verifier-guided generation 和代码推理系统有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出编译器引导的自适应证明搜索框架，在探索和利用之间做控制。探索侧使用双模型生成和停滞触发重采样获得多样起点；利用侧保留当前最优证明状态，并通过编译器 grounded 的 pairwise comparison 选择更有希望的修复方向。
summary.experiments: 在 miniCTX-v2 的 7 个真实 Lean 4 项目上评测。相比 pass@k 基线，在 pass@32 预算内平均通过率提升 12.8 个百分点，同时 LLM 调用数减少 21.9%，体现了更好的效果-效率折中。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Rochester。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses search efficiency for context-dependent theorem proving in real Lean 4 projects, where proofs depend on project-specific definitions and failed attempts must be reused carefully.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution. Theorem proving is a hard setting for code reasoning, and compiler feedback provides a verifiable signal for test-time search and repair.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses compiler-guided adaptive proof search. It explores diverse starting points through dual-model generation and stagnation-triggered resampling, while exploiting promising states via current-best refinement guided by compiler-grounded pairwise comparison.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on seven real Lean 4 projects from miniCTX-v2. Under a pass@32 budget, the method improves average pass rate by 12.8 percentage points and reduces LLM calls by 21.9% compared with pass@k baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Rochester.

recommendation.zh: 作为 verifier-guided test-time search 例子可备查；只看搜索控制逻辑和 pass@32 预算对比即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a verifier-guided test-time search case study; skim the search-control design and the pass@32 efficiency comparison.

paper.title: SkillForge: Self-Distilling Agents for Project-Specific Issue Resolution
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) based agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in automated software issue resolution, yet they often struggle to resolve issues in a specific repository because they lack project-specific knowledge. Existing self-evolving approaches acquire such knowledge from repository history or online repair trajectories, but they either depend on available historical issue-resolution signals or incur substantial per-issue test-time exploration cost. In this paper, we propo

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 软件工程 agent 在特定代码仓库中缺少项目知识，导致 issue resolution 能力不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 方法改进：不依赖历史 issue 修复记录，也尽量避免每个真实 issue 都做高成本在线探索，而是提前从仓库自身合成训练信号并沉淀为可复用技能。
summary.technical_approach: SkillForge 通过重新实现测试覆盖的核心功能来合成项目特定 issue；agent 解决这些合成 issue 后，将得到的经验自蒸馏为 entity-grounded skills，并把技能关联到仓库实体，供后续真实 issue 检索和复用。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体 benchmark、仓库数量、模型配置、token/轨迹成本或相对 SWE-agent 类 baseline 的提升幅度；只能确认目标场景是 repository-specific issue resolution。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the lack of project-specific knowledge in LLM-based software engineering agents for resolving issues in a particular repository.
summary_en.importance: It is a coding-agent method contribution: instead of relying on historical issue-resolution data or expensive per-issue online exploration, it proactively creates repository-specific learning signals and distills them into reusable skills.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillForge synthesizes project-specific issues by re-implementing test-covered core functionality. The agent solves these synthetic issues, then self-distills the resulting experience into entity-grounded skills linked to relevant repository entities for later retrieval and reuse.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report benchmark names, number of repositories, model sizes, trajectory costs, or quantitative gains over SWE-agent-style baselines. It only specifies repository-specific issue resolution as the target setting.

recommendation.zh: 思路像 repo 级离线 RL 数据制造；不必细读，确认合成 issue 是否真的覆盖真实维护知识即可。
recommendation.en: It resembles offline data generation for repo-level agents; skim only to check whether synthetic issues actually capture maintainers’ real knowledge.

paper.title: LEGO-RL: Harness-Native Reinforcement Learning for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for coding agents increasingly relies on long-running agent harnesses to manage tool integration, repository contexts, and execution feedback. However, the native execution environments of these harnesses are inherently misaligned with policy-gradient training: environmental crashes and reward hacking corrupt outcome signals, while train-inference discrepancies decouple rollout behavior from policy updates. To address this, we present LEGO-RL, a framework that bridges nati

summary.core_problem: 在为代码 Agent 进行强化学习（RL）训练时，原生的 Agent 运行框架（harness）与策略梯度训练之间存在严重的不匹配：环境崩溃和奖励作弊会破坏训练信号，而训练和推理时的差异（如历史重写、MoE 路由不一致）会导致概率重新计算不准确，从而破坏策略更新。
summary.importance: 提供了一个通用的、非侵入式的 RL 训练框架，能够将现有的原生代码 Agent 框架（如 SWE-agent、Claude Code 等）直接接入可扩展的策略梯度优化流程中，解决了长周期 Agent 训练中的执行可靠性和训练保真度问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Lego-RL 框架，核心包含三大支柱：1) 忠实优化（Faithful optimization）：通过进程内 LLM 代理捕获原始生成流，实现 token 级别的对齐和准确的训练端 log-p 重新计算，并重放 MoE 模型的推理期路由决策；2) 可靠执行（Reliable execution）：通过可扩展的沙盒编排、镜像缓存和分阶段防御保护奖励完整性，并过滤失败轨迹；3) 可观测训练（Observable training）：提供自动化验证、实时监控和轨迹级诊断。
summary.experiments: 在 OpenHands SDK、Claude Code 和 OpenCode 上使用稀疏 MoE 策略进行了评估。在 SWE-bench Verified 数据集上，Lego-RL 使三个框架的解决率分别从 64.0% 提升至 70.4%、62.4% 提升至 68.2%、57.2% 提升至 66.6%，同时保持 rollout 和训练概率相关性在 0.99 以上。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 3 对 Lego-RL 框架三大支柱的详细阐述，特别是 3.2.2 节中关于如何通过 LLM 代理解决历史重写导致的概率计算不一致问题。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When training coding agents with Reinforcement Learning (RL), there is a severe mismatch between native agent harnesses and policy-gradient training: environmental crashes and reward hacking corrupt training signals, while train-inference discrepancies (e.g., history rewriting, inconsistent MoE routing) lead to inaccurate probability recomputation, undermining policy updates.
summary_en.importance: Provides a general, non-intrusive RL training framework that seamlessly integrates existing native coding agent harnesses (e.g., SWE-agent, Claude Code) into scalable policy-gradient optimization pipelines, addressing execution reliability and training fidelity issues in long-horizon agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Lego-RL framework, built on three pillars: 1) Faithful optimization: uses an in-process LLM proxy to capture raw generation streams for token-level alignment and accurate trainer-side log-p recomputation, and replays rollout-time routing decisions for MoE models; 2) Reliable execution: protects reward integrity via scalable sandbox orchestration, image caching, and stage-wise defenses, while filtering failed trajectories; 3) Observable training: provides automated validation, real-time monitoring, and trajectory-level diagnostics.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on OpenHands SDK, Claude Code, and OpenCode using a sparse MoE policy. On SWE-bench Verified, Lego-RL improved resolve rates from 64.0% to 70.4%, 62.4% to 68.2%, and 57.2% to 66.6% across the three harnesses, respectively, while maintaining a rollout-training probability correlation above 0.99.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for a detailed explanation of Lego-RL's three pillars, especially Section 3.2.2 on how the LLM proxy solves probability inconsistencies caused by history rewriting. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“原生 agent 环境怎么接 RL”这件脏活讲得比较实；只看对齐 log-prob 和防 reward hacking 的实现细节，别先信总分。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is useful if you care about the messy interface between native agent environments and RL; read the log-prob alignment and anti-reward-hacking parts, not the headline scores.

paper.title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks
paper.abstract: Repository-scale coding requires an agent to keep tests, imports, configuration, and migration rules consistent within a bounded context window. We model this as reconstructing a coupled-fact graph: at each edit, a required fact comes from recent context or parametric memory, and the facts covered by neither form coherence debt. We supply and withhold each channel and inject faults across seven models and five harnesses. As expected, no model completes a task on an unseen API with both channels

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 repository-scale coding agent 的一个很具体也很关键的问题：模型在做跨文件修改时，真正决定成败的不是“上下文长不长”或“会不会分解任务”，而是编辑当下所需的耦合事实是否可用。作者把这些事实的可用来源分成两条通道：最近上下文中的 read-derived facts，以及模型参数里已经记住的 parametric memory。若某个必要事实两条通道都覆盖不到，就形成 coherence debt，模型会在不完整世界模型下继续写代码，导致局部看似合理、全局却不一致的补丁。论文要回答的是：这两条通道能否互相替代，缺失事实到底造成多大损失，以及现有基于“读了什么”的诊断方法为什么经常看不清真正的问题。
summary.importance: 对 coding agent 评测和训练都有启发。第一，它把 repository-level coding 失败从笼统的“上下文不够”“检索不准”收缩成一个更可操作的因果对象：edit-time fact availability。这个视角比单纯统计读取轨迹更接近真正的错误来源。第二，它说明 parametric memory 与显式上下文之间存在强替代关系，因此很多在熟悉仓库或熟悉 API 上看起来有效的 agent 策略，可能只是吃到了模型记忆，而不是工作流设计真的合理。第三，它指出 read-derived instrumentation 有系统性盲点：模型缺事实时不会停下来，而是会猜、会编、会继续行动，所以仅看读取行为会低估短缺、也会误判 harness 设计。对预训练研究者来说，这篇论文虽然不直接讲 pretrain，但它触到一个很重要的接口：模型参数里到底记住了什么、这些记忆如何与外部上下文替代、以及 benchmark 是否在无意中把 parametric prior 当成了 agent 能力。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出一个两通道、编辑时刻的工作集框架。每次编辑都依赖一组 coupled facts，例如某个 rename 需要同步 imports、tests、config、migration rule。事实来源要么是近期上下文，要么是参数记忆。若都没有覆盖，就产生 coherence debt。这个框架的好处是把 repository coherence 从模糊概念变成可干预对象。

实验设计很讲究控制变量。第一组是四个虚构 API migration 任务，每个任务有 12 条可机械校验的 requirement。closed-book 条件下不给 workspace 和 tools，等于把两条通道都尽量清空；matched front-loaded 条件则把精确规则和源码直接放进 prompt，模型和工具面保持不变，用来测试“上下文能否替代记忆”。第二组是真实 Pydantic migration，有 79 个测试；再构造一个 twin 版本，把所有 API 名称重命名，使模型原有记忆失效，用来隔离 parametric memory 的作用。第三组是在 tool-using 轨迹中测量：编辑某个文件前，agent 是否在短时间内读过它依赖的事实。第四组是作者自己构造的 synthetic tasks，因为所需事实完全已知，可以做 fault injection，精确测量缺某个事实会损失哪部分工作。

论文还有两个很有意思的边界分析。其一，availability 不是唯一决定因素：当 written standard 和 working code 冲突时，agent 会系统性偏向书面规范，即使代码才是更好的指导。这说明“事实被看见”不等于“事实被正确加权”。其二，任务分解不是天然有益：若任务耦合紧，拆给 subagents 反而会把相互依赖的事实切断，造成额外 coherence debt。作者还比较了不同 harness 的 token 成本，发现达到同样测试通过率时，系统开销可差到 12.8 倍，但前台持有上下文只差 1.8 倍，说明很多昂贵设计并没有换来更好的事实覆盖。
summary.experiments:
最关键的结果有五个。第一，在四个虚构 migration 上，154 次 closed-book 试验里没有任何模型能完成任务；而把同样事实前置到 prompt 后，300 次匹配试验里有 299 次至少满足 12 条要求中的 9 条。这几乎是直接证明：上下文中的事实可以替代缺失的参数记忆。第二，在真实 Pydantic migration 的重命名版本上，7 个模型里有 66/70 次试验停在同一个分数，并且通过的是完全相同的 24/79 个测试，说明当记忆失效后，失败位置高度一致，决定因素是事实可用性而不是模型风格差异。第三，作者声称损害与缺失事实支持的工作量呈线性关系：拿走哪个事实，就精确损失它支撑的那部分修改，不会无端扩散到别处。第四，距离本身不是问题：只要事实被提供，即便放在 128,000 字符上下文的远端，模型使用它的可靠性也接近放在编辑点附近。第五，不同 harness 在全部通过测试的配置下，token 消耗相差 12.8×，但并未在事实被 withholding 时恢复额外能力，说明很多系统成本只是为同样结果付更高价。

还有两个负结果同样重要。其一，在 39 次冲突试验中，agent 一律跟随书面标准而非现有正确代码，说明覆盖不等于判别。其二，这套框架在 SWE-bench 上不再直接成立，因为模型可能已经记住仓库，且任务结构观测过粗，导致“读了什么”不再预测成功与否。作者没有把自己的诊断硬推广到所有真实仓库，这一点比较克制。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先抓三部分。第一是 Introduction 和实验设计，弄清楚 coupled-fact graph、two-channel availability、coherence debt 这三个概念，否则后面结果会显得零散。第二是 closed-book / front-loaded / renamed migration 这三组干预实验，它们是全文最有说服力的因果证据。第三是关于 harness cost、subagent decomposition 和 conflicting facts 的分析，这些部分决定这篇论文不只是一个 coding benchmark 观察，而是在讨论 agent 系统设计的代价与边界。

如果时间有限，优先看主实验图表和作者总结的五个 claim，大约 35 分钟能抓住核心。若要深读，建议重点看 synthetic task 与 fault injection 的构造方式，以及作者为什么说 read-derived instruments 无法测到它们想测的 shortfall。这部分对设计更可靠的 coding-agent 诊断工具很有帮助。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a precise failure mode in repository-scale coding agents: when an agent edits code across files, success is determined less by raw context length or decomposition and more by whether the coupled facts required at edit time are actually available. The authors model fact availability through two channels: recent context obtained by reading or prompt supply, and parametric memory already stored in the model. If a required fact is covered by neither channel, the agent incurs coherence debt and writes from an incomplete view of the repository, producing patches that may look locally plausible but are globally inconsistent. The central question is how these two channels substitute for each other, how much damage missing facts cause, and why read-based diagnostics often fail to reveal the real bottleneck.
summary_en.importance: This is useful for both coding-agent evaluation and training. First, it reframes repository-level failure from vague claims about insufficient context or weak retrieval into a more causal object: edit-time fact availability. That is a sharper target for diagnosis. Second, it shows strong substitution between parametric memory and explicit context, which means many apparently successful agent strategies on familiar repositories or APIs may simply be benefiting from memorized knowledge rather than sound workflow design. Third, it exposes a systematic blind spot in read-derived instrumentation: when facts are missing, agents usually do not stop; they guess, fabricate, and continue. As a result, measuring what the agent read can underestimate the shortfall and mislead harness design. For pretraining researchers, the paper matters because it touches the interface between what is stored in parameters, what must be supplied externally, and how benchmarks can accidentally conflate memorized priors with genuine agent competence.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core framework is a two-channel, edit-time working-set model for repository coherence. Each edit depends on a set of coupled facts, such as imports, tests, configuration rules, migration constraints, or naming conventions. Those facts can come either from recent context or from parametric memory. If neither channel covers a required fact, the edit carries coherence debt. This turns repository coherence from a loose intuition into something that can be manipulated experimentally.

The experimental design is unusually controlled. The first setup uses four fictional API migration tasks, each with 12 mechanically checkable requirements. In the closed-book condition, the model gets the task description but no workspace and no tools, effectively emptying both channels. In the matched front-loaded condition, the exact rules and source files are placed in the prompt while keeping the model and tool surface fixed, isolating whether explicit context can substitute for missing memory. The second setup uses a real Pydantic migration with 79 tests, plus a renamed twin where all API names are changed so that memorized library knowledge becomes useless. This isolates the role of parametric memory. The third setup instruments tool-using trajectories by checking whether the agent read the dependencies of an edited file shortly before editing. The fourth uses synthetic tasks authored by the researchers, where the required facts are fully known, enabling precise fault injection and attribution.

Two boundary findings are especially important. Availability is not sufficient on its own: when written standards conflict with working code, agents systematically follow the written standard even when the code is the better guide. So seeing a fact is not the same as weighting it correctly. Also, decomposition is not automatically helpful: if the task is tightly coupled, splitting it across subagents can sever dependencies and create additional coherence debt. The paper also compares harnesses and finds that some configurations spend far more tokens for the same end result, without improving fact coverage.
summary_en.experiments:
There are five main empirical results. First, on the four fictional migrations, none of the 154 closed-book trials succeeds, while front-loading the exact facts into the prompt lifts 299 of 300 matched trials to at least 9 out of 12 requirements. This is strong evidence that explicit context can substitute for missing parametric knowledge. Second, on the renamed version of the real Pydantic migration, 66 of 70 trials across seven models end at the same score and pass the exact same 24 of 79 tests. Once memorized knowledge is neutralized, failures become highly aligned, suggesting that availability rather than model style determines the outcome. Third, the damage from withholding facts is reported to be linear in the work those facts support: removing a fact costs exactly the edits it enables and no more. Fourth, distance itself is not the issue: when a fact is supplied, models use it about as reliably at the far end of a 128,000-character context as when it is placed near the edit. Fifth, harnesses can differ by 12.8x in total token consumption while holding only 1.8x different amounts of context in front of the model at any moment, and the more expensive setups recover no extra capability when facts are withheld.

Two negative results matter as much. In 39 conflict trials, agents consistently follow written standards over contradictory but working code, showing that coverage does not guarantee correct arbitration. And the framework does not transfer cleanly to SWE-bench, where models likely already know the repositories and the task structure is observed only coarsely, so reading behavior no longer predicts success. The paper is careful not to overclaim universality beyond its controlled workloads.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and experimental design carefully to internalize the three key concepts: coupled-fact graph, two-channel availability, and coherence debt. Without them, the results can look like a collection of coding-agent anecdotes. Second, prioritize the closed-book, front-loaded, and renamed-migration interventions. These are the strongest causal pieces of evidence in the paper. Third, read the sections on harness cost, subagent decomposition, and conflicting facts, because they show that the paper is really about the design limits of coding-agent systems, not just benchmark behavior.

If time is limited, the main figures and the five headline claims are enough to capture the argument in about 35 minutes. For a deeper read, spend time on the synthetic-task construction and the fault-injection analysis, especially the argument that read-derived instruments cannot measure the shortfall they are intended to detect. That part is useful if you care about building better diagnostics for repository-scale agents.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的价值在于把“代码 Agent 不会做”拆成“事实拿不到”；先看 rename 故障和 distance 无关那组结果，它会直接影响你对 parametric memory 与 context engineering 的判断。
recommendation.en: The useful move here is separating 'can't reason' from 'can't access the needed fact'; read the rename failure and distance-invariant results first—they sharpen how you think about parametric memory vs. context.

paper.title: Procedural Content Metageneration via Program Search and Continual Abstraction Discovery
paper.abstract: Large language models can generate executable programs, which makes it possible to search directly over procedural content generators rather than individual levels. We study this approach in Sokoban, Zelda, Dangerous Dave, and Lode Runner. Each run evolves complete Python generators through language-model mutation and crossover. We introduce Continual Abstraction Discovery, or CAD, which extracts reusable primitives from high-fitness programs into a run-specific helper module. A 2x2 experiment c

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 生成可执行程序后，是否可以直接搜索程序化内容生成器，并在搜索过程中自动发现可复用抽象。
summary.importance: 贡献是程序搜索和代码生成搜索空间管理方法，不是 LLM 预训练。对基座研究员的间接价值在于：它把“持续发现库函数/抽象”作为搜索效率提升机制，和代码 Agent、自动化实验、latent tool discovery 有一定关系。
summary.technical_approach: 方法在 Sokoban、Zelda、Dangerous Dave、Lode Runner 中用语言模型 mutation 和 crossover 演化完整 Python 生成器。Continual Abstraction Discovery 会从高 fitness 程序中抽取 reusable primitives，放入 run-specific helper module，后续程序可以复用这些工具；实验还交叉考察是否提供固定手写 domain API。
summary.experiments: 完成 160 个完整 runs，每个 2x2 条件至少 10 个 50-generation runs。CAD 在 8 个 domain/API 比较中都提高 mean final best fitness；在 CAD runs 中，学习到的 libraries 被多数后续程序采用，并反复发现 validation、reachability 和 structural utilities。
summary.authors_note: Julian Togelius 是游戏 AI 与 procedural content generation 方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs can search directly over executable procedural content generators, and whether reusable abstractions can be discovered continuously during that search.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a program-search and code-generation search-space method, not an LLM pretraining result. Its indirect value is the treatment of continual library or abstraction discovery as a mechanism for improving search efficiency, which connects to coding agents, automated experimentation, and latent tool discovery.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system evolves full Python generators for Sokoban, Zelda, Dangerous Dave, and Lode Runner using language-model mutation and crossover. Continual Abstraction Discovery extracts reusable primitives from high-fitness programs into a run-specific helper module that later programs can use. A 2x2 design tests CAD with and without access to a fixed hand-written domain API.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 160 complete runs, with at least ten 50-generation runs in every condition. CAD improves mean final best fitness in all eight domain/API comparisons. In CAD runs, learned libraries are adopted by most later programs and repeatedly rediscover validation, reachability, and structural utilities.
