summary_en.authors_note: Julian Togelius is a well-known researcher in game AI and procedural content generation.

recommendation.zh: 读 CAD 抽象发现机制即可；它不是预训练论文，但对代码 Agent 的长期记忆和工具生长有弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the CAD abstraction-discovery mechanism; not a pretraining paper, but it gives a weak signal for long-term memory and tool growth in coding agents.

paper.title: Beyond Pass@k: Measuring Reliability and Security of Agentic Code Generation
paper.abstract: AI coding agent benchmarks rank agents with the Chen et al. (2021) pass@k estimator, but current implementations misapply it: they set n to the number of unit tests in a single submission rather than the number of independent rollout attempts, conflating test-suite size with attempt independence. We diagnose this operationalization error, prove it by counterexample, and propose reliability@k, the same estimator applied correctly, with n = independent rollouts and c = fully-passing rollouts per (

summary.core_problem: 当前 AI Coding Agent 评测中广泛使用的 pass@k 指标存在实现错误，导致分数虚高，且无法反映功能正确性与安全性之间的关系。
summary.importance: 指出了 Agent 评测中一个普遍存在且影响深远的指标误用问题，提出了修正后的 reliability@k 和 security-adjusted reliability@k，对规范代码 Agent 评测具有重要意义。
summary.technical_approach: 分析了当前评测框架（如 SWE-bench 等）在计算 pass@k 时，错误地将单次提交中的单元测试数量作为 $n$，混淆了测试套件大小与尝试独立性。提出 reliability@k，正确地将 $n$ 设为独立 rollout 次数，$c$ 设为完全通过的 rollout 次数。进一步提出 security-adjusted reliability@k，要求 rollout 同时满足功能正确和无高危安全漏洞。
summary.experiments: 在合成的多 rollout benchmark 上，误用的指标将分数绝对值夸大了 0.85-0.97。廉价的单次 rollout 代理指标无法替代重复运行（Spearman $\rho = 0.417$）。

summary_en.core_problem: The widely used pass@k metric in current AI coding agent evaluations is misimplemented, leading to inflated scores and failing to capture the relationship between functional correctness and security.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a pervasive and impactful metric misuse in agent evaluation, proposing corrected reliability@k and security-adjusted reliability@k, which is crucial for standardizing coding agent benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes how current evaluation frameworks erroneously use the number of unit tests in a single submission as $n$ when calculating pass@k, conflating test suite size with attempt independence. Proposes reliability@k, correctly setting $n$ to the number of independent rollouts and $c$ to the number of fully-passing rollouts. Further proposes security-adjusted reliability@k, requiring rollouts to be both functionally correct and free of high-severity vulnerabilities.
summary_en.experiments: On a synthetic multi-rollout benchmark, the misapplied metric inflates absolute scores by 0.85-0.97. A cheap single-rollout proxy fails to substitute for repeated runs (Spearman $\rho = 0.417$).

recommendation.zh: 指出了代码 Agent 评测中 pass@k 指标的严重误用，修正后的 reliability@k 更严谨，做 coding agent 评测的必看。
recommendation.en: Identifies a severe misuse of pass@k in coding agent eval; the corrected reliability@k is more rigorous. A must-read for those working on coding agent benchmarks.

paper.title: TDD-Agent: Test-Driven Reasoning for Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in code generation, yet ensuring correctness in complex, repository-level tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches often use generated tests as static post-hoc validators, which limits their ability to guide implementation and may introduce misleading feedback when the tests themselves are incomplete or incorrect. In this paper, we introduce TDD-Agent, which operationalizes the test-driven development paradigm for code generati

summary.core_problem: 在代码生成任务中，现有的基于测试的方法通常将生成的测试用作事后验证器（post-hoc validators），这限制了测试指导实现的能力，且当测试本身不完整或错误时，会引入误导性反馈。特别是在复杂的仓库级（repository-level）任务中，这种局限性更加明显。
summary.importance: 本文将测试驱动开发（TDD）范式引入 LLM 代码生成，提出 TDD-Agent。这不仅是一种新的 Agent 架构，更展示了“测试先行（test-first）”推理如何作为一种可执行的中间表示，帮助模型在编写代码前明确意图和边界条件，对提升复杂代码生成的正确性有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: TDD-Agent 采用单智能体框架，包含两个阶段：1. 测试设计阶段：Agent 利用工具提取仓库上下文，理解目标函数需求，并生成初始单元测试套件。这一步强制模型在实现逻辑前消除需求歧义并定义行为边界。2. 迭代执行与细化阶段：Agent 基于初始测试生成代码，执行测试并获取反馈。如果测试失败，Agent 可以同时修改代码和测试（dual-track refinement），而不是像以往方法那样将测试视为不可变的约束。
summary.experiments: 在函数级基准（LiveCodeBench）和仓库级基准（RepoEval）上进行了评估。结果表明，TDD-Agent 显著优于基线方法。在 LiveCodeBench 上，轻量级的 TDD-prompt 变体证明了测试先行推理的有效性；在 RepoEval 上，TDD-Agent 框架展示了在需要仓库导航和依赖理解的复杂任务中的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Methodology 部分关于 TDD-Agent 工作流的描述（特别是图 2），理解其如何实现代码和测试的双向迭代细化。此外，实验部分在 RepoEval 上的结果值得关注，这展示了该方法在复杂场景下的潜力。预计阅读时间 15-20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In code generation tasks, existing test-based approaches often use generated tests as static post-hoc validators, limiting their ability to guide implementation and potentially introducing misleading feedback when tests are flawed, especially in complex repository-level tasks.
summary_en.importance: This paper introduces TDD-Agent, operationalizing the Test-Driven Development (TDD) paradigm for LLM code generation. It highlights how "test-first" reasoning serves as an executable intermediate representation, helping models clarify intent and boundary conditions before coding, offering significant insights for improving correctness in complex code generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: TDD-Agent employs a single-agent framework with a two-phase workflow: 1. Test Design Phase: The agent uses tools to extract repository context, understand target function requirements, and generate an initial unit test suite, forcing the model to disambiguate requirements and define behavioral boundaries before implementation. 2. Iterative Execution and Refinement Phase: The agent generates code based on initial tests, executes them, and receives feedback. Crucially, if tests fail, the agent can refine both code and tests (dual-track refinement), unlike prior methods that treat tests as immutable constraints.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on function-level (LiveCodeBench) and repository-level (RepoEval) benchmarks. Results show TDD-Agent significantly outperforms baselines. On LiveCodeBench, a lightweight TDD-prompt variant isolates the effect of test-first reasoning; on RepoEval, the full framework demonstrates its advantage in complex tasks requiring repository navigation and dependency understanding.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methodology section detailing the TDD-Agent workflow (especially Figure 2) to understand the dual-track refinement of code and tests. The experimental results on RepoEval are also key to grasping the method's potential in complex scenarios. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做代码LLM后训练或Agent的可重点看§3的双轨迭代设计，纯基座预训练研究员仅需知道TDD先验能稳定提分。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on code LLM post-training or agents should focus on the dual-track refinement design in §3; pure pretrain researchers only need to note consistent gains from test-first priors.

paper.title: ATLAS: Scaffold-Free Algorithm Synthesis by LLMs via Embedding-Guided Quality-Diversity Search
paper.abstract: Most LLM-based automated algorithm design methods optimize a designated component within a human-specified scaffold, fixing overall organization and component interactions. We present ATLAS, an embedding-guided quality-diversity framework for scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis in combinatorial optimization. The problem specification supplies objectives and constraints; a minimal I/O interface fixes only instance and solution formats; the LLM chooses and restructures components, interactions,

summary.core_problem: 解决现有基于LLM的自动算法设计方法依赖人工指定算法脚手架、限制整体结构与组件交互搜索空间的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出无脚手架的全算法合成框架，结合质量多样性搜索与嵌入引导，扩大组合优化算法的设计空间探索范围。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ATLAS三层搜索框架：仅固定问题I/O格式，由LLM自由选择/重组算法组件、交互与控制流；独立检测执行/接口/可行性错误并做错误条件修复；用基于嵌入相似度的档案管理维持多样性，避免过早收敛。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未完整披露所用LLM型号、组合优化任务集合、基线方法与效果量化对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation of existing LLM-based automated algorithm design methods, which optimize only components within a human-specified scaffold and fix overall algorithm organization and component interactions.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution; introduces the first scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis framework combining quality-diversity search with embedding guidance to expand the design space of combinatorial optimization algorithms.
summary_en.technical_approach: ATLAS uses a three-layer search framework with only I/O formats fixed, allowing the LLM to freely select and restructure algorithm components, interactions, and control flow. It independently detects execution/interface/feasibility failures and applies error-conditioned repair, plus similarity-based archive management to preserve diversity and avoid premature convergence.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details (LLM backbone, combinatorial optimization benchmarks, baselines, quantitative gains) are not available in the truncated abstract.

recommendation.zh: 代码Agent在组合优化领域的垂直应用，质量多样性搜索的思路可做推理时搜索的参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Vertical coding agent application for combinatorial optimization; quality-diversity search idea is a minor reference for test-time search, abstract is sufficient.

paper.title: Kozuchi Agent: A Language-Agnostic Open-Weight Agent for Software Repair
paper.abstract: Industrial software-engineering teams increasingly need LLM agents that turn bug reports into correct patches, yet benchmark-scale operation adds long horizons, tool-use discipline, context persistence, heterogeneous clusters, and evaluation reuse. We present Kozuchi Agent, a language-agnostic open-weight repair agent and CI-operated evaluation pipeline. Explicit phases, persistent state, deterministic tools, a model-independent action interface, and cross-agent test-time selection make runs aud

summary.core_problem: 工业级软件修复 Agent 需要在长程任务、工具调用纪律、上下文持久化和跨语言评估复用之间取得平衡。
summary.importance: 工程系统贡献，在 SWE-bench Verified 和 Multi-SWE-bench 上以开源 27B 模型取得强结果，核心是可审计可复现的 Agent 流水线设计。
summary.technical_approach: 显式阶段划分、持久化状态、确定性工具、模型无关动作接口，以及跨 Agent 测试时选择（cross-agent test-time selection）；不微调，本地部署 Qwen3.5-27B，TTS@8。
summary.experiments: SWE-bench Verified 374/500；Multi-SWE-bench Java 41/128（32.03%），开源权重第一、总榜第四；Python 总榜第12、开源第一；跨语言每阶段行为波动在 ±5% 内。

summary_en.core_problem: Industrial software repair agents must balance long horizons, tool-use discipline, context persistence, and cross-language evaluation reuse.
summary_en.importance: Engineering system contribution achieving strong results on SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench with an open 27B model; core is an auditable, reproducible agent pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: Explicit phases, persistent state, deterministic tools, a model-independent action interface, and cross-agent test-time selection; no fine-tuning, locally hosted Qwen3.5-27B with TTS@8.
summary_en.experiments: 374/500 on SWE-bench Verified; 41/128 (32.03%) on Multi-SWE-bench Java (first among open-weight, fourth overall); 12th on Python (first open-weight); per-phase behavior within ±5 pp across languages.

recommendation.zh: 27B 开源模型在 SWE-bench 上 374/500 的数字值得知道，但核心是工程流水线而非方法创新；cross-agent test-time selection 可作为文献备查。
recommendation.en: The 374/500 number with a 27B open model is worth knowing, but the core is engineering pipeline rather than methodological novelty; skim cross-agent test-time selection as literature reference.

paper.title: Does a Language Server Save Tokens for Coding Agents? A Measurement Methodology and Preliminary Study
paper.abstract: Coding agents spend most of their context budget on retrieval. Lexical retrieval (grep) is universal, instant, and zero-setup, but noisy: it cannot tell a definition from a call from a comment. Semantic retrieval via the Language Server Protocol (LSP) is precise and typed, but needs a running, indexed server and pays a per-symbol round-trip. The claim that semantic retrieval is more token-efficient is, we find, asserted almost everywhere and measured almost nowhere: no public source isolates the

summary.core_problem: 衡量代码 Agent 中 LSP 语义检索相比 grep 词法检索是否真的能节省上下文 token，并在相同任务成功率下隔离检索方式带来的成本差异。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测方法和测量框架。它把“语义检索更省 token”这个常见系统假设转化为 tokens-to-success 指标，并设计消融来排除任务难度、模型能力和工具开销等混杂因素。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义 tokens-to-success 作为核心指标，设计五组实验臂来分离 LSP 语义检索与 grep 词法检索的影响，并把预先声明的三类失败模式映射到可测变量。方法重点不是提出新 Agent 架构，而是给代码 Agent 工具选择建立可复现实验协议。
summary.experiments: 初步实验覆盖 Python 和 TypeScript 仓库，使用 Claude Opus 4.8、Sonnet 4.6、Haiku 4.5。摘要报告，在符号名定位任务上，LSP 往往增加 token 成本，增幅约 +6% 到 +118%；结论是条件性的，并且多数情况下不支持“LSP 自动省 token”的经验假设。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LSP-based semantic retrieval actually saves context tokens over lexical grep retrieval for coding agents when task success is held fixed.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an evaluation methodology. It turns a common systems assumption—semantic retrieval is more token-efficient—into a tokens-to-success measurement and proposes ablations to isolate retrieval effects from task and model confounds.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work defines tokens-to-success, specifies a five-arm ablation that separates LSP retrieval from lexical retrieval, and maps three pre-declared failure modes into measurable variables. The emphasis is not a new coding-agent architecture, but a cleaner protocol for tool-selection measurement.
summary_en.experiments: The preliminary study uses Python and TypeScript repositories with Claude Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, and Haiku 4.5. The abstract reports that for symbol-named localization, LSP often costs more tokens, with overheads from roughly +6% to +118%; the conclusion is conditional and usually negative.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 token-to-success 定义即可；它提醒代码 Agent 工具收益不能只按单次调用估。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol and tokens-to-success definition; it is a useful warning that coding-agent tools cannot be judged by single-call cost.

paper.title: Ontology-Grounded Project Memory for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents have become the primary means of generating new code in many software projects, and the resulting velocity of changes makes keeping track of the reasons behind those changes challenging. This paper introduces MOOSEDev, a system designed to give coding agents structured, ontology-grounded project memory. The system captures architectural decisions, lessons, constraints, and rationales in a knowledge graph exposed to agents via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface. Records carry

summary.core_problem: 解决编码 Agent 在长期项目中难以保存、检索和更新“为什么这样改”的项目记忆问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是系统设计和 Agent 记忆机制。它把项目决策、约束、经验和替代关系显式结构化，试图替代常见的向量记忆检索；对通用 LLM 预训练没有直接增益，但对代码 Agent 的长期上下文管理有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MOOSEDev，用 ontology-grounded knowledge graph 表示项目记忆，记录包含 lifecycle status、provenance、supersession links 等字段，并通过 MCP 接口暴露给编码 Agent。检索和推理依赖 MOOSE 这个 proprietary neurosymbolic engine，符号层被设为主要推理基底，而不是只把文本嵌入向量库。
summary.experiments: 在 835 条 typed records 的公开中立语料上，与生产级 vector-memory 工具比较。MOOSEDev 在 supersession、set-completeness、negation 查询上返回预期答案集的比例约为 0.98-1.00；向量检索 baseline 的 top-k 命中约为 6%-27%。实验重点是结构化记忆查询，不是端到端 SWE-bench 类代码修复能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how coding agents can preserve and query project-level memory about architectural decisions, constraints, lessons, and rationales over time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory system rather than a foundation-model training result. It is relevant to long-horizon coding agents because it tests a structured symbolic memory design against vector retrieval, but it has little direct impact on LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MOOSEDev stores project memory as an ontology-grounded knowledge graph with lifecycle status, provenance, and supersession links. The memory is exposed through an MCP interface, and queried through the proprietary MOOSE neurosymbolic engine, where symbolic structure is treated as the main reasoning substrate instead of an auxiliary retrieval layer.
summary_en.experiments: The system is compared with a production vector-memory baseline on a public corpus of 835 typed records. MOOSEDev reportedly recovers nearly the full expected answer set, around 0.98-1.00, on supersession, set-completeness, and negation queries, while the vector baseline surfaces only 6%-27% in top-k retrieval. The evaluation is retrieval-centric, not an end-to-end coding-agent benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 作为编码 Agent 长期记忆设计备查即可；proprietary engine 和非端到端评测让结论难外推。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for long-term coding-agent memory, but the proprietary engine and non-end-to-end setup make the result hard to generalize.

paper.title: Specification-first convergence with an AI coding agent: a case study of dismantling a core architectural invariant across 189 files in a 717k-line codebase with no test oracle and no human code review
paper.abstract: This paper reports a single, fully instrumented case study of a large-scale architectural refactoring by an AI coding agent under a specification-first protocol, with no human review of the generated code and no pre-existing oracle to validate the target behaviour. The task, dismantling a central invariant across a large interdependent codebase, was assessed by the author as effectively infeasible through incremental refactoring, the kind of change that conventionally calls for a rewrite instead

summary.core_problem: 现有AI编码Agent的评估依赖测试预言与人工审查，但跨数百依赖文件、无预设目标行为测试的大规模架构重构任务会导致人工审查失效、现有评估范式不适用。
summary.importance: 提示编码Agent的能力边界不止取决于基座模型的代码能力，还受执行协议设计、约束系统规模的影响；同时面向长程跨文件代码任务的预训练数据与评估设计，需要覆盖无测试预言的架构重构场景，而非仅局限于有测试的issue修复。
summary.technical_approach: 采用spec-first执行协议，核心逻辑是将质量控制从代码生成后转移到生成前：先反复打磨书面规格说明并对照源码校验至无问题后冻结，再让Agent基于冻结规格生成补丁而非直接写文件，最后用无生成记忆的同模型新会话对照冻结规格审计结果，配套约25万字符的系统提示积累数百条失败规则以减少人工干预。
summary.experiments: 单案例压力测试显示，在71.7万行、3648个文件的生产级TypeScript应用中，Agent3天内完成了涉及189个文件的核心生命周期不变量拆除任务，全程无人工代码审查与预设测试预言，而该任务传统上被认为只能通过重写完成。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注审查瓶颈的问题定义、spec-first协议的三个核心步骤、与loop engineering模式的对比；预计阅读时间20-30分钟，可重点留意冻结规格作为唯一审计参照的设计逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI coding agent evaluation paradigms rely on test oracles and human review, but both fail for large-scale architectural refactoring tasks that span hundreds of interdependent files and lack pre-defined tests for target behavior, making human review infeasible as a quality gate.
summary_en.importance: Indicates that coding agent capability boundaries depend not only on base model code proficiency, but also on execution protocol design and constraint system scaling; pretraining data and evaluation for long-horizon cross-file code tasks should cover oracle-free architectural refactoring, rather than being limited to test-backed issue resolution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts a specification-first execution protocol that shifts quality control from post-generation to pre-generation: first iteratively refine a written specification and validate it against source code until no issues are found, then freeze the spec; next have the agent generate patches (instead of writing files directly) against the frozen spec; finally audit results with a fresh session of the same agent (no generation memory) against the frozen spec, paired with a ~250,000-character system prompt encoding hundreds of failure-derived rules to reduce manual intervention.
summary_en.experiments: A single stress-test case study on a 717,725-line production TypeScript application (3,648 files) shows the agent completed a core lifetime invariant dismantling task involving 189 files in 3 days, with no human code review or pre-existing test oracle — a change previously deemed infeasible via incremental refactoring and expected to require a full rewrite.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focus on the review bottleneck problem formulation, three core steps of the spec-first protocol, and comparisons to loop engineering patterns; estimated reading time 20-30 minutes, with extra attention to the design logic of using a frozen spec as the sole audit reference.

recommendation.zh: 大规模编码Agent的真实工业案例，重点看规范设计与失败回滚机制，对设计coding agent训练任务有直接参考价值
recommendation.en: Real industrial case study of large-scale coding agent; focus on specification design and failure rollback mechanism, with direct reference value for coding agent training task design

paper.title: Humans are Missing from AI Coding Agent Research
paper.abstract: Recent progress in AI coding agent research has led to rapid improvements in agents' ability to autonomously perform complex software engineering tasks, from editing large codebases to executing long-horizon development workflows. As these systems make strides, however, the primary bottleneck to practical usefulness increasingly shifts away from pure task-solving capability, and toward challenges in how users communicate with, supervise, and trust agents. In this position paper, we argue for a r

summary.core_problem: 当前AI编码智能体研究过度追求自主完成任务的成功率，忽略人机协作环节的交互瓶颈，导致智能体的能力提升无法有效转化为实际可用性。
summary.importance: 明确指出编码智能体领域的研究范式偏移问题，论证了从「自主能力优先」转向「人机协作优先」的必要性，为后续智能体评测指标设计、训练目标调整、交互架构优化提供了方向参考，对基座模型对齐和后训练阶段的交互能力建模有启发价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作为立场论文未提出具体算法，而是系统梳理了自主导向研究的局限，定义了覆盖人机协作全循环的四个核心交互维度：任务对齐（准确捕捉用户真实意图而非字面指令）、可验证性（输出结构便于人类快速检查确认）、可控性（人类可在执行过程中调整智能体方向）、适应性（智能体随多次交互持续改进行为）；对应提出四类研究方向：构建可扩展的人类用户模型、任务感知的高效验证机制、以交互为中心的可测量评测信号、拓展软件工程之外的编码智能体应用场景。
summary.experiments: 无量化实验，引用SWE-bench Verified等基准的分数上涨趋势佐证「能力提升快于交互设计进步」的论点，同时引用多项实证研究说明当前智能体存在意图误解、输出难验证、行为不可控等实际部署中的失败模式。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注第2节的瓶颈转移论证、第3节的四个交互维度定义、第4节的研究方向建议，预计阅读时间15-20分钟；从事智能体评测或交互架构设计的研究者可补充阅读第5节的反方观点回应部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Current AI coding agent research overprioritizes autonomous task completion success rates, neglecting interaction bottlenecks in human-agent collaboration, such that raw capability gains fail to translate into practical real-world utility.
summary_en.importance: It identifies a clear paradigm misalignment in coding agent research, justifying the shift from an autonomy-first to a human-collaboration-first design framework. It provides actionable direction for agent evaluation metric design, training objective adjustment, and interactive architecture optimization, with direct implications for alignment and interaction capability modeling during LLM post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: As a position paper, it does not propose a concrete algorithm. Instead, it maps the limitations of autonomy-centric research agendas and formalizes four core interaction dimensions spanning the full human-agent task-solving loop: task alignment (capturing true user intent rather than literal instructions), verifiability (outputs structured for efficient human inspection), steerability (human ability to adjust agent trajectory mid-execution), and adaptability (agent behavior improvement across repeated interactions). It also outlines four corresponding research directions: scalable human user modeling, task-aware efficient verification mechanisms, measurable interaction-centric evaluation signals, and expansion of coding agent use cases beyond traditional software engineering.
summary_en.experiments: No quantitative experiments are included. It cites rising scores on benchmarks such as SWE-bench Verified to support the claim that capability gains are outpacing interaction design progress, and references multiple empirical studies documenting real-world failure modes including intent misinterpretation, hard-to-verify outputs, and unpredictable agent behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading is sufficient. Focus on Section 2 for the bottleneck shift argument, Section 3 for formal definitions of the four interaction dimensions, and Section 4 for proposed research directions, with an estimated reading time of 15-20 minutes. Researchers working on agent evaluation or interactive architectures may also read Section 5 for structured responses to common counterarguments.

recommendation.zh: 立场清晰的领域反思文，只看 §3 四个交互维度定义即可，对设计 coding agent 评测或后训练目标有间接参考
recommendation.en: Clear field-reframing position paper; read only §3 for the four interaction dimension definitions, offers indirect reference for coding agent evaluation or post-training objective design

paper.title: Harness-IF: Evaluating Instruction Following Across Instruction Surfaces in Coding Agents
paper.abstract: When a coding agent obeys a rule, it may simply have been going to do that anyway. Existing instruction-following benchmarks cannot tell the difference: they concentrate rules in the user turn, while coding-agent benchmarks emphasize final task success. We introduce Harness-IF, which scores operational rules one at a time from execution evidence: 60 realistic multi-turn coding items drawn from a 642-rule library, 256 rules receiving verdicts, placed on the five configurable surfaces a deployed a

summary.core_problem: 现有指令跟随评测存在两处核心偏差：一是规则设置集中在用户单轮输入中，无法匹配真实部署的编码agent运行时接触的多层指令栈（系统提示、工具说明、技能文档、项目配置文件、用户指令等多个信号源）；二是现有编码agent基准仅评估最终任务成功率，无法区分agent是真正遵守了给定规则，还是其默认行为恰好与规则要求重合。
summary.importance: 提出的AP-Acc指标修正了传统指令跟随准确率的虚高问题，发现不同模型间准确率膨胀幅度存在最高两倍的系统性差异，并非固定偏移；对不同指令放置表面的优先级测试显示，实际生效的优先级顺序与“指令位置越靠近当前用户轮次优先级越高”的朴素假设不符，为实际agent的指令栈设计、指令跟随训练的数据构造、对齐信号设计提供了贴近真实部署场景的评测依据。
summary.technical_approach: 构建Harness-IF评测集：基于642条操作规则库，构造60个真实多轮编码任务，覆盖256条可通过执行证据（运行轨迹、代码diff、测试结果、输出日志）直接验证的规则。评测将规则放置位置作为控制变量，规则可被放置在5个可配置的指令表面，固定规则语义仅改变放置位置以做对照。核心指标设计为Against-Prior Accuracy（AP-Acc）：先在无规则注入的探针运行中测得agent的默认行为倾向，仅统计那些与agent默认倾向相反的规则的遵守率，排除巧合符合带来的准确率高估。另外设置对照冲突实验E0，将同一规则放置在不同表面并制造指令冲突，测试不同表面的实际优先级。
summary.experiments: 在12个前沿编码模型上的测试显示：1）所有模型的AP-Acc均低于原始准确率，原始准确率的虚高幅度在不同模型间可达2倍差异，并非固定偏移值，无法通过简单校准对齐模型间的排序；2）不同类型规则的失败模式存在显著差异；3）冲突实验测得的跨模型聚合指令表面优先级顺序，与“提示深度决定优先级”的简单假设不一致；4）在非编码场景的40个扩展case上，上述结论保持一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注AP-Acc的指标设计逻辑，以及不同指令表面优先级的实验结论，无需细读具体任务构造和规则库细节，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing instruction-following benchmarks have two key limitations for evaluating coding agents: they place nearly all rules in the user turn, failing to reflect the multi-surface instruction stack deployed agents encounter (system prompts, tool descriptions, skill documentation, project configuration files, user instructions), and they score only final task success, which cannot distinguish true rule compliance from cases where an agent’s default unprompted behavior happens to match the rule.
summary_en.importance: The proposed Against-Prior Accuracy (AP-Acc) metric corrects for systematic inflation in standard instruction-following accuracy scores, showing that inflation varies by a factor of two across model cohorts rather than acting as a constant offset. Measured surface precedence order is also inconsistent with the simple heuristic that instructions closer to the current user turn carry higher priority, providing a deployment-realistic evaluation foundation for agent instruction stack design, instruction tuning data curation, and alignment signal design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Harness-IF is built around a 642-rule library, instantiated into 60 realistic multi-turn coding tasks covering 256 rules whose compliance can be verified directly from execution evidence (run traces, code diffs, test outputs, log artifacts). Rules can be relocated across five configurable instruction surfaces while holding semantics fixed for controlled comparison. The core AP-Acc metric measures compliance only on rules that contradict an agent’s unprompted default behavior, identified via zero-injection probe runs where the rule is withheld, to exclude coincidental matches. A controlled conflict pilot (E0) places identical rules on conflicting surfaces to measure actual precedence across instruction sources.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations across 12 frontier coding models show: 1) AP-Acc is lower than raw accuracy for every model, with inflation varying by a factor of two across the cohort, meaning raw scores cannot be used for fair cross-model comparison even with simple calibration. 2) Distinct failure signatures appear across rule families and modalities. 3) The pooled surface precedence order from conflict experiments is inconsistent with simple prompt-depth priority heuristics. 4) These findings hold on a 40-case non-coding extension.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on the design logic of AP-Acc and empirical results on instruction surface precedence. There is no need to study the full task construction pipeline or rule library details in depth. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 指令跟随评测的重要新维度，AP-Acc区分真实遵守与巧合的思路干净，对后训练数据设计有参考价值，重点看§3的指标定义和§5的模型对比。
recommendation.en: A meaningful new dimension for instruction-following evaluation; the AP-Acc approach to separating compliance from coincidence is clean and relevant for post-training data design—focus on §3 metric definition and §5 model comparisons.

paper.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
paper.abstract: World modeling is an unsettled field: architectures, training objectives, and state representations interact in complex ways, and no single recipe dominates across environments. This makes it an ideal testbed for AI coding agents acting as autonomous researchers--a setting in which the improvement direction is not specified in advance, unlike the engineering-to-spec tasks that dominate current agent benchmarks. We introduce AutoWorldModel-Bench, a closed-loop benchmark in which frontier coding a

summary.core_problem: 构建一个闭环 benchmark，评测前沿 coding agent 在固定算力预算下能否自主改进 world model 研究代码，而不是只完成预先写死的工程任务。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测资产与协议设计。它把 agent 评测从“按 spec 修代码”推进到“在开放研究方向中做迭代改进”，对研究型 agent 和自动化实验循环有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoWorldModel-Bench：提供统一 starter、固定 compute budget、八个游戏环境和统一 structured-state 表示，刻意剥离感知问题，只保留动力学建模与训练目标选择。这样可以让 agent 在分钟级迭代中修改模型、损失或训练流程，并以闭环结果计分。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 64 个 session，Codex-5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.6 在 63 个 session 中改进了 starter，91% 的获胜编辑不是简单调参而是非平凡研究改动。未见更细的统计显著性、方差分解和与人类研究者对照信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a closed-loop benchmark to test whether frontier coding agents can autonomously improve world-model research code under a fixed compute budget, rather than merely completing spec-defined engineering tasks.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol. It pushes agent evaluation from 'implement the requested patch' toward 'iterate on an open research direction,' which is relevant for research agents and automated experimentation loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoWorldModel-Bench provides a common starter, fixed compute budget, eight game environments, and a unified structured-state representation. By removing perception and isolating dynamics modeling, it lets agents iterate quickly on architectures, losses, and training choices in a closed loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 64 sessions where Codex-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 improved the starter in 63 sessions, with 91% of winning edits being non-trivial research changes rather than mere hyperparameter tuning. The abstract does not expose deeper variance analysis or human baselines.

recommendation.zh: 评测想法比结果更值钱：它把 research agent 测试从 SWE 式修补转到开放式实验循环；只看 benchmark 设计和 state abstraction，模型排名先别太当真。
recommendation.en: The benchmark design matters more than the leaderboard: it shifts research-agent evaluation from SWE-style patching to open-ended experimental iteration; read the protocol and state abstraction, not the rankings.

paper.title: Why Does CLAUDE.md Keep Growing? Catastrophic Remembering in Agentic Coding
paper.abstract: Agentic coding READMEs like CLAUDE.md grow without bound in real repositories, stopping only when the repository retires or someone rewrites the file wholesale. We trace this to imperfect recall: appending an instruction is always cheap, but once an instruction's rationale is gone, deleting it without risking a correctness regression costs O(2^|D|) in a prompt of |D| instructions. We name the resulting divergence catastrophic remembering, the inverse of catastrophic forgetting around which conti

summary.core_problem: 编程Agent使用的系统提示文件（如CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md）在真实仓库维护过程中会无限制增长，冗余指令持续累积导致模型指令遵循能力下降，但删除旧指令的回归风险极高，此前没有研究解释该现象的根因，也无可行的缓解方案。
summary.importance: 提出“灾难性记忆（catastrophic remembering）”概念，与持续学习领域的灾难性遗忘形成对应，指出多作者维护过程中指令设计依据的丢失是导致删除成本指数级上升、提示只增不减的核心原因。该分析对长系统提示维护、Agent记忆管理、迭代式prompt工程有实际参考价值，但属于Agent应用层的现象分析与工程优化，对基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 首先建立提示维护的在线约束集估计理论模型，证明当指令写入时的设计溯源信息丢失后，安全删除单条指令需要O(2^|D|)量级的反事实测试，风险最小化的最优维护策略会退化为仅追加模式；通过分析1867个仓库中247694条指令的生命周期，验证指令删除风险随存活时间、参与维护的作者数量上升而下降，排除了指令自然过时、内容脆弱性等竞争性解释；提出prompt comment方案，类比代码注释的设计，在写入每条指令时同步记录其设计理由，供后续维护者参考但不送入模型执行。
summary.experiments: 实证测量显示真实仓库中的提示文件生命周期内平均长度增长226%，平均每次提交净增4.9条指令，76.8%的指令删除发生在整个文件被全量重写的提交中；在基于改造IFEval构建的可控评测环境（已知最优最小指令集）中，给指令补充结果导向的设计理由注释后，51轮维护迭代后提示的冗余尺寸从+211.3%降至+1.4%，15轮迭代后尺寸增长从+60.4%转为-5.8%的缩减，同时真实提示场景下的指令遵循准确率最高提升11.6个百分点（相对提升23.1%）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言与根因分析部分对“灾难性记忆”现象的定义、实证证据，以及prompt comment方案的核心思路，无需深入阅读理论模型推导部分，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent-facing coding instruction files (e.g. CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) grow without bound in real-world software repositories, accumulating redundant instructions that degrade model instruction-following performance. However, removing outdated instructions carries prohibitive regression risk, and no prior work has identified the root cause of this phenomenon or proposed a practical mitigation.
summary_en.importance: This work formalizes the concept of "catastrophic remembering", the inverse of catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, showing that lost write-time design rationale for instructions makes safe deletion exponentially costly, leading to append-only maintenance dynamics. The analysis provides practical reference for long system prompt maintenance, agent memory management, and iterative prompt engineering, though it sits at the agent application layer with limited direct implications for base model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: An online constraint set estimation model for prompt maintenance is derived, proving that when write-time instruction provenance (latent design rationale) is lost, safe deletion of a single instruction requires O(2^{|D|}) counterfactual tests, making append-only the optimal risk-minimizing strategy. Lifecycle analysis of 247,694 instructions across 1,867 repositories confirms deletion hazard decays with instruction age and number of contributing maintainers, ruling out competing explanations of natural instruction staleness or content fragility. A prompt comment solution is proposed, analogous to source code comments: design rationale for each instruction is recorded at write time for future maintainers, but is not exposed to the model executor.
summary_en.experiments: Empirical measurement shows real prompt files grow 226% on average over their lifetime, adding a net 4.9 instructions per commit, with 76.8% of instruction deletions occurring in full-file rewrite commits. On a controlled benchmark derived from IFEval with a known minimal optimal instruction set, adding outcome-grounded rationale comments reduces excess prompt size from +211.3% to +1.4% over 51 maintenance steps, and turns +60.4% growth into -5.8% shrinkage over 15 steps, while improving instruction-following accuracy on real-world prompts by up to 11.6 percentage points (23.1% relative gain).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction and root cause analysis sections for the definition of catastrophic remembering and supporting empirical evidence, as well as the core design of the prompt comment solution. Skip detailed theoretical derivations. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示的“灾难性记忆”现象直接指向基座模型长上下文指令遵循的缺陷，看§2的实证统计部分即可
recommendation.en: The "catastrophic remembering" phenomenon directly reveals flaws in base models' long-context instruction following; read the empirical statistics in Section 2 only

paper.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution
paper.abstract: Complex software systems develop over timescales that exceed the lifespan of any individual coding agent. Most agentic software systems preserve continuity through persistent sessions, memories, managers or shared context. We introduce EvoX Genesis (hereafter, Genesis), which instead makes the software project persistent while allowing local agents to remain finite-lived. Genesis represents software as a persistent recursive world: each local world is situated by an accepted version and a reposi

summary.core_problem: 长周期软件项目的演化时间通常超过单个 coding agent 的生命周期，论文试图解决 agent 失效、上下文断裂和项目连续性维护的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统设计。它把持久性放在软件项目和版本历史上，而不是放在长会话、长记忆或中心化 manager 上；这个视角对长周期 coding agent 的组织方式有参考意义，但与 LLM 基座预训练的直接关系较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EvoX Genesis，将软件项目表示为 persistent recursive world。每个局部 world 由 accepted version 和 repository path 定位，短生命周期 agent 只提出局部修改；递归 delegation 将任务分派到不同路径；只有被接受的后果才推进全局持久版本历史。方法核心是项目状态与 agent 生命周期解耦。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了 formation、continuation 和 redevelopment 三类评估。从一个没有 compiler 实现的仓库开始，Genesis 使用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 构建了一个 Rust-based C compiler，约 25 万 tracked lines；运行超过 120 小时，归档超过 1000 个 agent episodes，成本约 44 美元。摘要未给出严格 baseline、成功率统计或与 SWE-agent 类系统的对照。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how an autonomous coding system can preserve project continuity when the software evolution horizon is longer than any individual agent episode.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems contribution. Instead of relying on persistent sessions, long memories, or a central manager, it makes the software project and its accepted version history the persistent object. The idea is relevant to long-horizon coding agents, but only indirectly informative for LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoX Genesis models a software repository as a persistent recursive world. Each local world is anchored by an accepted version and a repository path; short-lived agents propose local changes; recursive delegation moves work across paths; only accepted consequences update the persistent history. The main design move is to decouple project persistence from agent lifetime.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports evaluations on formation, continuation, and redevelopment. Starting from a repository without a compiler implementation, Genesis used DeepSeek V4 Flash to build a Rust-based C compiler with roughly 250k tracked lines, over a 120-hour run, more than 1,000 archived agent episodes, and about US$44 cost. The abstract does not show clean baselines, success-rate statistics, or comparisons against established software-agent systems.

recommendation.zh: 作为长周期 coding agent 的系统案例可扫一眼；若没有严格 baseline，25 万行 compiler 更像演示，不足以改变训练侧判断。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as a long-horizon coding-agent systems case; without clean baselines, the 250k-line compiler run is a demo signal, not a training-side prior shift.

paper.title: A Unified Issue Resolution Benchmark for Requirement Clarification, Planning, and Code Generation for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model-powered coding agents are increasingly used to modify existing code repositories, for example, by adding features or fixing bugs. Yet existing repository-level benchmarks typically evaluate only whether the final patch passes tests. Satisfying a user request requires a long chain of interdependent reasoning and decisions: an agent must recover explicit and implicit requirements, formulate a repository-grounded implementation plan, and translate it into correct code. A pass/f

summary.core_problem: 现有仓库级 coding agent benchmark 主要看最终补丁是否通过测试，无法解释 agent 在需求澄清、实现规划、代码生成链条中哪里偏离了正确路径。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测资产贡献。SWE-RPG 把最终可执行补丁评测和中间过程的 ground-truth reference 结合起来，试图把 coding agent 评测从单一 pass/fail 推向可诊断的过程评测。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了包含三类信号的仓库级 benchmark：最终 patch 的可执行测试结果、需求澄清的标注参考、实现规划的标注参考。核心不是提出新的 coding agent，而是用经过验证的中间 GT 对完整 agent trajectory 做回溯诊断，分析失败来自需求理解、计划制定还是代码落地。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、样本量和提升数字。实验重点应是用多个 coding agent 在 SWE-RPG 上运行，并展示中间 GT 能提供比最终测试通过率更细的错误归因。

summary_en.core_problem: Repository-level coding-agent benchmarks usually score only whether the final patch passes tests, leaving no clean way to locate failures in requirement clarification, planning, or code generation.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution. SWE-RPG augments executable patch evaluation with validated intermediate ground truths, moving coding-agent evaluation from a binary outcome toward trajectory-level diagnosis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark provides ground-truth references for requirement clarification and implementation planning, in addition to final patch execution. The main contribution is not a new agent method, but a GT-aligned retrospective analysis protocol for full coding-agent trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete model sizes, dataset scale, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation compares multiple coding agents and shows that intermediate GTs expose failure modes hidden by final pass/fail scores.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造和诊断协议；对预训练没直接动作，但能校准 coding agent eval 是否只在测补丁运气。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and diagnosis protocol; it will not change pretraining, but it helps calibrate whether coding-agent evals are just testing patch luck.

paper.title: Mendel Gödel Machine: Recursive Self-Improving Coding Agents via Comparative Evolution
paper.abstract: Self-improving coding agents that iteratively rewrite their own source code have demonstrated impressive performance on coding tasks. However, existing solutions generally derive self-modification from a single failure trajectory at a time, overlooking rich comparative signals available in the agent's expanding archive of past attempts. According to Mendelian principles of controlled inheritance, we introduce Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM). In addition to the general single-trajectory clonal mutatio

summary.core_problem: 现有自改进代码智能体每次仅基于单条失败轨迹进行自我修改，忽略了历史尝试档案中积累的丰富比较信号，导致改进效率与稳定性受限。
summary.importance: 方法创新：借鉴孟德尔遗传思想提出两类新的自修改算子，并在加性适应度景观下给出理论证明与受控仿真验证，是递归自改进智能体方向的结构化推进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM)，在传统单轨迹克隆变异基础上新增两类自修改：1) 反应规范变异：基于同一智能体在多任务上的多条轨迹同时编辑；2) 跨谱系杂交：利用其他谱系参考智能体在同一任务上的轨迹进行编辑；整体在加性适应度景观假设下进行理论分析。
summary.experiments: 通过受控代理仿真验证新策略，理论证明两类算子在加性景观下能带来更快更优的改进；摘要未披露真实代码基准（如SWE-bench）上的量化结果与基线对比。
summary.authors_note: Volker Tresp 为 LMU Munich 资深机器学习研究者，长期从事知识图谱与概率建模；Yunpu Ma 聚焦图学习与大模型推理。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-improving coding agents derive self-modifications from one failure trajectory at a time, ignoring rich comparative signals accumulated in the agent's archive of past attempts, which limits improvement efficiency and stability.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: introduces two new self-modification operators inspired by Mendelian inheritance, with theoretical proof under an additive fitness landscape and controlled simulation validation, representing structured progress in recursive self-improving agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM), which adds two self-modification strategies on top of conventional single-trajectory clonal mutation: (1) reaction-norm mutation that edits the agent using its trajectories across multiple tasks simultaneously; (2) cross-lineage hybridization that edits using trajectories from a reference agent of another lineage on the same task; provides theoretical analysis under the additive fitness landscape assumption.
summary_en.experiments: Validates the new strategies via controlled surrogate simulation and proves theoretically that they enable faster and better improvement under additive landscapes; the abstract does not report quantitative results or baselines on real coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench.
summary_en.authors_note: Volker Tresp is a senior ML researcher at LMU Munich with long-standing work on knowledge graphs and probabilistic modeling; Yunpu Ma focuses on graph learning and LLM reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 自改进代码智能体的算子设计有新意，重点读 §3 两类变异的形式化与 §5 仿真结论，真实代码基准上的有效性仍待验证，可作为内部 agent 自迭代 ablation 的参考。
recommendation.en: Novel operator design for self-improving coding agents; focus on §3 for the formalization of the two mutation types and §5 for simulation results, though real-benchmark validity remains open and it can inform internal agent self-iteration ablations.

paper.title: ZhuLong: Execution-Grounded LLM Agent for EDA Scripting with Offline API Self-Exploration
paper.abstract: EDA scripting with tool-specific, often undocumented APIs remains a long-tail bottleneck that existing LLMs fail to address. This paper presents ZhuLong, an execution-grounded LLM coding agent for PyAether and SKILL that combines API retrieval, documentation inspection, and sandbox execution via unified MCP tools, augmented by an offline API self-exploration mechanism that infers undocumented API behaviors through counterfactual experimentation.   We evaluate ZhuLong on EDA-Eval-PyAether, a benc

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM无法处理EDA领域依赖未文档化API的脚本编写任务，缺乏有效的API行为推断与执行验证机制
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出执行接地+离线API自探索的EDA脚本编码Agent框架，首次通过反事实实验推断未文档化API行为，构建了EDA领域执行基准
summary.technical_approach: 1. 通过统一MCP工具整合API检索、文档检查、沙箱执行能力；2. 离线API自探索机制通过反事实实验推断未文档化API的输入输出行为；3. 基于沙箱执行结果的验证闭环迭代优化脚本
summary.experiments: 在自建的EDA-Eval-PyAether基准（158个真实任务，断言式执行验证）上，完整系统Pass@1达78.5%，远超纯LLM基线的23.6%；沙箱执行贡献最大（移除后降41.2个百分点），自探索机制额外提升3.2个百分点，减少22.1%的工具调用

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLMs fail to handle EDA scripting tasks relying on undocumented APIs, with no effective API behavior inference and execution validation mechanisms
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: an execution-grounded coding agent framework for EDA scripting with offline API self-exploration, the first to infer undocumented API behaviors via counterfactual experiments, and constructs an EDA-domain execution benchmark
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Integrates API retrieval, documentation inspection, and sandbox execution via unified MCP tools; 2. Offline API self-exploration mechanism infers input-output behaviors of undocumented APIs via counterfactual experiments; 3. Closed-loop validation based on sandbox execution results iteratively optimizes scripts
summary_en.experiments: On the self-built EDA-Eval-PyAether benchmark (158 real-world tasks with assertion-based execution validation), the full system achieves 78.5% Pass@1, far exceeding the pure LLM baseline of 23.6%; sandbox execution contributes the most (41.2 pp drop when removed), self-exploration adds 3.2 pp gain and reduces per-task tool calls by 22.1%

recommendation.zh: 仅需了解其未文档化API的反事实自探索思路，EDA领域特定内容对预训练研究无价值，无需精读
recommendation.en: Only the counterfactual self-exploration idea for undocumented APIs is relevant; EDA-specific content has no value for pretraining research, no need to read in detail

paper.title: The Scaffolding Matters More Than the Interface: A Controlled Comparison of MCP and CLI Tool Use Across Seven Agent Scaffoldings, Five Language Models, and One Software Task
paper.abstract: How much an AI coding agent costs to run can depend more on the agent scaffolding that drives it than on the interface through which it   reaches its tools. We set out to measure the cost of tool use over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) against tool use over an ordinary   command-line interface (CLI), a difference on which published estimates disagree by more than an order of magnitude while resting on   practitioner reports that cannot be reproduced. We ran one fixed software task -- six opera

summary.core_problem: 比较 coding agent 使用 MCP 与普通 CLI 调用工具时的运行成本，并区分接口本身和 agent scaffolding 对成本的影响。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是受控实验和工程测量，不是新的 agent 算法；价值在于把 MCP 成本争议从经验报告拉回到可复现实验，并指出脚手架设计可能比工具接口更决定 token 与调用开销。
summary.technical_approach: 固定一个软件任务，对私有在线 git 仓库执行六个操作；在七种 agent scaffolding 和五个语言模型上运行；用仓库最终状态验证任务完成，而不是依赖 agent 自报；比较 MCP 支持与 CLI-only 工作流的成本差异。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖七个 agent scaffolding、五个语言模型和一个固定软件任务。摘要报告两种 scaffolding 没有 MCP 支持但能用 CLI 完成全部运行，并且比五种支持 MCP 的 scaffolding 便宜 5.0 到 28 倍。任务范围较窄，结论更适合看作工程测量而非通用 scaling 规律。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures whether MCP or a standard CLI is the main driver of tool-use cost in coding-agent workflows.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a controlled engineering comparison rather than a new agent method. The useful point is that cost claims around MCP are tested under a reproducible setup, with scaffold choice separated from the tool interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors fix one software task involving six operations on a private online git repository, run it across seven agent scaffoldings and five language models, and verify success by inspecting repository state instead of trusting agent self-reports.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses seven scaffoldings, five models, and one software task. Two scaffoldings without MCP support complete all runs using only the CLI, and are reported to be 5.0x to 28x cheaper than the MCP-supporting scaffoldings. The narrow task setup limits how far the result should be generalized.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent 工程测量看一眼即可；结论更像提醒先控 scaffolding，再谈 MCP 开销。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as coding-agent measurement; the useful lesson is to control the scaffold before blaming MCP overhead.

paper.title: From Prompt to Harness: Coderlet from Scratch
paper.abstract: A model alone does not determine how a programming agent acts. What the model sees, how actions enter the environment, how feedback returns, and how one run affects the next all depend on how the harness is organized. Minimal examples usually show only the basic interaction between a model and tools, while production systems spread these relationships across complex components and dependencies. This paper studies a compact harness design by following a single request through context formation, m

summary.core_problem: 编程Agent的harness设计缺乏紧凑清晰的参考实现，现有示例要么过于简单要么组件复杂分散的问题
summary.importance: 工程实现总结，从单个请求的生命周期出发拆解harness的核心边界和运行机制
summary.technical_approach: 定义模型、执行、状态三个边界，分别连接模型服务、工具环境和持久化状态；通过请求生命周期决定各转换的执行顺序，核心作用是将模型生成转化为环境动作、携带运行时反馈到后续决策、支持跨请求状态延续
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，主要为框架设计和实现思路的拆解说明

summary_en.core_problem: Lack of compact, clear reference implementations for coding agent harness design; existing examples are either too minimal or have complex, scattered components
summary_en.importance: Engineering implementation summary: breaks down the core boundaries and runtime mechanism of a harness following a single request lifecycle
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines three boundaries: model, execution and state, connecting model service, tool environment and persistent state respectively; uses request lifecycle to determine transition order, with core functions of turning model generations into environment actions, carrying runtime feedback to later decisions, and enabling cross-request state continuation
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental data is provided in the abstract; the work mainly focuses on framework design and implementation breakdown

recommendation.zh: 编程Agent harness的紧凑设计拆解，做agent工程的可以参考结构，预训练研究员无需深读
recommendation.en: A compact breakdown of coding agent harness design; useful for agent engineering, no need for pretraining researchers to read deeply

paper.title: Can Coding Agents Solve Repository-Level Issues with Rendered Code? An Exploratory Study of Visual Representations
paper.abstract: Visual modality has recently been explored as a way to compress textual tokens, including rendering code as images for static code understanding. We study whether this representation can serve as operational context for agentic coding, where an agent must navigate repositories, edit source files, and verify executable patches. Using SWE-bench Verified, we evaluate rendered code in repository-level repair workflows and introduce controlled agent settings to separate unguided repository exploratio

summary.core_problem: 检验把代码渲染成图像这种视觉表示，是否能在仓库级代码修复 agent 中替代部分文本上下文，并在降低 token 成本的同时保持修复能力。
summary.importance: 价值在于它触到一个对基座研究员也有参考意义的问题：视觉压缩是否真能成为长上下文代码代理的有效工作记忆。贡献类型更像 exploratory analysis，而不是新范式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 rendered code 作为 agent 的操作上下文，在 SWE-bench Verified 上拆分不同阶段设置，区分无引导仓库探索与更结构化的修复流程，分析视觉表示对 token 成本、端到端修复率和稳定性的影响。核心不是提出新模型，而是控制变量地比较文本代码与视觉代码表示。
summary.experiments: 基准是 SWE-bench Verified。摘要明确给出三点：一是 rendered code 能稳定降低 prompt token 成本；二是节省幅度不随名义压缩率线性增长；三是端到端修复准确率大体能保留，但无法突破底层模型或 agent 架构上限，且在高压缩下会变得不稳定。更适合看作表示层 trade-off study。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies whether rendering code as images can serve as operational context for repository-level coding agents, reducing token cost without hurting repair performance too much.
summary_en.importance: The paper matters mainly because it probes a question relevant to foundation-model researchers: whether visual compression can become a practical working-memory mechanism for long-context code agents. This is more an exploratory analysis than a new paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors replace part of textual repository context with rendered-code visual representations and evaluate them on SWE-bench Verified under controlled settings that separate unguided repository exploration from more structured repair stages. The contribution is the controlled comparison, not a new model.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is SWE-bench Verified. The abstract gives three main findings: rendered code consistently reduces prompt-token cost; the savings do not scale linearly with nominal compression ratio; end-to-end repair accuracy is largely preserved but does not exceed the limits of the underlying model or agent architecture, and becomes unstable under aggressive compression.

recommendation.zh: 可当作“视觉 token 压缩是否真能替代文本上下文”的负面证据看；读实验结论就够，别把它误解成统一多模态建模已成立。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a useful negative result on visual compression as code context; the findings matter more than the method, and it does not validate multimodal unification by itself.

paper.title: DiDPO: Diff-in-Diff Policy Optimization for Coding Agent Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training coding agents, where the execution feedback from compilation and tests provides objective verification. However, unlike agent tasks, coding agents face a unique and finer-grained credit assignment challenge: at each step, coding actions simultaneously pack varying changes into different regions of a code version, which makes the contribution of independent change indistinguishable. Existing RLVR

summary.core_problem: 在 coding agent 的 RLVR 训练中，单步动作往往对应一个包含多处修改的 code diff，导致 credit assignment 过粗：成功/失败的回报无法区分 diff 内不同子修改的贡献。论文要解决的是：不引入 critic、也不增加额外环境 rollouts 的情况下，如何把轨迹级回报细化到 diff 内部的子区域，并把更细粒度的优势信号回传到对应的响应 token。
summary.importance:
更偏 post-train / agent RL 的方法论文，对“预训练”本身影响间接，但对 pretrain↔posttrain 闭环有两点启发：
1）当动作天然是“打包的结构化编辑”（diff）时，直接用 outcome reward 或 step reward 会浪费可验证信号；需要把结构拆开再做优势分配。
2）它提供了一种不依赖 value critic 的细粒度 credit 构造方式，和 GRPO/DAPO/GSPO 这类 group-based policy optimization 的工程路线兼容，适合在大规模 RLVR 训练里控制不稳定性与成本。

是否值得投入取决于你的工作是否覆盖 coding agent 的 RL 训练；若主要做基座预训练/数据/优化，这篇更多是“了解一种 credit 细化的做法”，不太会直接改你的 pretrain recipe。
summary.technical_approach:
DiDPO 的核心是把“轨迹级 group-relative advantage”继续向下分解到 diff 内部。

设定上沿用 CodeAct 式 Thought-Action-Observation 循环：每步 action 产生一次代码编辑（add/del/none），环境给 outcome reward（例如测试是否通过）。传统做法把整段响应当作一个 credit 载体；GiGPO 会按相似 state/action 分组做 state-level advantage，但 coding 的关键困难是：同一步 diff 里可能包含多个功能区域的修改。

DiDPO 做了三件事：
1）跨 rollouts 对齐 diff：对同一任务 prompt 采样多条轨迹，比较相邻版本之间的 diffs，在不同 rollout 的 diffs 中寻找“高度相似的 sub-diff”作为 anchor。
2）用 anchor 诱导 sub-diff 边界：把一个大 diff 切成若干 sub-diff，使这些 sub-diff 更像可复用的功能单元（例如某个函数、某段逻辑、某处 import/配置）。
3）sub-diff 分组并计算 diff-level advantage：把对齐后的 sub-diff 组成局部 group，计算局部的 group-relative advantage（diff-level advantage），再与轨迹级 advantage 结合，并投影回生成这些 sub-diff 的 token 上更新策略。

为避免 anchor 过大（语义太杂）或过小（难以聚合成组），论文引入 groupability score 来选择 anchor，平衡语义覆盖与可形成足够样本量的分组。

整体上它是 critic-free 的：优势来自组内相对比较，而不是学习一个 value function；并且强调“不需要额外 rollouts”，即在同一批采样轨迹上做更细的对齐与分配。
summary.experiments:
论文声称在多个 long-horizon coding benchmark 上优于现有 coding/agentic RL baselines（文中提到的对比对象包括 GRPO、DAPO、GSPO、GiGPO 等路线，以及一些 coding agent 相关方法）。但当前提供的正文片段未包含：具体 benchmark 名称与规模、基座模型大小、训练步数/rollout 数、pass@k 或 repo-repair 成功率的绝对值与提升幅度、以及关键消融（没有 sub-diff advantage / 没有 groupability / 不同对齐策略）的数字。

精读时建议重点核对两类结果：
- 细粒度 credit 是否真的带来稳定收益，还是主要来自某种隐含的“更强的样本筛选/重加权”；
- 计算开销：diff 对齐与相似度计算在大规模 RLVR 下是否成为瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
1）先读 Introduction 里对 coding 与一般 agent action 的三点差异（diff 打包、sub-diff 功能混杂、语法/执行约束），这是方法动机的关键。
2）再读 Problem Setting，确认它沿用的 group-relative advantage 形式，以及与 GiGPO 的关系。
3）方法部分重点看：sub-diff anchor 如何定义“相似”、边界如何诱导、groupability score 的具体形式，以及 token-level credit 如何回传。
4）实验部分优先找消融：没有对齐/没有 groupability/只用 trajectory advantage 的对比。

预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可把方法主线读懂；若要落地实现，需要额外时间看 diff 相似度与对齐的工程细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In RLVR training for coding agents, a single step often produces a bundled code diff touching multiple regions, making credit assignment too coarse. The paper targets fine-grained credit assignment inside a diff—down to aligned sub-diffs—without using a critic and without requiring extra environment rollouts.
summary_en.importance:
This is a post-training / agent-RL contribution rather than pretraining. The relevance to foundation-model training is indirect but practical if you run large-scale RLVR: (1) it argues that outcome/step rewards waste verifiable signal when actions are structured edits; (2) it offers a critic-free way to construct finer advantages compatible with group-based policy optimization (GRPO/DAPO/GSPO-style), potentially improving stability/cost.

If your focus is core pretraining (data/optimizer/scaling), this is more of a technique to be aware of than something that changes pretrain recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
DiDPO extends group-relative advantage from the trajectory level into the internal structure of a code diff.

Using a CodeAct-like interaction loop, each action yields an edit (add/del/none) and the environment provides an outcome reward (e.g., tests pass/fail). Instead of treating the whole response/diff as one credit carrier, DiDPO:
1) Aligns diffs across multiple rollouts for the same task by finding highly similar sub-diffs that recur across trajectories.
2) Uses these recurring sub-diffs as anchors to induce sub-diff boundaries within larger diffs, aiming to isolate functional regions.
3) Groups aligned sub-diffs and computes a local group-relative advantage (diff-level advantage), then combines it with the trajectory-level advantage and assigns it back to the tokens responsible for generating those sub-diffs.

To avoid anchors that are too broad (mixing functions) or too narrow (hard to aggregate), it introduces a groupability score to select anchors that balance semantic scope and group mass. The method remains critic-free and claims no additional rollouts beyond the sampled group.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports consistent improvements over strong RLVR baselines (e.g., GRPO/DAPO/GSPO/GiGPO-style methods) on long-horizon coding benchmarks. However, the provided excerpt does not include the concrete experimental tables: benchmark list, model sizes, training budgets, absolute success rates/pass@k, and key ablations (removing sub-diff alignment, removing groupability scoring, using only trajectory-level advantage).

When reading the full experiments, the main checks are: whether gains persist across tasks and seeds, and whether diff alignment/similarity computation becomes a scalability bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the introduction’s three properties distinguishing coding from generic agent RL; that is the real motivation.
- In the problem setting, confirm the baseline advantage formulation and how it relates to GiGPO.
- In the method section, focus on: how sub-diff similarity/anchors are defined, how boundaries are induced, what the groupability score is, and how token-level credit is assigned.
- In experiments, prioritize ablations isolating each component.

Time: ~20–30 minutes for the main idea; longer if you need implementation details for diff alignment.

recommendation.zh: 将 RL 的 reward 粒度下钻到 code diff 级别是个很直觉且 necessary 的改进，值得关注其具体的 diff 构造和 credit assignment 算法设计。
recommendation.en: Drilling down the RL reward granularity to the code diff level is an intuitive and necessary improvement; the specific diff construction and credit assignment algorithm design are worth examining.

paper.title: Blast Radius
paper.abstract: Agentic coding faces growing problems of affordability and wasted tokens. We introduce Blast Radius, a predictive memory management layer that estimates an incoming prompt's reach through coupled context and code channels. NECROPHORESIS enables reversible eviction by archiving dead context verbatim, while Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) identifies and buries repeatedly occurring transcripts. We formulate reversible context eviction over a Polish context space, providing a measurable foundation for r

summary.core_problem: Agentic coding 中 token 浪费和上下文溢出问题，需要可预测的上下文内存管理层。
summary.importance: 系统/方法贡献：提出 Blast Radius 预测性内存管理层，通过可逆上下文驱逐降低 token 消耗。
summary.technical_approach: NECROPHORESIS 逐字归档死亡上下文实现可逆驱逐；Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) 识别并埋葬重复出现的 transcript；在 Polish context space 上形式化可逆驱逐。
summary.experiments: 在 7 个 OpenAI 模型上 token 消耗降低 17-26%，溢出率最低，且字节级可逆。450 个被埋葬上下文中 378 个为 RDM，0 个被召回。

summary_en.core_problem: Token waste and context overflow in agentic coding, requiring a predictive context memory management layer.
summary_en.importance: System/method contribution: Blast Radius, a predictive memory management layer that reduces token consumption via reversible context eviction.
summary_en.technical_approach: NECROPHORESIS archives dead context verbatim for reversible eviction; Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) identifies and buries recurring transcripts; formalizes reversible eviction over a Polish context space.
summary_en.experiments: Across 7 OpenAI models, token consumption reduced by 17-26%, lowest overflow rate, byte-exact reversible. Of 450 buried contexts, 378 were RDM and zero were recalled.

recommendation.zh: 工程向的 coding agent 上下文管理，17-26% token 节省有实际意义，但方法偏启发式，对 pretrain 研究员仅作系统设计参考。
recommendation.en: Engineering-focused context management for coding agents; the 17-26% token saving is practically meaningful but the method is heuristic—only useful as system design reference for pretrain researchers.

paper.title: PACE: Primitive-Aware Code Evolution for Automated Algorithm Design
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based automated algorithm design typically evolves algorithms as complete, indivisible programs. While this whole-program perspective simplifies the search space, it fundamentally couples the useful local logic to its host program. Consequently, valuable code snippets vanish when the overall program is discarded, making it highly difficult to assess the contribution of individual algorithmic this http URL address this, we propose Primitive-Aware Code Evolution (PACE),

summary.core_problem: LLM驱动的自动化算法设计采用整程序进化范式，导致有用局部代码片段随程序丢弃，难以评估单个算法逻辑的贡献
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出原语级的代码进化范式，解决整程序进化的代码复用与逻辑贡献评估问题
summary.technical_approach: 提出PACE框架，将局部算法逻辑抽象为可执行算法原语（EAPs）并维护动态原语集；设计原语感知的进化操作符保证原语的保留与跨程序转移；采用基于父代相对性能提升的汤普森采样引导原语选择
summary.experiments: 未披露具体使用的LLM参数量，实验围绕自动化算法设计任务展开，对比整程序进化基线在代码复用率与算法搜索效率上的提升

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based automated algorithm design uses a whole-program evolution paradigm, causing useful local code snippets to be discarded with programs, making individual algorithmic logic contribution evaluation difficult
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a primitive-level code evolution paradigm to solve the code reuse and logic contribution evaluation problems of whole-program evolution
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the PACE framework, which abstracts local algorithmic logic into Executable Algorithmic Primitives (EAPs) and maintains a dynamic primitive set; designs primitive-aware evolution operators to ensure EAP retention and cross-program transfer; uses Thompson sampling based on parent-relative performance improvement to guide primitive selection
summary_en.experiments: No specific LLM parameter count disclosed; experiments are conducted on automated algorithm design tasks, comparing code reuse rate and algorithm search efficiency improvements against whole-program evolution baselines

recommendation.zh: 代码进化方向的增量创新，原语模块化思路对代码预训练的表示设计有微弱参考，仅看方法部分即可
recommendation.en: Incremental innovation in code evolution, the primitive modularization idea has weak reference value for code pretraining representation design, only read the method section

paper.title: Learning Globally Reusable Skills for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Automated skill evolution enables Large Language Model (LLM) agents to continuously improve without expensive retraining. However, existing approaches typically treat skill evolution as a sequence of local updates, overlooking relationships among skills and often producing overfitted skill updates that fail to generalize across tasks. We propose GSE, a globalized skill evolution framework that jointly optimizes skill compatibility and skill generalization. To preserve consistency across the skil

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 的技能库在持续演化时容易局部过拟合、跨任务复用能力弱的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 的系统方法改进。它关注不重新训练基座模型的能力积累路径，对“外部技能库如何补足参数更新”有一定参考价值，但离预训练方法论较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GSE，全局化技能演化框架。核心是维护 Skill Relation Graph 显式建模技能间关系，并用聚类式技能合并把局部更新抽象成更通用的能力；同时加入 replay-driven verification，检查新技能是否带来过拟合或行为回退。
summary.experiments: 在两个软件工程任务上评估：bug-revealing test generation 和 false-positive bug report filtering。摘要只说明与现有 coding agent 方法比较并取得更好表现，未给出完整提升幅度、模型规模或训练数据细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the problem that coding-agent skill evolution often overfits to local task updates and fails to produce reusable skills across tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a system-level method for coding agents. It is relevant as a non-parametric capability accumulation mechanism, but it is not directly about base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: GSE globalizes skill evolution by maintaining a Skill Relation Graph to model compatibility among skills, consolidating clustered local updates into reusable skills, and using replay-driven verification to detect overfitting and behavioral regressions.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers two software-engineering tasks: bug-revealing test generation and false-positive bug report filtering. The abstract reports gains over existing coding-agent approaches, but does not expose model sizes, training data, or exact improvement numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为 skill-memory 方向的工程信号可看摘要；预训练研究员只需记住“局部技能更新会过拟合”这个失败模式。
recommendation.en: Useful as an engineering signal for skill-memory systems; for pretraining, the only durable lesson is that local skill updates overfit easily.

paper.title: Scrouting: Cost-Aware Routing of Coding Agents by Scouting the Repository First
paper.abstract: Frontier language models can resolve repository-level software issues, but each attempt is expensive, and existing routers select a model from the issue text alone. We present SuperScout, which routes after scouting the repository: a 7B searcher, SuperScout-7B, first explores the repository and produces a structured handoff whose reproduction claims are sandbox-verified, with false claims stripped before delivery. The searcher's hidden states, together with the task text, then feed a resume-base

summary.core_problem: 仓库级代码修复任务中，现有路由机制仅根据 issue 文本在调用模型前做决策，既无法利用代码仓库本身的结构信息，也无法在保持最强模型解题率的前提下显著降低单任务成本；同时已有研究默认路由目标是提升准确率，但真实场景下不同模型的解题集合高度嵌套，准确率提升几乎没有空间。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在系统层：第一，证明了在多模型部署场景下，「先做轻量检索/探查再路由」的两阶段架构可以把昂贵大模型的能力前置摊薄，用一个极小的 7B 搜索模型承担信息收集工作，路由决策质量显著高于纯文本路由；第二，提出了「等解题率下的单位解题成本」这一部署导向指标，以及「盲混合基线」作为路由系统的最低有效门槛，避免了只看准确率或只看成本的片面评估；第三，搜索器隐藏状态作为路由特征、以及基于简历的 N 路可扩展路由池设计，对后续 agent 系统的模型编排和推理预算分配有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 整体架构叫 Scrouting（Scout + Routing），分三步：1）用一个 7B 规模的搜索模型 SuperScout-7B 先遍历仓库，输出结构化交接包——包括涉及的文件列表、诊断说明、候选复现测试；2）所有交接内容进入沙箱验证，不成立的声明被剔除，避免错误信息污染下游；3）路由阶段同时使用原始任务文本和搜索器的隐藏状态作为特征，采用「简历式」N 路路由池：每个候选修复模型对应一份历史表现简历，路由时做匹配打分，新增修复模型不需要重新训练路由模块。和已有方法的核心区别：路由发生在仓库探查之后，而不是之前；路由目标是成本控制而非准确率提升；引入了沙箱验证的交接包作为中间表示，而不是直接传递原始文本。
summary.experiments: 核心实验在 SWE-bench Pro 的完整 Python 子集（266 个任务）上，按官方封顶预算协议评测：SuperScout 解题 159/266，略高于最强单模型的 158/266，单位解题总成本 0.230 美元，仅为最强单模型 1.274 美元的约 1/5；搜索器本身的全部 GPU 开销仅 1.13 美元，占比可忽略。前置审计实验在三个 SWE 基准上重放已发表的逐任务结果：不同模型解题集合的包含度在 0.773–0.941 之间，即使只比较前沿模型之间也在 0.90–0.93，说明解题集高度嵌套；所有测试过的学习型路由（k-NN、逻辑回归、MLP、聚类、语言规则）都没有稳定超过始终调用最强模型的策略。配对校准实验在 100 个新任务上显示：交接包的作用是重新分配解题能力——提升三个较便宜修复模型的表现，略微削弱最强模型；搜索器隐藏状态对成本路由有增益，而交接包文本本身没有。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看三部分：1）第 3 节的路由前置审计和解题集嵌套度分析，这是整篇工作的动机基础，附录 A 的完整审计表可以快速扫一眼确认结论稳定性；2）第 4–5 节的 Scrouting 架构和沙箱验证流程，理解交接包的结构和过滤机制；3）第 6 节的盲混合基线定义和第 7 节的主结果，重点把握「等解题率下的单位成本」这个指标的构造逻辑。值得深挖的点：搜索器隐藏状态作为路由特征的可迁移性，以及沙箱验证的开销在更大规模任务上的伸缩性。

summary_en.core_problem: In repository-level code repair, existing routers make decisions solely from issue text before any model touches the codebase, so they cannot exploit repository structure and fail to materially reduce per-task cost while preserving the strongest model's solve rate. Prior routing work also targets accuracy gains, but real-world solve sets across models are heavily nested, leaving almost no headroom for accuracy-oriented routing.
summary_en.importance: The main implications for pretraining research sit at the system layer. First, a two-stage "lightweight scouting then routing" architecture is shown to amortize the cost of expensive frontier models: a tiny 7B search model handles information gathering, and routing quality substantially improves over text-only routers. Second, it introduces a deployment-oriented metric — total cost per solve at matched solve rate — together with a blind-mixing baseline as the minimum bar for any useful routing system, avoiding one-sided evaluation on either accuracy or cost alone. Third, using the searcher's hidden states as routing features, plus a résumé-style N-way router pool that supports adding fixers without retraining, offers direct design cues for model orchestration and inference budget allocation in agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The full pipeline is called Scrouting (Scout + Routing) and runs in three steps. (1) A 7B search model, SuperScout-7B, first explores the repository and produces a structured handoff: implicated files, diagnostic notes, and a candidate reproduction test. (2) Every claim in the handoff goes through sandbox verification, and unverified claims are stripped before downstream consumption. (3) Routing uses both the original task text and the searcher's hidden states as features, with a résumé-based N-way pool: each candidate fixer is associated with a résumé of historical performance, and routing scores against it, so adding a new fixer requires no retraining. Key differences from prior work: routing happens after repository scouting, not before; the objective is cost control rather than accuracy; and a verified structured handoff serves as the intermediate representation instead of raw text.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation runs on the full Python slice of SWE-bench Pro (266 tasks) under the official capped-budget protocol. SuperScout resolves 159/266 tasks, slightly above the best single fixer's 158/266, at a total cost per solve of $0.230 versus $1.274 for the strongest model — roughly a 5x reduction. The searcher's total GPU cost across the evaluation is only $1.13, negligible in the overall budget. A pre-hoc audit replays published per-task outcomes on three SWE benchmarks: solve-set containment ranges from 0.773 to 0.941 across model pairs, and 0.90–0.93 even among frontier-only pools, confirming heavy nesting. None of the learned routers tested (k-NN, logistic, MLP, clustering, language-rule baselines) reliably beats always calling the strongest model. A paired calibration study on 100 fresh tasks shows the handoff redistributes rather than adds solving ability: it lifts the three cheaper fixers while slightly hurting the strongest, and hidden-state features improve cost-aware routing, whereas the handoff text alone does not.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, estimated 25–35 minutes. Focus on three parts. (1) Section 3's pre-routing audit and solve-set nesting analysis, which is the real motivational foundation of the work; Appendix A's full audit tables can be scanned quickly to confirm robustness. (2) Sections 4–5 on the Scrouting architecture and sandbox verification gate, to understand the handoff structure and filtering mechanism. (3) Section 6's definition of the blind-mixing baseline and Section 7's main results, especially the construction logic of "cost per solve at matched solve rate". Points worth deeper follow-up: transferability of searcher hidden states as routing features, and how sandbox verification overhead scales to much larger task volumes.

recommendation.zh: 路由前先做 sandbox 验证的 handoff 是干净设计；对 test-time 路由有借鉴，看 §3 和成本表即可。
recommendation.en: The sandbox-verified handoff before routing is a clean design; useful for test-time routing. Read §3 and the cost table.

paper.title: EA-Graph: Artifact-Anchored Verification Memory for Coding Agents under Upstream Drift
paper.abstract: Coding agents increasingly work across sessions, but prose notes can preserve a conclusion without the program state that supported it. After an upstream change, a repository may still build even though earlier verification claims are no longer valid. EA-Graph is an artifact-anchored memory for verification claims. It represents artifacts at sub-path granularity, resolves aliases to leaf definitions, anchors each claim to the content used to establish it, and keeps evidence strength separate fro

summary.core_problem: 跨会话代码Agent的文本笔记仅保存结论，上游代码变更后原有验证断言失效却无法被可靠识别。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出首个以代码制品为锚点的验证断言记忆结构，解决上游漂移下的断言有效性判定问题。
summary.technical_approach: 设计EA-Graph：以子路径粒度表示代码制品，解析别名到叶子定义，将每个验证断言锚定到其依据的具体代码内容，并分离证据强度与新鲜度两个维度；缺失依据时标记为不可证而非猜测。
summary.experiments: 在7个构造的可观测ground truth仓库、42个会话、3种记忆条件、2个模型等级上评测，任务是在上游值漂移、逻辑漂移、内容缺失场景下分类断言状态。

summary_en.core_problem: Prose notes of cross-session coding agents only preserve conclusions, so verification claims become invalid after upstream code changes but cannot be reliably detected.
summary_en.importance: Novel method proposing the first artifact-anchored verification memory structure to determine claim validity under upstream drift.
summary_en.technical_approach: EA-Graph represents code artifacts at sub-path granularity, resolves aliases to leaf definitions, anchors each verification claim to the exact content used to establish it, and decouples evidence strength from freshness; claims are marked unprovable rather than guessed when supporting content is missing.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 7 constructed repositories with known behavior-to-artifact ground truth, 42 sessions, 3 memory conditions, 2 model tiers; task classifies prior claims as unaffected/affected/unprovable under value drift, logic drift, and withheld upstream content.

recommendation.zh: 代码Agent记忆结构的小创新，思路干净但场景狭窄，仅对做长会话SWE Agent的人有参考，预训练研究员可快速扫过方法节。
recommendation.en: Small but clean innovation in coding agent memory structure; narrow scenario, only useful for long-horizon SWE agent researchers — pretraining folks can quickly skim the method section.

paper.title: SparseDitto: Customizing GPU Kernels for Different Sparsity Patterns with LLM-Based Agentic System
paper.abstract: Sparse matrix kernels are fundamental to scientific computing, graph analytics, and machine learning. Their GPU performance depends strongly on the input sparsity pattern and execution strategy. For the same SpMM on the same matrix, cuSPARSE exhibits a 350x performance gap between CSR and Blocked-ELL. Our study of multiple data formats, specialized systems, and sparse compilers shows that no single implementation consistently dominates across sparsity patterns and operators. This motivates a sys

summary.core_problem: 稀疏矩阵 GPU kernel 的最优数据格式和执行策略强依赖输入稀疏模式与目标 GPU，固定库或固定编译器很难在 SpMV、SpMM、SpGEMM 上稳定占优。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 LLM agent 驱动的系统自动化和 kernel 生成；它不是 LLM 推理 serving 工作，但对自动生成硬件相关代码、未来训练系统自动调优有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: SparseDitto 为每个矩阵、算子和 GPU 构造专用 kernel。系统先用轻量 additive model 根据矩阵结构特征排序已有策略，再由 architecture-aware planner 提出候选设计，随后通过 LLM 进行代码生成、验证和迭代修正。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出一个动机性数字：同一矩阵同一 SpMM 在 cuSPARSE 的 CSR 与 Blocked-ELL 之间可出现 350 倍性能差距。论文覆盖 SpMV、SpMM、SpGEMM，但摘要未提供最终加速比、GPU 型号、矩阵集合规模或对比系统的完整结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Sparse GPU kernels require different data formats and execution strategies depending on sparsity structure and target hardware, so a single library implementation or compiler strategy rarely dominates.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an LLM-agent system for automated kernel customization. It is not directly an LLM serving paper, but it is a useful signal for code-generation-based systems autotuning and hardware-aware optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: SparseDitto builds a specialized kernel for each matrix, operator, and GPU. It uses a lightweight additive model to rank established strategies from matrix features, an architecture-aware planner to propose candidate designs, and LLM-based coding plus verification to implement and revise kernels.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a motivating 350x cuSPARSE performance gap between CSR and Blocked-ELL for the same SpMM on the same matrix. It covers SpMV, SpMM, and SpGEMM, but the abstract does not give final speedups, GPU details, matrix-suite size, or full baseline comparisons.

recommendation.zh: 预训练相关性弱，但自动 kernel 搜索的系统分解可借鉴；看策略排序和验证闭环即可。
recommendation.en: Weakly tied to pretraining, but the decomposition of kernel search is useful; skim the strategy-ranking and verification loop only.

paper.title: MT-Web2Code: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Multi-Turn Regional Reconstruction and Localized Modification
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in web UI generation. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on single-turn full-page generation from scratch, overlooking the iterative workflow of real-world frontend engineering, where developers repeatedly reconstruct missing regions and modify localized elements within existing codebases. To bridge this gap, we introduce MT-Web2Code, the first multimodal coding benchmark for multi-tur

summary.core_problem: 现有面向网页UI生成的多模态编码基准大多采用单轮全页生成设置，仅能评估模型一次性生成完整页面的能力，无法匹配真实前端开发中迭代修改现有代码库的工作流，也无法衡量模型在多轮编辑中保留非目标区域内容、阻断错误跨轮传播的能力。
summary.importance: 该基准针对多轮迭代式网页UI编码场景设计，覆盖了现有单轮生成评测缺失的迭代工作流评测维度。其提出的反向污染轨迹构造方法为低成本生成确定性多轮交互数据提供了可复用方案；配套的双轴评估协议同时衡量目标区域生成质量和非目标区域内容保留程度，暴露了现有编码agent在迭代修改场景下的共性缺陷，也可为后续迭代式编码agent的可验证奖励RL训练、效果评测提供基础支撑。
summary.technical_approach: 基准包含16个垂直领域共102个网页，覆盖两类互补任务：宏观级区域重建，要求模型根据视觉参考补全缺失的语义区域，并将其整合到现有页面结构中；微观级局部修改，要求模型修复细粒度的结构、样式缺陷，且不破坏无关内容。研究团队设计了反向污染轨迹引擎用于构造数据：从完整的黄金页面出发，迭代注入确定性的结构、样式缺陷，再将污染序列反转得到修复轨迹，每一轮编辑的目标状态都被唯一确定，无需昂贵的人工逐轮标注即可生成可复现的多轮评测数据。配套双轴评估协议：区域重建任务采用五维VLM评分规则衡量目标区域保真度，局部修改任务采用基于像素对齐的确定性指标，两类评估都同时度量非编辑区域的内容保留程度。
summary.experiments: 对13个前沿编码agent的评测显示三个共性问题：第一，现有agent很难在忠实重建目标区域的同时，保持编辑区域外内容的一致性；第二，模型缺乏精确局部修改所需的细粒度视觉-代码对齐能力；第三，早期轮次出现的错误会在后续编辑中被继承、放大，多轮轨迹下存在明显的错误滚雪球效应。单轮静态UI生成任务上的表现无法直接预测模型在迭代编码场景下的可靠性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注反向污染轨迹引擎的设计逻辑，以及双轴评估协议中对非目标区域保留程度的度量方式。实验部分可重点关注现有agent三类核心缺陷的具体表现。无需深究网页收集、过滤的工程细节，预计阅读时间10-15分钟。可留意其构造的确定性轨迹作为可验证奖励信号的潜力，这与当前代码agent的RL训练数据构造思路直接相关。
