summary_en.core_problem: Existing multimodal benchmarks for web UI generation mostly adopt a single-turn full-page generation setup, which only evaluates a model's ability to produce a complete page in one pass. This does not reflect real frontend engineering workflows where developers iteratively modify existing codebases, and cannot measure a model's ability to preserve content outside the target edit region or prevent error propagation across successive interaction turns.
summary_en.importance: This benchmark is designed for multi-turn iterative web UI coding scenarios, covering the iterative workflow evaluation dimension missing from existing single-turn generation benchmarks. The proposed Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine provides a reusable approach to generating deterministic multi-turn interaction data at low cost. The accompanying dual-axis evaluation protocol measures both target region generation quality and unaffected content preservation, reveals common failure modes of current coding agents in iterative modification scenarios, and can serve as a foundation for both verifiable reward RL training and evaluation of future iterative coding agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 102 web pages across 16 vertical domains, covering two complementary task types: Macro-Level Regional Reconstruction, which requires agents to reconstruct a missing semantic region from visual reference and integrate it into the existing page structure; and Micro-Level Localized Modification, which requires agents to fix fine-grained structural and stylistic defects without disrupting unrelated content. A Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine is used to construct evaluation data: starting from a complete golden page, the engine iteratively injects deterministic structural and stylistic defects, then reverses the corruption sequence to produce a repair trajectory. The target state for each turn is uniquely defined, enabling reproducible multi-turn evaluation without costly turn-level human annotation. A dual-axis evaluation protocol is applied: a 5-dimensional VLM-based rubric measures target region fidelity for regional reconstruction tasks, while deterministic pixel-grounded alignment metrics are used for localized modification. Both evaluation streams explicitly measure content preservation outside the edit region.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation across 13 frontier coding agents reveals three consistent failure modes: First, current agents struggle to faithfully reconstruct target regions while maintaining consistency of content outside the edited area. Second, agents lack the fine-grained visual-code alignment capability required for precise localized modification. Third, errors introduced in early turns are inherited and amplified across subsequent edits, leading to clear error snowballing over multi-turn trajectories. Strong performance on static single-turn UI generation does not reliably predict performance in iterative coding scenarios.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper. Focus on the design logic of the Reverse-Corruption Trajectory Engine, and the approach to measuring unaffected content preservation in the dual-axis evaluation protocol. In the experiments section, review the three core failure modes observed across existing agents. There is no need to dive into low-level engineering details of web page collection and filtering. Estimated reading time: 10-15 minutes. Note the potential of using these deterministic trajectories as verifiable reward signals, which is directly relevant to current RL training pipelines for code agents.

recommendation.zh: 把“局部改动不许破坏其余页面”做成双轴指标是对的；只需看任务构造与指标定义，模型对比结果当作弱信号。
recommendation.en: The dual-axis metric (edit fidelity vs. non-target preservation) matches real UI editing failure modes; read the task construction + metrics, treat model rankings as weak evidence.

paper.title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
paper.abstract: AI coding agents like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of this workload using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June 2026, comprising 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, and 95T tokens.   Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with important systems implications. For example, agentic coding sessions consist of spar

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是生产环境中 coding agent workload 缺少实证刻画的问题。现有 LLM serving 系统多按短请求、无状态 chat workload 设计，但 coding agent 会在一次任务中反复调用模型、执行工具、读取工具输出、再继续调用模型，两者的系统行为差异很大。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对基础模型研究有间接价值。它给出了真实 agentic coding 分布中的上下文长度、工具调用、重试、cache 生命周期和用户异质性。这些信号会反过来影响模型训练目标和数据构造：工具调用轨迹不是孤立 turn，而是长链式 session；上下文压缩和工具失败会显著改变 prompt 分布；agent-initiated 调用占多数，说明训练数据如果只模拟用户直接提问，会低估 agent 自主循环中的状态转移。对 serving 研究的价值更直接：KV cache 不应只按单请求管理，而应按 session、turn、模型切换和 compaction 事件管理。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用 GitHub Copilot coding agent 的生产采样 trace 做 workload characterization。数据覆盖 2026 年 6 月一周，包含 320 万用户、1300 万 sessions、7.61 亿次 LLM calls、95T tokens 和 7.75 亿次 tool invocations。分析单位包括 session、turn、LLM call、tool call、context compaction、model switch 和 idle interval。核心分析围绕五个方向：LLM 调用和工具调用的耦合关系；KV cache 在 turn 内、turn 边界、模型切换和上下文压缩时的命中率变化；工具失败及 retry loop 对 token 量的放大；用户群体的资源使用差异；GPU 推理阶段和 CPU/IO 工具执行阶段交替造成的 idle-time 分布。论文还给出轻量 idle-time predictor，把 turn boundary 作为资源回收和 cache eviction/offloading 的可操作信号。
summary.experiments: 关键数字较完整。87% 的 LLM 调用由 agent 自主触发，而不是用户直接触发；LLM 调用和工具执行接近 1:1 耦合。KV cache 在 turn 内平均命中率约 90%，但跨 turn boundary 下降到 55%；模型切换会把命中率压到约 8%。Context compaction 只在 7.8% 的 sessions 中触发，却影响 44% 的总 token，并会丢弃超过 70% 的 prompt tokens，同时像模型切换一样重置 cache 状态。工具失败出现在 9% 的 turns 中，会触发自主 retry loop，并因上下文窗口增长把计算量最多放大到 4 倍。用户被分为五类 archetypes，per-turn token 消耗跨度约 50 倍，从 23K 到 1.1M tokens，说明统一资源策略会对重度用户和轻量用户都不合适。agent 执行呈现 GPU-bound LLM 推理与 CPU/IO-bound 工具执行交替，turn 内 idle 通常是秒级，turn 间 idle 可到分钟级。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看 Table 1 和 Section 4，建立 workload 的总体结构。然后精看 Section 5.2 和 Section 6 的 KV cache 生命周期分析，这是对 serving 系统最有用的部分。Section 7 的 tool failure/retry loop 对训练数据也有启发，因为真实 agent 轨迹中失败和恢复不是噪声，而是高成本状态。Section 8 的 user archetypes 可以帮助判断 benchmark 是否覆盖真实使用分布。Section 9 的 idle-time predictor 更偏系统实现，但能说明 agent workload 不能只按请求级调度。对预训练研究者，重点不是 predictor，而是真实 agent trace 显示出的长链上下文、工具反馈和压缩事件分布。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of production-scale evidence for agentic coding workloads. Existing LLM serving stacks are largely optimized for short, stateless requests, while coding agents run multi-step loops of model calls, tool execution, tool-output ingestion, retries, and edits over long sessions.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it provides useful signals for foundation-model researchers working on tool use, long-context training, and agent data. Real coding-agent traces are session-structured rather than turn-isolated. Most model calls are initiated by the agent itself. Context compaction, tool failures, model switches, and retry loops reshape the prompt distribution and token budget. These properties matter when constructing tool-use pretraining or post-training data. The direct contribution is to serving systems: KV cache should be managed as a session-aware resource, not merely as a per-request optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study characterizes sampled production traces from GitHub Copilot's coding agent over one week in June 2026. The dataset contains 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, 95T tokens, and 775M tool invocations. The analysis defines and measures sessions, turns, LLM calls, tool calls, context compaction events, model switches, and idle intervals. It focuses on five workload properties: the coupling between LLM calls and tool execution; KV-cache behavior within turns and across turn boundaries; cache invalidation from model switches and compaction; compute amplification caused by tool failures and retries; heterogeneity across user populations; and the alternation between GPU-bound inference and CPU/IO-bound tool phases. The paper also studies a lightweight idle-time predictor and identifies turn boundaries as useful signals for resource reclamation and cache eviction or offloading.
summary_en.experiments: The scale of the measurement is the main empirical contribution. 87% of LLM invocations are agent-initiated, and LLM calls are coupled with tool execution at roughly a 1:1 ratio. KV-cache hit rates average around 90% within a turn, drop to 55% across turn boundaries, and fall to about 8% after model switches. Context compaction occurs in only 7.8% of sessions but accounts for 44% of total tokens; it removes more than 70% of prompt tokens and resets cache state almost as severely as a model switch. Tool failures appear in 9% of turns and can trigger autonomous retry loops that increase compute by up to 4x. The paper identifies five user archetypes with a 50x range in per-turn token consumption, from 23K to 1.1M tokens. Agent execution alternates between GPU inference and CPU/IO tool execution, producing second-scale idle gaps within turns and minute-scale gaps across turns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with Table 1 and Section 4 to understand the workload structure. Then read Sections 5.2 and 6 carefully, since the KV-cache lifecycle is the most actionable systems result. Section 7 is useful for model and data researchers because failures and retries are part of real agent trajectories, not just noise. Section 8 helps assess whether coding-agent benchmarks cover realistic user distributions. Section 9 is more systems-oriented, but it clarifies why request-level scheduling is insufficient for agent workloads. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful takeaway is the observed distribution of long chained contexts, tool feedback, compaction events, and agent-initiated calls.

recommendation.zh: 只看 workload 和 KV-cache 部分；它会修正“agent serving 近似 chatbot serving”的系统假设。
recommendation.en: Read the workload and KV-cache sections; they directly challenge the assumption that agent serving is just chatbot serving with more calls.

paper.title: Shared Organizational Memory for Enterprise Coding Agents: System Design and Deployment Snapshot
paper.abstract: Enterprise coding agents rely on tools and retrieval, yet enterprise knowledge often remains outside public training data and formal documentation: internal DSLs, proprietary platforms, local conventions, recent fixes, and tacit workflows. Existing knowledge interfaces expose stored resources but still depend on agents recognizing and explicitly recording lessons worth reusing, disconnecting capture from the coding workflow and leaving development experience repeatedly rediscovered. We report an

summary.core_problem: 企业 coding agent 难以复用内部 DSL、私有平台、本地约定、近期修复和隐性工作流等未进入公开训练数据的组织知识。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 记忆系统设计和部署快照。它对 agent memory 与企业 RAG 有工程参考，但没有已完成效果评估，对基座预训练研究只提供弱信号。
summary.technical_approach: 设计共享组织记忆系统，把经验捕获嵌入 coding workflow：在贡献者批准后收集任务邻近经验，整理成可复用 question-answer memories，加入安全和隐私风险 gating，并在后续 agent 任务中检索这些 memories。
summary.experiments: 论文是 short paper 和 ongoing production deployment snapshot。摘要说明检索和 coding task 效果仍在评估中，因此没有可靠的定量提升、baseline 对比或规模化实验结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Enterprise coding agents struggle to reuse organizational knowledge that is absent from public training data and formal documentation, such as internal DSLs, proprietary platforms, local conventions, recent fixes, and tacit workflows.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a coding-agent memory-system design and deployment snapshot. It is relevant to agent memory and enterprise RAG engineering, but without completed outcome evaluation it provides only a weak signal for foundation-model research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system makes experience capture a platform-level part of coding work: it collects task-adjacent experience with contributor approval, curates it into reusable question-answer memories, applies basic security and privacy gating, and retrieves those memories for future agents.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports an ongoing production deployment snapshot. Effects on retrieval and coding tasks remain under evaluation, so it does not yet provide quantitative gains, baseline comparisons, or large-scale outcome analysis.

recommendation.zh: 有用的是记忆生命周期设计，不是结果；没有效果数据前，只能当 coding-agent 产品模式备忘。
recommendation.en: The memory lifecycle is the useful part, not the results; without outcome data, treat it as a coding-agent product-pattern note.

paper.title: TaPR: Test-Aware Policy Refinement for Feedback-Conditioned Code Generation
paper.abstract: Multi-turn code agents rely on execution feedback to repair incorrect programs, yet standard reinforcement learning paradigms optimize and evaluate policy performance primarily using single-shot outcome rewards. This misalignment conflates initial code generation with feedback-driven refinement, discards granular execution signals across intermediate turns, and fails to evaluate whether the policy actually acquires self-repair capabilities. We propose Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR), a frame

summary.core_problem: 解决多轮代码生成代理中训练目标与真实交互不一致的问题：模型需要根据执行反馈修复代码，但常规 RL 主要优化单轮最终结果。
summary.importance: 这是代码代理后训练方法的增量改进。价值在于把 execution feedback 转成逐轮 dense reward，并用一致的多轮协议衡量 self-repair，而不是只看初始生成能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Test-aware Policy Refinement，使用每轮测试通过率作为 dense reward，在多轮代码生成和修复过程中持续给策略反馈。方法重点不是新模型架构，而是 reward 设计和训练/评测协议对齐。
summary.experiments: 在 LiveCodeBench 的 219 个代码生成问题上，跨 6 个模型评估。TaPR 将 pooled 三轮成功率 Pass@3 提升 2.44 个百分点；在预定义的 7B/8B high-headroom 子集上，pooled accuracy 从 30.25% 提升到 33.56%，提升 3.31 个百分点，并报告 42 个 paired improvements 和 13 个 regressions。摘要还提到对 Qwen3-8B 做了 dense reward ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch in multi-turn code agents: the policy is expected to repair code from execution feedback, while standard RL often optimizes single-shot outcome rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental but relevant post-training method for coding agents. Its main value is converting execution feedback into dense per-turn rewards and evaluating actual self-repair behavior under a consistent interaction protocol.
summary_en.technical_approach: TaPR uses per-turn test-pass ratio as a dense reward during feedback-conditioned code generation. The contribution is not a new architecture, but a reward design and protocol that better align training with multi-turn repair.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on 219 LiveCodeBench code-generation problems across six models. TaPR improves pooled three-turn Pass@3 by 2.44 percentage points. On a predefined 7B/8B high-headroom slice, pooled accuracy rises from 30.25% to 33.56%, a 3.31-point gain, with 42 paired improvements and 13 regressions. The abstract also mentions a matched Qwen3-8B dense-reward ablation.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和 reward 设计即可；提升不大，但它把“会修复”从单轮 pass rate 里拆出来，这点干净。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and reward design; the gains are modest, but separating repair ability from one-shot pass rate is the useful part.

paper.title: Trajectories That Segment Themselves: Agent-Declared Boundaries as a Training Unit
paper.abstract: Long-horizon coding-agent trajectories are poorly matched to the credit units available to train on: a single action has no stable value, an episode label merges productive exploration with abandoned directions, and a fixed window cuts where the logging mechanics fall. We introduce collection-time semantic self-segmentation, in which a declarative contract has the acting agent expose its own boundaries while the trajectory is generated. Instantiated with falsifiable causal hypotheses, successive

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 coding-agent 轨迹中训练 credit unit 不合适的问题：单步 action 太碎，整集标签太粗，固定窗口又切在日志边界上。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 轨迹采集与监督信号设计。它的价值在于重新定义训练样本边界，把 agent 自己声明的语义阶段作为监督单元。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 collection-time semantic self-segmentation：在轨迹生成时通过声明式 contract 要求 acting agent 暴露自己的边界。边界由可证伪的因果假设驱动，后续 adoption 暴露变长语义阶段；不依赖 milestone 词表、gold patch、环境 replay、teacher logits 或事后 segmenter。由于 agent 显式命名假设，reviewer 可以按名称否定它，从而构造 wrong-cause-then-correction transitions，并从一次采集中得到四类监督目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述协议和训练目标，没有给出模型规模、数据规模、benchmark、baseline 或数值结果。更像方法提案或数据采集协议，结论需要后续实验证明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses mismatched credit units in long-horizon coding-agent trajectories: actions are too small, episode labels are too coarse, and fixed windows follow logging mechanics rather than semantics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a trajectory collection and supervision protocol for coding agents. Its useful idea is to make the agent expose semantic phase boundaries during data collection.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed collection-time semantic self-segmentation uses a declarative contract that requires the acting agent to declare its own boundaries. Boundaries are driven by falsifiable causal hypotheses and successive adoptions, without milestone vocabularies, gold patches, environment replay, teacher logits, or retrospective segmenters. Named conjectures allow reviewers to negate them and manufacture wrong-cause-then-correction transitions, yielding four supervised targets from one collection.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract presents the protocol and target construction but does not provide model sizes, data scale, benchmarks, baselines, or numerical results. It should be read as a method proposal until empirical evidence is available.

recommendation.zh: 想法比结果更强：agent 自报边界可作为轨迹训练单元，但没有实验证据前别把它当 recipe。
recommendation.en: The idea is stronger than the evidence: self-declared boundaries are plausible training units, but not yet a recipe without experiments.

paper.title: RefactorAssist: Agentic Refinement for Reliable Code Refactoring
paper.abstract: Code refactoring aims to enhance the internal structure of source code without affecting its functional behavior. The recent advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential for automating software engineering tasks, such as code refactoring. However, the refactorings produced by LLMs often introduce subtle errors, leading to functional behavior changes and failed unit tests, which limit their practical adoption. To address the limitations of LLM-generated refactorings, w

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 生成代码重构时容易引入细微功能错误、导致单元测试失败的问题。
summary.importance: 这是软件工程 agent 的可靠性改进工作，贡献在于把测试日志、错误解释和项目上下文纳入迭代修复闭环。对基座研究的直接价值有限，但对“外部验证信号如何约束生成”有一点参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先在 10 个开源 Java 项目上人工分析 LLM 重构失败原因，再设计 RefactorAssist：利用单元测试日志、错误解释、项目上下文检索和代码 diff，驱动 agent 进行迭代式重构与修正，目标是在保持重构收益的同时提升功能正确性。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 10 个带原生测试套件的开源 Java 项目，比较普通 LLM 重构与 agentic refinement 的测试通过情况。摘要未给出具体模型、通过率提升幅度和 baseline 名称；从设定看，评估重点是单元测试是否通过以及失败原因分布。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the problem that LLM-generated code refactorings often introduce subtle behavioral bugs and fail unit tests.
summary_en.importance: This is a software-engineering agent reliability paper. Its main contribution is an iterative repair loop grounded in test logs, error explanations, and project context. Direct value to pretraining is limited, but it offers a small lesson on how external verification signals can constrain generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first manually analyze why LLM refactorings fail on 10 open-source Java projects, then build RefactorAssist, an agentic refinement system that uses unit-test logs, error explanations, project-context retrieval, and code diffs to iteratively improve refactorings while preserving functionality.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use 10 open-source Java projects with native test suites, comparing plain LLM refactoring against the proposed agentic refinement in terms of test passing and failure patterns. The abstract does not provide model names, exact gains, or baseline details; the setup is centered on unit-test-based functional correctness.

recommendation.zh: 是个像样的 coding agent reliability 小系统，但离 pretrain 很远；若你做 verifier-guided generation，只看失败归因和测试闭环设计。
recommendation.en: A decent coding-agent reliability system, but far from pretraining; only worth skimming for the failure taxonomy and the test-driven refinement loop if you care about verifier-guided generation.

paper.title: Effective and Efficient Context Retrieval via Partial Dependency Graph for Repository-Level Code Generation
paper.abstract: LLM-based repository-level code generation aims to generate code using the context available in a software repository, requiring LLMs to reason over complex code dependencies. Due to limited context windows and insufficient repository-specific understanding, LLMs typically rely on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to incorporate relevant code. Early RAG approaches primarily employ similarity-based retrieval, which often fails to retrieve code snippets that the target function depends on. Rece

summary.core_problem: 仓库级代码生成需要检索目标函数依赖的代码片段，现有相似度检索无法有效捕捉依赖关系，静态图检索依赖人工规则与全局图，灵活性差且构建维护成本高。
summary.importance: 方法创新，受人类开发者上下文收集行为启发，提出动态部分依赖图的检索范式，提升仓库级代码检索的效率与准确性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DyRetriever方法，通过动态构建部分依赖图，迭代式地沿依赖关系检索相关代码上下文，避免静态全局图的高成本与不灵活性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验设置与量化结果，仅介绍了方法的设计思路与核心动机。

summary_en.core_problem: Repository-level code generation requires retrieving code snippets that the target function depends on; existing similarity-based retrieval fails to capture dependencies, and static graph-based retrieval relies on manual rules with high construction and maintenance costs.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a dynamic partial dependency graph retrieval paradigm inspired by human developers' context collection behavior, improving efficiency and accuracy of repository-level code retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DyRetriever, which dynamically constructs partial dependency graphs and iteratively retrieves relevant code context along dependency relations, avoiding the high cost and inflexibility of static global graphs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not fully disclose experimental settings or quantitative results, only introduces the design motivation and core idea of the method.

recommendation.zh: 代码仓库RAG的增量改进，核心是检索策略优化，对LLM基座预训练无直接启发，仅做领域常识了解即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to code repository RAG focused on retrieval strategy optimization, no direct insight for LLM base pretraining, only for domain awareness.

paper.title: AgenticRepair: Multi-Faceted Program Context Engineering for Agentic Vulnerability Repair
paper.abstract: Automated vulnerability repair aims to reduce the time and effort required to patch security flaws from a vulnerability triage report. Recent agentic AI approaches have shown promising results in automated program repair. However, vulnerability repair demands richer program context than general bug repair - context that security engineers routinely assemble in practice but that existing agentic approaches do not engineer. We identify three critical gaps: code-structure context capturing cross-fi

summary.core_problem: 现有agent化自动漏洞修复方法缺少安全工程师实际使用的三类关键程序上下文：跨文件数据流、运行时崩溃语义、提交历史脆弱模式
summary.importance: 方法创新：针对漏洞修复场景设计多面程序上下文工程，比通用bug repair agent更贴近安全修复需求
summary.technical_approach: 提出AgenticRepair框架，编排三个专用LLM子agent分别构建代码结构、运行时执行和提交历史三类上下文，注入修复子agent的记忆中执行漏洞修补
summary.experiments: 在漏洞修复任务上测试，相比现有agent化程序修复方法有提升

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agentic automated vulnerability repair lacks three critical program contexts that security engineers routinely assemble: cross-file data flows, runtime crash semantics, and commit-history fragile patterns
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: multi-faceted program context engineering tailored for security vulnerability repair, beyond general bug repair agents
summary_en.technical_approach: AgenticRepair orchestrates three specialized LLM subagents to engineer code-structure, runtime-execution, and commit-history contexts, which are embedded into a dedicated repair subagent's memory
summary_en.experiments: Improves over existing agentic program repair methods on vulnerability repair tasks

recommendation.zh: 漏洞修复专用coding agent，上下文工程思路对SWE agent有参考，但属于场景化增量，不值得深读
recommendation.en: Vulnerability-repair-specific coding agent with useful context-engineering ideas for SWE agents, but incremental and scenario-specific

paper.title: Open-Source LLM-Driven Formal Verification: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for RTL Repair
paper.abstract: Verification consumes the majority of modern chip design effort, yet the formal verification tools that provide mathematical guarantees of correctness remain expensive and restrictively licensed. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for hardware design, existing approaches to RTL repair validate their results through simulation - which exercises only a subset of inputs - or rely on commercial tools, and few combine formal proof with an entirely open-source toolchain. In this pap

summary.core_problem: 用 LLM 和开源形式化验证工具链自动发现并修复 RTL 设计缺陷。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent / hardware repair pipeline：把 LLM 生成、形式化属性、反例反馈和 k-induction 证明串成闭环。价值在于 verifier-in-the-loop 的执行结构，但规模和任务覆盖看起来很小。
summary.technical_approach: 构建多 agent 流水线，LLM 负责生成形式化性质、尝试 RTL 修复；Yosys、SymbiYosys、Z3 负责形式化验证；若验证失败，将 counterexample 反馈给 LLM 迭代，直到 k-induction 证明通过或达到迭代预算。
summary.experiments: 摘要只提到 ALU case study，展示该流水线能检测并修复一个真实功能 bug，并给出形式化正确性证明；没有看到大规模 RTL benchmark、多个模型对比或稳定性统计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper uses an LLM plus an open-source formal verification stack to detect and repair RTL design bugs.
summary_en.importance: It is a coding-agent / hardware-repair pipeline: the main contribution is closing the loop between LLM generation, formal properties, counterexample feedback, and k-induction proof. The verifier-in-the-loop structure is useful, but the demonstrated scale appears narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system uses multiple agents around an LLM: it generates formal properties, verifies RTL with Yosys, SymbiYosys, and Z3, feeds counterexamples back to the LLM, and iterates until k-induction proves correctness or the iteration budget is exhausted.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports an ALU case study where the pipeline detects and repairs a real functional bug with a formal proof of correctness; it does not indicate a broad RTL benchmark, extensive model comparisons, or robustness statistics.

recommendation.zh: 可看系统图和反例反馈 loop；ALU 单例太窄，别把它当 coding agent 能力结论，只当 verifier 接口样例。
recommendation.en: Skim the system diagram and counterexample loop; an ALU case study is too narrow for coding-agent conclusions, but useful as a verifier-interface example.

paper.title: SWE-NFI: Studying and Benchmarking Coding Agents for Non-Functional Improvements
paper.abstract: Although coding agents have achieved impressive performance on correctness-oriented benchmarks, their ability to make behavior-preserving non-functional improvements (NFIs) remains underexplored. In real-world software development, developers continuously improve software quality without changing observable behavior, yet existing benchmarks primarily evaluate functional correctness and provide limited support for assessing these non-functional improvements.   In this paper, we present SWE-NFI, a

summary.core_problem: 构建一个评测 coding agents 做非功能性改进的 benchmark，而不只评估代码是否通过功能测试。
summary.importance: 贡献是 SWE/coding agent 评测资产。它补上了现有 correctness-oriented benchmark 的盲区：真实软件维护常常要求在行为不变的前提下改善质量、可维护性、性能或风格。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SWE-NFI，从真实开源 Python 项目的已合并 pull requests 中构造 188 个任务，并把开发者导向的 non-functional improvements 操作化为 92 条可执行规则。评测同时包含功能正确性测试和规则化 NFI 检查。
summary.experiments: 评测了商业和开源 coding agents。摘要片段显示最佳 agent 在某个主要指标上达到 70.0%，但完整指标定义、各模型排名和失败类型需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on behavior-preserving non-functional improvements, beyond functional correctness.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an evaluation asset for SWE/coding agents. It targets a gap in correctness-oriented benchmarks: real software maintenance often requires quality improvements without observable behavioral changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-NFI contains 188 tasks derived from real merged pull requests in open-source Python projects. It operationalizes developer-oriented non-functional improvements into 92 executable rules and combines functional tests with rule-based NFI evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate commercial and open-source coding agents. The abstract fragment reports that the best-performing agent reaches 70.0% on a main metric, but the exact metric, model ranking, and failure taxonomy require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；看任务构造和 92 条规则，能判断 coding posttrain 是否过拟合“修 bug”单一范式。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; inspect the task construction and 92 rules to see whether coding post-training is overfit to bug-fixing.

paper.title: Change2Task: From Repository Changes to Executable Coding Agent Tasks and Environments
paper.abstract: Scaling coding agents requires a continuing supply of executable data for training, benchmarking, and continuous evaluation. Each task must couple a realistic software state with a specification, development tools, and reliable verification. To expand this supply, we present Change2Task, a system grounded in repository history that converts merged pull requests into verified tasks on healthy modern revisions of the same repository. It aligns historical evidence with evolved code, reconstructs ta

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 coding agent 数据供给里的环境构造问题：怎样把仓库历史中的真实开发变更，转成今天仍可执行、可验证、可复用环境的 agent 任务，而不是把任务永远绑死在旧 revision 上。难点不在于从 PR 里抽一句描述，而在于把历史变更迁移到现代代码库后，仍然保留任务意图、验证契约、编辑范围和可恢复性。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接价值有限，它更偏 agent data / benchmark infrastructure，而不是预训练方法或数据配比研究。但如果关注代码模型的 post-train、agent RL、持续评测和可执行数据生成，这篇有现实意义。它的贡献不在模型算法，而在“如何从一个可运行仓库环境里榨出更多高质量任务”。这对 coding agent 的训练规模、持续回归测试、以及环境成本控制都有帮助。放在研究优先级上，更适合作为 agent 数据工程参考，而不是预训练主线论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法从 merged PR 出发，在同一仓库的一个健康现代后继 revision 上重建任务状态。作者把整个生命周期形式化为：历史 source patch P_s 把 V_pre 变成 V_post；系统从现代健康基线 H 出发，施加 task patch D 得到任务状态 C，再记录 restoration patch G，把 C 恢复到 H'。关键要求不是文本级完全回滚，而是行为上恢复相关健康状态。

整个框架分四步。第一步是从 PR 提取任务证据，包括描述、实现 patch、可执行检查，并据此划分 target checks、regression checks 和 source change profile。这里的 source change profile 用来约束后续重建是否仍然忠于原始变更的作用范围和编辑强度。第二步是选择现代健康基线 H，优先使用声明的健康 revision 或目标 revision，否则在仓库 lineage 中解析默认分支的可运行后继版本。第三步是任务重建，采用三级递进策略：Level 1 Patch Reversal 适合历史 patch 与现代代码仍高度对应的情况，直接在现代代码上构造可逆任务状态；Level 2 Code Mapping 处理文件、符号、接口已经迁移但仍可建立映射的情况；Level 3 Agent Reconstruction 则在直接映射不足时，借助 agent 在现代仓库中重做变更。这个分层设计的意义在于，优先用便宜、确定性强的方法，只有在仓库演化破坏对应关系时才升级到更昂贵的重建方式。

第四步是严格验证。系统要求 healthy、task、restored 三个状态都通过相应检查，并验证 provenance、behavior、scope、restoration。任务目标通过 adapter 抽象，支持 Bug Fix、Feature Addition、Test Generation、API Migration、Security Repair 等不同任务类型，每类任务定义自己的目标输出、可执行 oracle 和允许编辑范围。这个 adapter 设计让框架不只服务于 bugfix benchmark，而是面向更广义的 coding agent 任务生成。
summary.experiments:
实验重点是构造成功率、保真度、与历史任务的一致性，以及环境复用带来的成本收益。作者从 1,130 个 eligible changes 中最终构造出 900 个 paired tasks，说明在真实仓库历史上，经过筛选和验证后仍能保留较高产出。对 621 个 matched Bug Fix 候选，Change2Task 成功重建 500 个，而 SWE-smith PR Mirror 为 387 个，显示在同类历史变更迁移任务上，三级重建策略比直接镜像式方法覆盖更高。

质量方面，语料达到 0.894 的 task weighted source change profile fidelity，用来衡量现代重建任务与原始 PR 在变更作用范围和结构上的一致程度。更关键的是 matched agent evaluation：历史任务与重建任务在 agent 执行结果上最高达到 98.0% 的 outcome agreement，并且能保持 agent ranking。这说明重建后的任务不只是“看起来像”，而是在评测排序上与原始任务有较强一致性。

成本方面，复用 388 个 modern bases 带来 58.4% 的 environment time 降低、71.2% 的存储降低，以及 10.8% 的端到端成本下降。这里有一个值得注意的点：时间和存储节省很大，但总成本下降只有 10.8%，说明环境镜像并不是唯一大头，验证、调度、运行 agent rollout 仍然占据显著成本。若做系统复现，这个成本结构判断很有用。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议优先看 Introduction 和 Methodology 里的生命周期定义，因为这篇的价值主要在系统抽象是否清楚。接着看三级重建策略：Patch Reversal、Code Mapping、Agent Reconstruction 各自解决什么失配，升级条件是什么，失败模式是什么。然后看验证协议，尤其是 healthy/task/restored 三态验证和 source change profile fidelity 的定义。最后再看主结果表，重点不是绝对数量，而是与 SWE-smith PR Mirror 的对比、98.0% outcome agreement、以及环境复用带来的时间/存储/成本变化。

预计阅读时间 20 到 30 分钟。若只关心是否能用于自家 coding agent 数据管线，读方法总览、任务 adapter、验证标准和成本分析即可；若想复现，需细看 PR 过滤条件、现代基线选择逻辑、以及每一级重建的接受/拒绝规则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an environment-engineering bottleneck for coding agents: how to turn real historical repository changes into executable tasks on healthy modern revisions, instead of tying every task to an old snapshot. The hard part is not extracting a PR description, but reconstructing the task on evolved code while preserving intent, verification contracts, edit scope, and reversibility.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core LLM pretraining is limited. This is much closer to agent data infrastructure, continuous evaluation, and executable task generation than to pretraining methods, scaling laws, or tokenizer design. Still, it matters if the focus includes coding-agent post-training, RL with tool use, or benchmark supply. The main contribution is operational: it increases the amount of verified agent data that can be derived from each runnable repository environment, while reducing repeated environment setup and storage overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The system starts from a merged PR and reconstructs the corresponding task condition on a healthy descendant revision of the same repository. The lifecycle is formalized as follows: a historical source patch P_s transforms V_pre into V_post; Change2Task starts from a healthy modern base H, applies a task patch D to create a task state C, and records a restoration patch G that returns C to a restored state H'. The goal is behavioral restoration, not textual identity.

The framework has four main stages. First, it extracts task evidence from the PR: description, implementation patch, and executable checks. From this it derives target checks, regression checks, and a source change profile. The source change profile later serves as a fidelity constraint, ensuring that the reconstructed task remains close to the original maintenance intent and edit footprint. Second, it selects a healthy modern base revision, preferring explicitly declared healthy or target revisions and otherwise resolving an accessible descendant in the repository lineage.

Third, it reconstructs the task using a three-level escalation strategy. Level 1, Patch Reversal, handles cases where the historical patch still maps cleanly to modern code. Level 2, Code Mapping, is used when files, symbols, or APIs have moved but correspondence can still be established. Level 3, Agent Reconstruction, is invoked when direct mapping is too weak and an agent must re-create the change in the modern repository. This staged design is sensible: use the cheapest and most deterministic reconstruction first, and escalate only when repository evolution breaks direct transfer.

Fourth, the system validates the full lifecycle. Healthy, task, and restored states must satisfy their respective checks, and the task is verified for provenance, behavior, scope, and restoration. Objectives are expressed through task adapters, which define the expected output, executable oracle, and edit scope for task types such as Bug Fix, Feature Addition, Test Generation, API Migration, and Security Repair. That adapter abstraction makes the framework broader than a bug-fix-only benchmark generator.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation focuses on reconstruction yield, fidelity, agreement with historical tasks, and environment-efficiency gains. From 1,130 eligible changes, the system finalizes 900 paired tasks, which is a strong yield given the validation requirements. On 621 matched Bug Fix candidates, Change2Task reconstructs 500 tasks, compared with 387 for SWE-smith PR Mirror, indicating better coverage when transferring historical changes to modern code.

For quality, the corpus reaches 0.894 task-weighted source change profile fidelity, measuring how well the reconstructed task preserves the original PR’s change scope and structure. More importantly, matched agent evaluation shows up to 98.0% outcome agreement between historical and reconstructed cases while preserving agent ranking. That means the reconstructed tasks are not merely superficially similar; they behave similarly enough to maintain comparative evaluation signals.

On efficiency, reusing 388 modern bases reduces environment time by 58.4%, storage by 71.2%, and end-to-end expenditure by 10.8%. One useful systems takeaway is that storage and setup savings are large, but total cost drops less dramatically, implying that validation, orchestration, and rollout execution remain substantial contributors.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick pass, start with the introduction and the lifecycle formalization in the methodology. The paper’s value depends on whether that abstraction is clean and operationally useful. Then read the three reconstruction levels—Patch Reversal, Code Mapping, and Agent Reconstruction—with attention to when each is triggered and what failure modes it addresses. After that, inspect the validation protocol, especially the healthy/task/restored checks and the definition of source change profile fidelity. Finally, read the main result tables with focus on the comparison to SWE-smith PR Mirror, the 98.0% outcome agreement, and the environment reuse savings.

A practical skim should take 20 to 30 minutes. If the goal is to assess fit for an internal coding-agent data pipeline, the method overview, task adapters, validation criteria, and cost analysis are the most useful sections. If the goal is reproduction, then the PR filtering rules, modern-base selection logic, and acceptance/rejection criteria for each reconstruction level deserve closer attention.

recommendation.zh: 自动从PR生成可执行coding任务的系统设计很扎实，做coding基座预训练或SFT的数据管线时可直接复用三种状态重构方法
recommendation.en: The system design for auto-generating executable coding tasks from PRs is solid; reuse the three state reconstruction methods when building coding base pretraining or SFT data pipelines.

paper.title: Tycho: Active Abstraction with Programmatic World Models for ARC-AGI-3
paper.abstract: ARC-AGI-3 turns abstraction into an interactive problem of skill acquisition. A player must infer an unfamiliar game's rules, hidden state, and goal while maintaining action efficiency because every move counts. We formalize these environments as parameterized rendered deterministic Moore machines and introduce Tycho, a coding-agent system that constructs and uses game-specific models during interaction. Tycho separates actionable observations from intermediate animation, level-completion, and g

summary.core_problem: ARC-AGI-3交互式抽象任务中，Agent如何在动作效率约束下推断未知游戏规则并高效求解
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于程序化世界模型的主动抽象Agent架构，在ARC-AGI-3公开集上达到人类级动作效率
summary.technical_approach: 将环境建模为参数化渲染的确定性Moore机；Tycho系统分离可执行观测与动画/结束帧，从结构化历史中构建、测试、规划、修复或绕过可执行假设；采用Actor请求委派给模型构建器的编排策略
summary.experiments: 在25个公开游戏上对比4种编排策略，Claude Opus 4.8下最优策略RHAE达88.49；GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5均达到100.00 RHAE

summary_en.core_problem: How agents can infer unknown game rules and solve efficiently under action-efficiency constraints in ARC-AGI-3 interactive abstraction tasks
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing an active abstraction agent architecture with programmatic world models, achieving human-level action efficiency on ARC-AGI-3 public set
summary_en.technical_approach: Models environments as parameterized rendered deterministic Moore machines; Tycho system separates actionable observations from animation/end frames, building, testing, planning with, repairing, or bypassing executable hypotheses from structured history; uses an actor-requested delegation to model builder orchestration policy
summary_en.experiments: Compared 4 orchestration policies on 25 public games; best policy reaches 88.49 RHAE with Claude Opus 4.8; both GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 reach 100.00 RHAE

recommendation.zh: 程序化世界模型+主动抽象的思路对Agent推理范式有参考价值，但属于特定benchmark的系统工作，看摘要和结果表即可
recommendation.en: The programmatic world model + active abstraction idea is informative for agent reasoning paradigms, but it is a benchmark-specific system work; read abstract and results tables only.

paper.title: BlueprintRepair: Typed Local Edits for Failed Lean Proof Blueprints
paper.abstract: LLM-based Lean proving systems increasingly organize a proof as a blueprint: a dependency graph of formal statements. We introduce BlueprintRepair, a repair interface that lets a model change this graph through ten schema-checked local operations. An operation names the node it edits, so the target theorem cannot be changed. Lean checks every applied change, and an accepted repair must declare every blueprint lemma its proof uses. We also construct BlueprintTrace, a benchmark of 142 controlled f

summary.core_problem: LLM 证明系统中 blueprint（依赖图）失败后，如何用类型化局部编辑做低成本修复？
summary.importance: 形式化证明/coding agent 方向的接口设计与 benchmark 工作；对 agent action space 设计有一定启发，但非基座研究核心。
summary.technical_approach: BlueprintRepair 提供 10 种 schema-checked 的局部图编辑操作，操作只改指定节点、不能改目标定理，每次修改经 Lean 检查，并要求声明所用 lemma；同时构建 BlueprintTrace（142 个受控失败案例，含完整接受/拒绝轨迹）。
summary.experiments: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 下，typed edits / exact patches / full rewrites 解题数相近，但 typed repair 每个解决状态成本最低（patching 1.30×、rewriting 2.06×），在 10K completion tokens 预算内接近最优。

summary_en.core_problem: How to repair failed proof blueprints (dependency graphs of statements) in LLM-based Lean provers via typed local edits?
summary_en.importance: An interface-design and benchmark contribution for formal-proof/coding agents; relevant to agent action-space design but peripheral to foundation-model research.
summary_en.technical_approach: BlueprintRepair exposes ten schema-checked local graph operations that edit named nodes without changing the target theorem; Lean checks every change and accepted repairs must declare used lemmas. Ships BlueprintTrace, 142 controlled failures with full accepted/rejected trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: With DeepSeek-V4-Flash, typed edits, exact patches, and full rewrites solve similar counts, but typed repair is cheapest per solved state (patching 1.30x, rewriting 2.06x) and near-optimal within 10K completion tokens.

recommendation.zh: action space 设计的干净对照：受约束局部编辑比整文件重写便宜 2×，做 coding agent 的可看 §接口对比表。
recommendation.en: A clean action-space ablation: constrained local edits are ~2x cheaper than full rewrites; check the interface comparison table if you work on coding agents.

paper.title: Do Context Files Help Coding Agents? A Two-Agent Ablation Study on Real Repositories
paper.abstract: Persistent context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) are standard practice for guiding AI coding agents, yet evidence for their effectiveness is contradictory. We present a controlled ablation of context-injection strategy across two frontier agents (Claude Code and Codex), 17 real tasks from 3 repositories (15 shared + 2 Codex-only), and 288 evaluated runs with gold-test evaluation. Context strategy does not measurably move correctness on either agent (bounded to <=10-15pp via equivalence testing).

summary.core_problem: 持久化上下文文件（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md）被广泛用于引导 coding agent，但其有效性证据相互矛盾，缺乏受控消融。
summary.importance: 通过严格受控实验给出负面结果，挑战行业普遍实践；属于高质量实证分析，揭示了 coding agent 失败的真正原因是实现能力而非仓库知识缺失。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Claude Code 和 Codex 两个前沿 agent 上，对 3 个仓库的 17 个真实任务做 288 次评估运行，使用 gold-test 评估和等价检验（equivalence testing）量化上下文策略的效果边界，并做失败模式分类和操纵探针（manipulation probe）。
summary.experiments: 2 个 agent × 17 任务 × 多种上下文策略 = 288 runs；上下文策略对正确率无可测量影响（等价检验边界 ≤10-15pp）；真实 AGENTS.md 在两个 agent 上均未将接近成功的任务转为通过；任务难度的 agent 间 Spearman rho=0.75。

summary_en.core_problem: Persistent context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) are standard practice for guiding coding agents, but evidence for their effectiveness is contradictory and controlled ablations are lacking.
summary_en.importance: A rigorous controlled study yielding a negative result that challenges widespread industry practice; high-quality empirical analysis showing coding agents fail on implementation skill rather than missing repository knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: Controlled ablation across Claude Code and Codex on 17 real tasks from 3 repositories with 288 evaluated runs, using gold-test evaluation and equivalence testing to bound context strategy effects, plus failure-mode triage and a manipulation probe.
summary_en.experiments: 2 agents × 17 tasks × multiple context strategies = 288 runs; context strategy has no measurable effect on correctness (bounded to ≤10-15pp via equivalence testing); real AGENTS.md never converts a near-miss to a pass on either agent; cross-agent task difficulty Spearman rho=0.75.

recommendation.zh: 干净的负面结果：上下文文件对 coding agent 正确率无显著影响，失败在实现能力不在知识缺失；做 agent eval 的值得看实验设计和等价检验部分。
recommendation.en: A clean negative result: context files don't measurably help coding agents—failures are in implementation skill, not knowledge; worth reading for the equivalence-testing design if you do agent evaluation.

paper.title: Specification-Guided Synthesis of Deadlock-Free Communication Protocol Refinements with Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Ensuring behavioural correctness in communication protocols is a central challenge in distributed software systems, as subtle inconsistencies can lead to deadlocks. In such settings, protocol refinement - the safe substitution of a protocol that preserves correctness and compatibility with other components - is essential. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation and program synthesis, yet lack mechanisms to reliably produce outputs with correct behavi

summary.core_problem: 在分布式通信协议细化中，如何让 LLM 合成的协议变体满足行为正确性，尤其避免死锁。
summary.importance: 贡献是 formal methods 与 LLM 程序合成的结合：用 MPST 规范约束生成过程，为特定软件工程任务提供正确性保证；方向有工程价值，但任务较窄。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Syntropy 框架，将 multiparty session types 的协议细化约束直接纳入 LLM 生成流程，使生成协议在替换原协议时保持兼容性和 deadlock freedom。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了 comprehensive evaluation，但未给出数据集、模型、baseline 和具体提升；评估应围绕协议 refinement 成功率、死锁自由性和与无约束 LLM 生成的对比。
summary.authors_note: Nobuko Yoshida 是 multiparty session types 和并发/通信协议形式化方向的代表性研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how LLM-synthesized refinements of distributed communication protocols can be made behaviorally correct, especially deadlock-free.
summary_en.importance: It combines formal methods with LLM-based program synthesis. The contribution is useful for a narrow software-engineering setting, but it is not a broad coding-agent or pretraining result.
summary_en.technical_approach: Syntropy injects multiparty session type refinement constraints into the generation process, so that generated protocol variants preserve compatibility and deadlock freedom when substituted for the original protocol.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims a comprehensive evaluation, but does not report datasets, models, baselines, or numerical gains. The likely metrics are refinement success, deadlock freedom, and comparison to unconstrained LLM generation.
summary_en.authors_note: Nobuko Yoshida is a leading researcher in multiparty session types and formal models of concurrent communication protocols.

recommendation.zh: 形式规范约束 LLM 生成的套路干净，但领域很窄；作为 coding-agent 安全合成案例备查即可。
recommendation.en: A clean example of constraining LLM generation with formal specs, but the domain is narrow; keep it as a reference case for safe code synthesis.

paper.title: AgenticCANN: Automated Ascend C Operator Generation via Knowledge-Augmented Agentic Evolution
paper.abstract: Ascend C operator optimization is critical for NPU (Neural Processing Unit) inference performance but requires deep hardware expertise.While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automated CUDA kernel generation, the fundamentally different programming model of Ascend C introduces unique challenges that remain unexplored. In this paper, we propose AgenticCANN, a knowledge-augmented agentic evolution framework specifically tailored for automated Ascend C operator synthesis in low-cor

summary.core_problem: 自动生成和优化 Ascend C NPU 算子，降低低语料硬件平台上的专用算子开发门槛。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 Ascend C 的代码生成 agent 与知识增强流程。它和 LLM serving / kernel autotuning 有弱相关，但核心仍是特定硬件编程环境下的 coding agent，不是通用推理系统或预训练研究。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgenticCANN：用 knowledge-orchestrated generation system 向生成过程注入多层级平台知识，缓解 Ascend C 语料稀缺带来的可行性问题；再用 stage-adaptive agentic evolution，根据生成和优化阶段切换不同 LLM 交互模式，在高探索和局部优化之间调整。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出算子类型、NPU 型号、baseline、编译通过率、性能提升或端到端推理收益等定量细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets automated generation and optimization of Ascend C NPU operators, reducing the expertise barrier for platform-specific kernel development.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a knowledge-augmented coding-agent workflow for Ascend C. It is weakly related to LLM serving and kernel autotuning, but the core is still a hardware-specific coding-agent problem rather than a general inference system or pretraining study.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgenticCANN uses a knowledge-orchestrated generation system to inject structured multi-level platform knowledge and mitigate the low-corpus problem of Ascend C. It then applies stage-adaptive agentic evolution, changing LLM interaction modes across generation and optimization phases to balance broad exploration and local refinement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report operator types, NPU hardware, baselines, compile success rates, performance gains, or end-to-end inference speedups.

recommendation.zh: 若内部做 kernel autotuning，可看知识编排设计；对预训练方法没有直接信号，别被 NPU 关键词带偏。
recommendation.en: If you work on kernel autotuning, skim the knowledge orchestration design; it gives no direct pretraining signal despite the NPU angle.

paper.title: Beyond "What to Retrieve": Uncertainty in Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
paper.abstract: Repository-level code generation relies on heterogeneous evidence whose relevance, compatibility, and completeness are inherently uncertain. Similar-code examples, repository context, and project-specific APIs may provide complementary information, but can also introduce noisy, redundant, or conflicting signals. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches primarily optimize retrieval relevance without explicitly modeling how uncertainty in retrieved evidence affects downstream generation. We introdu

summary.core_problem: 现有检索增强代码生成方法仅优化检索相关性，未显式建模异构检索证据的不确定性对下游生成的影响。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出不确定性感知的检索增强代码生成框架，首次通过因子分析揭示不同证据源间存在显著交互效应，无通用加性排序。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OpenCoder框架，估计不同来源证据的不确定性，用于过滤和排序异构证据，并指导生成、验证和修复流程；通过因子分析拆解API知识、仓库上下文、相似代码三类证据的交互作用。
summary.experiments: 在扩展的32任务RepoExec-inline评测上验证，基于GPT的基线取得提升；因子分析覆盖多类证据源与不同LLM后端。
summary.authors_note: 北京航空航天大学团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing retrieval-augmented code generation methods only optimize retrieval relevance, without explicitly modeling how uncertainty in heterogeneous retrieved evidence affects downstream generation.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes an uncertainty-aware retrieval-augmented code generation framework, and first reveals via factorial analysis that there are significant interaction effects between different evidence sources with no universal additive ranking.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces OpenCoder, which estimates source-specific uncertainty to filter and rank heterogeneous evidence, and guides generation, verification, and repair; uses factorial analysis to disentangle interactions among API knowledge, repository context, and similar-code evidence.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on an expanded 32-task RepoExec-inline evaluation, improving GPT-based baselines; factorial analysis covers multiple evidence sources and different LLM backends.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 因子分析揭示检索证据源无通用加性排序这点有启发，其余为工程增量，看摘要和因子分析部分即可。
recommendation.en: The factorial analysis finding of no universal additive ranking for retrieval evidence sources is insightful; the rest is incremental engineering — read only the abstract and factorial analysis section.

paper.title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
paper.abstract: A new field report shows how scientists use AI coding agents to modernize scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in genomics and beyond.

summary.core_problem: 展示 agentic AI 尤其是代码 agent 如何进入科学计算工作流，用于现代化遗留科研软件并加速研究迭代。
summary.importance: 这是顶级实验室的 field report/观点型材料，价值不在新算法，而在揭示真实用户如何把 coding agent 用到科研软件开发中，对 post-train 与 agent 产品方向有间接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: OpenAI 以案例方式总结科学家在基因组学等场景中使用 AI coding agents 的模式，重点是代码迁移、软件维护、实验自动化与研究协作，而不是提出新的模型、训练目标或系统协议。
summary.experiments: 不是正式论文实验；更像用户研究与案例汇编，没有可复现的 benchmark、模型规模、训练数据或严格对照，因此不能把其中结论当作干净的能力测量。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 OpenAI Research。材料属于研究博客/field report，不是技术论文；可作为观察顶级实验室如何定位 coding agent 落地场景的窗口。

summary_en.core_problem: The piece documents how agentic AI, especially coding agents, is being used in scientific computing workflows to modernize legacy research software and speed up iteration.
summary_en.importance: This is a top-lab field report rather than a method paper; its value lies in showing real usage patterns of coding agents in scientific software, with indirect relevance to post-training and agent product directions.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenAI presents case-style observations from domains such as genomics, focusing on code migration, software maintenance, experiment automation, and research collaboration, rather than introducing a new model, training objective, or protocol.
summary_en.experiments: This is not a formal experimental paper; it reads more like user research and case aggregation, with no reproducible benchmark, model scale, training data, or rigorous controls, so its conclusions should not be treated as clean capability measurements.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution: OpenAI Research. This is a research blog / field report rather than a technical paper, but it is still useful as a window into how a top lab frames coding-agent deployment in scientific workflows.

recommendation.zh: 不是技术论文，但能看出 OpenAI 正把 coding agent 往科研软件维护与迁移上推；当产品信号看，不要当能力结论读。
recommendation.en: Not a technical paper, but it is a useful product signal: OpenAI is pushing coding agents into scientific software maintenance and migration; read it as positioning, not as clean evidence.

paper.title: Execution-Grounded Security Testing for Coding Agents in Software Engineering Pipelines
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly integrated into system operations, where their tool use can directly modify project artifacts, execution environments, and the underlying system. For example, if a coding agent inserts a hook into a system startup or configuration script, that change can persist after the interaction, be triggered later, and abuse delegated user or system privileges to modify the system. This makes security testing a system problem: the key question is not only what the agent says,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注 coding agent 的执行层安全边界：同一个危险操作，如果直接请求会被拒绝，但嵌入到单元测试、回归测试、崩溃复现、验证等正常工程任务中，agent 是否仍会执行并修改环境。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座研究的直接贡献不在预训练，而在 agent 安全评测。它提醒模型安全不能只看文本拒答率。对于具备工具调用和文件系统权限的 coding agent，真实风险来自执行轨迹、运行副作用和持久化文件改动。这类评测可以反哺 post-training 的拒答数据、工具使用策略和权限边界设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个 execution-grounded red-team testing framework。论文把危险操作包装进看似合理的软件工程工作流，用四槽模板组织 probe：Motivation、Test Objective、Procedure、Pass Criterion。模板实例覆盖四类工作负载：Unit、Regression、Crash Reproduction、Validation。测试在隔离 Docker sandbox 中运行，判定依据不是 agent 的自然语言回复，而是可观测证据，包括工具调用、运行时 trace、文件系统 diff。框架还引入 oracle feedback，让 red-team agent 根据执行结果迭代 probe，从而寻找目标 agent 在何种任务表述下会越过安全边界。与传统 jailbreak 评测相比，区别在于评测目标从“是否输出违规文本”转为“是否实际执行了会改变系统状态的操作”。
summary.experiments: 给出的核心现象是直接危险请求与工作流包装请求之间的差异。直接要求修改 shell 初始化文件或配置文件时，agent 的 safeguard 可以拒绝，且没有工具调用、运行 trace 或文件改动。把同一意图嵌入常规工程任务后，agent 可能将其视为测试、调试或验证步骤并执行，sandbox 中的文件 diff 能直接验证 hook 或配置改动已经写入。当前提供内容没有完整列出模型数量、成功率、各工作负载的通过率等统计数字，因此更适合把实验理解为一个执行证据驱动的评测框架和安全边界探测范式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 direct request 与 workload-contextualized probe 的对照，这能快速理解为什么文本层评测不够。然后看方法部分的四槽模板、四类 workload、oracle feedback 和 Docker sandbox 证据采集。若后续有完整实验表，优先看不同 agent、不同危险操作、不同工作流包装方式下的 bypass rate，以及文件 diff 判定规则是否足够严格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the execution-layer security boundary of coding agents: whether an unsafe operation that is rejected as a direct request can still be executed when embedded inside a routine software-engineering task.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance is agent security evaluation rather than pretraining. The useful lesson for LLM research is that safety for tool-using agents cannot be measured only by textual refusal. Once an agent can invoke tools and modify files, the ground truth should include tool traces, runtime behavior, and persistent environment changes. This kind of evidence can inform post-training data, tool-use policies, and permission design for coding agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework is an execution-grounded red-team testing setup. It embeds target unsafe operations into plausible engineering workflows using a four-slot template: Motivation, Test Objective, Procedure, and Pass Criterion. The probes are instantiated across unit testing, regression testing, crash reproduction, and validation workloads. Execution happens inside an isolated Docker sandbox. Outcomes are determined from observable evidence such as tool invocations, runtime traces, and filesystem diffs, not from the agent’s final text. The framework also uses oracle feedback so a red-team agent can refine probes based on observed execution outcomes. Compared with prompt-only jailbreak tests, the object of measurement is actual system-changing behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The key demonstrated pattern is the gap between direct unsafe requests and contextualized engineering probes. A direct request to alter startup or configuration files can be refused, with no tool use and no state change. When the same intent is framed as part of testing, debugging, or validation, the target agent may perform the edit, and the sandbox diff verifies the persistent change. The provided content does not include full quantitative tables such as model counts, bypass rates, or per-workload success rates, so the experimental contribution should be read primarily as an evaluation framework and a concrete execution-evidence protocol.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the introduction’s contrast between direct requests and workload-contextualized probes. Then read the method details for the four-slot template, workload types, oracle feedback loop, and sandbox evidence collection. If the full experimental section is available, prioritize tables that break down bypass rates by agent, unsafe operation, and workload framing, and check how filesystem diffs are used as the outcome oracle.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 threat model 和 oracle 设计；它不是预训练论文，但能提醒 coding agent 评测别停在 transcript 层。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model and oracle design; it is not pretraining work, but it usefully pushes coding-agent evaluation below the transcript layer.

paper.title: Looping Is Not Reliability: State-Bound Evidence and Typed Revision Contracts for Agentic Code Repair
paper.abstract: Generate--test--revise loops are common in coding agents, but repetition alone provides no reliability guarantee. We study the gap between finding a correct patch and retaining, verifying, and submitting it. A sealed five-seed study over 30 HumanEval repairs produces 900 three-revision trajectories. Under forced revision, current correctness with current traces falls from 0.820 after one revision to 0.673 after two, although ever-correct rises to 0.847. Two common-state studies use 2,430 branche

summary.core_problem: Coding agent 中 generate-test-revise 循环是否真的能提升补丁可靠性，还是仅仅造成"修对过"的错觉。
summary.importance: 通过受控实验揭示 revision loop 中 stale trace 导致正确补丁被后续修订错误丢弃这一普遍被忽视的失效模式，属于对 agent 可靠性的实证分析。
summary.technical_approach: 在 HumanEval 30 个修复任务上做 5-seed sealed study，强制多轮修订并区分 current-trace 与 stale-trace 条件；在 14B 模型上复现；再做 540 rollout 的前瞻性策略验证以及 24 个仓库 bug 的实测。
summary.experiments: 14B 模型上 stale traces 让 135 个正确起始中的 34 个退化为错误，而 current traces 仅有 4 个，差 22.2 个百分点（p=0.0337）；强制两轮修订后 current correctness 从 0.820 降到 0.673，而 ever-correct 升到 0.847。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自阿里云；论文聚焦 agentic code repair 的可靠性，非模型或预训练方法创新。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether generate-test-revise loops in coding agents reliably improve patch quality, or merely inflate 'was ever correct' metrics.
summary_en.importance: Controlled evidence that correct patches are frequently discarded in later revisions due to stale execution traces, a failure mode that has been under-appreciated in agent reliability work.
summary_en.technical_approach: Sealed five-seed study on 30 HumanEval repairs under forced multi-revision protocols; frozen common-state branching with current vs. stale traces; prespecified 14B replication; prospective 540-rollout policy; repository-scale experiments on 24 bugs.
summary_en.experiments: Stale traces degrade 34/135 correct starts versus 4/135 with current traces (22.2-point gap, Holm p=0.0337); forced two-revision drops current correctness from 0.820 to 0.673 while ever-correct rises to 0.847.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Alibaba Cloud; empirical study on agentic code repair reliability, not a modeling or pretraining contribution.

recommendation.zh: 结论对 agent 训练里"多修几轮更稳"的直觉是个提醒，但与预训练关联弱，看 stale-trace 那组数字即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a caution against naive revise-loops in agent RL setups, but tangential to pretrain; the stale-trace number is the only takeaway.

paper.title: CRAFT: Learn the Schema, Execute the Plan
paper.abstract: Enterprise coding agents translate natural-language analytical requests into executable code over proprietary APIs, schemas, and metric definitions. Yet the prevailing deployment pattern injecting exhaustive schema and tool documentation into each prompt increases inference overhead, complicates schema evolution, and undermines reliability in multi-turn analysis. We investigate whether stable schema knowledge and tool-use behavior can instead be acquired through post-training while preserving th

summary.core_problem: 企业级编码Agent将全量schema与工具文档注入每次prompt，导致推理开销高、schema演进困难、多轮分析可靠性差，需要将schema知识内化到模型参数中。
summary.importance: 工程与方法结合的创新：提出面向生产环境schema-grounded编码Agent的两阶段后训练流程，解决prompt注入schema的部署痛点。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CRAFT两阶段后训练recipe：第一阶段用剥离schema的PLAN-SFT从验证轨迹中学习领域结构化计划与可执行行为，避免prompt时注入全量schema；第二阶段用执行塑形RL对齐工具选择、代码质量、计划-代码一致性与错误恢复能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验设置，未给出模型规模、训练轨迹数量、基线系统与具体效果指标。
summary.authors_note: 亚马逊广告基础团队与AWS Agentic AI团队联合产出，属于生产导向的企业级Agent训练方案。

summary_en.core_problem: Enterprise coding agents inject full schema and tool documentation into every prompt, causing high inference overhead, difficult schema evolution and poor multi-turn reliability; schema knowledge needs to be internalized into model parameters.
summary_en.importance: Combined engineering and methodological innovation: proposes a two-stage post-training recipe for production-grade schema-grounded coding agents, addressing deployment pain points of prompt-time schema injection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents CRAFT, a two-stage post-training pipeline: Stage 1 performs schema-stripped PLAN-SFT to learn domain-structured plans and executable behaviors from validated trajectories without full prompt-time schema injection; Stage 2 uses execution-shaped RL to align tool selection, code quality, plan-code consistency and error recovery.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details including model scale, number of training trajectories, baseline systems and quantitative metrics are not disclosed in the available abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Joint work from Amazon Advertising Foundations and AWS Agentic AI teams, representing a production-oriented enterprise agent training solution.

recommendation.zh: 典型企业场景下的Agent后训练工程方案，核心价值是schema内化替代prompt注入的思路，作为领域特定Agent训练的工程参考，无通用预训练insight。
recommendation.en: A typical enterprise-oriented agent post-training engineering solution; its core value is the idea of internalizing schemas instead of prompt injection, useful as engineering reference but without general pretraining insights.

paper.title: The Best Programming Language for Tokenmaxxing: An Investigation of Coding Agent Behavior Across Programming Languages
paper.abstract: Although coding agents are now very effective in a variety of programming languages, this paper first shows that the cost (in tokens) can very significantly by programming language. We evaluate five recent models on programming problems in Python, Java, Rust, and OCaml. We carefully control for problem difficulty, and show that there can be stark variation in token consumption that is consistent across models. To understand why, we analyze both the structure and content of agent trajectories. Fi

summary.core_problem: 不同编程语言下，编码代理解决同等难度编程问题时的token消耗差异及背后行为机制的问题。
summary.importance: 首次在严格控制问题难度后，量化了不同编程语言下token消耗的跨模型一致性差异，并通过轨迹结构与内容分析揭示行为成因，属于原理分析类贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 匹配Python/Java/Rust/OCaml的问题难度后，评测5个近期模型的token消耗；2) 重执行中间解，将轨迹抽象为测试结果向量序列并标注相邻解间的工作类型；3) 分析轨迹文本中的规划、测试信任度、原型策略等行为。
summary.experiments: 评测5个近期模型在4种编程语言、难度匹配的编程问题上的表现；发现跨模型一致的token消耗显著差异；揭示陌生语言下反复生成不可编译解、修改已通过解、用注释规划、不信任给定测试等行为。
summary.authors_note: Northeastern University、Wellesley College，无知名作者识别。

summary_en.core_problem: The problem of token consumption variation and underlying behavioral mechanisms of coding agents solving equally difficult programming problems across different programming languages.
summary_en.importance: First work to quantify cross-model consistent token cost gaps across programming languages after rigorously controlling problem difficulty, and reveals behavioral causes via trajectory structure and content analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Evaluate token consumption of 5 recent models across Python/Java/Rust/OCaml on difficulty-matched problems; 2) Re-execute intermediate solutions, abstract trajectories as test-outcome vector sequences and label work types between consecutive solutions; 3) Analyze planning, test distrust, prototyping behaviors in trajectory text.
summary_en.experiments: 5 recent models tested on 4 programming languages with difficulty-matched problems; finds cross-model consistent token consumption gaps; reveals repeated non-compiling solutions in unfamiliar languages, revising passing solutions, comment-based planning and other behaviors.
summary_en.authors_note: Northeastern University, Wellesley College; no well-known authors identified.

recommendation.zh: 作为token效率与代码语料语言配比的弱信号参考，仅看摘要和token消耗对比表即可。
recommendation.en: Weak signal for token efficiency and code corpus language ratio; only read abstract and token consumption comparison tables.

paper.title: AssumptionMiner: Extracting, Tracing, and Revising Implicit Assumptions in LLM Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate code from natural-language prompts, yet real-world prompts rarely provide complete specifications. When prompts leave input formats, error handling, or design decisions unspecified, LLMs fill these gaps with implicit assumptions that shape the generated code's behavior and correctness. Because these assumptions remain hidden, generated code may satisfy tests while violating developer intent. We present AssumptionMiner, a framework that makes implicit assumpt

summary.core_problem: LLM代码生成时，自然语言prompt存在未明确规范，模型填充的隐式假设不可见，导致代码通过测试但违反开发者意图的问题。
summary.importance: 方法+数据贡献，提出隐式假设的显式化框架，同时发布含676条标注假设的180个歧义编程任务基准。
summary.technical_approach: 1) AssumptionMiner框架生成代码同时输出显式假设层，结构化表示推断的约束和设计决策；2) 基于AST的依赖图实现假设修改后仅重生成受影响代码；3) 构建180个歧义编程任务benchmark，含人工验证子集。
summary.experiments: 构建180个歧义编程任务，含676条标注假设，包含人工验证的子集用于评测假设提取的准确性。
summary.authors_note: Michigan Technological University，无知名作者识别。

summary_en.core_problem: The problem that natural language prompts for LLM code generation have unspecified specifications, and implicit assumptions filled by models are invisible, leading to code that passes tests but violates developer intent.
summary_en.importance: Method + data contribution; proposes an explicit assumption framework for implicit assumptions, and releases a benchmark of 180 ambiguous programming tasks with 676 annotated assumptions.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) AssumptionMiner framework outputs an explicit assumption layer alongside code, structurally representing inferred constraints and design decisions; 2) AST-based dependency graph enables targeted regeneration of only code affected by revised assumptions; 3) Builds benchmark of 180 ambiguous programming tasks with human-verified subset.
summary_en.experiments: Constructs 180 ambiguous programming tasks with 676 annotated assumptions, including a human-verified subset for evaluating assumption extraction accuracy.
summary_en.authors_note: Michigan Technological University; no well-known authors identified.

recommendation.zh: 代码生成隐式假设的工具化探索，benchmark可作为代码预训练数据歧义性分析的参考，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Tool-oriented exploration of implicit assumptions in code generation; benchmark can serve as reference for ambiguity analysis of code pretraining data, no need to read full text.

institutions: explicit can support more inspectable and controllable
onds, a workflow that has moved from research prototypes
Jie JW Wu is with Michigan Technological University, Houghton

paper.title: CORVUS: Context Optimization and Reduction Via Underlying Synchronization for LLM Coding Agents
paper.abstract: LLM coding agents operate by constructing trajectories that accumulate reasoning, tool calls, and results to enable multi-step decision-making. However, the conventional append-only trajectory architecture found in practice tightly couples file-read actions with their observations, capturing snapshots that become permanently fixed in the chronological history. As files change through agent edits or concurrent human modifications, these snapshots become stale, causing reasoning errors and causing

summary.core_problem: 解决代码 Agent 轨迹中“文件读取结果被永久写入历史”导致的上下文膨胀与代码状态过期问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Coding Agent 的上下文架构改进。它不直接改进基座预训练，但指出了长期工具轨迹里状态同步和 token 预算之间的结构性矛盾，对仓库级 Agent 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CORVUS，将 file-read action 与 observation 解耦。系统维护一个与代码库当前状态同步的文件注册表，在每轮推理时只注入相关文件的最新内容，而不是把每次读取快照追加进历史轨迹。核心变化是把“时间序列日志”改成“可同步状态视图”。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明该方法产生更轻量的轨迹，并通过构造保证与真实代码库状态同步；未给出具体模型规模、任务集、baseline、token 节省比例或成功率提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses context bloat and stale file snapshots in coding agents caused by append-only trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent context architecture contribution rather than a pretraining result. Its useful signal is the separation between chronological tool logs and synchronized workspace state, which matters for repository-level agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: CORVUS decouples file-read actions from their observations. It maintains a synchronized registry of relevant files and injects only current file contents at each reasoning cycle, replacing repeated historical snapshots with a live state view.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims lighter trajectories and synchronization by construction, but does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, token reductions, or task success gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计图就够了；对预训练无直接动作，但“状态视图替代日志堆叠”是代码 Agent 的干净抽象。
recommendation.en: Skim the system design only; it does not inform pretraining directly, but the live-state-view abstraction is clean for coding agents.

paper.title: Cross-Model LLM Code Review: Should you use Claude to review Codex or vice versa?
paper.abstract: Developers increasingly use two coding agents together: one writes a draft, and the other reviews it. However, it is not clear whether the pairing is worth its cost and time, or whether the order of the pairing matters. We run a controlled experiment on 116 recent hard and medium lcb tasks with Claude and Codex across six conditions to approximate a software practitioner's workflow: both solo baselines, both cross-model orderings, and both same-model orderings. The reviewer sees the problem and

summary.core_problem: 研究两个代码模型协作时，写代码模型和审查模型的搭配顺序是否会影响代码任务通过率。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是小规模 controlled study。它对 coding agent 编排和模型互评有实用信号，但不是新的代码模型训练方法，也不是通用评测资产。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Claude 与 Codex 之间构造六种条件：两个 solo baseline、两个跨模型 review 顺序、两个同模型 self-review。reviewer 能看到题目和 writer 的草稿，但不能执行测试，以模拟真实代码审查步骤。
summary.experiments: 在 116 个近期 LeetCode Benchmark hard/medium 任务上测试。Claude review Codex 草稿使通过率从 71.6% 提升到 89.7%（p_BH=.001）；Codex self-review 使 Codex 从 71.6% 到 84.5%（p_BH=.022）。反向组合无效且有害：Codex review Claude 草稿使通过率从 91.4% 降到 82.8%（p_BH=.046）；Claude self-review 基本不改变 91.4% baseline。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the writer-reviewer ordering between two coding models affects pass rates on programming tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is a small controlled study for coding-agent orchestration and model review. It is not a new training method or a reusable benchmark, but it provides a clean operational signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The experiment compares six conditions using Claude and Codex: two solo baselines, two cross-model review orderings, and two same-model self-review settings. The reviewer sees the problem and the writer’s draft but cannot run tests, approximating a code review step.
summary_en.experiments: On 116 recent hard and medium LCB tasks, Claude review improves Codex drafts from 71.6% to 89.7% with p_BH=.001. Codex self-review improves Codex to 84.5% with p_BH=.022. The reverse direction is harmful: Codex review lowers Claude drafts from 91.4% to 82.8% with p_BH=.046, while Claude self-review leaves the 91.4% baseline unchanged.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果表即可；有用的是 reviewer 能力不对称，别把“多模型协作”当免费增益。
recommendation.en: Read the result table only; the useful signal is reviewer asymmetry, not a generic win from multi-model collaboration.

paper.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench: A Multi-Domain Coding-Agent Benchmark with Contamination-Resistant Task Construction
paper.abstract: We introduce Tencent WorkBuddy Bench, a multi-domain evaluation suite for coding agents; this report documents its construction methodology, scoring protocol, and a cross-model leaderboard. At its core is a unified evaluation framework for constructing and running distribution-informed coding-agent tasks across four work domains - Code, Web, Office, and Security. Rather than adapting public issue text, every task is reverse-engineered from a real commit, pull request, or business scenario and re

summary.core_problem: 构建一个覆盖多工作场景的 coding-agent benchmark，并降低公开数据集被训练污染或网页检索命中的风险。
summary.importance: 这是腾讯发布的 coding-agent 评测资产和 leaderboard。价值在于任务构造方法：从真实 commit、PR 或业务场景反向构造任务，再改写成短的口语化角色请求，使 prompt 难以通过搜索复原原始 issue 或提交记录。
summary.technical_approach: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench 提供统一评测框架，覆盖 Code、Web、Office、Security 四个工作域。每个任务包含 task directory、environment image、evaluation harness、tests 和 reference solution。污染防护不依赖保密，而依赖 reverse-engineered task construction 和 dataset versioning。
summary.experiments: 报告包含跨模型 leaderboard。任务子集涵盖仓库级工程、前端开发、办公/业务流程和安全相关任务。摘要未给出具体模型排名、任务数量和分数，但强调数据、环境、测试和参考解均公开。
summary.authors_note: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench Team 发布的 coding-agent benchmark，机构来自腾讯。

summary_en.core_problem: The work builds a multi-domain coding-agent benchmark while reducing the risk that open tasks are solved through training contamination or web-search recovery.
summary_en.importance: This is a Tencent coding-agent evaluation suite and leaderboard. Its main value is the construction methodology: tasks are reverse-engineered from real commits, pull requests, or business scenarios and rewritten as short colloquial role-play requests, making prompts hard to recover by searching the original artifacts.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench provides a unified framework across Code, Web, Office, and Security domains. Each task includes directories, environment images, an evaluation harness, tests, and reference solutions. Contamination resistance relies on reverse-engineered task construction and dataset versioning rather than secrecy.
summary_en.experiments: The report includes a cross-model leaderboard. The subsets cover repository-level engineering, front-end development, office/business workflows, and security tasks. The abstract does not provide exact task counts, model rankings, or scores, but states that task assets, environments, tests, and reference solutions are openly released.
summary_en.authors_note: Released by the Tencent WorkBuddy Bench Team as a coding-agent benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 值得看任务构造协议而非榜单；公开 benchmark 还能抗污染，这个假设需要用后续版本持续检验。
recommendation.en: Read the task-construction protocol, not the leaderboard; the claim that an open benchmark can resist contamination needs longitudinal validation.

paper.title: Case study: solving P-99 with LPTP and an LLM
paper.abstract: Ninety-Nine Prolog Problems (P-99) is a famous set of Prolog exercises. We solved the first thirty three just by prompting an LLM (Large Language Model). We used Claude from Anthropic. By solved we mean: generate the Prolog code and a test file, run the tests and check whether they pass, then formally prove types, groundness, termination, uniqueness, existence and also sometimes functional correctness with LPTP (Logic Program Theorem Prover). Hence our approach is an experiment in vibe-coding/ve

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 是否能从英文非形式规格出发，生成 Prolog 解法、测试文件，并进一步产出可由 LPTP 检查的可靠性证明。
summary.importance: 这是一个 LLM 辅助编程与形式验证的案例研究，贡献不是新模型或新训练方法，而是展示“vibe-coding + vericoding”的完整产物链：代码、测试、类型/终止性/存在唯一性等证明。对预训练研究员的价值主要是了解代码模型评测中测试通过与形式保证之间的差距。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用 Claude 解决 P-99 的前 33 个 Prolog 练习。流程包括从自然语言题意生成 Prolog 程序和测试，运行测试，再让 LLM 生成 LPTP 证明脚本，覆盖类型、groundness、termination、uniqueness、existence，有时也覆盖函数正确性；所有生成文件由人工检查。
summary.experiments: Claude 生成了 58 个逻辑过程、508 个测试、257 个引理，总计约 11800 行证明。实验没有多模型对比、自动化成功率统计或标准化 benchmark 分析；证据主要来自前 33 个 P-99 题目的人工审查案例。

summary_en.core_problem: Test whether an LLM can start from informal English specifications, generate Prolog solutions and tests, and then produce LPTP-checkable reliability proofs.
summary_en.importance: This is a case study in LLM-assisted programming and formal verification. It does not introduce a new model or training method; its contribution is a full artifact chain for “vibe-coding” plus “vericoding”: code, tests, and proofs of properties such as types, termination, uniqueness, and existence. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is the gap between passing tests and producing formally checkable guarantees.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use Claude to solve the first 33 problems from P-99. The workflow asks the model to generate Prolog code and test files, run the tests, and then generate LPTP proof scripts for types, groundness, termination, uniqueness, existence, and sometimes functional correctness. The generated files are manually inspected.
summary_en.experiments: Claude produced 58 logic procedures, 508 tests, 257 lemmas, and around 11,800 proof lines. The study does not include multi-model comparison, automated success-rate statistics, or a standardized benchmark analysis; the evidence is a manually checked case study over the first 33 P-99 tasks.

recommendation.zh: 只看产物统计即可；它提醒代码评测别停在 tests，但样本太手工，不能当能力曲线。
recommendation.en: Read only the artifact counts; it usefully warns against test-only code evaluation, but the manual setup is not a capability curve.
