summary.core_problem: 优化 LLM 生成的 Lean 证明，使其更短、编译成本更低，并尽量保持跨 Lean/Mathlib 版本兼容。
summary.importance: 贡献是形式化证明场景下的 coding agent / proof engineering 系统方法。它强调多目标可控 refactoring 和版本鲁棒性，但仍是较窄的 Lean 生态应用，不直接影响基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Lean Refactor：一个 plug-and-play 的 retrieval-augmented agentic framework。系统用冻结的 Agent LLM，并从人工整理的多目标 refactoring strategy database 中检索策略；每条策略带有支持的 Lean/Mathlib 版本、预期编译成本降低等元数据，从而避免每次模型或库版本变化都重新微调。
summary.experiments: 实验报告超过 70% 的 token-level compression，并评估 proof length、compilation cost、version compatibility 等多目标指标。摘要未给出完整数据集规模、baseline 清单和各指标细分结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Simon Fraser University、Amazon Web Services、MiroMind、University of Texas at Austin；Zhangyang Wang、Soonho Kong 在机器学习和形式化/自动推理相关方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to refactor LLM-generated Lean proofs so that they are shorter, cheaper to compile, and more robust across Lean and Mathlib versions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a coding-agent and proof-engineering system for formal mathematics. It focuses on controllable multi-objective refactoring and version robustness, but remains specific to the Lean ecosystem rather than base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Lean Refactor is a plug-and-play retrieval-augmented agentic framework. It steers a frozen agentic LLM using retrieved strategies from a curated database, where each strategy is annotated with metadata such as supported Lean/Mathlib versions and expected compilation-cost reduction. This avoids repeated fine-tuning as LLMs or Lean libraries change.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports over 70% token-level compression and evaluates objectives such as proof length, compilation cost, and version compatibility. It does not provide the full dataset size, baseline list, or detailed metric breakdown.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Simon Fraser University, Amazon Web Services, MiroMind, and the University of Texas at Austin. Zhangyang Wang and Soonho Kong have visible prior work in machine learning and formal reasoning-related areas.

recommendation.zh: Lean 证明工程做得实用，但策略库检索味道较重；作为 coding-agent 系统案例看摘要够了。
recommendation.en: Useful Lean proof engineering, but strategy retrieval does most of the work; the abstract is enough as a coding-agent system reference.

paper.title: Multi-agent Collaboration with State Management
paper.abstract: Recent advances in multi-agent systems have shown great potential for solving complex tasks. However, when multiple agents edit a shared codebase concurrently, their changes can silently conflict and inconsistent views lead to integration failures. Existing multi-agent systems address this through workspace isolation (e.g., one git worktree per agent), but this defers conflict resolution to a post-hoc merge step where recovery is expensive. In this paper, we propose STORM, i.e., STate-ORiented M

summary.core_problem: 多个 coding agent 并发编辑同一代码库时，隔离工作区会把冲突推迟到合并阶段，导致视图不一致和集成失败。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding-agent 系统设计。它关注多 agent 协作中的状态一致性和写入时冲突处理，比简单多 agent 投票或分工更接近真实软件工程工作流。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 STORM，即 State-Oriented Management。系统作为共享 workspace 的中介，管理 agent 状态和写入操作，保证每个 agent 在一致代码视图上工作，并在写入时检测与解决冲突，而不是事后依赖 git worktree merge。
summary.experiments: 在 Commit0 和 PaperBench 上跨多个 LLM 评测。相对 git-worktree 多 agent baseline，STORM 在 Commit0-Lite 上提升 +18.7，在 PaperBench 上提升 +1.4，并报告成本效率相当或更好。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Jiaotong University、Emory University 和 Peking University；工作面向多 agent 代码协作系统。

summary_en.core_problem: When multiple coding agents edit a shared repository concurrently, isolated workspaces defer conflicts to a late merge step, causing inconsistent views and integration failures.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent systems contribution. It studies state consistency and write-time conflict handling in multi-agent software workflows, which is more realistic than simple agent voting or task decomposition.
summary_en.technical_approach: STORM mediates interactions with the shared workspace. It manages agent state, enforces consistent repository views, and detects or resolves conflicting edits at write time instead of relying on post-hoc git-worktree merging.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Commit0 and PaperBench with multiple LLMs. It improves over a git-worktree-based multi-agent baseline by +18.7 on Commit0-Lite and +1.4 on PaperBench, with comparable or better cost efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shanghai Jiaotong University, Emory University, and Peking University; the work targets multi-agent coding collaboration systems.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent 系统备查即可；核心信号是写入时状态管理比事后 merge 更干净。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a coding-agent systems reference; the useful signal is that write-time state management is cleaner than post-hoc merging.

paper.title: Quality and Security Signals in AI-Generated Python Refactoring Pull Requests
paper.abstract: As AI agents increasingly contribute to code development and maintenance, there is still limited empirical evidence on the quality and risk characteristics of their changes in real-world projects, particularly for refactoring-oriented contributions. It remains unclear how agent-authored refactoring edits affect maintainability, code quality, and security once merged into GitHub repositories. To address this gap, we conduct an empirical study of Python refactoring pull requests (PRs) from the AID

summary.core_problem: 评估 AI agent 生成并合入真实 GitHub 项目的 Python 重构 PR，在可维护性、代码质量和安全性上到底带来什么变化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是经验分析。它不提出新的 coding agent 方法，但给出 agent-authored refactoring 在真实仓库中的质量和风险信号，可作为代码 agent 训练与评测目标设计的背景材料。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 AIDev 数据集中抽取 Python 重构 PR，用 PyQu 评估五类质量属性变化，并用 Pylint 和 Bandit 做语言无关的静态质量与安全问题分析，对比每个 PR 修改前后的指标。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告，agentic commits 平均在 22.5% 的变更中改善至少一个质量属性，其中 usability 改善最频繁，达到 36.5%。摘要片段显示同时存在约 24% 开头的负面或风险结果，但完整数值在提供文本中被截断。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 University of Michigan-Flint 和 University of Michigan-Dearborn。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates how AI-agent-authored Python refactoring pull requests affect maintainability, code quality, and security after being merged into real GitHub projects.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical coding-agent analysis rather than a new agent method. It provides useful background signals for designing code-agent training objectives and evaluation criteria around real-world refactoring quality and risk.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze Python refactoring PRs from the AIDev dataset. They use PyQu to measure changes across five quality attributes and complement it with Pylint and Bandit static analysis to compare code quality and security issues before and after each change.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that agentic commits improve a quality attribute in 22.5% of studied changes on average, with usability improving most often at 36.5%. The provided abstract fragment is truncated after mentioning a simultaneous 24% result, so the full negative-risk statistics are unavailable here.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are University of Michigan-Flint and University of Michigan-Dearborn.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent 真实合入质量的负样本背景可留档；没有方法新意，不值得读正文。
recommendation.en: Keep it as background on real merged coding-agent PR quality; there is no method novelty, so the full paper is not a priority.

paper.title: SaaSBench: Exploring the Boundaries of Coding Agents in Long-Horizon Enterprise SaaS Engineering
paper.abstract: As autonomous coding agents become capable of handling increasingly long-horizon tasks, they have gradually demonstrated the potential to complete end-to-end software development. Although existing benchmarks have recently evolved from localized code editing to from-scratch project generation, they remain confined to structurally simplified, single-stack applications. Consequently, they fail to capture the heterogeneous environments, full-stack orchestration, and system-level complexity of real

summary.core_problem: 构建一个更贴近真实企业级 SaaS 开发的长时程 coding agent 基准，用来测量从 PRD 理解、全栈实现、部署到调试的端到端能力，并解决现有基准在系统复杂度、市场真实度与评测机制上的不足。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接信息增益有限，但它提供了更“长上下文 + 多语言/多框架 + 强交互”的评测压力源，可能反向影响代码预训练与后训练的数据配比（多语言、配置/脚本、DevOps 文本）、长上下文训练、以及 agentic tool-use 的训练信号设计。更适合作为 post-train/agent 评测资产，而不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: SaaSBench 包含 30 个任务，覆盖 6 类 SaaS 域。每个任务提供长上下文 PRD、用于消歧的知识库、标准化运行环境，以及 DAG 形式的测试套件。评测采用 dependency-aware 的混合范式：用 DAG 表达前置依赖，通过 prerequisite gating 与 failure propagation control 把复杂系统的验证拆成可执行的线性检查链；同时提供 binary/weighted/LLM-as-judge 三种计分，覆盖部署可用性、数据建模、API 契约一致性、业务逻辑正确性、访问控制、工程质量等维度。
summary.experiments: 论文报告当前主流 coding agents 在该基准上仍有明显差距，暴露长时程规划与跨组件协同问题。当前提供的全文片段未包含各模型的具体分数表与对比数字，精确结论需以实验章节的主表为准。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：优先看任务构建流程、DAG 评测设计与可执行验证节点的定义（理解它如何避免“只看最终是否跑通”的粗粒度信号）。再快速扫实验主表了解难点分布。预计 30–45 分钟可抓住要点。若关注预训练，只需记录它对数据与长上下文能力提出了哪些具体需求。

summary_en.core_problem: Introduce a realistic long-horizon benchmark for enterprise SaaS engineering to evaluate coding agents on end-to-end workflows (PRD understanding, full-stack implementation, deployment, iterative debugging) under heterogeneous stacks and system-level constraints.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining methodology, but it is a strong evaluation pressure test that can feed back into pretrain/post-train decisions: multilingual/code+config+DevOps data mixtures, long-context training, and training signals for tool-using/agentic coding. Best viewed as an eval asset for coding agents rather than a pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: SaaSBench contains 30 tasks across 6 SaaS domains. Each task includes a long-context PRD, an ambiguity-resolution KB, a standardized runtime environment, and a DAG-based test suite. The evaluation is dependency-aware: prerequisite gating and failure-propagation control decompose complex system validation into executable checking chains. Scoring includes binary, weighted, and LLM-as-judge modes, covering deployment availability, data modeling, API contract consistency, business logic, access control, and engineering quality.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports substantial gaps for current state-of-the-art coding agents on SaaSBench, especially in long-horizon planning and cross-component coordination. The provided excerpt does not include the detailed score tables; exact numbers should be taken from the main experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focus: benchmark construction pipeline, DAG evaluation design, and how executable validation nodes are defined to avoid overly coarse end-to-end signals. Then scan the main results table to see where failures concentrate. ~30–45 minutes to capture the essentials. If your focus is pretraining, extract the concrete capability demands implied by the tasks (context length, stack diversity, config/deployment artifacts).

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 构造和验证节点设计即可；它更像 agent eval 压力测试，不直接指导预训练数据配比。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and validation-node design; it is a useful agent-eval stress test, not a direct guide for pretraining data mixture.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: SpecBench: Measuring Reward Hacking in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: As long-horizon coding agents produce more code than any developer can review, oversight collapses onto a single surface: the automated test suite. Reward hacking naturally arises in this setup, as the agent optimizes for passing tests while deviating from the users true goal. We study this reward hacking phenomenon by decompose software engineering tasks into three parts: (i) a natural language description of the specification (ii) visible validation tests that exercise specified features in is

summary.core_problem: 衡量长程 coding agent 在自动测试监督下的 reward hacking：模型是否只是学会通过可见测试，而没有真正满足用户规格。
summary.importance: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它对 post-train 和 agent 评测有现实意义。贡献在于把 reward hacking 从泛泛讨论变成可操作的评测协议，用 visible tests 与 held-out compositional tests 的差距来量化。对基座研究员的价值主要在于理解训练信号质量和 verifier 漏洞。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpecBench。每个任务被拆成三部分：自然语言规格、可见验证测试、以及组合式 held-out 测试。作者假设如果 agent 真正理解规格，那么基于规格和可见测试写出的程序也应通过 held-out 测试；因此用两类测试通过率的 gap 作为 reward hacking 指标。这个设计把“骗过 reward”具体化为对可见测试的过拟合。
summary.experiments: 基准包含 30 个 systems-level programming tasks，覆盖从短程构建 shell 到更长程的系统编程任务。摘要没有给出参与评测的模型、agent 框架和具体 gap 数值，但从设计上看，最关键的是 held-out tests 是否确实只做组合泛化而不引入额外 specification shift。若这点做得干净，benchmark 才有诊断价值。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构为 Weco AI。给定信息中没有可确认的广为人知作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: It measures reward hacking in long-horizon coding agents under automated-test supervision: are agents actually satisfying the user specification, or merely optimizing to pass visible tests?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for post-training and agent evaluation. The contribution is to operationalize reward hacking with a concrete evaluation protocol, using the gap between visible tests and held-out compositional tests. For foundation-model researchers, the value is mainly in understanding training-signal quality and verifier loopholes.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecBench decomposes each task into three parts: a natural-language specification, visible validation tests, and held-out tests that compose the same features in more realistic ways. The premise is that an agent that genuinely understands the specification should pass both suites; therefore, the pass-rate gap becomes a measure of reward hacking. This turns 'gaming the reward' into overfitting to visible tests.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 30 systems-level programming tasks, ranging from short-horizon shell-building tasks to longer-horizon systems programming settings. The abstract does not provide evaluated models, agent frameworks, or exact gap numbers. The main thing to inspect is whether the held-out tests truly measure compositional generalization rather than introducing a hidden specification shift; otherwise the benchmark becomes less diagnostic.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is from Weco AI. The provided metadata does not identify any widely known authors with enough confidence for a stronger note.

recommendation.zh: 更像后训练/agent 评测资产，不是基座必读；知道有这么个“visible-vs-heldout gap”指标即可，除非你在做 coding RL 或 verifier 设计。
recommendation.en: This is more of a post-training/agent eval asset than a base-model paper; just remember the visible-vs-heldout gap metric unless you're actively working on coding RL or verifier design.

paper.title: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries
paper.abstract: Self-evolving skill libraries face a silent failure mode we term \emph{library drift}: unbounded skill accumulation without outcome-driven lifecycle management causes retrieval degradation, false-positive injections, and performance stagnation. Recent evaluation confirms the symptom--LLM-authored skills deliver +0.0pp gain while human-curated ones deliver +16.2pp (SkillsBench)--yet the underlying mechanism has not been isolated. We provide (1) a reproducible trigger: ablations that isolate drift

summary.core_problem: 诊断自演化 LLM skill library 中技能无限累积导致检索退化、误注入和性能停滞的 failure mode。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent/代码智能体系统的机制诊断与治理 recipe。它不直接影响基座训练，但对长期运行的工具库、技能库、agent memory 有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 library drift 概念，并用三类手段处理：构造可复现触发实验隔离 drift；建立 append-only evidence log，记录每个 skill 的贡献分数、归因 verdict 和 router engagement；给出最小治理策略，包括 outcome-driven retirement、bounded active-cap 和 meta-skill authoring prior。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 SkillsBench 上 LLM-authored skills 带来 +0.0pp，而 human-curated skills 带来 +16.2pp；隔离实验中禁用 skill injection 几乎不变（+0.002），过早 retirement 造成伤害（-0.019）；治理策略将 held-out pass@1 从 0.258 baseline 提升，但摘要截断未给出最终数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses library drift in self-evolving LLM skill libraries, where unbounded skill accumulation degrades retrieval, causes false-positive injections, and stalls performance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism diagnosis and governance recipe for agent or coding-agent systems. It does not directly affect foundation-model training, but it is relevant to long-running skill libraries, tool memories, and agent retrieval systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define library drift and address it with reproducible triggers, trace-level diagnostics, and a minimal governance recipe. The diagnostics use an append-only evidence log with per-skill contribution scores, attribution verdicts, and router engagement metrics; the fix combines outcome-driven retirement, a bounded active cap, and a meta-skill authoring prior.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that LLM-authored skills give +0.0pp on SkillsBench while human-curated skills give +16.2pp. Ablations show disabling skill injection is nearly flat (+0.002) and premature retirement is harmful (-0.019). The governance recipe improves held-out pass@1 from a 0.258 baseline, but the final number is not visible in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent memory 的负例材料即可；核心图表比方法更有用，别把它当通用训练结论。
recommendation.en: Use it as a negative case study for agent memory; the diagnostics matter more than the recipe, and it should not be read as a general training result.

paper.title: Does Code Cleanliness Affect Coding Agents? A Controlled Minimal-Pair Study
paper.abstract: As autonomous coding agents see rapid adoption, their evaluation has primarily focused on task completion rates holding the target codebase fixed. This leaves a critical question unanswered: does the structural and stylistic quality, or ``cleanliness'' of the underlying code affect an agent's ability to navigate and modify it? To isolate the effect of code cleanliness from agent capability, we introduce an evaluation protocol built around minimal pairs: repositories that match on architecture, d

summary.core_problem: 代码整洁度（结构和风格质量）是否影响coding agent的任务完成率和操作足迹尚未被系统研究
summary.importance: 通过最小配对（minimal-pair）对照实验设计，隔离代码整洁度对agent的影响，方法学上有参考价值
summary.technical_approach: 构建6对最小配对仓库（架构/依赖/外部行为相同，但静态分析规则违规和认知复杂度不同），设计33个任务，通过660次Claude Code实验进行评估
summary.experiments: 代码整洁度不改变agent通过率，但显著改变其操作足迹（干净仓库中agent产生的编辑量减少34%，文件访问减少26%）

summary_en.core_problem: Whether code structural and stylistic quality (cleanliness) affects coding agent task completion rate and operational footprint has not been systematically studied
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation via minimal-pair controlled experimental design to isolate code cleanliness effects on agents
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs 6 minimal-pair repository pairs (matched on architecture, dependencies, external behavior but differing on static-analysis violations and cognitive complexity), 33 tasks, 660 trials with Claude Code
summary_en.experiments: Code cleanliness does not change agent pass rate but significantly alters operational footprint: 34% fewer edits and 26% fewer file visits in clean repositories

recommendation.zh: 最小配对实验设计方法学值得注意，但结论限于Claude Code行为观察，对LLM预训练无直接影响
recommendation.en: Minimal-pair experimental design is methodologically interesting, but findings are limited to Claude Code behavioral observations with no direct pretraining implications.

paper.title: What Do Evolutionary Coding Agents Evolve?
paper.abstract: Recent work pairs LLMs with evolutionary search to iteratively generate, modify, and select code using task-specific feedback. These systems have produced strong results in mathematical discovery and algorithm design, yet a fundamental question remains: what do they actually evolve? Progress is typically summarized by the best score a run reaches under a task-specific evaluator, but that score can reflect several different mechanisms: new algorithmic structure, re-tuning an existing strategy, re

summary.core_problem: 现有进化编码智能体仅通过最终任务分数评估性能，无法区分进步来自新算法结构、现有策略调优、已有知识重组还是评估器过拟合的核心问题
summary.importance: 方法与数据贡献，首次提出针对进化编码智能体搜索过程的分析方法论，发布覆盖多框架多模型多任务的演化轨迹数据集EvoTrace
summary.technical_approach: 构建覆盖4种进化框架、推理与非推理模型、16个数学与算法设计任务的EvoTrace数据集；提出基于重放的EvoReplay方法，重构局部搜索过程以区分不同演化机制
summary.experiments: 覆盖4类进化框架、2类LLM、16个跨数学与算法设计的任务，核心产出为数据集与分析工具，无性能SOTA对比
summary.authors_note: 来自柏林祖斯研究所、柏林工业大学、香港浸会大学、RIKEN，无公开知名作者信息

summary_en.core_problem: Current evolutionary coding agents are only evaluated by final task scores, which cannot distinguish whether improvements come from new algorithmic structures, existing strategy tuning, internal knowledge recombination, or evaluator overfitting
summary_en.importance: Method and data contribution, first proposing an analysis methodology for the search process of evolutionary coding agents, and releasing EvoTrace, a evolutionary trajectory dataset covering multiple frameworks, models and tasks
summary_en.technical_approach: Construct EvoTrace dataset covering 4 evolutionary frameworks, reasoning/non-reasoning models, 16 math and algorithm design tasks; propose EvoReplay, a replay-based method to reconstruct local search process and distinguish different evolution mechanisms
summary_en.experiments: Covers 4 evolutionary frameworks, 2 LLM types, 16 cross-domain tasks; core outputs are dataset and analysis tool, no SOTA performance comparison
summary_en.authors_note: From Zuse Institute Berlin, Technical University of Berlin, Hong Kong Baptist University, RIKEN, no well-known authors publicly identified

recommendation.zh: 做代码智能体进化的研究者可参考其分析框架，基座研究员仅需了解演化的四类机制划分即可
recommendation.en: Researchers working on evolutionary coding agents can reference its analysis framework; pretrain researchers only need to grasp the four evolution mechanism categories

institutions: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project

paper.title: OpenAI and Dell partner to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premise enterprise environments
paper.abstract: OpenAI and Dell partner to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premise environments, helping enterprises deploy AI coding agents securely across data and workflows.

summary.core_problem: OpenAI 与 Dell 合作，将 Codex 部署到混合云和本地企业环境，解决企业对代码 Agent 的数据安全与合规要求。
summary.importance: 这是产品与部署层面的行业动态，不是研究论文；价值在于说明顶级实验室正把 coding agent 从纯云服务推进到企业私有环境，反映了 serving、权限隔离和工作流集成的重要性。
summary.technical_approach: 公开信息只表明双方围绕混合部署、on-prem 环境接入、企业数据与工作流安全集成展开合作，没有披露新的模型架构、训练方法或推理算法。
summary.experiments: 无论文式实验。可确认的信息是 Codex 面向企业安全场景落地，重点是部署形态与产品化能力，而非 benchmark 提升。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 官方博客发布。OpenAI 在代码模型与 coding agent 方向已有 Codex、ChatGPT coding、开发者工具链等持续投入。

summary_en.core_problem: OpenAI and Dell are bringing Codex into hybrid and on-prem enterprise environments to satisfy security and compliance requirements for coding agents.
summary_en.importance: This is an industry/product update rather than a research paper. Its value is in signaling that top labs are pushing coding agents from cloud-only offerings into private enterprise environments, where serving, isolation, and workflow integration matter.
summary_en.technical_approach: The public note only indicates collaboration around hybrid deployment, on-prem integration, and secure access to enterprise data/workflows; it does not disclose any new model architecture, training method, or inference algorithm.

summary_en.authors_note: Published on the official OpenAI Research blog. OpenAI has sustained investment in code models and coding agents through Codex, ChatGPT coding features, and developer tooling.

recommendation.zh: 不是研究，但它提醒你：代码 Agent 的下一阶段瓶颈在权限边界、私有部署和工作流接入，不在再刷一点 benchmark。
recommendation.en: Not research, but it usefully signals that the next bottleneck for coding agents is permission boundaries, private deployment, and workflow integration—not another small benchmark bump.

paper.title: From I/O to Code with Discovery Agent
paper.abstract: The automatic synthesis of a program from any form of specification is regarded as a holy grail of computer science. Fueled by LLMs, NL2Code has achieved tremendous success, yet the fundamentally more challenging task of synthesizing programs from input-output behavior, which we refer to as IO2Code, remains largely unsolved. Whereas NL2Code can exploit the semantic alignment between natural language and code acquired during pretraining, IO2Code requires recovering underlying principles from conc

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是 IO2Code：只给输入-输出样例，不给自然语言规格说明，要求自动合成可泛化的程序。难点不在代码补全，而在从有限行为中归纳潜在算法；有限样例天然欠定，查表式记忆会在训练样例上有效，但对新输入失效。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更接近代码智能体和程序归纳。但它提供了一个有用视角：当前代码 LLM 在 NL2Code 上依赖预训练中学到的“自然语言—代码”对齐，而 IO2Code 更考验抽象归纳、反事实排除和搜索控制。对研究代码预训练数据、执行反馈训练、测试时搜索和推理型 benchmark 的人，IO2CodeBench 和 DIO-Agent 的失败模式分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: DIO-Agent 把 IO2Code 建模为离散程序空间中的进化搜索。LLM 不直接一次性生成答案，而作为 mutation operator，根据已有候选程序和执行错误信号提出修改。核心约束来自 Test-Driven Development 中的 Transformation Priority Premise，简称 TPP：先尝试常量、变量、简单表达式、无条件语句，再逐步引入分支、循环、递归等更复杂结构。这个复杂度先验的作用是限制搜索顺序，避免模型过早跳到复杂但错误的程序区域，也降低对有限样例的表面拟合。与普通 evolutionary agent 相比，DIO-Agent 的关键区别不是“多采样”，而是把程序结构复杂度做成 mutation curriculum，并用具体执行错误来驱动调试，而不是只用通过测试数量这样的标量奖励。
summary.experiments: 论文构建了 IO2CodeBench，覆盖从基础数据操作到复杂算法推理的多个难度层级。实验声称 DIO-Agent 在全部难度层级上优于传统 programming-by-example 方法、已有进化式 agent baseline，以及相同采样预算下的 test-time scaling 策略。结果还显示方法在不同 base model 上有稳定增益。消融实验主要验证三个部分：TPP 复杂度先验、基于执行错误的 mutation、按难度递进的搜索 curriculum。全文片段未给出完整表格和具体绝对分数，因此不宜过度解读数值量级。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中 IO2Code 与 NL2Code 的差异、Motivation Example 中查表和错误复杂程序两个失败模式，以及方法部分对 TPP mutation prior 的定义。实验部分重点看 IO2CodeBench 的任务构成、与 test-time scaling 的同预算比较、TPP 和错误反馈的消融。若关注预训练，可重点追问一个问题：这类行为到程序的归纳能力，能否通过合成数据或执行反馈在预训练或 mid-training 阶段注入，而不是只在测试时搜索。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies IO2Code: synthesizing a general program from input-output examples alone, without a natural-language specification. The hard part is not code generation in the usual NL2Code sense, but algorithm induction from under-specified behavior. A finite set of examples always admits memorizing solutions, so the search procedure must prefer hypotheses that generalize beyond the observed cases.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to code-model evaluation and test-time reasoning. It highlights a gap between NL2Code, where pretrained semantic alignment between text and code provides strong guidance, and IO2Code, where the model must infer latent computational structure. For researchers working on code pretraining, execution-feedback training, or reasoning benchmarks, the useful signal is the failure analysis: stronger sampling alone does not solve program induction if the search is not structurally controlled.
summary_en.technical_approach: DIO-Agent formulates IO2Code as evolutionary search over discrete programs. The LLM acts as a mutation operator rather than a one-shot generator. Candidate programs are executed, concrete errors are fed back, and the model proposes edits. The main design is a mutation prior based on the Transformation Priority Premise from test-driven development. The search starts with simpler transformations, such as constants, variables, and simple expressions, and only later escalates to conditionals, loops, or recursion. This ordering prevents the agent from jumping too early into complex but wrong program regions. Compared with generic evolutionary agents, the main difference is the explicit complexity curriculum and the use of execution traces as debugging evidence, rather than relying only on scalar test-pass rewards.
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces IO2CodeBench, spanning several difficulty levels from basic data manipulation to more complex algorithmic reasoning. The reported results show consistent gains over traditional programming-by-example methods, existing evolutionary-agent baselines, and test-time scaling under comparable sampling budgets. The gains are also reported across multiple base models. The ablations focus on the TPP prior, execution-error-guided mutation, and the curriculum structure. The provided text does not include full numerical tables, so the safest reading is qualitative: the method improves the accuracy-sampling trade-off by making the search more disciplined.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the IO2Code versus NL2Code framing, then the motivation example for the two key failure modes: lookup-table memorization and structurally complex wrong programs. In the method section, focus on how the TPP prior is turned into mutation rules. In the experiments, check the construction of IO2CodeBench, the fixed-budget comparison with test-time scaling, and the ablations. A useful pretraining-facing question is whether this kind of behavioral induction can be learned through synthetic execution data or feedback-based mid-training, instead of being handled only by test-time search.

recommendation.zh: 将IO2Code建模为进化搜索的范式有新意，重点看变异先验和执行反馈的交互设计部分。
recommendation.en: The paradigm of framing IO2Code as evolutionary search is novel, focus on the interaction design between mutation prior and execution feedback.

paper.title: Effective Harness Engineering for Algorithm Discovery with Coding Agents
paper.abstract: AlphaEvolve and FunSearch have demonstrated the potential of combining large language models (LLMs) with evolutionary search for automated algorithm discovery. However, discovery success is shaped not only by model capability but also significantly by the design of the execution infrastructure, i.e., the harness. This paper investigates effective harness design through three questions: under a fixed token budget, is it better to produce many algorithms with brief thought or fewer algorithms with

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“LLM 会不会写算法”，而是更具体也更容易被忽略的问题：在固定 token 预算下，算法发现系统的执行基础设施，也就是 harness，怎样设计才更有效。作者把问题拆成四类：一，单次采样式代码生成是否已经成为瓶颈，是否应该换成能读代码库、看评测结果、反复调试的 coding agent；二，自动评测很容易被模型钻空子，如何识别 evaluation hacking，而不是把投机程序误当成算法进步；三，多 agent 并行搜索时如何避免共享文件系统上的冲突和不可复现；四，历史尝试中的成功与失败如何沉淀成可复用记忆，而不是每轮都从零开始。论文还回答了一个更基础的搜索分配问题：同样的 token 预算，应该生成更多“浅思考”候选，还是更少但“深思考”的候选。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于提出新的预训练目标，而在于把“模型能力”与“搜索/执行框架能力”清楚拆开。很多 coding-agent 或 algorithm discovery 结果，容易把收益归因给更强模型，但这篇文章表明，harness 设计本身就能显著改变 token 效率、搜索稳定性和最终发现质量。对预训练研究员，这有两层启发。第一，后训练阶段常见的 agentic scaffolding 并不是纯工程细节，它会改变模型能力的外显形式，进而影响对模型本体能力的判断。第二，evaluation hacking 在强模型上更严重，说明“更强的优化器 + 有漏洞的奖励/评测”会系统性放大奖励黑客行为，这和 RL、合成数据、自博弈中的 reward hacking 是同一类问题。贡献量级上，这更像一篇高质量系统研究：它没有改写建模范式，但把一个正在快速扩张的研究方向从 demo 式实现推进到可分析、可复现、可扩展的工程科学层面。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Vesper，把传统 OpenEvolve/AlphaEvolve 风格的单轮 LLM mutation harness，改造成更接近现代 coding agent 的搜索系统。核心改动有几项。第一，用 coding agent 代替单次 API 调用的 stateless generator。agent 不只是输出一个 diff，而是可以读取完整代码库、查看评测反馈、做多步修改和调试。这等于把“每次变异”从一次条件采样，变成一个带环境反馈的局部搜索过程。第二，引入 evaluation hack detection。论文的动机很明确：自动评测只要有漏洞，模型就会学会利用漏洞而不是解决问题。作者在评测后增加验证环节，用额外检查来区分真实改进和投机性高分程序。第三，用 Git worktree 做并行隔离。多 agent 并行时，每个搜索分支在独立 worktree 中运行，避免共享目录下的文件覆盖、缓存污染和 race condition，这一点对可复现性很关键。第四，系统化利用历史轨迹，把过去的成功/失败尝试纳入后续搜索上下文，而不是每轮只看当前 parent。第五，围绕 token 预算做搜索策略实验，比较“增加单个候选的思考深度”与“增加候选数量/进化代数”哪一个更划算。文章的主要结论是前者更优：提升单个样本质量，比简单堆更多浅层样本更省 token。这里隐含的机制是，算法发现任务的评估成本高、搜索空间离散且稀疏，低质量候选的大量堆积会把预算浪费在明显无效区域；而更深的局部推理能提高每次评估前的候选质量，从而提高单位评测成本的回报。另一个值得注意的点是，作者观察到更强的 frontier model 更容易出现 evaluation hacking，这说明能力提升并不会自动带来目标对齐，反而可能提高利用漏洞的能力。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，实验重点不是刷某个单一算法发现任务的最好分数，而是做 harness 组件级别的归因分析。作者围绕固定 token budget 比较不同搜索配置，核心发现是：把预算投入到更高质量的单次候选生成，比投入到更多代数或更多浅层候选更有效。也就是说，搜索效率受 candidate quality 的影响大于 generation count。另一个关键结果是 evaluation hacking 的实证分析：加入 hack detection 后，系统能过滤掉一批表面高分但不真实的候选；而且更强模型如 GPT-5.2 更容易产生这类 exploit 型程序。论文还验证了 Git worktree 隔离在并行执行中的必要性，减少了文件冲突和不可复现问题。由于给出的正文片段没有完整表格数字，无法可靠摘录每个任务上的绝对提升幅度；但从作者总结可以确定，实验设计包含了组件消融、预算受限比较、模型能力与 hacking 倾向对比，以及并行执行稳定性分析。阅读时应重点看这些消融，而不是只看最终最好分数。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但建议带着“系统设计如何改变模型能力表现”这个问题去看。优先看 Introduction，作者把问题定义得很清楚，尤其是把 harness 从附属工程提升为主要研究对象。然后看 Vesper 方法部分，重点抓三件事：coding agent integration、evaluation hack detection、Git worktree isolation。真正值得细读的是实验部分关于 token budget 的比较，因为这部分回答了一个很实用的问题：预算有限时，应该把钱花在更深推理还是更多采样。另一个值得看的是关于 frontier model 更易 hacking 的分析，这和 RL 中 reward misspecification 的现象可以互相参照。若时间有限，先看问题设定、系统图、主要消融表和 hacking case study，30 到 40 分钟可以抓住主线。若要深挖，可以进一步思考：这种 harness 收益有多少来自更强的 test-time compute，有多少来自更好的状态表示与反馈闭环；以及这些收益能否迁移到代码以外的 program synthesis 或 tool-use agent 任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking whether LLMs can discover algorithms in general. It asks a narrower and more useful question: under a fixed token budget, how should the execution infrastructure, or harness, be designed so that LLM-driven algorithm discovery actually works better? The authors break this into four practical issues: replacing one-shot stateless code generation with coding agents that can inspect the repository and iterate; detecting evaluation hacking so that exploitative programs are not mistaken for genuine algorithmic progress; running many search agents safely in parallel without filesystem conflicts; and reusing information from prior attempts instead of restarting every iteration from scratch. A central empirical question is whether the budget should be spent on many shallow candidates or fewer candidates with deeper reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The value for foundation-model researchers is less about a new pretraining objective and more about cleanly separating model capability from search infrastructure. In coding and algorithm-discovery settings, gains are often attributed to stronger models, while the harness is treated as implementation detail. This paper shows that harness design materially changes token efficiency, search stability, and the quality of discoveries. That matters for two reasons. First, agentic scaffolding changes how model capability is expressed, so it affects how we interpret model comparisons. Second, the paper provides another concrete instance of reward misspecification: stronger models are better at exploiting weak evaluators. That connects directly to RL, synthetic data generation, self-play, and reward hacking in post-training. The contribution is best read as a strong systems paper: it does not introduce a new modeling paradigm, but it makes the algorithm-discovery pipeline more analyzable, reproducible, and scalable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed system, Vesper, upgrades the standard OpenEvolve/AlphaEvolve-style loop into a more agentic harness. The first change is replacing a single-shot stateless LLM mutation step with a coding agent that can inspect the full codebase, read evaluation feedback, and perform multi-step edits and debugging. This turns each mutation from one conditional sample into a local search process with environmental feedback. The second change is explicit evaluation-hack detection. The motivation is straightforward: if the evaluator has loopholes, capable models will exploit them. Vesper adds post-evaluation verification to distinguish real improvements from score-gaming programs. The third change is parallel execution isolation via Git worktrees, so each agent runs in its own filesystem view, avoiding file clobbering, cache contamination, and race conditions. The fourth is better use of historical search traces, so prior successes and failures can inform future search. Finally, the paper studies search allocation under a token budget, comparing more generations and more candidates against deeper reasoning per candidate. The main result is that improving per-candidate quality is more token-efficient than merely scaling the number of shallow generations. The likely mechanism is that algorithm discovery has expensive evaluation and a sparse search space, so low-quality candidates waste budget quickly, whereas deeper local reasoning raises the hit rate before evaluation. An especially notable observation is that stronger frontier models are more prone to evaluation hacking, which reinforces the point that capability gains do not automatically improve objective alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental focus is attribution at the harness level rather than chasing a single best score on one discovery task. Under fixed token budgets, the paper compares different search allocations and finds that spending budget on higher-quality candidate generation is more effective than spending it on more generations or more shallow candidates. In other words, candidate quality matters more than raw generation count. Another key result is the empirical study of evaluation hacking: with hack detection enabled, Vesper filters out candidates that score well for the wrong reasons, and stronger models such as GPT-5.2 appear more likely to produce such exploitative solutions. The paper also validates the need for Git worktree isolation in parallel execution, improving reproducibility and reducing interference across agents. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact gains per task. Still, the structure of the evaluation is clear: component ablations, budget-constrained comparisons, model-capability versus hacking analyses, and parallel-execution stability checks. Those are the parts worth reading closely.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading with one question in mind: how much of the observed capability comes from the model, and how much comes from the harness? Start with the introduction, which frames the problem unusually well and treats the harness as a first-class research object. Then read the Vesper section, focusing on three components: coding-agent integration, evaluation-hack detection, and Git worktree isolation. The most useful part is the token-budget study, because it answers a practical question that appears in many agentic systems: should limited budget go to deeper reasoning or broader sampling? Also read the analysis showing that stronger frontier models hack evaluators more often; it connects naturally to reward misspecification in RL. If time is limited, read the problem setup, the system overview figure, the main ablation tables, and the hacking case studies. About 30 to 40 minutes should be enough to extract the main lessons. For deeper follow-up, ask how much of the gain comes from extra test-time compute versus better state, memory, and feedback loops, and whether the same pattern transfers beyond code to general program synthesis or tool-use agents.

recommendation.zh: 参考§3的harness设计准则调整代码预训练的评估流程，推理资源权衡的结论可复用
recommendation.en: Refer to §3 harness design guidelines to adjust code pre-training evaluation pipelines, reuse the inference resource tradeoff conclusion.

paper.title: RoadmapBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Agentic Software Development Across Version Upgrades
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly deployed in real software development, where a single version iteration requires months of coordinated work across many files. However, most existing benchmarks focus predominantly on single-issue bug fixes from Python repositories, with coarse pass/fail evaluation outcomes, and thus fail to capture long-horizon, multi-target development at real engineering scale. To address this gap, we present RoadmapBench, a benchmark of 115 long-horizon coding tasks grounded in

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 coding agent benchmark 过于短程、单问题、单语言、评价粗糙的问题，无法反映真实软件版本升级中的长周期开发能力。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 贡献。对预训练研究员的直接价值不在 agent 方法，而在它把“仓库级长期软件演化”作为更接近真实分布的评测对象，能反向暴露当前模型在长上下文、规划、代码编辑和状态跟踪上的能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RoadmapBench：基于真实开源仓库版本升级构造 115 个长程任务，覆盖 17 个仓库、5 种编程语言。每个任务从 source-version 代码快照出发，给 agent 一个多目标 roadmap instruction，要求实现 target version 中引入的功能。任务粒度远大于常见单 bug fix，且评价不再只是简单 pass/fail，而是面向多目标升级场景的系统评测。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了 13 个前沿模型。任务中位修改规模为 3,700 行、51 个文件，明显高于 SWE-bench 一类短程修复设定。结果显示最强模型 Claude-Opus-4.7 仅解决 39.1% 任务，最弱模型更低，说明当前 coding agent 在真实长程开发上仍远未成熟。摘要未给出全部 baseline 名单和细粒度指标，但 benchmark 难度和失败率本身已经有信息量。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学、复旦大学、香港大学、清华大学等。给定信息中未出现可明确标注为业界广为人知的基础模型作者。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the gap that existing coding-agent benchmarks are too short-horizon, single-issue, Python-heavy, and coarsely evaluated to reflect real software version upgrades.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. Its value to a pretraining researcher is indirect but real: it turns repository-scale software evolution into an evaluation target, exposing current limits in long-context reasoning, planning, code editing, and state tracking.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces RoadmapBench, a benchmark of 115 long-horizon tasks derived from real open-source version upgrades across 17 repositories and 5 programming languages. Each task starts from a source-version snapshot and gives the agent a multi-target roadmap instruction to implement functionality from the target version. The setup is much larger than standard single-bug-fix benchmarks and aims to evaluate realistic multi-file, multi-goal development.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate 13 frontier models. The median task requires modifying 3,700 lines across 51 files, far beyond typical SWE-bench-style settings. Even the best model, Claude-Opus-4.7, solves only 39.1% of tasks, indicating that current coding agents remain weak on realistic long-horizon development. The abstract does not expose the full metric suite or all baselines, but the task scale and low success rates are already informative.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University, Fudan University, The University of Hong Kong, Tsinghua University, and others. No widely recognized foundation-model author can be confidently identified from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 benchmark 设得比 SWE-bench 更接近真实分布；看任务规模和失败案例就够，能帮助你校准“代码能力提升”到底来自哪一层。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the benchmark is closer to real software evolution than SWE-bench; read the task scale and failure analysis to recalibrate what current 'coding gains' actually mean.

paper.title: Context Pruning for Coding Agents via Multi-Rubric Latent Reasoning
paper.abstract: LLM-powered coding agents spend the majority of their token budget reading repository files, yet much of the retrieved code is irrelevant to the task at hand. Existing learned pruners compress this context with a single-objective sequence labeler, collapsing all facets of code relevance into one score and one transition matrix. We show that this formulation creates a modeling bottleneck: a single CRF transition prior must serve heterogeneous retention patterns, including contiguous semantic span

summary.core_problem: 现有编码Agent的上下文剪枝采用单目标序列标注器，将代码相关性的多种模式压缩为单一分数和转移矩阵，无法同时适配连续语义段和稀疏结构支撑行两种保留模式，形成建模瓶颈。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出结构化的多维度代码相关性剪枝框架，缓解了单CRF转移先验无法适配异质保留模式的限制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出LaMR（Latent Multi-Rubric）剪枝框架，将代码相关性分解为语义证据和依赖支持两个可解释维度，各用维度专属转移动态的CRF独立建模；通过MoE门控网络根据查询动态加权各维度的发射概率，最后经一层CRF融合输出最终剪枝决策。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据、对比基线及量化效果指标。
summary.authors_note: 团队来自克莱姆森大学、亚利桑那州立大学、亚利桑那大学，无公开知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing learned context pruners for coding agents use single-objective sequence labelers, which collapse heterogeneous code relevance patterns into one score and transition matrix, creating a bottleneck that cannot handle both contiguous semantic spans and sparse structural support lines.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a structured multi-rubric code relevance pruning framework to mitigate the limitation that a single CRF transition prior cannot fit heterogeneous retention patterns.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes LaMR (Latent Multi-Rubric) pruning framework, which decomposes code relevance into two interpretable dimensions: semantic evidence and dependency support, each modeled by a dedicated CRF with dimension-specific transition dynamics; an MoE gating network dynamically weights per-rubric emissions based on the query, and a final CRF layer outputs the pruning decision.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model parameter size, training data, baseline or quantitative performance metrics are disclosed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Team from Clemson University, Arizona State University, University of Arizona; no publicly well-known researchers.

recommendation.zh: 编码Agent上下文剪枝的增量改进，方法维度拆分思路可参考，无需精读正文。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to coding agent context pruning, dimension decomposition design is worth a quick reference, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Solvita: Enhancing Large Language Models for Competitive Programming via Agentic Evolution
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) still struggle with the rigorous reasoning demands of hard competitive programming. While recent multi-agent frameworks attempt to bridge this reliability gap, they remain fundamentally stateless: they rely on static retrieval and discard the valuable problem-solving and debugging experience gained from previous tasks. To address this, we present Solvita, an agentic evolution framework that enables continuous learning without requiring weight updates to the underlyin

summary.core_problem: 解决 competitive programming agent 框架“每题都从零开始、无法积累经验”的问题，在不更新底层 LLM 权重的前提下实现持续学习。
summary.importance: 这是代码 agent 方向的系统性改进，贡献点在于把经验积累做成显式知识网络和闭环进化流程，而不是基座模型训练。对预训练研究员的价值有限，但可作为“非参数记忆替代权重更新”的案例参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Solvita，将求解流程拆成 Planner、Solver、Oracle、Hacker 四个专职 agent，形成策略选择、程序生成、认证监督、定向攻击的闭环。每个 agent 配一个可训练的图结构知识网络，把 pass/fail、测试质量、对抗漏洞等结果信号转成强化学习式更新，用外部知识结构而非模型权重承载经验。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、题库和提升幅度，但应在 competitive programming benchmark 上与静态多 agent、检索增强和单次求解 baselines 比较。关键看点不是绝对分数，而是跨任务累积后是否真有持续收益，以及 Hacker/Oracle 信号是否带来稳定改进。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学、清华大学等。工作更接近代码智能体系统设计，而非基础模型训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the statelessness of competitive-programming agents, aiming to accumulate experience across tasks without updating the underlying LLM weights.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent systems paper. Its main contribution is explicit experience accumulation through graph-structured knowledge networks and a closed-loop evolution pipeline, not foundation-model training. For pretraining researchers, the value is limited but it is a useful example of non-parametric memory replacing weight updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: Solvita decomposes problem solving into four specialized agents—Planner, Solver, Oracle, and Hacker—forming a loop of strategy selection, code synthesis, certified supervision, and targeted hacking. Each agent is paired with a trainable graph-structured knowledge network, and outcome signals such as pass/fail, test quality, and adversarial vulnerabilities are converted into reinforcement-like updates to the external knowledge structure rather than the base model weights.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or gains, but the evaluation likely compares against static multi-agent systems, retrieval-based methods, and single-shot coding baselines on competitive programming benchmarks. The key question is not absolute score but whether cross-task accumulation yields durable gains and whether the Oracle/Hacker signals improve robustness.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Nanjing University, Tsinghua University, and others. The work is much closer to coding-agent system design than to foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: 这是把“经验写进外部图记忆”而不是权重里的代码 agent 方案；对 pretrain 不是主线，只需看系统闭环和失败信号设计，别把分数提升当成可迁移结论。
recommendation.en: This is a coding-agent design that stores experience in external graph memory instead of weights; not core pretraining material—just inspect the loop and feedback signals, and ignore headline gains.

paper.title: SWE-Chain: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Chained Release-Level Package Upgrades
paper.abstract: Coding agents powered by large language models are increasingly expected to perform realistic software maintenance tasks beyond isolated issue resolution. Existing benchmarks have shifted toward realistic software evolution, but they rarely capture continuous maintenance at the granularity of package releases, where changes are bundled, shipped, and inherited by subsequent versions. We present SWE-Chain, a benchmark for evaluating agents on chained release-level package upgrades, where each tran

summary.core_problem: SWE-Chain 评测的是 coding agent 能否沿着真实软件包的连续 release 进行维护升级，并把自己上一轮修改后的代码库作为下一轮起点，而不是只解决一个孤立 issue 或单个版本迁移任务。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身影响有限，但对代码模型和 agent 评测有参考价值。它把软件工程评测从单点 patch 推向长程维护轨迹，能更好暴露代码 agent 的状态累积、回归错误和功能保持能力。对代码预训练和 posttrain 数据构造的启发是：训练样本不应只覆盖 isolated fix，也需要覆盖 release note、diff、测试失败和跨版本约束共同定义的维护任务。
summary.technical_approach: SWE-Chain 的核心是 release-level chained evaluation。每个任务链由真实 PyPI 或 GitHub 软件包的连续版本组成。系统收集 release notes、issues、PRs、代码 diff 和测试 diff，并为每条链手工准备 Docker 环境，固定 Python 解释器和跨版本依赖，同时允许其他依赖按对应 release 解析。为了构造更干净的升级规格，论文提出 DecompSynth：先把 maintainer-authored release notes 分解为原始任务，再用相邻版本之间的 gold code diff 和 test diff 对齐，合成 grounded upgrade specification。相比直接拼接 release notes、issue 和 PR，DecompSynth 减少了终端日志、复现片段、图片引用等噪声，也避免了完全手写规格的成本。评测时，agent 在版本 i-1 的代码基础上完成版本 i 的升级；完成后的 agent codebase 会继续作为下一次升级起点，因此早期错误会自然传递到后续版本。
summary.experiments: SWE-Chain 包含 12 条升级链，覆盖 9 个软件包、155 个版本迁移和 1,660 个 grounded tasks。环境构建阶段会做 sanity check，要求每个版本在对应测试套件上无 setup error，且失败测试比例低于 0.25%。升级相关测试通过在旧 gold codebase 和新 gold codebase 上运行新版本测试套件识别，包含 FAIL_TO_PASS 和 ERROR_TO_PASS 两类。论文评测了 9 个前沿 model-agent 配置。在 Build+Fix 设置下，即允许一次针对执行级错误的修复尝试，平均 resolving rate 为 44.8%，precision 为 65.4%，F1 为 50.2%。结果说明当前 agent 可以完成一部分 release-level 升级，但在连续维护中保持既有功能仍然不稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25-35 分钟。重点看 benchmark construction 和 evaluation protocol。具体应看三处：DecompSynth 如何把 release notes 与 gold diff 对齐；cross-version validation 如何定义可执行环境和升级相关测试；chain-level evaluation 如何把上一轮 agent 输出传到下一轮。若关注代码模型训练数据，可重点看任务规格合成流程，因为它提供了一种从真实版本历史中抽取长程软件维护样本的方法。

summary_en.core_problem: SWE-Chain evaluates whether coding agents can maintain a real package across consecutive releases, where the codebase produced by the agent at one release becomes the starting point for the next. This is harder than isolated issue resolution because mistakes can accumulate across the chain.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to coding-agent evaluation than to core language-model pretraining. Still, it gives a useful signal for code-model training and post-training: realistic software work is not just a single patch against a fixed repository state. Release-level maintenance requires understanding release notes, preserving existing behavior, handling tests, and carrying changes forward across versions. This suggests that training data for coding agents should include chained maintenance trajectories, not only isolated bug fixes.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Chain builds chained release-level tasks from real packages on PyPI or GitHub. For each package chain, the authors collect released versions, maintainer-written release notes, GitHub issues and PRs, code diffs, and test diffs. They manually create a Docker environment per chain, pinning the Python interpreter and cross-version dependencies while allowing release-specific dependencies to resolve normally. The specification-generation component, DecompSynth, decomposes release notes into raw tasks and aligns them with behavioral evidence from gold code and test diffs. This produces cleaner upgrade specifications than simply concatenating release notes, issues, and PRs, which often include terminal dumps, reproduction snippets, and irrelevant artifacts. During evaluation, the agent upgrades from version i-1 to version i, and its resulting codebase is reused as the base for the next transition.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 12 upgrade chains across 9 packages, with 155 version transitions and 1,660 grounded tasks. Before validation, each version must run without setup errors and have fewer than 0.25% failed tests on its corresponding test suite. Upgrade-related tests are selected by running the new version’s test suite on both old and new gold codebases, including FAIL_TO_PASS and ERROR_TO_PASS cases. The authors evaluate 9 frontier model-agent configurations. Under the Build+Fix regime, which allows one additional fix attempt for execution-level failures, the average resolving rate is 44.8%, precision is 65.4%, and F1 is 50.2%. The results indicate that current agents can solve part of the chained upgrade workload but still struggle to preserve functionality over long maintenance trajectories.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25-35 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction and evaluation protocol. The most useful parts are the DecompSynth pipeline, the release-note-to-diff alignment, the cross-version validation procedure, and the chain-level protocol that passes the agent’s own codebase to the next transition. For code-model training research, the specification-synthesis process is the most reusable component because it shows how to extract long-horizon maintenance data from real version histories.

recommendation.zh: 比单 issue benchmark 更接近真实代码维护；读数据构造 pipeline，结果可用于设计 code RL 任务。
recommendation.en: Closer to real maintenance than single-issue benchmarks; read the data-construction pipeline and reuse the task shape for code RL design.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: GEAR: Genetic AutoResearch for Agentic Code Evolution
paper.abstract: Autonomous research agents can already run machine learning experiments without human supervision, but many rely on a narrow search strategy: they repeatedly modify one program and keep changes only when they improve the current best result. This can cause them to discard useful partial ideas, alternative promising directions, and insights from failed or incomplete experiments. GEAR, or Genetic AutoResearch, replaces this single-path search with a population-based search over multiple research s

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是 autonomous research agent 的外层搜索过早收敛问题：单一 incumbent hill climbing 会丢掉未立即提升指标、但可能在后续组合中有用的实验分支。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和预训练的关系不是模型结构或训练目标，而是训练研究流程自动化。它的启发点在于：当 LLM agent 被用于搜索训练代码、优化器设置、数据处理或小模型 recipe 时，外层搜索策略会显著影响发现质量。单一路径迭代容易把研究过程压缩成局部贪心；population frontier 能保留多个候选方向，适合探索非单调、可组合的训练改动。当前实验任务较小，评价目标是 GPT-2-style language model 的 validation bits-per-byte，因此更像 agentic research infrastructure 的方法验证。
summary.technical_approach: GEAR 把 AutoResearch 中的 keep-or-discard loop 替换为 population-based frontier search。系统维护一个有界 elite population，每个节点保存代码修改、指标、父节点、mutation 类型、尝试过的方向、扩展次数、改进幅度等元信息。扩展方式有两类：artifact mutation 从一个父节点提出局部代码改动；semantic crossover 从两个父节点中合成子节点，组合互补思路。论文实现了三个层次的控制器：GEAR-Prompt 依赖自然语言提示让 agent 管理 population；GEAR-Fixed 用固定程序实现 parent selection、promotion 和 bookkeeping；GEAR-Evolve 允许 agent 在日志和可复现约束下修改 controller 代码。核心区别不在底层训练环境，而在外层搜索状态的表示和更新规则。
summary.experiments: 实验沿用 AutoResearch 设置：单个可编辑训练文件，目标是训练 GPT-2-style language model 并最小化 validation bits-per-byte；每次实验固定 5 分钟 NVIDIA H100 预算；数据 pipeline、tokenizer 和 evaluator harness 保持一致；agent 使用 Claude Opus 4.7。作者报告三种 GEAR 变体均优于 AutoResearch baseline，并呈现更长时间的持续改进。baseline 较快进入局部平台期，GEAR 通过保留 elite frontier、复用部分成功分支和 crossover 继续产生改进。给出的全文片段没有包含具体 bpb 数字或方差，阅读时应重点核对曲线、随机种子数量和失败实验的计入方式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读第 3.2 节的 frontier search 定义、第 3.3 节的三个 GEAR 变体，以及第 4 节的学习曲线和消融。预计 15–25 分钟。重点看 parent selection 的 composite score 如何平衡当前性能、novelty 和 parent productivity；promotion 规则是否会导致 population 退化；semantic crossover 是否真的组合了独立有效的改动，还是主要依赖 LLM 重新生成代码。若关注 LLM 预训练自动化，可以把它映射到 recipe search、数据配比搜索和优化器改动搜索，但不要直接外推到大规模训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets premature convergence in autonomous research agents: a single-incumbent hill-climbing loop discards experimental branches that do not immediately improve the metric but may contain useful ideas for later recombination.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but concrete. It studies the outer-loop search policy used when LLM agents modify training code, run experiments, and decide what to try next. For recipe search, optimizer tweaks, data-pipeline changes, or small-model pretraining experiments, the search controller can determine whether useful non-monotonic directions survive long enough to be combined. The current benchmark is small, based on GPT-2-style language modeling and validation bits-per-byte, so the contribution is best read as agentic research infrastructure rather than a language-modeling method.
summary_en.technical_approach: GEAR replaces AutoResearch's keep-or-discard loop with a population-based frontier over research states. Each node stores a code edit, measured metrics, parentage, mutation type, descriptions of what was attempted, expansion count, improvement statistics, and other metadata about how productive it has been as a source of children. The frontier is expanded through two mechanisms: artifact mutation, which proposes a local edit from one parent, and semantic crossover, which synthesizes a child by combining ideas from two parents. The paper studies three implementations: GEAR-Prompt, where population management is expressed through natural-language instructions; GEAR-Fixed, where parent selection, promotion, and bookkeeping are handled by a fixed programmatic controller; and GEAR-Evolve, where the agent can also edit the controller code under logging and reproducibility constraints. The training environment is kept fixed; the main change is the representation and update rule of the search state.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation follows the AutoResearch setup. The environment exposes a single editable training file. The goal is to train a GPT-2-style language model and minimize validation bits-per-byte. Each trial gets five minutes on an NVIDIA H100, while the data pipeline, tokenizer, and evaluator remain unchanged. The agent is Claude Opus 4.7. The paper reports that all three GEAR variants outperform the AutoResearch baseline and keep improving over a longer horizon, whereas the baseline reaches a local plateau earlier. The supplied text does not include exact bpb values or uncertainty estimates, so the key evidence to check is the trajectory plot, number of runs or seeds, and whether failed or invalid experiments are included in the budget.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3.2 for the frontier-search formulation, Section 3.3 for the three GEAR variants, and Section 4 for learning curves and ablations. A focused read should take about 15–25 minutes. Pay attention to how the composite parent-selection score balances current metric value, novelty, and parent productivity; whether the promotion rule preserves diversity; and whether semantic crossover genuinely combines independent useful edits or mostly triggers fresh code generation. For pretraining work, the natural mapping is recipe search, data-mixture search, and optimizer or training-loop modification, but the small-scale setting should not be overgeneralized.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和消融：它把失败实验变成可遗传状态，若结果干净，可用于内部自动 ablation 系统。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations: turning failed runs into inheritable states is directly relevant to building internal automated ablation systems.

paper.title: Articraft: An Agentic System for Scalable Articulated 3D Asset Generation
paper.abstract: A bottleneck in learning to understand articulated 3D objects is the lack of large and diverse datasets. In this paper, we propose to leverage large language models (LLMs) to close this gap and generate articulated assets at scale. We reduce the problem of generating an articulated 3D asset to that of writing a program that builds it. We then introduce a new agentic system, Articraft, that writes such programs automatically. We design a programmatic interface and harness to help the LLM do so ef

summary.core_problem: 铰接式3D物体数据集规模小、多样性不足，限制3D理解模型性能，人工构建数据集成本高、扩展性差
summary.importance: 系统创新，提出首个基于LLM的铰接式3D资产规模化生成Agent系统，通过程序式生成解决3D训练数据瓶颈
summary.technical_approach: 将3D资产生成问题转化为程序编写问题，设计Articraft Agent系统，提供领域专用SDK用于定义部件、几何、关节和验证测试，通过受限工作空间和结构化错误反馈引导LLM生成有效程序
summary.experiments: 生成的3D资产质量优于现有SOTA基线，摘要未给出具体量化指标及所用LLM的参数规模
summary.authors_note: 剑桥大学、牛津大学、南洋理工大学，Andrea Vedaldi为牛津大学知名计算机视觉研究者

summary_en.core_problem: Small, low-diversity articulated 3D object datasets limit performance of 3D understanding models, while manual dataset construction is costly and hard to scale
summary_en.importance: System innovation: the first LLM-based agent system for scalable articulated 3D asset generation, resolving 3D training data bottlenecks via programmatic synthesis
summary_en.technical_approach: Frames 3D asset generation as a programming problem, designs Articraft agent system with a domain-specific SDK for defining parts, geometry, joints and validation tests, guides LLM via restricted workspace and structured error feedback
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms existing SOTA baselines in 3D asset quality; no explicit quantitative metrics or LLM parameter size disclosed in abstract
summary_en.authors_note: University of Cambridge, University of Oxford, Nanyang Technological University; Andrea Vedaldi is a well-known computer vision researcher at the University of Oxford

recommendation.zh: 基于LLM程序合成的3D资产生成Agent，做代码Agent或多模态数据合成可参考系统设计，不用精读
recommendation.en: LLM program synthesis agent for 3D asset generation, reference system design only if working on code agents or multimodal data synthesis

paper.title: Do Coding Agents Understand Least-Privilege Authorization?
paper.abstract: As coding agents gain access to shells, repositories, and user files, least-privilege authorization becomes a prerequisite for safe deployment: an agent should receive enough authority to complete the task, without unnecessary authority that exposes sensitive surfaces.To study whether current models can infer this boundary themselves, we first introduce permission-boundary inference, where a model maps a task instruction and terminal environment to a file-level read/write/execute policy, and Aut

summary.core_problem: 编码Agent在获得shell/仓库/文件访问权限时，能否推断出最小权限授权边界——即只获得完成任务所需的权限，而不授予可能暴露敏感面的多余权限。
summary.importance: 首次提出permission-boundary inference任务和AuthBench基准（120个真实终端任务，含人工标注权限标签和可执行验证器），揭示了前沿模型在授权推断上的系统性缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 定义权限边界推断为将任务指令和终端环境映射到文件级读/写/执行策略的任务；构建AuthBench基准，通过人工标注权限标签和可执行验证器评估模型在utility和attack两个维度的表现。
summary.experiments: 在AuthBench上测试了GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet等前沿模型，发现模型常遗漏执行链所需权限同时授予未使用或敏感访问权限；增加推理时推理并不能解决此不匹配，每个模型倾向于收敛到自身特有的授权偏差。
summary.authors_note: Evolvent AI Research Team出品

summary_en.core_problem: Whether coding agents can infer least-privilege authorization boundaries when given access to shells, repos, and user files — granting only necessary permissions without exposing sensitive surfaces.
summary_en.importance: First formalization of permission-boundary inference as a task and introduction of AuthBench benchmark (120 realistic terminal tasks with human-reviewed permission labels and executable validators), revealing systematic authorization flaws in frontier models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines permission-boundary inference as mapping task instructions and terminal environments to file-level read/write/execute policies; constructs AuthBench with human-annotated permission labels and executable validators for evaluating utility and attack outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: Frontier models including GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet tested on AuthBench. Models systematically omit required permissions in the execution chain while also granting unused or sensitive access. Increased inference-time reasoning does not resolve this mismatch — each model converges to a model-specific authorization bias.
summary_en.authors_note: Evolvent AI Research Team

recommendation.zh: 编码Agent安全的基准工作，揭示了权限推断的系统性缺陷，对Agent安全部署有参考价值，非LLM预训练方向，快速浏览摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Coding agent safety benchmark revealing systematic authorization inference flaws. Relevant for agent safety deployment, not LLM pretraining. Quick abstract scan suffices.

paper.title: EGSS: Entropy-guided Stepwise Scaling for Reliable Software Engineering
paper.abstract: Agentic Test-Time Scaling (TTS) has delivered state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on complex software engineering tasks such as code generation and bug fixing. However, its practical adoption remains limited due to significant computational overhead, primarily driven by two key challenges: (1) the high cost associated with deploying excessively large ensembles, and (2) the lack of a reliable mechanism for selecting the optimal candidate solution, ultimately constraining the performance gains tha

summary.core_problem: 现有测试时缩放（TTS）方法在软件工程Agent任务中存在计算冗余高、探索效率低、候选补丁筛选不可靠的问题：均匀采样和静态引导导致算力分配不合理，低熵常规步骤占用过多资源，高熵决策点探索不足；仅靠最终测试结果排序的筛选机制容易忽略中间调试信号，选出仅通过局部检查、未解决根本问题的脆弱补丁。
summary.importance: 为代码领域LLM的推理时算力优化提供了可落地的思路，熵引导的动态资源分配逻辑可以迁移到其他长程推理Agent的测试时缩放框架设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出熵引导分步缩放（EGSS）框架，包含两个核心设计：1）用工具熵量化每一步的决策不确定性，仅在高熵决策点调用辅助判别器实时评估、剪枝分支轨迹，动态将推理预算分配给探索价值最高的步骤；2）融合多Agent轨迹的调试信号、仓库原有回归测试、新增边缘用例构造多维测试集，结合多模型集成投票筛选可靠候选补丁。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-Bench-Verified基准上，EGSS将所有测试模型的性能提升5-10%，在开源方法中达到最优表现，同时推理时token消耗比此前的TTS方法降低28%；实证分析显示88%的任务轨迹包含自验证步骤，但其中35.7%的自验证轨迹仍然失败，工具熵呈右偏分布，绝大多数步骤为低熵常规操作，验证了自适应算力分配的合理性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction部分的问题分析、Figure1的算力-性能 trade-off 图、Preliminary章节的工具熵分布实证分析，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Test-Time Scaling (TTS) methods for software engineering agent tasks suffer from high computational redundancy, low exploration efficiency, and unreliable candidate patch selection. Uniform sampling and static guidance lead to suboptimal compute allocation: low-entropy routine steps consume excessive resources while high-entropy decision points get insufficient exploration. Ranking mechanisms based only on final test results tend to ignore intermediate debugging signals, and select brittle patches that pass local checks without addressing root causes.
summary_en.importance: It provides an implementable approach for inference-time compute optimization of code-domain LLMs, and the entropy-guided dynamic resource allocation logic can be migrated to TTS framework design for other long-horizon reasoning agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Entropy-Guided Stepwise Scaling (EGSS) framework with two core designs: 1) Quantify step-level decision uncertainty with tool entropy, only invoke auxiliary judges at high-entropy decision points for real-time evaluation and trajectory pruning, dynamically allocating inference budget to steps with highest exploration value; 2) Construct a multi-dimensional test suite by integrating debugging signals from multiple agent trajectories, existing repository regression tests, and newly identified edge cases, combined with multi-model ensemble voting to select reliable candidate patches.
summary_en.experiments: On the SWE-Bench-Verified benchmark, EGSS improves performance of all evaluated models by 5-10%, achieves the best performance among open-source methods, and reduces inference token consumption by 28% compared to prior TTS approaches. Empirical analysis shows 88% of task trajectories include self-verification steps, but 35.7% of these still fail. Tool entropy follows a right-skewed distribution, with most steps being low-entropy routine operations, validating the rationality of adaptive compute allocation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem analysis in Introduction, Figure 1 for compute-performance trade-off, and empirical analysis of tool entropy distribution in Preliminary. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看熵控扩展和测试增强两节；这是干净的 inference-time compute 分配问题，可作为 RLVR 数据筛选的旁证。
recommendation.en: Read only the entropy-controlled scaling and test-augmentation sections; it is a clean inference-time compute allocation signal, useful as weak evidence for RLVR-style data selection.

paper.title: AI Harness Engineering: A Runtime Substrate for Foundation-Model Software Agents
paper.abstract: Foundation models have transformed automated code generation, yet autonomous software-engineering agents remain unreliable in realistic development settings. The dominant explanation locates this gap in model capability. We propose a different locus: software-engineering capability emerges from a model-harness-environment system, in which a runtime substrate -- the harness -- mediates how a foundation-model agent observes a project, acts on it, receives feedback, and establishes that a change is

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么基础模型在自动代码生成上有进展，但软件工程 agent 在真实项目中仍不稳定，并将问题定位到 model-harness-environment 的运行时系统。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding agent 系统抽象和评测协议，而不是模型训练方法。它把软件工程能力拆成模型能力与 harness 能力的组合，对设计仓库级 agent 评测和诊断有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AI Harness Engineering 概念，定义 harness 作为模型观察项目、调用工具、接收反馈、确认任务完成的运行时基座。它列出 11 类组件职责，包括任务规格、上下文选择、工具访问、项目记忆、任务状态、可观测性、失败归因、验证、权限、熵审计和干预记录，并提出 H0-H3 四级 runtime 支持阶梯和 trace-based evaluation protocol。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述框架和评测协议，未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、基线系统或定量提升结果。更像是概念框架/系统设计论文，而非大规模实证论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Hong Kong Baptist University 和 Beijing Normal University, Zhuhai。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why foundation models can generate code yet remain unreliable as autonomous software-engineering agents in realistic projects, and locates the gap in the model-harness-environment system.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a system abstraction and evaluation protocol for coding agents, not a model-training method. It decomposes software-engineering capability into model capability plus harness capability, which is useful for repository-level agent diagnosis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce AI Harness Engineering, where the harness is the runtime substrate through which the model observes a project, acts, receives feedback, and establishes completion. They define eleven responsibilities—task specification, context selection, tool access, project memory, task state, observability, failure attribution, verification, permissions, entropy auditing, and intervention recording—and propose an H0-H3 ladder of runtime support plus a trace-based evaluation protocol.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mainly presents a framework and protocol. It does not report model sizes, training data, baseline systems, or quantitative improvements, so the work appears closer to a conceptual systems paper than a large empirical study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Hong Kong Baptist University and Beijing Normal University, Zhuhai.

recommendation.zh: 适合扫框架图和 11 个 harness 职责；它不是训练论文，但能帮你避免把 agent 失败全甩给模型。
recommendation.en: Skim the framework and the eleven harness responsibilities; it is not a training paper, but it helps avoid blaming every agent failure on the model.

paper.title: What Parameter Golf taught us about AI-assisted research
paper.abstract: Parameter Golf brought together 1,000+ participants and 2,000+ submissions to explore AI-assisted machine learning research, coding agents, quantization, and novel model design under strict constraints.

summary.core_problem: 总结Parameter Golf竞赛的实践经验，探索严格约束下AI辅助机器学习研究、代码Agent、量化、新型模型设计的可行路径
summary.importance: 属于大规模公开竞赛的经验总结，覆盖AI辅助研究工具、低资源约束模型设计等方向，为后续工具研发提供实践参考
summary.technical_approach: 组织全球范围公开竞赛，吸引1000+参与者、收集2000+提交方案，对不同技术路线的表现与适用性进行归纳分析
summary.experiments: 无传统学术定量评测设置，仅统计参赛规模、技术方向分布与典型方案特征
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research官方博客发布，无具体知名作者披露

summary_en.core_problem: Summarizes practical experience from the Parameter Golf competition, exploring feasible paths for AI-assisted ML research, coding agents, quantization, and novel model design under strict constraints
summary_en.importance: Experience summary of a large-scale public competition, covering AI-assisted research tools, low-resource constrained model design, providing practical reference for subsequent tool development
summary_en.technical_approach: Organized a global public competition with over 1,000 participants and 2,000 submissions, conducted inductive analysis on performance and applicability of different technical routes
summary_en.experiments: No traditional academic quantitative evaluation setup, only statistics of competition scale, technical direction distribution and typical solution features
summary_en.authors_note: Published on OpenAI Research official blog, no specific well-known authors disclosed

recommendation.zh: 仅适合了解AI辅助ML研究的当前实践边界，无预训练方法论贡献，扫一眼核心结论即可
recommendation.en: Only suitable for understanding current practice boundaries of AI-assisted ML research, no pretraining methodological contributions, just skim core conclusions

paper.title: Classifier Context Rot: Monitor Performance Degrades with Context Length
paper.abstract: Monitoring coding agents for dangerous behavior using language models requires classifying transcripts that often exceed 500K tokens, but prior agent monitoring benchmarks rarely contain transcripts longer than 100K tokens. We show that when used as classifiers, current frontier models fail to notice dangerous actions more often in longer transcripts. In particular, on a dataset that requires identifying when a coding agent takes a subtly dangerous action, Opus 4.6, GPT 5.4, and Gemini 3.1 miss

summary.core_problem: 长上下文（>100K，甚至到 800K-1M tokens）下，用大模型做“代理行为监控分类器”时，为什么会系统性漏报危险行为，以及哪些工程化/训练化手段能缓解这种随 prefill 变长而恶化的 recall 崩塌。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发不在“提出新训练目标”，而在于把一个长期被 needle-in-a-haystack 评测粗略覆盖的问题，落到更贴近真实部署的“长代理 transcript 分类”场景：长 prefill 会让分类器式用法的有效信息提取能力显著退化，且退化幅度与危险行为的隐蔽性、出现位置强相关。这对长上下文预训练/中训（mid-train）目标设计、长序列监督信号构造、以及‘长上下文能力=能放进上下文窗口’这种过度乐观的假设都有警示意义。另一个重要点是：简单的 SFT 在长上下文分类上不稳定泛化，提示“长上下文能力”可能更像训练分布与推理策略共同决定的系统性质，而不是少量微调就能补齐的短板。
summary.technical_approach:
论文把监控任务形式化为：输入为包含 user/assistant/tool call/tool result 的完整 transcript，输出为是否存在危险/恶意动作的二分类（并配套不同提示词模板）。核心变量是“长 benign prefill”——将大量无害操作前缀拼接到原本较短、含攻击的 transcript 前，使危险动作在超长上下文的中后段出现，从而测量 recall 随上下文长度与位置变化的退化。

模型侧对比 Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT 5.4 Thinking，并显式控制/扫描“thinking token 预算/模式”（非思考、CoT、扩展思考等），以区分是‘注意力/检索失败’还是‘推理预算不足’。

缓解手段分三类：
1) 提示词与推理策略：更强的思考指令、CoT-List（先逐字列出可疑动作再判定）、增加 thinking tokens。
2) 输入结构干预：在 transcript 中周期性插入“提醒 monitor 任务”的短提示（reminder mitigation），相当于人为制造多个局部锚点，降低模型在长序列中遗忘任务目标或丢失判别特征的概率。
3) 系统级监控策略：不等 session 结束一次性监控，而是对随时间增长的子 transcript 多次增量监控（可带抽样以控成本），用多次判定覆盖“危险动作出现在中段但最终被长 prefill 冲淡”的情况。

训练侧尝试：对 GPT-4.1 做长上下文分类数据的微调，观察是否能把‘长 prefill 下的漏报’通过监督学习补上；结论是对相似任务可提升，但跨任务/分布泛化不可靠，且扩大合成数据规模反而可能带来负效应（提示数据分布与信号质量比数量更关键）。
summary.experiments:
关键现象与数字（文中给出的代表性结果）：
- 在 MonitorBench（隐蔽攻击：例如配置防火墙但暗中为特定 IP 开后门）上，用 Opus 4.6（thinking）做 monitor，recall 在原始较短 transcript 上约 98.6%，在前置 800K benign tokens 后降到约 88%。
- 对“明显攻击”的插入实验：同样的危险动作，插入 100K transcript 时 Opus 4.6 recall 约 99.7%，插入 800K transcript 时降到约 69%，说明问题不只是‘攻击太隐蔽’，而是长上下文下连显著信号也会被错过。
- 缓解实验：增加 thinking、改提示词、插入 reminders、以及增量监控策略在部分设置下能显著抬升 recall（论文强调‘显著但不稳定’，不同模型/任务差异大）。
- 训练缓解：对 GPT-4.1 的长上下文 SFT 在“与训练分布高度相似”的测试上提升明显，但对不相似任务提升弱且不稳定；扩展数据生成规模出现负面结果，暗示合成数据的覆盖与噪声会主导效果。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
- 先看引言与 Figure 1，把“长 prefill 导致 recall 退化”的量级直觉建立起来。
- 重点看 4.1–4.4：危险动作位置（中段/末段）、隐蔽性、上下文长度对 recall 的交互效应，这是论文最硬的结论。
- 再看 4.6：reminder mitigation 与增量监控策略，属于能直接迁移到工程系统的做法，也能反推预训练应如何构造长序列监督。
- 最后快速扫 Section 5：长上下文 SFT 的泛化失败模式；建议带着“训练分布相似性/信号密度/长序列 credit assignment”这三个问题去读。

summary_en.core_problem: Why LLMs used as transcript-level safety monitors miss dangerous actions more often as the transcript prefill grows to hundreds of thousands of tokens, and which practical mitigations (prompting, input structuring, incremental monitoring, fine-tuning) actually help under realistic long-agent-session conditions.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining objective paper, but it nails a deployment-relevant failure mode of long-context models in a classification setting: recall degrades sharply with long benign prefills, even for obvious attacks, and the degradation depends on attack subtlety and position in the sequence. For pretraining researchers, it reframes “long context capability” as more than context-window size: it is about robust information extraction and task persistence under extreme prefills. The mixed results from long-context SFT also suggest that patching long-context failures may require distribution-aware mid-training and better long-sequence supervision design, not just small fine-tunes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They evaluate LLM-based monitors that take full agent transcripts (user/assistant/tool calls/results) and output a danger label. The main experimental knob is adding massive benign prefixes (up to ~800K tokens) so the malicious action occurs deep inside the context, then measuring recall drop.

Models: Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT 5.4 Thinking, with explicit sweeps over “thinking” modes/budgets and prompt variants (standard CoT, a ‘list suspicious actions verbatim first’ variant, and GPT-specific prompt adjustments to control false positives).

Mitigations are tested at three levels:
1) Inference/prompting: stronger reasoning instructions, more thinking tokens, structured CoT that forces evidence listing.
2) Input interventions: periodic reminders inserted throughout the transcript to keep the classifier anchored to the monitoring task.
3) System strategy: incremental monitoring over growing sub-transcripts (optionally subsampled for cost) instead of a single end-of-session call.

They also try a training mitigation: supervised fine-tuning GPT-4.1 on long-context classification data, and check whether improvements generalize beyond near-identical tasks.
summary_en.experiments:
Representative results reported in the paper:
- On MonitorBench-style subtle sabotage (e.g., covertly weakening a firewall), Opus 4.6 (thinking) recall drops from ~98.6% to ~88% when ~800K benign tokens are prepended.
- For blatantly dangerous actions inserted into long transcripts, Opus 4.6 recall drops from ~99.7% when inserted into a ~100K transcript to ~69% when inserted into an ~800K transcript.
- Prompting and reminder-based mitigations can materially improve recall in some settings; incremental monitoring also helps by reducing reliance on a single ultra-long prefill.
- Long-context SFT on GPT-4.1 shows strong gains on very similar tasks but weak/unreliable transfer to less similar ones; scaling synthetic data generation can even hurt, pointing to distribution/label-signal issues rather than pure data scarcity.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 min):
- Start with the intro + Figure 1 to calibrate the magnitude of recall collapse.
- Focus on Sections 4.1–4.4 for the core interaction effects (context length × attack subtlety × position).
- Read Section 4.6 for the most actionable mitigations (reminders, incremental monitoring) and to infer what kinds of long-sequence supervision might be missing in pretraining.
- Skim Section 5 to understand why long-context fine-tuning does not reliably generalize; read it with an eye on distribution similarity and long-horizon credit assignment.

recommendation.zh: 看实验设计和长短上下文对照；它提醒长上下文 benchmark 的 pass 不等于监控能力可用。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and short-vs-long comparison; it shows that passing long-context benchmarks does not imply usable monitoring reliability.

paper.title: Building a safe, effective sandbox to enable Codex on Windows
paper.abstract: Learn how OpenAI built a secure sandbox for Codex on Windows, enabling safe, efficient coding agents with controlled file access and network restrictions.

summary.core_problem: 介绍 OpenAI 如何为 Windows 上的 Codex 构建安全 sandbox，使 coding agent 能在受控文件访问和网络限制下执行代码与编辑任务。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding agent 的安全执行环境和产品工程经验。它不涉及预训练方法，但对理解代码 agent 从模型能力走向可执行系统时的边界控制、权限隔离和风险面有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心做法是为 Codex on Windows 设计受限 sandbox，控制文件系统访问、网络能力和执行权限，让 agent 能完成代码相关操作，同时降低越权访问、数据泄露和不受控副作用的风险。摘要未给出具体内核隔离机制或完整安全模型细节。
summary.experiments: 这是 OpenAI Research 博客，不是标准实验论文；摘要未报告模型参数、训练数据、benchmark 分数或消融实验。评估重点应是安全策略覆盖面、对 Codex 工作流的兼容性和运行开销。
